chapters.title: Chapter 101: Ascending the City Tower Alone
paragraphs: The soldier was a player.
Upon hearing this, his eyes darted, and he immediately said:

"The general only needs to hold on for a while. I believe Marquis Wenn and the Prime Minister will certainly lead the main forces here. By then, Ding Ling and Zhao Yun will have no way to escape, certain to die."
He pointed downward, saying:
"You must know they are merely two people."
’But even if I hold them off, I won’t be able to sit still in this position.’
Yang Ding’s face looked grim as he recalled how he had just ordered a return shot, causing one soldier, in a panic, to nearly shoot Dong Huang dead.
He was scared out of his wits!
If Dong Huang really died, he wouldn’t be able to clear his name even if he jumped into the Yellow River.
But even though Dong Huang wasn’t shot dead.
Dong Huang’s arrow wound was an undeniable fact, and coupled with several times Dong Huang ignored his orders before, Dong Huang bore a grudge against him, almost certain to settle accounts later.
Thinking of this.
Yang Ding was filled with regret, regretting coming to Yique City to take charge!
Bang!
Another loud noise, a sword shield soldier flew out sideways, thud! He fell heavily not far from Yang Ding.
Yang Ding snapped back to reality, looked at Ding Ling, and saw that several of his horses had quite a few quivers, each seemingly filled with arrows.
Ding Ling finishes one quiver and then uses another.
When he finishes all his quivers.
Won’t all his defending soldiers be dead?!
"Hide, take cover!"
Yang Ding roared.
He also swiftly hid behind the side of the city wall, no longer letting shield soldiers protect him.
The shield soldiers felt as if they were granted amnesty.
One by one, they threw away their shields and hid behind cover.
Afraid they would be too slow and follow their comrades’ footsteps.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You’ve intimidated Yang Ding’s defense army!]
[Note: Under the sharpness of your heavy arrows! No one can escape unharmed! In just a short moment. The defense army suffered heavy casualties.
Their awe of you reached its peak at this moment!
They are terrified, trembling in fear, not daring to retaliate, let alone show themselves to face the arrows you released at any given moment!]
Another achievement medal.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow slightly.
Thoughts:
’It seems these days a player can only single-handedly deal with famous figures and generals. Not many players seem to be able to take on entire troops?’
Ding Ling pondered.
But soon.
He snapped back.
Jumped off his horse.
One hand held a halberd, the other the Shuoyue Sword, and he swiftly charged toward the direction of the city.
Dong Huang looked dazed, very puzzled:
"What is he doing?"
Zhao Yun intended to help, but seeing the city wall as high as three to four zhang, he could only sigh in exasperation.
With such height, he couldn’t possibly leap over it.
Da-da!

Ding Ling activated the Breathing Technique to boost himself, fully utilizing the Wall-Climbing Technique, light as a flying swallow, he leaped several meters in the air with a few steps, reaching the base of the city wall.
At this moment, including Yang Ding, everyone hid on one side of the city wall, not daring to show their heads.
So the majority had no idea Ding Ling had already dismounted.
Yet a few players, always keeping an eye on Ding Ling, were shocked to see him brazenly daring to charge the city gate alone and couldn’t help but shout:
"Ding Ling is coming!"
"What?"
Yang Ding snapped back, holding a long spear, peeking at the city below, indeed not seeing Ding Ling, causing his heart to race.
He swiftly commanded the sword shield soldiers to rise and defend.
He too grabbed a shield and quickly went to the front of the city wall, looking down at the city under the players’ guidance.
He saw Ding Ling as light as the wind, and with a clear shout, threw the halberd in his hand!
Bang!
The tip of the halberd pierced deeply into the city wall about two zhang high.
Not waiting for Yang Ding to react.
Whoosh!

Ding Ling kicked off the ground, soared two zhang high, landed on the halberd shaft, then kicked off the halberd again, his body soared another two zhang, resembling a true dragon soaring to the heavens, a Spiritual Phoenix landing gracefully, and landed dominantly on top of the city wall.
Yang Ding was dumbfounded.
All the defending army who saw this were utterly speechless!
"Boom!"
Ding Ling activated the Sword God Skill, drew his sword, clang!
And directly plunged into Yang Ding’s defense army.
Sunset Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Resembling a Xun Wind sweeping across, an autumn wind scattering fallen leaves.
Wherever Ding Ling went, severed limbs, a storm of blood!
The screams were endless, shaking the heavens and the earth!
Not a single person could match Ding Ling’s strength in a single exchange!
Often where the sword flower flashed, three to five necks would be severed simultaneously!
Or when the Setting Sun Diagram flashed in the air, four to five soldiers could be clearly seen getting their eyes gouged, heads pierced.
The sharpness of a single person’s sword!
It was as if a thousand troops were charging!
Causing a profound sense of fear, terror, and soul-crushing dread!
Yang Ding’s hair stood up in terror.
For the first time, he realized the true gap between himself and a Super-Elite expert.
He had no doubt that if he tried to confront Ding Ling, he might not survive even a single move before being killed instantly!
He didn’t want to die!
Yang Ding turned and ran.
This was a humiliation for him!
Since becoming a general, he had never been this embarrassed, miserable, pitiful, or helpless!
But today, at this moment, he experienced it all.
Yang Ding even began to regret not opening the city gates to let Ding Ling pass!
If only Ding Ling had passed, none of this would have happened!
But now it was too late to say anything.
Whoosh!
Clang!
Ding Ling’s sword moved with him.

High agility, great strength, and high endurance combined with the mastery of the Sword God Skill, Ding Ling resembled a Sword God descending into the Mortal World! One man, one sword, slaying enemies like scattering flowers, causing a chaotic retreat.
The soldiers brave enough to confront Ding Ling perished!
The rest were running.
Including the players.
However, Ding Ling remembered the player whispering with Yang Ding, instinctively sensing that this player might know some secret.
He wanted to catch him, but as soon as the player saw Ding Ling coming, without thinking, he slipped into the crowd like a mudfish and vanished.
Ding Ling missed the opportunity.
He no longer cared about it, instead focusing on Yang Ding.
Yang Ding stood out too much.
Dressed in General Armor, imposing and majestic, even while running, he stood out among the crowd!
Ding Ling activated the Wall-Climbing Technique, a few fleet-footed steps across the void tens of meters, bang!
He landed right in front of Yang Ding, thrusting a sword at him.
Yang Ding’s expression changed dramatically, without thinking activated the Breathing Technique, and used his family’s supreme skill.
Yang Family Spear Technique!
Bang!
Gunflowers bloomed in the air, transforming into rotating blades aimed at Ding Ling’s throat.
Ding Ling’s wrist flicked, the Shuoyue Sword swept, the Setting Sun Diagram flashed through the void, clang clang clang! Intense clashing sounds tore through the sky, the next moment!
Poof!
Yang Ding’s right arm was severed, the spear in his hand dropped to the ground, Ding Ling kicked it up, grabbed it, and with a reverse thrust.
Poof!
It pierced through a few charging soldiers.
Then he swung his sword again at Yang Ding.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: The Court Officer’s Letter (7/50)
paragraphs: Clang!
The sword blade landed on Yang Ding’s neck.
Ding Ling did not slash further down.
Yang Ding waited for a moment, seeing that he wasn’t dead, he couldn’t help but widen his eyes at Ding Ling:
"Kill me if you want, the decision is yours!"
"I can let you live."
Ding Ling said.
Yang Ding’s eyebrows twitched, he glanced at his broken right arm, and let out a bitter laugh:
"What meaning is there in living like this?"
"Your left hand is still intact."
"What do you want from me?"
Yang Ding, knowing there’s no free lunch in this world, asked straightforwardly.
Ding Ling’s long spear trembled again, and faintly a wolf’s howl could be heard, boom!
The long spear pierced straight through a Sword Shield Soldier’s shield, stabbing through his chest!
"This, this, this..."

The Sword Shield Soldier originally wanted to rescue Yang Ding, ambushing Ding Ling, but never imagined he’d encounter such a spear attack, he died with regrets, yet recalling that world-shattering, earth-quaking, godlike spear technique, he couldn’t help but utter a murmur of astonishment, somewhat self-speaking, somewhat sighing:
"What a fine spear technique!"
To die under such a spear technique, they could rest in peace.
The light in the Sword Shield Soldier’s eyes dimmed.
And such a spear technique.
Startled some soldiers who initially wanted to ambush, causing them to retreat and shrink back.
Some clever ones, afraid of death, took the opportunity, taking off their armor, blending into the city, escaping swiftly.
"Howling Moon Spear Technique!"
Yang Ding was shocked:
"Are you of the imperial family?!"
"I’m not."
"You’re not of the imperial family yet you’ve trained the Howling Moon Spear Technique to mastery? How’s that possible?!"
Yang Ding didn’t believe it.
Ding Ling didn’t explain further, simply said:
"If you teach me your Yang Family Spear Technique, I can spare your life."
"Absolutely impossible!"
Yang Ding answered firmly, resolutely:
"The family tradition supreme skill cannot be passed on! Or else how could I face my parents and elders? Even in the underworld, I wouldn’t have the face or qualification to meet the ancestors!"
"But you might die."
"Even if I escape this calamity, I won’t live long."
Yang Ding seemed to have accepted his fate, smiling calmly, looking towards the northwest:
"It’s just a pity I didn’t die in my homeland."
Thunk!
He suddenly turned his head and collided with Ding Ling’s sword.
Ding Ling was caught off guard, only managing to slightly step back, but it was already too late.
The Shuoyue Sword was incredibly sharp.
Yang Ding thrust himself unexpectedly and forcefully, and the blade sliced across his neck.
His neck snapped, with blood gushing out, he looked at Ding Ling as if wanting to say something, but after a few blood bubbles gurgled from his mouth, his head drooped lifelessly.
"General!"
A soldier mournfully charged at Ding Ling:
"I’ll fight you to the death!"
Clang!
Ding Ling’s long spear trembled, spear flowers blossomed, and more than ten charging soldiers quickly fell in pools of blood.
"Alas."
For the first time, Ding Ling felt no joy in killing the enemy.
He sighed.
Glanced at the long spear in his hand, casually tossed it, and the spear planted straight beside Yang Ding.
Let this Yang Family Spear accompany Yang Ding.
Ding Ling held the Shuoyue Sword, activated the Breathing Technique, a sharp aura of the Sword God shot straight into the sky, making people dare not look directly, dare not approach.
Yang Ding may have won the hearts of people.
But once the soldiers truly willing to die for him were slain.
The rest scattered in all directions;
Or cowered and hid on the side, not daring to approach Ding Ling at all.
Ding Ling didn’t intend to kill these soldiers, he just descended from the tower, opened the city gate.
Tap tap tap!
Zhao Yun rode in.
Behind him followed a few fine horses.
Ding Ling leapt onto a horse, preparing to ride away.
Suddenly remembered something, he went back to the city wall, pulled out the halberd, then went to the tower, and rummaged through Yang Ding’s body to find a letter.
The letter was already stained with blood.
Only some words could be faintly seen.
But the seal at the end was so bright and glaring.
"Court Officer!"
Ding Ling crumpled the letter.
Looked towards Luoyang:
"Is it that rascal Duanmu Qing? To think he’s behind this, plotting against me. Haha."
He laughed coldly:
"If I encounter him in the future, I must kill him every time. I won’t rest until I’ve killed Duanmu Qing to level 0. How can I vent this anger in my heart!"
Originally with Dong Huang by his side.
This dispute wouldn’t have happened!
Yang Ding was prepared to open the city gate.
But it’s this letter from the Court Officer that ruined everything.
At this moment.
Ding Ling had every reason to suspect, his martial arts training with Wang Yue was revealed by Duanmu Qing.
And killing Hu Zhen, toppling Hu Zhen’s Legion, he did everything so secretly, no one should have known.
Hu Feng also said it was a frame-up, looking for a scapegoat!

And the one framing him, Ding Ling initially thought was Li Meng, now it seems it had to be Duanmu Qing behind the scenes, was he the one leaking it to Li Meng, and then having Li Meng inform Hu Feng?
Whatever the truth.
Ding Ling couldn’t know.
But knowing it involves the Court Officer is enough.
And the Court Officer, if Ding Ling remembered correctly, should be that player Duanmu Qing whom he killed!
"Duanmu Qing..."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, stopped thinking about it, turned and descended the tower, heading with Zhao Yun towards the armory in Yique City.
Dong Huang, being very cautious, held his breath, riding at Ding Ling’s side.
He truly didn’t expect Ding Ling to actually succeed in training the Howling Moon Spear Technique!
’And to have reached the Transformation Realm mastery?!’
’Are you sure he didn’t study the Howling Moon Spear Technique before?’
Dong Huang was very skeptical.
Because if Ding Ling really learned it just by flipping through the Secret Manual, that would be too outrageous.
Even the unparalleled genius Lü Bu wasn’t so exaggerated!
He was so shocked, amazed, that he forgot he’d been shot.
As for Yang Ding’s death, Dong Huang felt satisfied!
Even if Ding Ling hadn’t killed Yang Ding.
Dong Huang had resolved, as long as it was safe, he would definitely kill him!
It was intolerable! To dare ignore him Dong Huang! Almost getting him shot! If he could endure this, he wouldn’t be Dong Huang!
"Why go to the armory?"
Zhao Yun asked in confusion.
"I’m looking for a bow."
Ding Ling pointed to the Five-Stone Bow on the side of the horse:
"The Five-Stone Bow is about to break."
Zhao Yun looked and found indeed, the Five-Stone Bow had cracks, thinking it would soon be unusable if used a few more times.
Dong Huang gasped, looking at Ding Ling as if seeing livestock, seeing a Celestial God!
The Five-Stone Bow!
To draw it fully, would require at least six to seven hundred pounds of force!
Such... to be on the verge of breaking.
How much power is that?!
Terrifying beyond measure!
Thinking of Ding Ling drawing the Five-Stone Bow, Dong Huang couldn’t help but grit his teeth.
Zhao Yun was also moved.
If it were him, he definitely couldn’t achieve this.
The three, with seven horses, stormed into the City Guard Office.
Several soldiers saw them and turned to run.
Thinking the battle on the city head, they must have seen it.
Not everyone is willing to risk their lives.
Most people are afraid of death.

Thinking of Ding Ling drawing the Five-Stone Bow, Dong Huang couldn’t help but grit his teeth.
Zhao Yun was also moved.
If it were him, he definitely couldn’t achieve this.
The three, with seven horses, stormed into the City Guard Office.
Several soldiers saw them and turned to run.
Thinking the battle on the city head, they must have seen it.
Not everyone is willing to risk their lives.
Most people are afraid of death.

chapters.title: Chapter 103: The Suspected Divine Bow of Li Guang
paragraphs: Ding Ling didn’t kill them either.
As long as they’re not blocking his way, not trying to kill him.
Ding Ling never thought of killing anyone.
He’s not a Human Demon!
He stopped halfway, intercepting an old soldier to lead the way to the Armory.
The old soldier dared not disobey, meekly agreed, and after leading a few people to the Armory, took the opportunity while Ding Ling and the others went inside to choose weapons and swiftly ran away!
Ding Ling didn’t care, he picked out two large bows in the Armory.
One was a Five-Stone Bow.
One was a Six-Stone Bow!
The Six-Stone Bow had been sealed away for a long time, carrying a sense of historical vicissitude.
The bow’s body was engraved with a character ’Li’.
No one knows which General was the previous owner of this Six-Stone Bow.
But without a doubt.
Only a First-class Fierce General could draw the Six-Stone Bow.
To wield the Six-Stone Bow as a weapon and continue drawing it, that requires a Super-Elite.
"A super-elite fierce general with the surname Li? Could it be Li Guang?"
Ding Ling tried pulling the Six-Stone Bow, and it was indeed a Divine Bow.
Not only does it take immense strength to pull it open.
But also the bow body is made from superior materials.
The bowstring, nobody knows what kind of sinew it’s made from, is extremely durable and elastic!
Truly extraordinary!
"Good bow." Ding Ling praised, questioning:
"How would such a good bow be stored here?"
Dong Huang hurriedly explained:

"After my uncle became Prime Minister, he divided and hid the treasures in Royal Armory and Library. Yique City isn’t far from Luoyang, so part of it is hidden there. Additionally, Yanshi City, Gu City, and other places also stash small portions.
The majority, however, is hidden in Meiwu."
"Why hide it?"
Zhao Yun was puzzled:
"He’s already the Prime Minister! And the entire Si Li Region is controlled by the Dong Family!"
"To prevent the unexpected." Dong Huang chuckled dryly and said:

"The world is in chaos. My uncle also knows the principle of not putting all eggs in one basket. Moreover, I heavily suspect most of the items placed in Meiwu are just a decoy. The true treasures might be hidden elsewhere."
Selling off ancestral property without heartache.
Dong Huang’s current behavior is just like this.
Desperate to survive, he would say anything, dare to say anything.
Seeing his performance, Ding Ling’s heart stirred with ideas.
But now isn’t the time to discuss it, he swiftly began armoring the strongest of the quality horses in heavy platemail.
The previous horse armor was discarded aside.
The heavy platemail in this Armory is of Upper Grade, whether it’s defense, texture, or fit, it crushes Ding Ling’s previous horse armor!
Of course, Ding Ling uses the best.
The reason for using heavy platemail.
Is for charging into battle.
As for the two horses equipped with heavy platemail, Ding Ling doesn’t plan to ride them.
They just follow closely in heavy platemail.
Besides heavy platemail.
Ding Ling also found many quivers in the Armory.
These quivers were designed to carry as much as possible, all placed one by one on the horse’s flank.
Seven horses.
A lot can be carried.
But so as not to affect the speed.
Ding Ling tries to take the lighter items, he abandons anything too heavy.
Those two quality horses in heavy armor, Ding Ling does not allow extra weight on them to prevent them from lagging behind.
Besides bows and arrows.
The Armory holds weapons like spears, swords, shields.
Ding Ling uses none of these.
Nor does Zhao Yun, he has the Divine Weapon Dragon Gall Silver Spear, ordinary long spears simply can’t catch his eye.
However, Ding Ling still selected a sturdy protective leather armor for him to wear, just in case.
Dong Huang is most afraid of death, he donned three layers of armor on himself!
Having been nearly shot to death before left him with severe psychological trauma, despite being clumsy in stature, he still wants to wear more.
He was scolded by Ding Ling, which made him stop.
"If your horse carrying you can’t keep up with us, don’t blame me for being unkind." Ding Ling warned.
Only then did Dong Huang sheepishly take off one layer of heavy armor.
"Let’s go."
Three people and seven horses, fully equipped, left directly.
Clip-clop clop!
The sound of hooves gradually faded into the distance.
Until it was completely inaudible.
Only then did the players, the warriors dare to emerge from hiding around, glancing at each other, speechless.
Shortly after.
This event stirred up Player Plaza, and all over Luoyang.
Making Ding Ling’s reputation soar!
[Ding Ling! The New Age War God!]
[Ding Ling, takes the city gate single-handedly with a sword!]
[Ding Ling, shoots at long range with a bow, injuring hundreds!]
These all rushed into the top ten of the trending charts once!
One could say.
Today’s trending top ten, five were related to Ding Ling!
His fame is evident.
It’s not too much to say he’s the ’King of Traffic’ of the New Age!
Among the players, the response was enthusiastic, with various commentaries and discussions.
All over Luoyang, those receiving the news like Lü Bu, Dong Zhuo were furious!
Each of them expressed determination to capture Ding Ling and Zhao Yun!
Especially Ding Ling, dead or alive doesn’t matter!
When the new orders reached Wei Xu and Song Xian.
They were elated to see instructions indicating no need to consider ’Dong Huang’s life’.
"Is this true?" Wei Xu glanced at the soldier delivering the message.
He couldn’t help doubting.
Let’s not forget Dong Huang is Prime Minister Dong’s own nephew! The leader of the Imperial Guard! How could Prime Minister Dong bear Dong Huang’s death?!
"We can deploy the Divine Archer primarily attacking, you just assist." The soldier replied respectfully:

"Divine Archer General Cao Xing rides a Ferghana Horse, rushing here, by the reckoning he should soon arrive! With him in main attack, you assist from the side, just tread carefully, make sure not to really shoot Dong Huang dead, and it shouldn’t be a big issue."
"Who said that?"
"Marquis Wenn."
"What did Prime Minister Dong say?"
"I don’t know."
"Hmm. You may withdraw."
Wei Xu gestured, contemplating the orders.
He knew saying not to worry about Dong Huang’s life must be from Marquis Wenn, and saying better be careful not actually get Dong Huang killed was also from Marquis Wenn.
Shows Marquis Wenn’s internal conflict.
"When Cao Xing arrives, let him shoot Ding Ling and Zhao Yun." Song Xian slightly raised the large sword in his hand:
"We seize the opportunity to lead the Wolf Cavalry charging them, when timed right, rescuing Dong Huang is not difficult."

"Sounds simple." Wei Xu disagreed with Song Xian’s view, but for now can only deal with it step by step. He called in the scouts to inquire about Ding Ling’s side’s situation, and upon learning Ding Ling single-handedly broke through Yique City, his mouth twitched, finding it incredulous.
After confirming three times.
He took a deep breath and muttered:
"The world surprisingly has such fierce individuals. Good job we didn’t impulsively challenge him one-on-one; otherwise, ten to nine, it would’ve ended in death!"

"Indeed. I wonder when Marquis Wenn will arrive?" Song Xian’s heart was also immensely stirred, feeling lucky. Before he had almost sought to provoke Ding Ling out of anger, seeing now it was fortunate he didn’t do so, or he’d surely have been severely injured.
"Marquis Wenn usually protects the Prime Minister, even if coming, should arrive later than Hua Xiong."
"Hua Xiong’s arrival also helps greatly. His Flying Bear Army is no less than our Wolf Cavalry, in certain measures even superior!"

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Flying Bear Breathing Technique
paragraphs: Ding Ling had no knowledge of the actions or orders of Wei Xu and Song Xian’s side.
After leaving Yique City, he headed directly to the next city.
On the way.
He asked Dong Huang to tell him about the breathing techniques and martial arts they had learned.
Dong Huang was taken aback, puzzled:
"Hero, don’t you already know some extraordinary breathing techniques? Why would you want my ordinary breathing technique?"
"Are you going to tell me or not?"
Ding Ling frowned, staring coldly at him.
He could see that Dong Huang was selfish and petty, willing to do anything to survive.
Yang Ding would rather die than reveal his family’s supreme skills.
But Dong Huang wasn’t necessarily the same.
He didn’t initially expect to obtain any supreme skills from Dong Huang, as he knew that many people valued their family’s supreme skills more than their own lives.
Especially breathing techniques.
They were certainly not going to be passed on to outsiders.
That he learned Battlefield Saber Technique from Gao Lan was, to say the least, a stroke of luck! One could also say Gao Lan was a man of his word, willing to honor his promises!
Gao Lan couldn’t have known that Ding Ling was capable of extraordinary things, or he would never have used Battlefield Saber Technique as a bet.
As for Tong Yuan and Wang Yue, they were exceptions, being reclusive masters.
Pan Feng was an exception among exceptions.
Ordinary people like Zhang Hex and Yang Ding would never pass on their family’s secret supreme skills.
That’s the essence of a family!
If they were passed on, it would shake the family’s foundation! It’s a betrayal to one’s ancestors.
Ordinary people simply couldn’t bear the price!
So Ding Ling had never thought of forcing other military generals to pass on their family’s supreme skills because he knew it wasn’t realistic.
This world is one of belief in gods, fate, and reincarnation!
For this reason, they are even less likely, under normal circumstances, to do anything against the ancestral precepts.
Unless forced by circumstances beyond control.
But Dong Huang?
Unlike Yang Ding and others, he had no thought of ancestors, family precepts, or elders, only himself!
Very few are like him.
Sure enough.
Under Ding Ling’s rebuke and threats.
Dong Huang anxiously, and with unease, disclosed the family’s ’Flying Bear Breathing Technique’ while demonstrating it.
After one round.
Ding Ling slightly recalled, pondering.
He glanced at the library.
To find a new virtual book appeared on a bookshelf, titled "Flying Bear Breathing Technique"!
Ding Ling then had Dong Huang talk about other martial arts.
Dong Huang was puzzled, only once was enough?
But since Ding Ling said it’s okay, he naturally had no objections.
Having already mentioned the most precious Flying Bear Breathing Technique.
There was nothing else not worth mentioning.
Dong Huang began recounting the Dong Family’s secret supreme skills.
There were two types of supreme skills.
One was archery.
The other was saber technique.
Ding Ling’s eyes lit up and had Dong Huang talk about archery first.

"The archery is called Double Extreme Arrow Skill! Once this skill is mastered, it allows for ambidextrous shooting, quickly firing a terrifying arrow imbued with annihilative force. To master this archery, one must first cultivate Initial Tier Arrow Skill, Middle-tier Arrow Skill, and High-tier Arrow Skill. Only when these three archery skills reach a certain level can one progress to Double Extreme Arrow Skill.
Otherwise, forcefully cultivating could harm the organs, even immortals would struggle to heal."
He paused.
Noticing Ding Ling’s unchanged expression, seeming to be listening.
His eyelids twitched, you still want to learn this?

"I only know Initial Tier Arrow Skill, so I can’t perform Double Extreme Arrow Skill, but I have its mantra, cultivation skill, and techniques. I can tell you, but if you can’t successfully cultivate it, I suggest you don’t. Forceful cultivation is too dangerous."
This wasn’t out of kindness from Dong Huang.
He was just worried that if Ding Ling injured himself through forceful cultivation, he might take it out on him!
"What about Middle-tier and High-tier Arrow Skills?"
"I don’t know those either."
Dong Huang was somewhat embarrassed, ashamed:

"If it weren’t for the family mandating that everyone memorize the mantra and techniques of Double Extreme Arrow Skill thoroughly, I probably wouldn’t have remembered this cumbersome mantra and complex techniques."
Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, this guy remembered the key points of Double Extreme Arrow Skill.
If not, wouldn’t such a supreme archery skill be missed?
The Dong family rose to power due to martial skills, which shows the extraordinary nature of this archery skill!

Otherwise, how could a man like Dong Zhuo with nothing, achieve such high rank? It was because he was brave and daring in his youth, showcasing his prowess and winning over many subordinates, that he acquired unparalleled status and rank!
"Speak then."
Ding Ling saw Dong Huang stop and gestured for him to continue.
Dong Huang hesitated:
"This is too dangerous. I suggest you don’t try to cultivate it. Without a good mentor to guide you, the difficulty is sky-high, and forceful cultivation can harm yourself, it’s not worth it!"
He glanced at Ding Ling, speaking quickly:
’Besides, hero, your archery is already remarkable. Given your astonishing martial power, is it necessary to learn the Double Extreme Arrow Skill?’
"Are you going to say it or not?"
Ding Ling asked sternly.
Dong Huang paused, then obediently recited the mantra, techniques and everything about Double Extreme Arrow Skill, not forgetting to add:
"Hero, if anything goes wrong during cultivation, it’s absolutely none of my concern. I’ve told you everything, accurately and completely. Don’t blame me then!"
Ding Ling ignored him.
Gently closing his eyes.
A book materialized on the bookshelf:
"Double Extreme Arrow Skill!"
The next moment.
[Double Extreme Arrow Skill Full Level]
[Defense +0.4]
His body felt slightly warm.
The skin, meridians and such seemed to have been tempered by mysterious energy, with increased defense accordingly.
Simultaneously.
All the essentials, esoteric truths, and principles of Double Extreme Arrow Skill transformed into instinctive imprints all over Ding Ling’s body!
Ding Ling had a very clear feeling.
He seemed able to easily shoot two arrows simultaneously!
Each arrow’s power was immensely strong, laced with a fiercely violent aura!
This aura was unique to the Flying Bear Breathing Technique!
Ding Ling found it difficult to execute.
But it didn’t matter.
His Sword God Breathing Technique and Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique were more advanced than Flying Bear Breathing Technique.

With both breathing techniques supporting Double Extreme Arrow Skill, the arrows are imbued with the sharpness of Sword God Breathing Technique, and the nobility and dominance of Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique!
Such arrows!
Could be considered unmatched!
Aside from meeting force with force, unless there are higher-tier arrow skills, there’s no other way.
Meeting force with force, arrows imbued with unique breathing technique aura, ordinary archery experts simply cannot withstand!
Whoosh!
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
Retrieved the Five-Stone Bow.
Bent the bow, nocked the arrow!
Two arrows simultaneously laid on the large bow.
As Ding Ling activated the breathing technique, operating Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Creak!
A loud, crisp sound pierced the sky.
Two arrows soared into the sky, striking two geese flying high!
The geese were obviously far apart.
Yet, the two arrows perfectly hit at the same time!
Thud!
The geese weakly cried out, plummeting from the sky, with two thuds, landing not far in front of Dong Huang.
Dong Huang was dumbfounded.

Ding Ling took a deep breath.
Retrieved the Five-Stone Bow.
Bent the bow, nocked the arrow!
Two arrows simultaneously laid on the large bow.
As Ding Ling activated the breathing technique, operating Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Creak!
A loud, crisp sound pierced the sky.
Two arrows soared into the sky, striking two geese flying high!
The geese were obviously far apart.
Yet, the two arrows perfectly hit at the same time!
Thud!
The geese weakly cried out, plummeting from the sky, with two thuds, landing not far in front of Dong Huang.
Dong Huang was dumbfounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Dong Zhuo Clan Supreme Skill Full Level (10/50)
paragraphs: "How is this possible?!"
Dong Huang was in disbelief, completely unable to trust his own eyes!
This was the Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
His uncle, Dong Zhuo, was reputed to be the greatest genius in the family in a hundred years!
He took a whole decade to achieve great success in mastering this Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
And Ding Ling?!
Not even a moment!
If you exclude the time he took for explanation, he might have mastered it in just a few blinks?
This is terrifying!
Is this person even human?
Dong Huang began to suspect whether Ding Ling was a lost disciple of the Dong Family because he simply couldn’t imagine that there could be such a world-defying genius in existence!
This completely subverted his worldview and defied the standard definition of a genius in the world!
"Indeed, he did it."
Zhao Yun, however, looked as if it was to be expected.
Even so, he was quite moved.
He hadn’t thought Ding Ling’s talents in spear skills and saber skills were extraordinary, and even in archery, it was the same!
In the whole world, is there any martial art that Ding Ling cannot master?!
"Let’s discuss another saber technique."
Ding Ling felt very satisfied.
The Double Extreme Arrow Skill, although not a high-tier martial art,
is already a very rare archery skill among archery skills!
For a typical family legacy, having a high-tier arrow technique is already commendable, let alone a true martial art.
The Dong Family having a Double Extreme Arrow Skill as a legacy shows how incredible their foundation is.
"Alright."
Dong Huang snapped back to reality, looking at Ding Ling with some doubt and uncertainty, and began to talk about the saber technique:

"The saber technique is called Double Extremes Saber Technique! As the name suggests, when perfected, one can hold dual sabers and strike with unstoppable force, overcoming all who stand in the way. However, mastering this martial art is extremely difficult."
Saying this,
he paused.
He thought about the scenes when Ding Ling was just practicing the Double Extreme Arrow Skill.
He didn’t remind Ding Ling of all the precautions, directly reciting the mantra, moves, etc., of the Double Extremes Saber Technique.
The moves were demonstrated to Ding Ling by him dismounting, enduring the pain, and illustrating with gestures.
He hadn’t learned the Double Extremes Saber Technique.
But because of the family rules, he followed the routine of ’memorizing the secret manual’ without issue.
Ding Ling listened once.
A book immediately materialized on the shelf:
"Double Extremes Saber Technique"!
The next moment.
[Double Extremes Saber Technique Full Level]
[Defense +0.5]
All the core esoteric truths and principles of the Double Extremes Saber Technique flashed through his mind one by one!
With a breath, Ding Ling had completely mastered the Double Extremes Saber Technique.
This saber technique is in no way inferior to the Double Flower Swordsmanship or the Gale Spear Technique!
In some respects, it even surpasses them!
Although it doesn’t match high-tier martial arts like the Ten Thousand Flowers Swordsmanship.
But among low-tier martial arts, it’s considered top-notch!
As Ding Ling grows stronger, the attribute point increase from typical low-tier martial arts becomes less and less.
But the Double Extremes Saber Technique still increases defense by 0.5.
Its extraordinariness is evident!
Whoosh whoosh!
Two white hot breaths spurted from Ding Ling’s nostrils.
This was a natural reaction due to the increase in his defense and strength.
It made Zhao Yun and Dong Huang deeply moved, each thinking, "Stronger again?! Incredible!"
Zhao Yun felt proud.
Dong Huang held even more respect!
Boom!
Ding Ling drew the treasure saber from the side of the horse’s belly, clang!
The saber light slashed across the void like a ribbon!
Crackling!
Brilliant saber lights, horizontal strikes, reverse slashes, with just two casual moves, yet they encapsulated the essence of the Double Extremes Saber Technique!
Seeing the fleeting ’cross’ pattern in the void.
Dong Huang was dumbfounded:
"This, this, this is a telltale external manifestation that only occurs when the Double Extremes Saber Technique becomes an innate ability! You, you, you..."
He looked at Ding Ling as if looking at a ghost or god:
"You, you’ve really succeeded in training it!"
"Once you see a lot, it’s no longer surprising."
Zhao Yun casually remarked, further startling Dong Huang, making his scalp tingle, his hair stand on end, understanding Zhao Yun’s implication.
Ding Ling must have always learned martial arts like this before!
Thinking of this.
At this moment, Dong Huang truly believed that Ding Ling just casually flipped through the secret manual of the Howling Moon Spear Technique and successfully mastered it.
He laughed bitterly, trembling with fear, cowering.
Daring not to look directly at Ding Ling.
Such a fierce person!
In all of history and future, someone like this could never exist! How unfortunate that Dong Huang encountered one! Such bad luck!
"Hero."
Dong Huang seemed to have thought of something, with an ingratiating smile:
"You’ve learned my Dong Family’s supreme skills, could you not tell others that I revealed them? Otherwise, I’ll be in big trouble. My uncles would most certainly beat me to death!"
Uncles.
It seems Dong Huang has more than just Dong Zhuo as an uncle.
Ding Ling understood, nodded.
Dong Huang breathed a sigh of relief. He obviously also knew that if Ding Ling used the Double Extreme Arrow Skill on the battlefield, the first suspect for leaking would be him.
But he could deny it to the death!
No one would believe he was ’kidnapped’ for a while and Ding Ling just learned all of Dong Family’s skills!
Even witnessing it, he could hardly believe it!
He didn’t believe his uncles would either!
The more Dong Huang thought about it, the more at ease he became, no longer worrying about it.
Now he was considering whether Ding Ling would let him go.
"Hero, you see, I..."
He wanted to plead for mercy.
"Go."
Ding Ling gave him a cold glance.
The words he wanted to say were instantly swallowed back.
He was now more and more afraid of Ding Ling, finding facing him more terrifying than facing his own uncles!
Standing before Ding Ling, he felt like a sheep in front of a true dragon, a fierce tiger, without even the courage to resist!
Clip-clop!
The three of them with seven horses sped up.
Disappeared into the distance.
Learning the secret skills of the Dong Zhuo Clan didn’t cost Ding Ling much time.
Therefore.
By the time they reached the next city.
The sky just dimmed.
Dong Huang still went to call at the gate as usual.
This time, the general guarding the gate was a historically unknown figure, seemingly very afraid of Dong Huang, obediently letting them pass.
Finally, Dong Huang proved to be useful.
He himself heaved a sigh of relief, wiped the cold sweat from his forehead secretly.
The three of them with seven horses, after eating and drinking their fill at the Defender General’s mansion in the city, continued their journey.
The Defender General sent them off like a plague god.
Once they were far away.
He realized his back was drenched in cold sweat.
He later thanked his aide.
The aide was a player, naturally, taking this action to farm an achievement medal.
He had worked hard to establish a relationship with the Defender General in this city, not wanting him to perish, hence advised the General, resulting in Ding Ling’s smooth departure this time.
The aide glanced in the direction of Luoyang, feeling very disdainful:
"Duanmu Qing, a mere little reporter, dares to command me? What a joke! Does he not realize who he is after playing an official in the game world?!"
He snorted coldly, then looked in Ding Ling’s direction, eyes shining with marvelous light:

"What I’m most curious about now is how Ding Ling rapidly learns various martial arts, and how he achieves such an explosive growth in combat power. If I were to obtain his secret, wouldn’t I be soaring?"
The aide’s heart burned with anticipation, starting to contemplate how to gain Ding Ling’s trust and have him share that secret.

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Lord Imperial Attendant Is an Actor
paragraphs: Ding Ling was unaware that many people like strategists were plotting against him.
Even if he knew.
He wouldn’t be afraid.
After acquiring the cheat, swiftly mastering martial arts, and becoming a regular on the leaderboard, he was mentally prepared for this.
That’s why he hid in a small village at the foot of the mountain.
This place was sparsely populated, with almost no visitors usually.
Of course, he had thought about using hacker skills to ’secretly’ divert some black money from foreign banks to himself, or using hacking skills to ’clean’ his ID.
But after careful consideration, he gave up!
After he last returned to the real world, he specifically went online to learn some hacking skills.
He even went to the library in the neighboring city district to scan through some shelves, learning all the relevant computer technology.
But the reality was, even if his hacker skills were full level.
There were many hackers in this world whose skills weren’t weaker than his, and with guns and artillery existing in this world, some real big shots deploy thunderous means that exceed imagination.
Especially in foreign lands, where various instances of life being recklessly taken happen frequently.
How could Ding Ling put himself in danger?
He did not rent out a ’luxury house’ because he knew that even if the security measures in the luxury area were advanced, if someone really brought guns to seize him.
He absolutely couldn’t withstand it!
After all, wanting to rent a luxury house would likely require signing a contract, and once signed, it would definitely expose him!
Wanting to rent a luxury house without signing a contract?

Unless Ding Ling was lucky or paid an extremely high price! Moreover, even if he paid the price, it would likely lead to exposure, as people in the city come from all directions, and Ding Ling would have to communicate with them to get food, and once communication happened, he’d be exposed.
As for ordering food delivery etc.?
The risk is quite high too, considering Ding Ling’s large appetite, eating so much could certainly arouse curiosity from others, who might then share it with colleagues, or on social media networks?
This way, wouldn’t he end up exposed again.
While learning hacker techniques to hide himself has a certain effect, as long as Ding Ling is living in the city, the risk is definitely greater than in the mountain village.
Unless the time comes when he’s not afraid of guns and artillery, perhaps then he would return to city life.
For now, he won’t consider it.
Ding Ling is a prudent person, unwilling to take risks without absolute certainty.
This is reality, if you die, you’re really dead.
His cheat is too heaven-defying, bound to be coveted by others, caution is paramount!
As for those rare events?
Ding Ling wouldn’t even trust the beautiful landlady who accompanied him for years, let alone others?
He never relies his hopes on others!
’The best way is to rapidly grow and improve myself! Until I’m not afraid of atomic bombs. Then I can fear nothing!’
As he spurred his horse forward quickly, Ding Ling thought to himself:

"Last time I returned to reality, I secretly moved to another mountain village, completely severed connections with the previous village. With my prudence, there’s no way someone could find me in a short time!"
Ding Ling chooses regions that are all mountain villages.
The fundamental reason is that mountain villages have no ’surveillance’!
Even if discovered, he can flee into the vast mountains, even if the opponent has drones or other measures, in the short term Ding Ling is absolutely safe.
Moreover, he remains highly low-key in reality.
Fearing triggering suppression from the largest big shots.
’One must remain grounded. Especially when lacking absolute strength!’
Ding Ling’s heart is like a clear mirror:
"Once I’ve grown strong enough to fear nothing, naturally I can do whatever I want."
Ding Ling admits he can’t compare to sages like Zhuge Liang, but he’s stable enough, with a good mindset, knowing what he wants and what he needs to do.
Just like now.
He needs to head south to Yangzhou to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique, his goal is crystal clear!
"The next city is Luhun City!"
Before was Xin City.
After Xin City is Luhun City.
The three of them hurried through the night under the moonlight, switching horses on the way.
In the deep night.
They arrived at the gate of Luhun City.
"Open the gate!"
Dong Huang was exhausted, and injured on top of that, his face looking miserable and haggard.
But his physical strength was high, even so, his voice was like thunder:
"I am Dong Huang the Imperial Guard Commander! Nephew of Prime Minister Dong!"
In front of others.
Dong Huang displayed extreme overbearingness, like a roaring lion king! Full of overbearing aura!
His demeanor showed his confidence and extraordinary presence at a glance.
"Lord Imperial Attendant!"
A Defender General stuck his head out:
"We received a pigeon post saying not to open the gate for you."
Pigeon post was involved.
Needless to say.
Players certainly played a significant role!
"Whose pigeon post?!"
Dong Huang roared:
"Dare to block my path?!"
"It’s from Marquis Wenn."
The Defender General shrank back:
"I cannot afford to offend Marquis Wenn.
"You mean you can afford to offend me?"
Dong Huang was so angry his nostrils puffed white smoke! He glared at the Defender General.
"I wouldn’t dare offend Lord Imperial Attendant either."
The Defender General shrank even further.
"If you don’t dare, just open the gate for me."
Dong Huang glared and shouted:
"If you don’t open, I’ll chop you up!"
Zhao Yun watched from behind, amazed.
Dong Huang switched roles between petty person, bandit, rogue, and attendant effortlessly, almost reaching perfection, leaving no trace of acting!
Zhao Yun questioned if he could achieve such skill.
Ding Ling also saw the acting potential in Dong Huang, playing a sidekick was first-class! Being a villain was absolute king!
"We can’t open the gate, Lord Imperial Attendant."
The Defender General hesitated:
"Please don’t make it difficult for me.’
"I’m making it difficult for you."
Dong Huang was about to say more.
Ding Ling motioned him over.
Dong Huang immediately shut up obediently, rode over to Ding Ling’s side, nodding and bowing with a fawning demeanor.
Watching left the Defender General dumbfounded, unable to believe his eyes!
Involuntarily, he looked at Ding Ling, asking a soldier beside him:
"Is he the Ding Ling you mentioned?"
"Yes."
The soldier was a player, holding a shield to protect himself comprehensively, then spoke softly to the Defender General:

"My lord, I have relatives and friends in Luoyang and elsewhere, they sent me a pigeon post. The messages were clear, Ding Ling did great things in Luoyang, and after leaving Luoyang, he single-handedly slashed through Yique City with a sword..."
The soldier roughly recounted Ding Ling’s deeds.
The Defender General gasped in shock, his gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly.
At last, filled with astonishment and reverence.
"Do not open the city gates."
Ding Ling looked up towards the gate, shouting:
"Are you prepared for a battle with me?"
The voice was clear, echoing through the night skies.
The Defender General swallowed hard, feeling at a loss, looking at the soldier, only to see the soldier was also very nervous, occasionally glancing at the Defender General, whispering advice:
"If you really can’t, then do open the city gate, General. Where there’s life, there’s hope! If you truly die, think about your wife, your child, your parents..."

The messages were clear, Ding Ling did great things in Luoyang, and after leaving Luoyang, he single-handedly slashed through Yique City with a sword..."
The soldier roughly recounted Ding Ling’s deeds.
The Defender General gasped in shock, his gaze at Ding Ling changed repeatedly.
At last, filled with astonishment and reverence.
"Do not open the city gates."
Ding Ling looked up towards the gate, shouting:
"Are you prepared for a battle with me?"
The voice was clear, echoing through the night skies.
The Defender General swallowed hard, feeling at a loss, looking at the soldier, only to see the soldier was also very nervous, occasionally glancing at the Defender General, whispering advice:
"If you really can’t, then do open the city gate, General.
Where there’s life, there’s hope!
If you truly die, think about your wife, your child, your parents..."

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Double Extremes Arrow Pierces the Tornado Arrow
paragraphs: If you die, you will level down.
The skill level will fall first.
Then your actual level will drop.
Once it drops to level 0, it’s game over!
Therefore, even players don’t want to die, especially those who have worked hard to level up their skills to level 5 or 6; they don’t want to die!
"This, this..."
The Defender General hesitated.
"Look, Ding Ling is already drawing his bow and nocking an arrow."
The player was startled:

"Sir, if you hesitate any longer, Ding Ling will shoot down the archers, storm the tower, and then we are doomed. The tower of Luhun City isn’t as high as Yique City’s. If Ding Ling could leap onto the walls of Yique City, do you really think the walls of Luhun City will be a challenge for him?"
The player earnestly persuaded, analyzing the pros and cons.
Especially saying:

"If Marquis Wenn blames us, you can just shift the responsibility onto Lord Imperial Attendant, right? Besides, seeing how ruthless Ding Ling is, with Yique City as a precedent, I doubt Marquis Wenn would dare to truly hold you responsible. After all, he’s just a marquis, not the Prime Minister! And you are under the Prime Minister’s jurisdiction."
The Defender General woke up from his daze, realizing the situation, and immediately opened the city gates for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was slightly surprised.
But seeing a soldier next to the Defender General winking at him, he understood.

It’s needless to say, it must have been the player who helped him. He nodded amicably towards him, and the soldier was overjoyed, barely restraining himself from running up to Ding Ling shouting ’Great God, please take me along’ or something like that.
Ding Ling mounted his horse and left.
He didn’t linger in Luhun City.
He headed directly for the next city: Songh County.
Along the way, they traveled on the main roads.
Only the main road allowed for a fast gallop.
Other mountain paths couldn’t be traveled swiftly, let alone heading down to Yangzhou.
Unless Ding Ling reached the edge of Si Li, he should avoid taking small paths.
After all, the Si Li border has many mountains, making it ideal for hiding.
As for the mountains near Luhun City?
Ding Ling didn’t consider them.
If he truly hid in such areas, and Lü Bu set fires to the forests and mountains or blocked the exits...
Wouldn’t he be trapped like a turtle in a jar?
Such an act would be unwise.
With players aiding Lü Bu, Ding Ling could definitely anticipate various sneaky tricks waiting for him!
His best method is to stay away from Si Li!
"I can’t take it anymore, hero!"
Dong Huang was gasping heavily, his face growing paler, and he kept waving to signal a need to rest a while.
Ding Ling frowned, looked at the sky, and also saw that the seven horses were quite exhausted, panting heavily.
Even Zhao Yun, a fierce general, appeared weary.
He thought it over and nodded in agreement.
After dismounting, Dong Huang collapsed directly onto the ground.
His wounds, which had been simply bandaged, tore open again from the rushed journey, oozing blood.
He grimaced in pain, not daring to ask Ding Ling for help, dealing with his wounds silently.
He secretly vowed.
Whenever traveling from now on, he must learn from his uncle and bring an unparalleled fierce general as a guard; otherwise, he’d feel too insecure!
The seven horses were eating grass nearby.
Zhao Yun was practicing his Breathing Technique, adjusting his state.
Ding Ling appeared full of energy, showing no signs of fatigue.
Zhao Yun and Dong Huang watched in silent shock, feeling deeply envious of such a vigorous physique, truly formidable!
After resting for about half an hour.
The three of them mounted their horses, ready to speed away.
Clip-clop!
Under the moonlight.
In the silent night, besides the occasional calls of wild animals, the sudden sound of horse hooves was extremely jarring.
"Someone’s coming."
Zhao Yun’s expression tightened, gripping his Dragon Gall Silver Spear, and he rode to Ding Ling’s side.
Dong Huang seemed timid, hiding not far behind the two.
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows, looking towards the direction of the hoofbeats.
It was too late to run now.
The opponent’s speed was extremely fast.
Even faster than Ding Ling’s.
Even if Ding Ling ran fast, as long as he stopped, he would definitely be caught.
And if Ding Ling ran to the front of a city and got surrounded by these people.
A pincer attack?
Wouldn’t that be like wrapping him into a dumpling?
Ding Ling would never do such a foolish thing.
Although he wasn’t afraid.
But there was no need to risk Zhao Yun’s and his own life.
So Ding Ling straightforwardly picked up the Six-Stone Bow, drew his bow and nocked the arrow, aiming into the distance.
He chose to face his opponents directly.
He certainly hoped the newcomers weren’t enemies, which could avoid a battle, but unfortunately...
"Clip-clop!"
The urgent sound of hooves thundered in his ears.
Ding Ling saw a large number of light cavalry.
The leaders were Wei Xu, Song Xian, and several unfamiliar generals.
At this moment, Ding Ling was even grateful they had rested midway, greatly restored his Essence, Qi, and Spirit, and regained plenty of stamina and endurance.
Otherwise, if they were caught before reaching the next city, it would be even more dangerous!
"Ding Ling!"
Wei Xu spotted Ding Ling, pointed at him, and said to a general alongside:
"It’s him!"

The general, riding an Unparalleled Horse different from the other healthy horses, upon seeing Ding Ling, said nothing more, immediately grabbing his bow and arrow from the side of the horse’s belly, clop-clop-clop!
He nocked three arrows on the big bow, separating them left, middle, and right!
He drew his bow and aimed at Ding Ling!
Sproing!
Along with the sound of the bowstring breaking!
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Three arrows launched simultaneously!
Each arrow faster than the last!
Each arrow seemed to stir a whirlwind! As they passed, the void seemed to ripple! The sound of the wind howled, like a tornado sweeping the ground!
Three arrows, like fast boats cutting through waves;
Also like lightning cutting through the void!
Not only were they extremely fast!
The sharpness and destructiveness rushing towards one’s face were enough to dazzle and terrify anyone.
Generally, any First-class Fierce General facing these three arrows would absolutely be unable to dodge!
Dodging one arrow would indeed be remarkable.
To consecutively dodge all three, perhaps only true archery masters or extremely agile and responsive First-class peak Fierce Generals could manage!
But at such close range, caught off guard, even a Super-Elite might find it difficult.
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted, realizing the prowess of the newcomer, immediately releasing the arrow in his hand!
Sproing! Sproing!
Two resonant sounds tore through the void.

Two arrows shot out from the Six-Stone Bow, transforming into colossal serpents that seemed capable of devouring, accompanied by piercing sounds of breaking through the air, with the arrows infused by two major Breathing Techniques, innately carrying sharpness, nobility, and overbearing aura!
Like a Sword God riding a Spiritual Phoenix falling into the Mortal World, swinging an unparalleled Divine Sword at the human realm.
The sharp, overbearing aura that seemed able to pierce and shatter everything, amid the booming sound!

Struck the enemy general’s two Tornado Arrows back-to-back with a resounding crash! Like the sound of drums, accompanied by crisp cracking sounds breaking through the air, the two Tornado Arrows shattered explosively, directly pierced through by the sharp, overbearing Double Extremes Arrows.
The arrowheads of the Double Extremes Arrows also shattered and spread across the sky after piercing through the Tornado Arrows.
But the arrow shafts remained, still speeding towards the enemy general.
"Double Extremes Arrows!"
Wei Xu, Song Xian, and other fierce generals recognized this archery skill, looking at each other in shock and fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Divine Archer Cao Xing (13/50)
paragraphs: "How could that person use Prime Minister Dong’s Double Extremes Arrow?!"
Wei Xu and Song Xian were shocked and puzzled.
They watched helplessly as the two blunted arrows flew toward Cao Xing.
Clang!
Suddenly, a long saber engraved with a Yellow Dragon appeared from the side; its blade shook, dispersing Vigorous Qi, and with a clanging sound, struck the arrow shafts one after another.
Clang, clang!
The two arrows shattered and scattered everywhere.
Cao Xing was just the mighty general who had fired the three arrows.
He rode a Ferghana Horse, his body powerful and strong, especially his well-developed and robust arms.
His eyebrows were like swords, his features were imposing, looking ordinary, but his eyes were sharp like a hawk’s, emitting a burning light even in the dark night.
He took a couple of quick breaths, thanked the general who rescued him:
"Zhang Liao, thank you."
"Mm."
Zhang Liao, with an impressive appearance and tall stature, holding a long saber, looked sharply towards Ding Ling, and said in a deep voice:
"The opponent is stronger than I imagined!"
Ding Ling reacted extremely swiftly.
In an instant, he was counter-shooting with Cao Xing!
Not only did he directly pierce Cao Xing’s two arrows, but the third arrow was even shattered with a sword strike!
This rapid action was as fast as lightning!
If one’s strength was slightly lower and reaction speed a bit slower, they would definitely be shot by the opponent’s arrows!
In terms of reaction.
Cao Xing was not inferior to any top-tier general, but facing the opponent’s Double Extremes Arrow, he was still almost hit!
Yet the opponent seemed to effortlessly resolve this crisis, indicating that the opponent’s strength surely exceeded Cao Xing’s! Extremely formidable!
"From the major events the opponent has accomplished, one can see the person is extremely fierce and terrifying."
Song Xian said beside him:
"What shocks me the most is that he knows the Dong family’s Double Extremes Arrow! This is a secret skill that the Dong Family definitely would not and could not pass on!"

"The Double Extremes Arrow is in no way inferior to Cao Xing’s Tornado Arrow! If combined with the Breathing Technique, it could even surpass it to some extent. And now, looking at the situation, the opponent has greatly enhanced the Double Extremes Arrow! It seems to exceed the Flying Bear Breathing Technique, carrying an innate sharpness and overbearing aura! Cao Xing’s Tornado Arrow can’t withstand it! It’s truly unbelievable!"
Zhang Liao tightly gripped the long saber in his hand:
"If Cao Xing’s Breathing Technique were stronger, perhaps he could surpass the opponent, but now it seems he can only match him."
"The archery skill can be on par, but the strength difference is too great."
Cao Xing smiled wryly:
"I sent three arrows, and he resolved them, but when he sent two arrows, I might not be able to resolve them."
"I have no idea how he learned the Double Extremes Arrow."
Zhang Liao was also puzzled:
"Could Dong Huang have taught him?
"How is that possible?"
Wei Xu denied:

"How long has it been? Even if Dong Huang disregarded ancestral norms and taught external people cultivation techniques and martial arts, Ding Ling couldn’t have possibly mastered these martial arts to a Transformation Realm level in such a short time!"
"It’s puzzling."
Just as Zhang Liao was about to say more, he saw Ding Ling resolve the three arrows, then suddenly draw his bow once more, aimed at their side, causing his heart to tighten, saying:
"Cao Xing, be careful. Ding Ling will probably use his arrow skill for a decisive kill; counter-shoot with him and resolve his arrow technique!"
"No problem."
Cao Xing nodded, drew his bow and placed three arrows left, center, and right, aiming at Ding Ling.
As Ding Ling fired two arrows.
He released his grip.
Boom!
The three Tornado Arrows mixed with swirling Tornado Qi, spiraled toward the Double Extremes Arrow!
Boom!
Midway, the Tornado Arrows and Double Extremes Arrow collided!
The scene happened just like before!
Two Tornado Arrows were pierced, but the Double Extremes Arrow still shot at Cao Xing like a thunderbolt.
The other Tornado Arrow was shattered in mid-air by Ding Ling’s casual sword strike.
Meanwhile, Zhang Liao effectively intervened to neutralize the Double Extremes Arrow!
Bang!
Bang, bang!
Both sides competed in speed, each arrow flew faster than the last!
The shooting speed accelerated more and more!
In just a brief moment, they had shot back and forth seventeen or eighteen times!
The clashing sounds were endless, slicing through the night sky, echoing through the darkness!
Ding Ling remained vigorous, full of spirit, rapidly drawing his bow and shooting, with the Double Extremes Arrow fierce as ever.
Cao Xing was struggling to keep up, the power of the Tornado Arrow waning.
He was shaken inside, and while drawing his bow and shooting against Ding Ling, he spoke quickly:
"Ding Ling’s skill, endurance, and stamina far exceed mine; in such an ongoing standoff, I won’t be able to hold on!"
Zhang Liao, Wei Xu, and the others had already noticed this, discussing strategies on the side.
Upon hearing Cao Xing’s comments.
Wei Xu said:

"There’s no other way. To minimize the risk of hurting Dong Huang, we can only adopt the charge strategy. Let Zhang Liao and Chenglian confront Ding Ling; the other generals will surround Zhao Yun with me. The remaining Wolf Cavalry, in the ensuing chaos, have the chance to rescue Dong Huang.
Afterwards, the Military Marquis will take Dong Huang far away, while the other Wolf Cavalry will assist us in encircling and annihilating Ding Ling and Zhao Yun!"
Chenglian, holding a long saber, with an unusual appearance and three tufts of short beard beneath his chin, nodded upon hearing this.
The other generals also agreed.
Upon conclusion of their deliberation.
At the very moment Ding Ling and Cao Xing finished their twentieth shot.
Zhang Liao and Chenglian suddenly rode forth, rushing towards Ding Ling, shouting:
"Ding Ling, dare you fight a duel to the death?!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, looked at Zhang Liao and Chenglian, not knowing who they were.
But seeing Zhang Liao’s agility and swift saber technique, he knew this was definitely a top-tier general!
Right now, even Zhao Yun probably surpasses him only slightly.
Such a mighty general must be a historically renowned warrior.
Ding Ling paid no mind to his shout, abruptly drew his bow and fired at Chenglian.
He didn’t know Chenglian’s name, but seizing the opportunity to kill was inevitable.
Whizz, whizz!
The Double Extremes Arrow revealed its power, pierced through the void, mixed with unparalleled sharpness, shooting towards Chenglian.
Chenglian was startled.
Cao Xing also rode forth with Zhang Liao and Chenglian, saw this, immediately engaged in counter-shooting with Ding Ling!
Boom!
Another unfavorable outcome in the shooting duel.
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
He knew it was hard to achieve success with Divine Archer present.
But since the opponent wished to clash.
He had no reason for fear.
Having charged into formation multiple times alone.
Ding Ling had transformed long ago!
He might not even realize it, but his courage had already metamorphosed, and his charisma far exceeded ordinary people.
Full of heroic spirit, awe-inspiring.
Even facing several generals leading over a thousand Wolf Riders.
He displayed zero fear.
Instead, his blood boiled.
With a loud yell, he wielded a Heaven-piercing Halberd in one hand and a Shuoyue Sword in the other, and charged towards Zhang Liao and Chenglian.
Zhao Yun, clad in armor, wearing a leather jacket, holding the Dragon Gall Silver Spear, followed closely behind, guarding Ding Ling on both sides.
Both knew that only by defeating this group of Wolf Riders thoroughly...

Right now, even Zhao Yun probably surpasses him only slightly.
Such a mighty general must be a historically renowned warrior.
Ding Ling paid no mind to his shout, abruptly drew his bow and fired at Chenglian.
He didn’t know Chenglian’s name, but seizing the opportunity to kill was inevitable.
Whizz, whizz!
The Double Extremes Arrow revealed its power, pierced through the void, mixed with unparalleled sharpness, shooting towards Chenglian.
Chenglian was startled.
Cao Xing also rode forth with Zhang Liao and Chenglian, saw this, immediately engaged in counter-shooting with Ding Ling!
Boom!
Another unfavorable outcome in the shooting duel.
Ding Ling took a deep breath.
He knew it was hard to achieve success with Divine Archer present.
But since the opponent wished to clash.
He had no reason for fear.
Having charged into formation multiple times alone.
Ding Ling had transformed long ago!
He might not even realize it, but his courage had already metamorphosed, and his charisma far exceeded ordinary people.
Full of heroic spirit, awe-inspiring.
Even facing several generals leading over a thousand Wolf Riders.
He displayed zero fear.
Instead, his blood boiled.
With a loud yell, he wielded a Heaven-piercing Halberd in one hand and a Shuoyue Sword in the other, and charged towards Zhang Liao and Chenglian.
Zhao Yun, clad in armor, wearing a leather jacket, holding the Dragon Gall Silver Spear, followed closely behind, guarding Ding Ling on both sides.
Both knew that only by defeating this group of Wolf Riders thoroughly...

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Zhang Liao’s Soaring Dragon Saber Technique
paragraphs: Only then can they successfully leave Si Li!
Otherwise, the endless pursuit would make it difficult to have a good outcome!
As for Dong Huang?
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun no longer cared.
As long as they defeat the opponent, Dong Huang won’t escape; on the contrary, if they fail, whether Dong Huang stays or leaves is beyond their control!
Clatter-clatter!
The sound of horseshoes on the avenue was deafening!
Both sides urged their horses towards each other, moving at great speed.
The horses were fine horses!
The men were fierce generals.
The moment both sides charged, they exhibited a momentum as tumultuous as a flood crashing against a dam!
Though there were only a few people, they exuded a deadly aura of intense combat!
It was as if thousands of troops and horses were confronting each other in battle!
Dong Huang and other bystanders watched with twitching eyelids.
They realized the limitless impact powerful generals could have on their side!
Whoosh whoosh!
Cao Xing, behind Zhang Liao and Chenglian, occasionally shot arrows secretly at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Ding Ling was furious.
If he weren’t struggling to kill Cao Xing.
He would’ve shot him dead long ago.
Clang!
With a sword in one hand and a halberd in the other, Ding Ling protected himself tightly, rendering Cao Xing’s Tornado Arrows unable to penetrate his defense!
The current Cao Xing was no longer the sharp, awe-inspiring figure he had been at the outset.
After repeatedly using his ultimate skill Tornado Arrow.
His sharpness and endurance were declining rapidly.
Now, although the Tornado Arrows were still lethally powerful.
They could no longer penetrate Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s defenses, nor could they break through the ’barricade’ protecting Ding Ling and Zhao Yun.
Boom!

Both sides soon met midway, with Ding Ling wielding halberd and Shuoyue Sword, executing the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique, conjuring a pattern of birds paying homage to the phoenix, rapidly stabbing toward Chenglian.
The Shuoyue Sword swung, displaying the Sword God Skill, the Setting Sun Diagram swirling in the air, occasionally flashing, clashing fiercely in the void with Zhang Liao’s approaching saber.
Upon meeting.
Only one round.
Accompanied by a miserable scream.
Chenglian’s wrist was pierced by the halberd, causing his saber to fall to the ground.
"What?!
Zhang Liao was stunned, Chenglian was a powerful warrior, already in the first-class!
Compared to the likes of Wei Xu and Song Xian, he was much stronger.
Yet he couldn’t withstand even a single strike from Ding Ling!
"Chenglian, retreat!"
Zhang Liao shouted loudly.
His saber unleashed its might!
The supreme Soaring Dragon Saber Technique utilized, an overpowering dragon’s might swept toward Ding Ling.
Roar!
Hidden within were faint dragon roars.
The Yellow Dragon carved on Zhang Liao’s saber seemed eager to break free, its dragon eyes gleaming vividly, appearing almost alive!
One slash came down!
Vigorous Qi spread in all directions!
The fierce, ruthless momentum seemed intent on cutting everything down!

Ding Ling turned his head slightly, visibly moved, letting out a clear shout, abandoning the chance to kill Chenglian, as his halberd lightly trembled, the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques activated, various graceful moves rushed toward the dragon blade!
Clang!
A halberd and a saber collided heavily in mid-air.
It felt like a clash between Mars and Earth, a thunderbolt against lightning!
Sparks flew violently at the moment of the clash!
Crack!
The halberd and saber engaged in a vehement face-off, slashing at each other tens of times in an instant!
Like a dragon and a phoenix, tearing and devouring each other!
The more Ding Ling fought, the more invigorated he became.
The more Zhang Liao fought, the more shocked he was, as his hands began to weaken.
With every collision, he felt as if struck by lightning!
After over a dozen collisions, his hands felt numb!
’Such great strength!’
’If not for the Yellow Dragon Breathing Technique’s reinforcement, and the Soaring Dragon Saber Technique amplifying my arms, he would’ve killed me already!’
Inwardly, Zhang Liao’s heart surged with waves of astonishment, already contemplating avoiding further engagement.
Especially seeing Wei Xu, Song Xian, and Houcheng struggling against Zhao Yun, barely holding, instead being disorganized, left him even more amazed.
Had it not been for Cao Xing occasionally shooting at Zhao Yun, Houcheng and the others would have surely suffered casualties!
"Withdraw!"

Zhang Liao twisted the hooked scythe in his hand, activating the Soaring Dragon Saber Technique to its full power, slashing heavily towards Ding Ling, Boom! As the halberd and saber clashed once more.
Zhang Liao took the opportunity to withdraw and retreated into the charging Wolf Cavalry army:
"Wolf Cavalry, hear my command, carry out shooting actions against Ding Ling!"
At this moment.
Several Military Marquises took advantage of the chaos to ride towards Dong Huang, taking him away.
Zhang Liao finally could act without reservations.
But when he saw Ding Ling pursuing him with a sword in one hand and a halberd in the other, he was dumbfounded.
He realized he might have underestimated Ding Ling’s courage and bravery!
Facing over a thousand Wolf Riders and numerous fierce generals, he advanced instead of retreating!
This disrupted Zhang Liao’s plans.
He had already retreated into the army.
Yet Ding Ling followed him closely into the army.
By now, the ’shooting’ advantage of the Wolf Riders was almost completely nullified!
Attempting to shoot Ding Ling in the chaos was never an option.
Because at night, the Wolf Riders’ visibility was already inferior to the daytime, and their shooting accuracy naturally fell far short of usual!
Shooting at Ding Ling within the army would likely result in heavy casualties among themselves.
For random arrows might wound Ding Ling, but would certainly kill or injure their own troops.
Indeed.
Upon receiving the order, the Wolf Riders instinctively released a volley at Ding Ling, accompanied by the constant sound of pained cries.
But a dozen or so of their own Wolf Riders were hit, tumbling off their saddles, trampled to death by the charging iron hooves.
Ding Ling was unscathed, in contrast, his sword and halberd began slashing furiously.
Clang!
The Setting Sun Diagram and Flowers in Full Bloom magnificently unfurled at the tip of the Shuoyue Sword.
Wherever he went!
Men and horses toppled!
One by one, the Wolf Riders were pierced or wounded!
No one could withstand the edge of the Sword God Skill!
The right hand’s halberd swung wide, and with its sufficient length, wherever it pointed, the spear flowers bloomed, and the axe light was astounding, often with one move, Boom!
Boom!
Five or six Wolf Riders were slashed, cut down, or pierced to death!

The Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique, Battlefield Saber Technique, Howling Moon Spear Technique, and Double Extremes Saber Technique were frequently displayed on Ding Ling’s halberd!
Under the Breathing Technique’s augmentation.
The pride and lone courage of the Howling Moon Spear Technique were fully exhibited, like an unrivaled fierce man charging into a myriad of enemies!
The Double Extremes Saber Technique, with its inherent dual extremities, when enhanced by the two Breathing Techniques, transformed into a Tai Chi Diagram, occasionally flashing across the void.
Clearly a ’cross’ blade edge!
Yet at its peak, it seemed to curve into a Tai Chi!
Double extremities plus double Breathing Technique.
Their power augmented by more than a notch.

With various moves rotating and transforming, the Military Marquises among the Wolf Riders, comparable to third-class generals, couldn’t withstand, often before they realized, they were already beheaded.
