chapters.title: Chapter 110: One Man and One Horse Break Through the Battle Lines
paragraphs: In a short moment.
More than dozens of Wolf Cavalry were killed and wounded by Ding Ling.
Zhang Liao watched with eyes wide in shock, realizing for the first time that he might have made a grave mistake.
He had completely overestimated his combined combat power with Chenglian!
Underestimating Ding Ling’s strength!
"This person seems even stronger than Marquis Wenn! How is that possible?!"
It’s important to know that when working together with Chenglian, they could fully withstand Lü Bu for dozens of rounds!
This was exactly the reason.
Zhang Liao dared to propose teaming up with Chenglian to confront Ding Ling.
If they could hold off Ding Ling for dozens of moves, everything afterward would be easy.
According to the plan, Ding Ling was undoubtedly doomed!
But the development of events completely exceeded Zhang Liao’s expectations!
In the initial clash of a single round.
Chenglian was incapacitated and had to retreat into the Great Army to hide.
While he used all his might, unleashing his Supreme Skill to explosively attack Ding Ling, he still couldn’t hold off for twenty rounds, and after a dozen or so rounds he was exhausted and weakened!

This was also because his Breathing Technique and Saber Technique were exceptional, fierce, and bestowed an extraordinary enhancement upon him, otherwise, he might have been defeated or killed in just three to five rounds.
Reflecting on this, Zhang Liao’s pupils contracted, feeling an uneasy premonition.
"I was too confident this time and misjudged the situation!"
Zhang Liao was frustrated and regretful.
Yet he could hardly believe there was someone in the world stronger than Lü Bu!
Based on Ding Ling’s achievements.
He had already elevated Ding Ling to a super-elite fierce general position equivalent to Lü Bu.
For him.
That was cautious enough.
Because Lü Bu’s name shook the borders, he was indisputably the Flying General!
Finding someone comparable throughout the Jiuzhou Land would be difficult!
But he couldn’t imagine that Ding Ling seemed to surpass Lü Bu in certain aspects!
This caught him off guard, completely disrupting his arrangements.
Making two successive blunt moves.
By the time he realized, it was already too late.
Ultimately, Zhang Liao hadn’t truly matured yet; if fully developed, he would certainly not be like this!
But Zhang Liao was extraordinary; upon recognizing his errors, he immediately began devising a recovery strategy.
"Perhaps the only way to win is to shoot Ding Ling from a distance."
"But we had already initiated the melee assault on him earlier. Now it’s too late for ranged attacks as Ding Ling has already penetrated our Grand Array.
At this point.
They could only engage in bareblade combat, melee battle to recover losses, trying to ensure the Wolf Cavalry distanced themselves thoroughly from Ding Ling.
Zhang Liao gritted his teeth and quickly summoned powerful Military Marquis and Village Chiefs to join forces against Ding Ling.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Ding Ling darted through the military formation, rampaging at will.
Wielding a sword in one hand, a halberd in the other, he left heads rolling, blood flowing like rivers!
Screams echoed to the heavens and shook the earth.
Groans erupted continuously!
A single person fiercely cutting through the military formation, then turning his horse to charge again into the formation!
Such actions!
Were akin to disregarding and despising the Wolf Cavalry!
The Wolf Cavalry was enraged, attempting to retaliate.
But Ding Ling’s agility, responsiveness, and body technique were all extraordinary!
On horseback, he seemed like a gust of wind, a drifting cloud, elusive and unpredictable.
Any Wolf Cavalry trying to attack his mount or him were stabbed, chopped, or sliced to death!
Wherever Ding Ling and his horse went.
It was like mowing grass, with Wolf Cavalry being knocked off their horses one after another!
Ding Ling alone on horseback commanded an invincible aura as if charging through ten thousand troops!
By the time Zhang Liao and the Military Marquis joined forces against Ding Ling, Ding Ling had already killed or wounded over a hundred Wolf Cavalry.
"Prepare to die!"
Zhang Liao was enraged, teaming up with seven fierce generals to engage in fierce battle with Ding Ling, while constantly shouting commands for the Wolf Cavalry to move away quickly from Ding Ling!

Ding Ling shook his spirits vigorously, laughing heartily, wielding a sword in one hand and a halberd in the other, seemingly a true dragon overturning rivers and seas, more like a Celestial God creating the heavens and the earth.
At times, the sword stirred up heavenly Flowers in Bloom, knocking a fierce general from his horse;
At other times, the halberd danced with miraculous craftsmanship, consecutively stabbing two fierce generals to death.
No matter how many were surrounding him.
None could withstand Ding Ling’s rapid "mowing" ferocity.
In the several confrontations and clashes between Zhang Liao and Ding Ling, Zhang Liao sustained internal injuries again.
His face turned pale.
Realizing if the fight continued, he would likely not make it out.
In the corner of his eyes, he glimpsed Zhao Yun stabbing Houcheng off his horse, life and death unknown, his heart ached intensely, shouting:
"Wolf Cavalry, retreat quickly!"
Several fierce generals led over a thousand elite Wolf Cavalry.
Yet they were forced to retreat humiliatingly by just two individuals.
This was an unprecedented disgrace for Zhang Liao!
But after witnessing Ding Ling’s exceptional Martial Arts!
He abandoned the idea of surrounding and killing Ding Ling up close relying on the Great Army.
The Wolf Cavalry had high attack and speed but lacked defense.
Once Ding Ling got closer, the death toll was exceedingly severe.
If heavy cavalry was sent instead, things might fare better.
But light cavalry was definitely unsuitable for surrounding Ding Ling closely!

’Initially thought that after being promoted by Marquis Wenn, I could earn some military success from this battle to make the Prime Minister and Marquis Wenn take notice, now it seems utterly futile.’
Zhang Liao no longer harbored thoughts of killing Ding Ling, Zhao Yun.
At least not tonight.
Tap tap tap!
As Zhang Liao shouted repeatedly, individual Wolf Cavalry swiftly retreated.
How could Ding Ling let Zhang Liao have his way, stabbing a Military Marquis to death, riding his horse towards the Wolf Cavalry army.
Alone, daringly chasing the Great Army!
Yet blockades and desperate attempts by several fierce generals fell upon the eyes of the players, like a thunderbolt out of the blue.
They murmured, aghast:
"Originally thought attaining the Wolf Cavalry position was a heavenly opportunity. And Ding Ling this scoundrel?! Practically not human!"
"How did he train?!"
"Isn’t it said players typically have to join a prominent family to become some general’s slave or servant to learn Breathing Technique? How did Ding Ling learn his Breathing Technique?"
"Are you silly? Surely it’s Tong Yuan who taught him!"
The fastest-running Wolf Cavalry were indeed players.
Understanding Ding Ling’s unmatched power.
They had their first direct experience!
Too terrifying it was!
That was Zhang Liao, one of the Five Generals, renowned for smashing ten thousand, shaking Jiangdong!
Yet even Zhang Liao was forced to flee after being helplessly killed by Ding Ling!
Watching Zhang Liao being pursued and hacked by Ding Ling.
The players were utterly astonished!
The deaths of Hu Feng, Wang Fang, Hao Meng, and other fierce generals didn’t stir much emotion within them.
But Zhang Liao was different!
This was a true Supreme General, famous throughout history, celebrated in later eras!
"Zhang Liao is nearly chopped to death!"

The players looked at each other, contemplating if they should aid Zhang Liao at this moment to gain his favor; obtaining the Achievement Medal simultaneously might make Zhang Liao grateful enough to impart some true Supreme Skill upon them?

"Isn’t it said players typically have to join a prominent family to become some general’s slave or servant to learn Breathing Technique?
How did Ding Ling learn his Breathing Technique?"
"Are you silly?
Surely it’s Tong Yuan who taught him!"
The fastest-running Wolf Cavalry were indeed players.
Understanding Ding Ling’s unmatched power.
They had their first direct experience!
Too terrifying it was!
That was Zhang Liao, one of the Five Generals, renowned for smashing ten thousand, shaking Jiangdong!
Yet even Zhang Liao was forced to flee after being helplessly killed by Ding Ling!
Watching Zhang Liao being pursued and hacked by Ding Ling.
The players were utterly astonished!
The deaths of Hu Feng, Wang Fang, Hao Meng, and other fierce generals didn’t stir much emotion within them.
But Zhang Liao was different!
This was a true Supreme General, famous throughout history, celebrated in later eras!
"Zhang Liao is nearly chopped to death!"

The players looked at each other, contemplating if they should aid Zhang Liao at this moment to gain his favor; obtaining the Achievement Medal simultaneously might make Zhang Liao grateful enough to impart some true Supreme Skill upon them?

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Narrow Escape from Death
paragraphs: In the beginning, Ding Ling didn’t know that the person he was fighting against was Zhang Liao.
But as the battle went on, more and more warriors shouted Zhang Liao and the others’ names.
Only then did Ding Ling realize who he was up against.
He understood, thinking no wonder this person was so difficult to deal with, it was Zhang Liao; that explained it.
If it were an ordinary person, Ding Ling would have killed him long ago.
But even if it was Zhang Liao, Ding Ling didn’t hold back at all.
If you want to kill him,
you must be prepared to be killed by him!
Boom!

Ding Ling’s Sword God Skill showed its power, stabbing and killing the last military marquis, then fiercely smashed down with the halberd in his hand, boom! It hit the back of Zhang Liao’s hooked scythe!
Clang! The force produced a ringing sound!
Zhang Liao’s hand trembled, and an unsteady grip caused the ancestral hooked scythe to be knocked away, falling to the ground.
Ding Ling took the opportunity to sweep his halberd towards Zhang Liao’s neck.
The strong wind rushed towards him.
The sharpness of the halberd’s edge seemed to cover the sky, crushing down as if it was going to completely drown and devour him!
Zhang Liao felt suffocated; never had he been so close to the Death God!

His heart raced to the extreme, pupils dilating and bloodshot; in the life-and-death crisis, he activated the Breathing Technique, boom! He suddenly rolled over on the horse’s back, falling off the horse, and rolled on the ground to pick up the hooked scythe. Without a word, he slashed heavily towards Ding Ling’s mount’s hoof.
Thud!
The horse’s leg was severed.
The sturdy horse let out a mournful cry and fell to its knees on the ground.
Ding Ling couldn’t balance, about to fall headfirst to the ground.

Zhang Liao was overjoyed, without hesitation, he leapt up, chopping towards Ding Ling’s face, pushing the Soaring Dragon Saber Technique to its limit! Boom! It seemed like a surging dragon blade manifested in the void, and the hooked scythe inscribed with the Yellow Dragon once again seemed to emit a dragon’s roar, buzz!
One slash cut through the waves, split the sea, diverted the flow! The path it took seemed to make the void tremble, as if it wanted to cleave Ding Ling into two.
Zhao Yun watched from afar, astonished.
He wanted to charge in for rescue but was blocked by the combined efforts of Cao Xing, Wei Xu, Song Xian, and other fierce generals.
The players watched intently, their eyes sparkling with a strange sense of anticipation.
Dong Huang, who had been saved by the Wolf Cavalry and saw this from afar, was grinning ear to ear, almost wanting to laugh out loud at Heaven’s mercy.
Yet in the next moment,
everyone who had been holding expectations came to a halt.

They saw Ding Ling’s body, like a drifting maple leaf, at the critical moment, straightened up, his toes lightly tapped the horse’s belly, and he shot out three to four meters away like a cannonball, narrowly avoiding Zhang Liao’s astonishing strike.
Thud!
The slash came down.
It actually cleaved the fallen sturdy horse in half!
Blood flowed across the ground, the horse let out two mournful cries, and the light in its eyes gradually dimmed.
It was imaginable.
If that slash landed on Ding Ling’s head, Ding Ling would have definitely died!
Ding Ling broke into a cold sweat.
Enraged, he rapidly activated two Breathing Techniques, boosting his Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix Spear and Sword God Skill.
He no longer needed the heavy halberd, casually tossing it aside.
He kicked up a long spear from the ground with his toes, holding the long spear in one hand and the Divine Sword in the other, quickly charging at Zhang Liao.
Zhang Liao’s expression changed slightly, without thinking, he turned and fled.
During the battle with Ding Ling, his stamina and endurance were severely depleted!
The previous slash almost exhausted the remaining strength in his body!
To continue fighting Ding Ling in anger would be a sure death.

But enraged, Ding Ling activated the Wall-Climbing Technique, with High Agility buff and Breathing Technique amplification, he seemed like lightning breaking through the sky, more like a desperate rabbit running across the grassland.
Whoosh!
He swept across the ground like a Xun Wind.
In just a moment, Ding Ling had already caught up with Zhang Liao, who had just leapt onto the back of an unmounted fine horse.
"General, be careful!"
Several players saw this and rushed towards Ding Ling, trying to curry favor with Zhang Liao.
They were prepared for this, charging so fast that just as Zhang Liao was about to be attacked by Ding Ling, they leapt out, brandishing long spears at Ding Ling.
Meanwhile, there were dozens of Wolf Cavalry members that they had brought along.
They all attacked Ding Ling together.
Some slashed with swords and spears, others shot arrows to kill.
Ding Ling’s Sword God Skill and Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear displayed their power, gunflowers flashed in the void, each sweeping area would inevitably take a life.
Compared to the heavy halberd.

The long spear was light as a feather in Ding Ling’s hand, almost nonexistent; wielding the long spear to perform Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix Spear and Howling Moon Spear Technique, he was unstoppable.
Gunflowers bloomed one after another.
Like sickles cutting through pigweeds!
Thud!
Crack!
Each Wolf Cavalry member’s forehead was pierced by the spear tip, and in the blink of an eye, seven or eight Wolf Cavalry members met their untimely end.
Enraged, Ding Ling entered berserk mode!
The long spear, like a poisonous dragon drill, pierced through skulls and organs wherever it went!
The Shuoyue Sword, like a scorching sun fallen to Earth, often swept through large areas!
The Sword God Breathing Technique-enhanced Sword God Skill projected mesmerizing Flowers in Bloom patterns among the Wolf Cavalry, inflicting massive damage in an instant.
Though not enough to kill.
But sweeping through with Floral Sword God Map was enough to instill dread, shatter courage, and wreck spirits.
The players who had just rushed up didn’t understand what had happened when they felt a stabbing pain in their forehead and were then taken down.
They couldn’t comprehend it even in their dying moments.
How could the gap be this wide for players both?
They couldn’t even manage to put up a slight hindrance?!
Too terrifying!
They just hoped that after they were resurrected, they could find Zhang Liao to obtain his Secret Technique or Martial Arts, otherwise, their deaths would be in vain.
Therefore.
They sincerely hoped Zhang Liao wouldn’t die!
But they wouldn’t see the subsequent battlefield situation anymore.

Like chopping vegetables, Ding Ling killed and wounded five to sixty surrounding Wolf Cavalry members, then pursued Zhang Liao, only to see that Zhang Liao had already fled into a group of Wolf Cavalry dozens of meters away.
Seeing Ding Ling kill and wound all the Wolf Cavalry who came to his aid, Zhang Liao was both shocked and furious, fearing Ding Ling for the first time with great reverence.
[Achievement Medal obtained: You’ve struck deep fear into Zhang Liao! And made him hold extreme admiration for you!]

[Note: Zhang Liao has rarely faced moments of life and death. Today he experienced several times. Your martial power has intimidated him! Your various exquisite ultimate skills also made him admire you!
If it weren’t for being on opposing sides,
he would surely be willing to be friends with you. Because you’re too strong!
Zhang Liao loves exchanging techniques with strong people and being friends with them. Because it grants him significant progress!
But your killing has already enraged him.
You two may have another battle in the future!
He won’t hold back against you. Because he’s afraid of being killed by you!]
The notification sound brushed past his ear.
Ding Ling ignored it.
It’s not just Zhang Liao who was enraged.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Unstoppable (17/50)
paragraphs: Ding Ling was also extremely angry.
If he doesn’t completely cripple this group of Wolf Cavalry who always chase and bite him today,
he would never give up!
Even though it’s a game, that split second just now still sent a shiver down his spine, like needles piercing bones, blades scraping his back.
He didn’t want to die!
Even in the Game World, it’s the same.
Because a sixth sense from somewhere told him that dying would definitely cause a lot of trouble later.
This sixth sense came from a sort of blessing from the ’library’.
Ding Ling didn’t know the specifics.
But he trusted this feeling, if he could avoid death, then he must not die!
On his journey so far,
Ding Ling had been very steady, courageous, and strategic in his killings.
He would never do anything without certainty.
But even so,
just now, he almost stumbled, which made him vigilant and realize that before killing someone, he must not underestimate or overlook them!
Even a lion fights a rabbit with all its strength!
How could he show mercy just because the opponent is a famous general?
Ding Ling sprinted like a galloping horse, not a bit slower than a fit horse!
"Shoot!"
Zhang Liao ordered.
Shu-shu!
An overwhelming rain of arrows poured down on Ding Ling.

Ding Ling thrust with his long spear, skewering a corpse to use as a shield in front of him, with his left hand swinging the Shuoyue Sword non-stop. The Sword God Skill was unleashed, with the Setting Sun Diagram and Flowers in Full Bloom spinning and blooming in the void, deflecting some of the sharp arrows.
Clatter-clatter!
Ding Ling sprinted, like the leaping thunder, a divine being in the air, extremely fast, pushing through the arrow rain. In just moments, he charged into the midst of the Wolf Cavalry.
In the stunned, terrified eyes of the Wolf Cavalry,
Boom!
Ding Ling smashed the corpse skewered on his spear heavily onto the foremost Wolf Rider, with a loud crash, sending him flying with a scream, crashing into several cavalry before finally stopping.

Ding Ling took the opportunity to leap onto the horseback, squeezing the horse’s belly, unleashing his full-level Horse Taming Skill, controlling his mount, charging towards the densest cluster of Wolf Cavalry.
Wherever the crowd is,
the Wolf Cavalry wouldn’t dare to shoot! Otherwise, they would risk killing their own by mistake.
"How terrifying!"

Watching Ding Ling fearlessly wielding a sword in one hand and a spear in the other, riding through the Wolf Cavalry slaughtering left and right, with almost no opponent able to withstand a single move!
Indeed, touching means injury, brushing means death!
The sounds of grunts and screams constantly tore through the night sky.
Zhang Liao’s body trembled and shook!
He had never been so afraid of anyone like this moment!
Not even Lü Bu was this fierce!
Ding Ling was truly too ferocious, too terrifying.
"Retreat quickly!"
Wei Xu, Song Xian, Cao Xing, and others also retreated into the main troop.
Ding Ling saw Cao Xing and immediately charged towards him!
He had his eyes on Cao Xing’s mount!
Moreover, Cao Xing’s archery skill was terrifyingly formidable, with him around, Ding Ling’s Double Extreme Arrow Skill couldn’t show its might!
As long as he takes Cao Xing down!
Ding Ling could use the Double Extreme Arrow Skill to absolutely intimidate the Wolf Cavalry!
Ding Ling’s mind was perfectly clear.
He knew he couldn’t kill Zhang Liao in a short time, even though Zhang Liao looked exhausted now, but he was resting and recovering within the crowd.
Ding Ling couldn’t do anything about him temporarily.
After taking down Cao Xing.
Then using the Double Extreme Arrow Skill to deal with Zhang Liao, success would be twice as likely with half the effort!
Gallop-gallop!
Ridding speedily.
Wherever he headed, no one could stop him!
The Wolf Riders who tried to obstruct him were easily killed by Ding Ling.
His immensely strong body exerted tremendous might at this moment!
His endurance and stamina were astonishing, far surpassing top-tier experts!
Up to now in the battle, still maintaining peak combat strength, executing absolute crush and massacre upon the Wolf Cavalry!
Zhang Liao might burst out, his power could match Task a hit or two.
But his physicality was definitely far inferior to Ding Ling!
Ding Ling could be described as a polygonal warrior!
Strength, agility, and physique had all broken their shackles multiple times. Defense had also broken a shackle once!
A comprehensive development indeed!
Normal third-class fierce generals couldn’t withstand even a single spear from him!
Momentarily being stabbed to death!
Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear!
Howling Moon Spear Technique!
Spirit Crane Spear Technique!
Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique!
Various spear techniques constantly changing, sometimes exuding overbearing aura, sometimes eerily agile, and sometimes transforming into patterns of spear flower diagrams!
No one could predict what Ding Ling’s next move would be.
Seeing Ding Ling breaking through waves like splitting the sea, charging towards their own troops.
Wei Xu, Song Xian, Cao Xing, and others were terrified.
Especially since Zhao Yun was also chasing behind them.
A wolf at the front, a tiger at the back!
There’s no retreat, nowhere to escape.
Wei Xu and others exchanged a glance, and actually charged towards Ding Ling.
They had no choice.
Ding Ling was evidently coming for them.
They could only fight desperately!
At the same time, they ordered some Wolf Riders to launch indiscriminate shooting at Zhao Yun and Ding Ling!
They could no longer care about anything at this moment.
If they didn’t counterattack, they truly would be facing an unprecedented life and death crisis.
Shoo-shoo!
Occasionally, cold arrows could be seen bursting forth from oblique angles, most targeting Zhao Yun’s and Ding Ling’s mounts.
Zhao Yun, tired from the fight till now, his mount was hit by a cold arrow with a cry of pain, nearly toppling to the ground.
Zhao Yun’s face changed dramatically, leaping off the horseback, cautiously deflecting the cold arrows aimed at him to protect his Night-Shining Jade Lion.
This mount was a gift from his master, and he did not wish for it to be harmed.
He looked at Ding Ling, seeing him still exuberantly fierce, and couldn’t help but exhale in relief.
Simultaneously, he secretly admired.
He had been arduously repelling a few fierce generals under Wei Xu, Song Xian, Cao Xing, et al.
Still, he felt strained.
Mainly due to Cao Xing’s cold arrows’ formidable power, a misstep might lead to getting hit.
Not just Cao Xing’s cold arrows, many cold arrows aimed at him secretly as well, he could no longer count how many there were.
Were it not for this, he wouldn’t have felt so exhausted.
At this moment, seeing Ding Ling decisively killing, slashing in all directions, coming and going as he pleased, naturally moving tremendously, thinking:
"Ding Ling’s physicality might have exceeded my imagination! His endurance and stamina are really too strong."
Boom!

Ding Ling’s mount was toppled by a cold arrow, previously caught off guard, but now prepared. Just as the mount began to fall, he kicked off the horseback, his body like a sword emerging from its sheath, executing a swift flash, already arriving in front of a Wolf Rider, piercing him with a spear, and with a light leap, mounted back on a horse, continuing charging towards Wei Xu and others.
He didn’t shield his mount at all.
Charging with extreme ferocity and speed.
As long as the mount wasn’t hit on vital spots, it could recklessly gallop forward under Ding Ling’s Horse Taming Skill!
Very quickly,
Ding Ling collided with Wei Xu and the others.
Zhang Liao felt his scalp tingling, instinctively shouting:
"Watch out!"
Boom!
Clang! Clang! Clang!
As soon as both sides met, they unleashed their strongest Supreme Skills.

Mainly due to Cao Xing’s cold arrows’ formidable power, a misstep might lead to getting hit.
Not just Cao Xing’s cold arrows, many cold arrows aimed at him secretly as well, he could no longer count how many there were.
Were it not for this, he wouldn’t have felt so exhausted.
At this moment, seeing Ding Ling decisively killing, slashing in all directions, coming and going as he pleased, naturally moving tremendously, thinking:
"Ding Ling’s physicality might have exceeded my imagination!
His endurance and stamina are really too strong."
Boom!
Ding Ling’s mount was toppled by a cold arrow, previously caught off guard, but now prepared.

Just as the mount began to fall, he kicked off the horseback, his body like a sword emerging from its sheath, executing a swift flash, already arriving in front of a Wolf Rider, piercing him with a spear, and with a light leap, mounted back on a horse, continuing charging towards Wei Xu and others.
He didn’t shield his mount at all.
Charging with extreme ferocity and speed.
As long as the mount wasn’t hit on vital spots, it could recklessly gallop forward under Ding Ling’s Horse Taming Skill!
Very quickly,
Ding Ling collided with Wei Xu and the others.
Zhang Liao felt his scalp tingling, instinctively shouting:
"Watch out!"
Boom!
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!
As soon as both sides met, they unleashed their strongest Supreme Skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Ferghana Horse
paragraphs: "Mountain Opening Saber Technique!"
Song Xian slashed fiercely, as if he could split mountains and cleave the earth. The explosive vigorous qi rolled through the void, aiming directly at Ding Ling’s head!
"Infinite Spear Technique!"
Wei Xu’s spear trembled, a surging force following the spearhead toward Ding Ling’s vulnerable neck!
"Tornado Arrow!"
Cao Xing stood behind the others, drawing his bow and shooting three arrows in succession at Ding Ling’s head, neck, and heart!
Other second-class generals also unleashed their ultimate techniques.
For a moment.
The blade’s edge, arrow rain, spear gleam, and axe’s force seemed to engulf Ding Ling!

Ding Ling, invigorated and fearless, swung the Shuoyue Sword with his left hand, producing thousands of sword blossoms, while his right hand wielded the spear, creating numerous Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix patterns!
Clang!
The Shuoyue Sword clashed with the arrows, occasionally vibrating, keeping them firmly at bay!
Even when stray arrows hit Ding Ling from unexpected angles, they did not strike his vital points.
Relying on his impressive defense, Ding Ling focused only on protecting vital areas like his head, neck, and heart, with less attention to other parts.
He aimed to kill his opponents swiftly.
Thus, he concentrated his defenses!
This strategy widened his attack range and intensified his counterattack!
Boom!
His spear pierced forward, striking Wei Xu’s spear with immense force, causing it to shake uncontrollably and fly out of his hand!
Seizing the opportunity, Ding Ling struck Wei Xu’s forehead with his spear!
Thud!
A spray of blood!
Filled with confusion, disbelief, regret, and longing for life.
Wei Xu closed his eyes forever.
"Wei Xu!"

Other fierce warriors were shocked, angry, and scared. Some, fueled by rage, attacked Ding Ling with even more terrifying strength, hacking at him wildly, as if driven to madness, intent on mutual destruction.
Others, paralyzed by fear, lost strength in their limbs, their combat power greatly diminished, and fell one after another under Ding Ling’s attack!
Intimidating many others.
Ding Ling hesitated not at all.
With another spear strike, the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear flashed and vanished in the void, thud!
Striking the neck of the maddened Song Xian!
Thud!
The spear point pierced his vital area.

Song Xian’s strength dissipated madly, his slashes became weak, the once formidable force lost, easily deflected by Ding Ling’s spear, the broadsword flew into the air, smashed heavily by Ding Ling’s spear body, sending it flying like a meteor, shooting toward Cao Xing!
Five or six Military Marquises and two valiant generals fell.
Cao Xing, dazed, found his drawing hand weakening.
Awakened by Zhang Liao’s shout, Cao Xing attempted to turn and flee.
But he was too late.
Cao Xing was at the end of his strength.
Strenuous arrow shooting had drained him completely!
He could only rely on his mount to escape.
His mount was extremely fast.
But not faster than Ding Ling’s spear!
Ding Ling wielded his fully-leveled throwing skill.
Heavily hurling the spear toward Cao Xing’s fleeing direction.
Whoosh!
Crack!
A piercing sound of armor-breaking split the night sky.
With a scream.
The immense force on the spear dragged Cao Xing off his horse, hurtling to the ground!
Ding Ling seized the moment, riding swiftly to catch up to Cao Xing’s mount, standing upright on his own horse, leaping onto another horse’s back.
Neigh!
The horse reared, attempting to throw Ding Ling off.
Ding Ling’s horse taming skill prevailed, strongly clamping the horse’s flanks, steering it back after several head turns. The horse, in pain, ceased resisting, obediently carrying Ding Ling.
"Good horse!"
Ding Ling sensed the horse’s extraordinary nature.
Truly a peerless steed, rivaling the Night-Shining Jade Lion!
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: You have tamed a Ferghana Horse!]
[Note: One of the world’s top-class steed, the Ferghana Horse! Taming it is a remarkable achievement!]
Upon hearing the notification tone, Ding Ling suddenly understood.
It turned out to be a Ferghana Horse. No wonder it was so exceptional.
And it was among the few outstanding horses!
Meaning this horse ranks in the top ten of this world and era!
Ding Ling couldn’t help but feel a slight joy.
For a war general.
The support of a good horse is immense.
In earlier battles against the Bandits Bai Bo, Ding Ling realized this point, always longing for a truly peerless horse, though in vain.
Today, it finally happened.
With the Ferghana Horse, Ding Ling’s aura soared, appearing more domineering, terrifying!
Ding Ling sheathed his left-hand Shuoyue Sword, gripping the reins, steering the Ferghana Horse toward Zhang Liao.
The Ferghana Horse was remarkably tall.
And extremely fast!
With Ding Ling riding its momentum, nothing could stand in his way!
"Retreat!"
Zhang Liao, terrified and enraged to the extreme.
But he had no confidence in defeating Ding Ling!
Forced to stifle his anguish, he shouted crisply, leading a large contingent of Wolf Cavalry to swiftly retreat toward their path.
Zhang Liao never imagined this battle would conclude with such an unimaginable result!
It exceeded his expectations!
Mind you, this was commanded by Wei Xu, Song Xian, and others, leading the Wolf Riders!
Against two people!
Yet they suffered utter defeat!
Zhang Liao glanced at Dong Huang, galloping fearfully, turning occasionally to look back, and sighed privately, thinking:
"Had it not been for the concern over Dong Huang’s life, initiating the encounter with long-range arrow rain over Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, we wouldn’t have faced such a disastrous defeat!"
He regretted:
"Had I known, even facing Prime Minister Dong’s punishment, I should have ordered the long-range arrow rain without hesitation."
To achieve the perfect result.
He chose to rescue Dong Huang.
Clearly overestimating his and Chenglian’s combat strength;
And underestimating Ding Ling and Zhao Yun’s slaughter capability!
A close encounter, nearly a complete loss!
"If Ding Ling’s stamina had been slightly less, the outcome might have reversed. But alas, there’s no if."’
Witnessing Ding Ling’s slaughter of hundreds, and dozens of generals.
He remained as valiant, fierce beyond compare.
Zhang Liao felt an unsettling chill.
Especially after Ding Ling acquired the Ferghana Horse, becoming even more formidable, unstoppable!
How could Zhang Liao dare to engage?
He had not yet restored his strength; fighting Ding Ling would mean inviting death!
Long-range arrow cover?
Now it was useless too.
Stopping to chase and shoot, this wasn’t the grassland, too narrow to maneuver. Easily trailing by Ding Ling on the Ferghana Horse, leading to something akin to alley fighting.
Ultimately, they would suffer again!
Calculating, their chance of defeat was enormous.
Whoosh!
"Ah!"
With the sound slicing through the air, screams occasionally echoed from behind.
Looking back, Zhang Liao saw Ding Ling bending, drawing, and shooting, the Double Extremes Arrow swiftly ending one Wolf Cavalry after another.
Zhang Liao was utterly furious, dismayed, and despondent!

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Overlord Halberd Technique
paragraphs: Zhang Liao badly wanted to join the fight again.
But he knew he couldn’t.
He had to quickly return to the supply point and regroup with Hua Xiong!
As long as he joined forces with the Heavy Cavalry Flying Bear Army and reached the vast territory!
The offensive and defensive roles would surely reverse!
Whoosh, whoosh!
The sounds of arrows breaking through the air were continuous.
After shooting down no less than fifty to sixty lagging Wolf Cavalry, Ding Ling reached for more arrows but found nothing.
He picked up the spear hanging from one side of his horse, galloped forward, and came to the mount of a dead Wolf Rider, pulling the quiver, bow, and arrows hanging from the horse’s side.
The arrows he had prepared earlier had been taken away by that scoundrel Dong Huang amid the chaos.
Along with those few horses.
Ding Ling could only shoot arrows while replenishing his equipment along the way.
Luckily, every Wolf Rider had a bow and a quiver.
Ding Ling was not short of arrows.
His Ferghana Horse had great stamina and was fast.
Chasing and shooting at the Wolf Riders all the way.
Dong Huang, no longer caring about the "spoils of war," abandoned Ding Ling’s earlier mount and sped away alone, lightening his load.
Zhang Liao saw this, seethed with hatred, and regretted saving Dong Huang even more.
To save that useless Dong Huang.
He sacrificed Wei Xu, Song Xian, Houcheng, and the others.
It was totally not worth it!
Zhang Liao knew that even if he survived, he would definitely face severe punishment.
How could Lü Bu tolerate such a big mistake?

The more Zhang Liao thought about it, the heavier his heart became, especially with Ding Ling occasionally shooting cold arrows from behind the Wolf Cavalry, making it impossible for him to ignore Ding Ling’s "mounts."
After catching up with his earlier "mount," Ding Ling picked up a Five-Stone Bow from the side of one of the horse’s flanks.
BOOM!
The power of the Five-Stone Bow far surpassed his previous Two-Stone Bow!
Faster speed, greater strength! Vigorous Qi surged overwhelmingly!
The Double Extremes Arrow enhanced by the Breathing Technique!
Shooting it with the Five-Stone Bow.
At close range, one arrow could pierce through the belly of a lightly armored Wolf Rider and still hit another!
One arrow killed or injured two people!
Two Double Extremes Arrows.
In an instant, they could cause four casualties!
With the Five-Stone Bow’s support.
Ding Ling’s Double Extremes Arrows were even more formidable!
Whizz, whizz, whizz!
Like the Death God urging souls! Like King Yama taking spirits!
The Wolf Cavalry suffered heavy casualties.
In less than a moment, hundreds more souls were added to the dead!
Zhang Liao was furious, wanting to turn around and fight desperately.
But seeing Ding Ling bend his bow and shoot over a hundred times without exhausting himself, he couldn’t help but be astonished and found it unbelievable.
If it were Cao Xing.
He would probably have been out of strength long ago!
Even he wouldn’t have lasted.
Ding Ling slaughtered all the way and could still exert strong combat power now, truly inhuman!
"Huh?"
Ding Ling stopped after chasing for over ten miles.
Because he saw what seemed to be more of the great army rushing ahead in the territory.
Clip-clop, clip-clop!
The sound of horse hooves shook the earth and sky.
Louder than the alignment of the Wolf Cavalry.
"Are more enemies coming?"
Ding Ling thought for a moment, then turned his horse to leave.
Since he couldn’t kill Zhang Liao.
Ding Ling would not press the issue.
He had already achieved his goal.
Over a thousand Wolf Riders were almost entirely slaughtered by him!
Only two or three hundred remnants remained.
Out of dozens of might warriors, only Zhang Liao was left.
In such a situation.
If the enemy were wise, they would no longer pursue him.
If they still pursued.
Ding Ling had plenty of ways to retaliate.
Ding Ling thought this way and then urged his horse to speed back to the original spot.
The speed of the Ferghana Horse was astonishingly fast.
At least twice as fast as his earlier mount, truly an unrivaled steed.
"No wonder warriors love fine horses."
Ding Ling, riding the Ferghana Horse, only felt a strong wind hitting his face, with an indescribable sense of freedom and comfort.
After a while.
Ding Ling arrived at Zhao Yun’s side.
Zhao Yun had already performed a simple bandage on the Night-Shining Jade Lion.
The Night-Shining Jade Lion, worthy of being a peerless horse, had a very high recovery rate, now able to run again.
Ding Ling, with many medical skills at full level,
also checked and medicated the Night-Shining Jade Lion,
accelerating its recovery speed.
"Here."
Zhao Yun handed a thin Secret Manual to Ding Ling:
"I took it from Wei Xu’s body."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling, curious, took it and glanced at it.
The Secret Manual was stained with blood.
But the large characters on the front were still clear:
"Overlord Halberd Technique"!
"Huh?!"
Ding Ling’s pupils contracted.
Waves rippled in his heart, uncertain."
He thought of many legendary stories at that moment.
Suppressing his emotions, he quickly flipped through it.
The Secret Manual was made of silk, only five or six pages!
It had stances and mantras.
Filled with densely packed writing.
Only the surface of the Secret Manual was blood-stained, the inside was very clean.
So Ding Ling could clearly and thoroughly see everything about the Overlord Halberd Technique.
Very quickly.
He finished reading.
Closed his eyes.
A book "Overlord Halberd Technique" condensed on the library shelf instantly!
In a flash.
[Overlord Halberd Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.6]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.4]
In terms of improvements in strength, agility, and constitution.
The overall data was no less impressive than the Dawn Swordsmanship!
The Sword God Skill’s Sunset Swordsmanship is Strength +0.4, Agility +0.6, Constitution +0.4.
And the Overlord Halberd Technique clearly focused more on strength!
As Ding Ling continued to grow stronger.
Even high-tier Martial Arts could grant him diminishing Attribute Points!
So in some sense, the Overlord Halberd Technique was even stronger than the Sunset Swordsmanship!
This demonstrated the terror of the Overlord Halberd Technique!
Of course, the Sword God Skill was a combination of several Sword Techniques, and for the Overlord Halberd Technique to surpass a part of the Sword God Skill was not surprising to Ding Ling.
Because only after truly comprehending the Overlord Halberd Technique did he realize its dominance and ferocity!
In terms of attack power, the Overlord Halberd Technique was the strongest Supreme Skill that Ding Ling currently possessed!
The Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, Sword God Skill focused more on speed! Highest agility!
The Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques focused on strength and constitution! High in both strength and constitution!
Only the Overlord Halberd Technique focused solely on strength!
This was a Supreme Skill that could bring strength to its fullest potential!
BOOM!
Ding Ling’s bones vibrated.
His whole body felt hot, muscles, tendons, and channels were forging and improving!
His internal organs were mysteriously strengthened once again!

Countless Halberd Technique Esoteric Truths and essences surged through the depths of his Sea of Consciousness, then transformed into a torrent, flowing into Ding Ling’s every limb, turning into an instinct!
At this moment.
Ding Ling suddenly became a Grandmaster who could easily wield the Overlord Halberd Technique!
"Overlord Halberd Technique!"
Ding Ling tightly grasped the Heaven-piercing Halberd.

Took a deep breath, suddenly opened his eyes, a sharp aura flashed across his eyes, and he struck forward to the left with the Heaven-piercing Halberd, BOOM! The void seemed to shatter, vaguely hearing the sound of thunder roaring!
As if a towering Overlord was roaring!
BOOM!
The Overlord Halberd Technique unfolded, and at that moment, Ding Ling seemed to transform into an Overlord that could destroy everything in the world, able to strike against the ancient Canglong!

Of course, the Sword God Skill was a combination of several Sword Techniques, and for the Overlord Halberd Technique to surpass a part of the Sword God Skill was not surprising to Ding Ling.
Because only after truly comprehending the Overlord Halberd Technique did he realize its dominance and ferocity!
In terms of attack power, the Overlord Halberd Technique was the strongest Supreme Skill that Ding Ling currently possessed!
The Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, Sword God Skill focused more on speed!
Highest agility!
The Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques focused on strength and constitution!
High in both strength and constitution!
Only the Overlord Halberd Technique focused solely on strength!
This was a Supreme Skill that could bring strength to its fullest potential!
BOOM!
Ding Ling’s bones vibrated.
His whole body felt hot, muscles, tendons, and channels were forging and improving!
His internal organs were mysteriously strengthened once again!

Countless Halberd Technique Esoteric Truths and essences surged through the depths of his Sea of Consciousness, then transformed into a torrent, flowing into Ding Ling’s every limb, turning into an instinct!
At this moment.
Ding Ling suddenly became a Grandmaster who could easily wield the Overlord Halberd Technique!
"Overlord Halberd Technique!"
Ding Ling tightly grasped the Heaven-piercing Halberd.
Took a deep breath, suddenly opened his eyes, a sharp aura flashed across his eyes, and he struck forward to the left with the Heaven-piercing Halberd, BOOM!
The void seemed to shatter, vaguely hearing the sound of thunder roaring!
As if a towering Overlord was roaring!
BOOM!
The Overlord Halberd Technique unfolded, and at that moment, Ding Ling seemed to transform into an Overlord that could destroy everything in the world, able to strike against the ancient Canglong!

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Tornado Arrow Skill, Volume One (20/50)
paragraphs: A chilling, overbearing aura emanated from Ding Ling.
The halberd in his hand seemed to come alive at this moment!
It became extraordinarily agile!
Sometimes it seemed it could pierce the clouds to strike the Celestial God, other times it seemed capable of plunging a hundred feet into the earth to hit a Ground Dragon!
Unrestrained and fearless!
Domineering and fierce!
Wham!
Ding Ling, having only executed a few essential moves of the Overlord Halberd Technique, immediately withdrew his Heaven-piercing Halberd.
He took a deep breath and looked at Zhao Yun:
"This Overlord Halberd Technique is truly remarkable. How did you discover that Wei Xu had hidden this secret manual in his bosom?"
Zhao Yun gulped with difficulty, though he had long been awed by Ding Ling.
Yet seeing Ding Ling cultivate the Overlord Halberd Technique to the mastery level within a few breaths left Zhao Yun utterly stunned!
It’s just that he had already browsed through this secret manual while waiting for Ding Ling.
Unfortunately.
Though he understood it, he knew his limits. Without a master’s guidance, he could at most cultivate it to a middle-tier level, beyond which he could not progress.
Even reaching middle-tier might require several years of extended effort!
And Ding Ling?
He had already surpassed high tier and achieved complete mastery, reaching the great success into innate ability level!
Incredible!
Zhao Yun admired inwardly but said,

"After you killed Wei Xu, he fell off his horse, rolling to the ground, and that’s when this secret manual emerged from his bosom. I inadvertently saw this, and after you went to pursue the Wolf Cavalry Legion, I went forward to pick up the manual, recognizing it as the Overlord Halberd Technique, I knew it would definitely suit you.
And it indeed does.
This Overlord Halberd Technique suits you perfectly.
You have always wielded the Heaven-piercing Halberd, yet using axe techniques, saber techniques, and spear techniques couldn’t fully unleash the halberd’s maximum power.
Now with the Heaven-piercing Halberd paired with the Overlord Halberd Technique,
Your combat power is sure to reach a new height!"
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude.
Zhao Yun waved his hand repeatedly, signaling that Ding Ling shouldn’t be formal with him.
He then inquired about Ding Ling’s related combat situation.
Ding Ling briefly covered the main points.
Zhao Yun felt nervous, saying:
"We should leave quickly, then. Continuous fighting, even iron will wear you down!"
Ding Ling nodded, but before leaving, he decided to loot the bodies.
He had never done this before.
Because he felt it was impossible for someone to carry their family’s secret techniques or supreme skills on them!
Most people would have memorized them thoroughly, like Dong Huang!
This is the correct way to inherit a family’s supreme skills!
But Zhao Yun acquiring the Overlord Halberd Technique suddenly made him realize something.
Family’s supreme skills might not be carried, but those passed from others?
Like this Overlord Halberd Technique!
Ding Ling speculated there was a seventy to eighty percent chance it was passed to Wei Xu by Lü Bu.
Because Wei Xu was Lü Bu’s brother-in-law!
The two had familial ties; Wei Xu was one of the people Lü Bu trusted and was closest to. Passing the Overlord Halberd Technique to Wei Xu at his wife’s request was very plausible.
Of course, this was just a possibility.
There was also a twenty to thirty percent chance Wei Xu stole it himself, or Lü Bu’s wife stole it for him.
As for why he thought it was Lü Bu’s halberd technique?
Such a domineering and terrifying Overlord Halberd Technique, if not Lü Bu’s, then whose? Wei Xu’s own?!
Naturally.
The specific facts await verification.
But to unexpectedly obtain such an unparalleled supreme skill as the Overlord Halberd Technique was undoubtedly a delightful surprise for Ding Ling!
Therefore.
He suddenly had the notion to loot corpses.
He mainly focused on the corpses of officers above the village chief level.
He looted seven or eight consecutively, finding nothing.
Confused, Zhao Yun asked for the reason and came to help.
His luck seemed much better than Ding Ling’s, as shortly he said to Ding Ling:
"I found one."
"Hmm?!"
Ding Ling was surprised.
Zhao Yun truly had amazing luck!
He found one after searching only two.
While Ding Ling had searched almost eleven without any gains.
Ding Ling signaled Zhao Yun to keep searching.
He continued as well.
After looting dozens of officers’ corpses,
Ding Ling still found nothing.
He sighed.
Looking at the two secret manuals in Zhao Yun’s hand, he was speechless.
He thought about Zhao Yun’s lifetime of warfare, ending without any scars on his body, and couldn’t help but ponder:

"Dian Wei, a super-elite expert, met a tragic end in Wan City! Lü Bu, Zhang Fei, Guan Yu, and other super-elites all suffered injuries! Only Zhao Yun remained unscathed throughout his life! Truly a child of fortune! A favored of the Heavenly Dao!"
Ding Ling glanced at Zhao Yun with a curious look.
He thought keeping Zhao Yun beside him might be a very wise decision.
Having such a lucky general around might indeed bring some good fortune.
Like right now.
Ding Ling accepted the two secret manuals and glanced at them:
"Tornado Arrow Skill!"
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted.
It’s actually Cao Xing’s supreme skill?!
This is impossible!
How could he carry a supreme skill on him?
He glanced at Zhao Yun.
Zhao Yun explained,
"It wasn’t found on Cao Xing. It was discovered in Houcheng’s bosom."
’Oh?’
Houcheng was one of Lü Bu’s Eight Brave Generals, a renowned fierce general in history.
Joining Wei Xu and others in a battle against Zhao Yun, he was unfortunately stabbed to death.
Such a fierce general normally wouldn’t die so easily against an ordinary first-class warrior, but he was unlucky to face Zhao Yun with his exceptionally fast spear!
"How did Houcheng end up with Cao Xing’s supreme archery skill?"
Ding Ling couldn’t fathom it.
But he chose to first examine the Tornado Arrow Skill.
It was inscribed on silk fabric.
Containing only three pages.
The recorded Tornado Arrow Skill only had half the moves and mantras.
Ding Ling felt his enthusiasm forcibly halted mid-flow.
He was almost choked by disappointment!
"What a pity, such a pity."
Such a supreme skill, yet only half remains.
However, half is better than none.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A remarkably thin secret manual rapidly coalesced on the library shelf:
"Tornado Arrow Skill, Vol. 1!"
In the next moment.
[Tornado Arrow Skill Vol. 1 Full Level]
[Defense +0.1]
His body felt slightly warm.
The plastron, meridians, and more all enhanced slightly.
Defense power increased by 0.1.
After Double Extreme Arrow Skill reached full level, defense increased by +0.4
Tornado Arrow Skill only added 0.1.
Ding Ling ventured a guess, perhaps because there was only half of it and also due to his improved strength.
Because he knew very well that the Tornado Arrow Skill was absolutely not inferior to the Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
If his breathing technique wasn’t stronger than Cao Xing’s,
The three arrows of the Tornado Arrow Skill would definitely provide a considerable critical hit over the Double Extreme Arrow Skill!
Having an additional arrow with attack power and speed, the destructive force is imaginable!
"Let’s try."
Ding Ling drew his bow and set the arrows.
The two breathing techniques activated simultaneously.
At the same time, Tornado Arrow Skill and Double Extreme Arrow Skill were also activated.
Twack twack twack!
Three sharp arrows were positioned to the left, center, and right of the big bow by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling aimed at a large tree in front.
Release!
Bam!
A crisp sound.
The three arrows, carrying whirlwind and keenness, flew like meteors through the void, thudding into the large tree, penetrating three inches deep!

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Cao Mengde to Campaign Against Dong Zhuo
paragraphs: "Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
Although the Tornado Arrow Skill was only half a volume.
But because it was simultaneously supported by two kinds of ultimate Breathing Techniques.
Combined with the Double Extreme Arrow Skill.
It could also shoot three arrows at once!
Moreover, each arrow carried the Vortex Qi of the Tornado Arrow Skill, enhancing the speed and attack power of the arrows!
Not only did it carry the attributes of the Tornado Arrow.
It also had the fierce attributes of the Double Extreme Arrow!
This made Ding Ling’s arrows far more powerful than before!
If compared again with Cao Xing, the Divine Archer.
Ding Ling would certainly come out on top, absolutely overwhelming him!
"If only I could obtain the complete Tornado Arrow Skill."
So thought Ding Ling.
But soon, he put this matter aside.
Being able to get half of the Tornado Arrow Skill was already a fortune, and he couldn’t demand too much.
He looked towards another Secret Manual.
On the cover were large characters:
"Golden Gate Saber Technique"!
After flipping through it once.
It immediately formed a complete volume in the library.
In an instant.
[Golden Gate Saber Technique Full Level]
[Defense +0.3]
The essence of all the Esoteric Truth of saber techniques flashed before integrating into his body instinctively.
Not only did it enhance Ding Ling’s foundation.
His defense power also increased a bit.
This was a Martial Arts that was in no way inferior to the Gale Spear Technique!
It’s also because Ding Ling’s strength was continually improving, making such lower-tiered martial arts bring him fewer attribute points.
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel.
Strength:
[Root Bone 1 (1 point for ordinary people), Wisdom 2, Strength 24.6+0.6 (25.2), Agility 21.9+0.4 (22.3), Constitution 21.3+0.4 (21.7), Defense 17.9+0.4+0.5+0.1+0.3 (19.2), Charisma 4]
His strength had already reached a terrifying two thousand five hundred pounds!
An absolute top Super-Elite expert!
Agility and Constitution also surpassed the usual Super-Elite!
Defense was close to Super-Elite!
Ding Ling felt invigorated.
After several enhancements.
The previously heavily depleted stamina and energy were actually recovering very quickly.
However, closely following was a rumbling stomach.
Hunger was now acting up.
Ding Ling resisted the hunger, looking towards Zhao Yun:
"Let’s go.
The Golden Gate Saber Technique originated from Song Xian.
This was said by Zhao Yun.
And Song Xian’s family martial art was clearly the Mountain Opening Saber Technique!
This Golden Gate Saber Technique must have been an unexpected gain for Song Xian, as Ding Ling had never seen Song Xian use this saber technique!
Or was this Golden Gate Saber Technique a gift to Song Xian from someone else?
The specifics were unknown.
However, these three Secret Manuals.
For Ding Ling, they undoubtedly originated from the Eight Brave Generals!
Yet, there was nothing on Cao Xing and the other Eight Brave Generals.
It was clear that not everyone carried a Secret Manual.
Apart from the Secret Manuals.
Ding Ling also took along a lot of arrow quivers, healing medicine, and some dry food.
He initially planned to hunt and have a barbecue.
Since there were supplies on the side of the Wolf Cavalry’s mounts, it saved effort and trouble.
Ding Ling ate while riding, alleviating his hunger.
What surprised them was.
There was no large army chasing them.
Even when they arrived before the next city, someone opened the city gate for them to pass.
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Zhao Yun also found it bewildering.
Things were so chaotic just yesterday.
How could Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu let them go?
For this, Ding Ling specially picked an opportune moment to return to reality for a bit, connect to the neighbor’s WiFi, and search online for this reason.
Only then did he understand.
"So it’s related to Dong Huang."
Unexpectedly, this guy went back and greatly extolled my prowess!
Plus, Cao Mengde had already assembled a great army to assault Hulao Pass!
At this time, Dong Zhuo was plagued by both internal and external troubles!
He naturally wished for me to leave his Si Li territory quickly, eager to send away this Plague God!
"Cao Mengde is already starting to campaign against Dong Zhuo so soon?"
Ding Ling was surprised.
He searched online carefully, and after a while, he had an epiphany:
"With the help of players, Cao Mengde had long left Luoyang!
The very day he left.
Dong Zhuo launched a Thunderbolt operation against Cao Mengde and others, as if to thoroughly eliminate them in their embryonic state!
Sadly, some invested in Dong Zhuo.
Naturally, there were also players who chose to invest in Cao Mengde, Yuan Shao and others.
These people fled faster than rabbits, returning to their rightful places well in advance!"
To players.
They came to this Game World to become stronger!
And the techniques for becoming stronger are mostly in the core areas of noble families.
If they can’t exchange for martial arts skill through merits and can’t learn them in the military camp, they can only study basic skills like Pile Skill, Saber Technique, Spear Technique.
Unless they encounter an opportunity, or are deeply recognized, appreciated, or admired.
Otherwise, a lifetime of hard cultivation, low-level techniques, would only leave them ordinary and undistinguished.
How could players be content with that?
Each brainstormed, either joining noble families as servants to learn core martial arts and Breathing Techniques;
Or working hard for some warlords, families, and generals, gaining recognition and being granted Cultivation Techniques!
Or impressing some hermits with their perseverance, becoming their disciples and learning Divine Skill!
The Eight Immortals crossed the sea, each showing their own divine abilities!
With the players’ involvement.
They had long muddied the waters of the Three Kingdoms World.
It was no surprise that Cao Mengde would advance his campaign on Dong Zhuo.
But...
"If Cao Mengde really campaigns against Dong Zhuo, will Pan Feng go? Will he still die against Hua Xiong?"
Ding Ling didn’t know Hua Xiong’s combat abilities.
But he was sure Pan Feng’s skills were absolutely Super-Elite level!
How could an ordinary First-class Fierce General beat him?
"Pan Feng has shown me great kindness. I can’t fail to repay it."
After thinking it through, Ding Ling immediately went online to learn about pigeon breeding methods.
Some time later.
Feeling it about right.
Ding Ling logged in.
He glanced at the Character Panel.
Sure enough:
[Pigeon Breeding Skill Full Level.]
[Pigeon Post Technique Full Level]
He bought a lot of pigeons in Songh County.
No doubt.
Now main cities all had pigeon posts.
The demand for pigeons skyrocketed.
Where there is trade, there would be people breeding and catching pigeons.
It’s no surprise that pigeons were available in a place like Songh County.
After buying them.
Because his pigeon breeding skill was Full Level, far surpassing ordinary breeding experts, reaching the true Peak Realm.
He could even conduct special and mysterious communication with pigeons to some extent.
It’s hard to explain in detail.
But that’s just how the skill is.
Ding Ling then enlisted some players to help, promising them a High-Tier Saber Technique if they helped set up the pigeon breeding site.
Anyway, he had given High-Tier Saber Techniques to players before.
Giving them again now.
Ding Ling didn’t have any psychological burden.
For him, low-tiered martial arts were almost losing their effect.
This High-Tier Saber Technique was just foundational, not even as good as low-tiered martial arts!
He used it as an ’incentive,’ making players work for him, could anything be better?
And players were generally at the stage of learning Pile Skill, Initial Tier Saber Technique, Initial Tier Spear Technique.
Upon suddenly learning they could access a High-Tier Saber Technique.

Sadly, some invested in Dong Zhuo.
Naturally, there were also players who chose to invest in Cao Mengde, Yuan Shao and others.
These people fled faster than rabbits, returning to their rightful places well in advance!"
To players.
They came to this Game World to become stronger!
And the techniques for becoming stronger are mostly in the core areas of noble families.
If they can’t exchange for martial arts skill through merits and can’t learn them in the military camp, they can only study basic skills like Pile Skill, Saber Technique, Spear Technique.
Unless they encounter an opportunity, or are deeply recognized, appreciated, or admired.
Otherwise, a lifetime of hard cultivation, low-level techniques, would only leave them ordinary and undistinguished.
How could players be content with that?
Each brainstormed, either joining noble families as servants to learn core martial arts and Breathing Techniques;
Or working hard for some warlords, families, and generals, gaining recognition and being granted Cultivation Techniques!
Or impressing some hermits with their perseverance, becoming their disciples and learning Divine Skill!
The Eight Immortals crossed the sea, each showing their own divine abilities!
With the players’ involvement.
They had long muddied the waters of the Three Kingdoms World.
It was no surprise that Cao Mengde would advance his campaign on Dong Zhuo.
But...
"If Cao Mengde really campaigns against Dong Zhuo, will Pan Feng go?
Will he still die against Hua Xiong?"
Ding Ling didn’t know Hua Xiong’s combat abilities.
But he was sure Pan Feng’s skills were absolutely Super-Elite level!
How could an ordinary First-class Fierce General beat him?
"Pan Feng has shown me great kindness.
I can’t fail to repay it."
After thinking it through, Ding Ling immediately went online to learn about pigeon breeding methods.
Some time later.
Feeling it about right.
Ding Ling logged in.
He glanced at the Character Panel.
Sure enough:
[Pigeon Breeding Skill Full Level.]
[Pigeon Post Technique Full Level]
He bought a lot of pigeons in Songh County.
No doubt.
Now main cities all had pigeon posts.
The demand for pigeons skyrocketed.
Where there is trade, there would be people breeding and catching pigeons.
It’s no surprise that pigeons were available in a place like Songh County.
After buying them.
Because his pigeon breeding skill was Full Level, far surpassing ordinary breeding experts, reaching the true Peak Realm.
He could even conduct special and mysterious communication with pigeons to some extent.
It’s hard to explain in detail.
But that’s just how the skill is.
Ding Ling then enlisted some players to help, promising them a High-Tier Saber Technique if they helped set up the pigeon breeding site.
Anyway, he had given High-Tier Saber Techniques to players before.
Giving them again now.
Ding Ling didn’t have any psychological burden.
For him, low-tiered martial arts were almost losing their effect.
This High-Tier Saber Technique was just foundational, not even as good as low-tiered martial arts!
He used it as an ’incentive,’ making players work for him, could anything be better?
And players were generally at the stage of learning Pile Skill, Initial Tier Saber Technique, Initial Tier Spear Technique.
Upon suddenly learning they could access a High-Tier Saber Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Lü Bu, Lü Fengxian
paragraphs: Some players who are extremely obsessed with martial arts naturally readily agreed.
Of course, those who have already joined clans and other forces and obtained real Martial Arts are excluded.
Ding Ling also wouldn’t contact such people.
He prefers to deal with ordinary players.

Those who have already communicated with clans or heroes like Cao Mengde, and obtained real Cultivation Techniques and Breathing Techniques, except for those who are truly fortunate, most are definitely high-tier formidable individuals, and in the real world, they are surely strong in both emotional and intellectual intelligence!
Deal with such people?
Ding Ling consciously marked it as a no!
Fortunately, in both reality and the Game World, most are ordinary people.
These ordinary people, although they are all working hard to obtain Cultivation Techniques.
But they are often one step slower than those high-tier players.
And being one step slower means falling behind step by step.
They eventually can only become ordinary people in the Game World, either continuing to a military camp, becoming a thief, or finding another way...
Thus, Ding Ling took out his High-tier Saber Technique.
The temptation for ordinary players was still significant.
They also knew Ding Ling and trusted him considerably.
There were female players who even expressed on the spot their desire to stick with Ding Ling, hoping he would take them along!
Ding Ling naturally refused.
The female player, feeling full of charm, tried several times, but Ding Ling refused each time, which greatly hit her, making her start to question her life.
Yet she didn’t know.
Ding Ling simply didn’t want to carry any burdens.
Moreover, his cheat is exclusively his, and it simply cannot help others improve.
It was useless for a female player to follow him!
With the help of players.
Ding Ling successfully built his pigeon post in Songh County.
The next step is to develop the pigeon post in Jizhou Ye City.
And all this, these players will assist in doing.
Ding Ling, to facilitate future connections with Pan Feng and others in Yangzhou and other places.
Specifically brought many pigeon cages and placed them on the side of the horse’s belly.
Pigeon cages contained many pigeons.
Under the complex gaze of players and local natives, Ding Ling and Zhao Yun rode away from Songh County.
He had already written the letters.
Specifically paid the native of Songh County a large sum to take one to Ye City.
The players will naturally also go.
A double insurance.
Ding Ling had done this many times before.
As for how players would receive the High-tier Saber Technique after succeeding?
Ding Ling directly told them he would come back to Songh County to find them later.
To reassure them.
Ding Ling presented a Middle-tier Spear Technique Secret Manual!
This basic Spear Technique was already useless to him.
Even Zhang Hex and others had no objections to teaching this basic Spear Technique.
Ding Ling had no problem taking it out for players.
Clip-clop!
Galloping all the way.
On this day.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun came to a large riverside.
Just crossing the river.
Would bring them closer to Jingzhou.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun brought a total of eight horses.
Ding Ling’s Ferghana Horse and Zhao Yun’s Night-Shining Jade Lion were both unparalleled horses, ranking among the top ten in this world!
The other six horses were all excellent warhorses ridden by Houcheng and others!
Eight horses.
Their high value was indisputable.
Taking a few good horses to horse-scarce Yangzhou would definitely bring convenience.
The two found a boatman and successively ferried several warhorses across the river.
After Zhao Yun also crossed the river.
Ding Ling, leading his Ferghana Horse, was about to board the boat.
Whoosh!
An arrow, carrying the sound of wind and thunder, suddenly shot from an angle, fast, swift, and incredibly terrifying.
Having acquired the Overlord Halberd Technique, Tornado Arrow Skill, and Golden Gate Saber Technique, with several improvements, Ding Ling was no longer the same.
His reaction speed was faster.
Agility higher.
At the moment the arrow was about to hit his face, he suddenly lowered his head.
Sizzle!
The arrow actually penetrated his helmet, and with immense force, brought the helmet crashing down onto the boatman.
The boatman let out a miserable cry and fell at the bow of the boat.
Ding Ling had no time to worry about the boatman’s injuries, quickly leaping onto his horse, wielding the Heaven-piercing Halberd, blocking the second rapidly fired arrow.
Countless gunflowers bloomed!
The Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix Pattern occasionally flashed through the void!
In terms of speed, the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear is rarely rivaled by any Kung Fu.
With the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear for defense.
The successive arrows were all shattered by the halberd.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The halberd and arrows clashed multiple times, each collision releasing a thunderous roar, as if Thor was hammering, and the Mother of Electricity was beating the drum!
"What immense strength!"
Ding Ling was moved.
After deflecting six arrows in succession, Ding Ling finally had time to look into the distance.
He saw ahead, a fiery red tall horse looked like a sweeping blaze of fire, its imposing aura rushing at him, overwhelming like a great wave, giving an impression of unmatched power.
On this red horse sat a man.
Upon closer look.

He wore a Three-pronged Purple Gold Crown, a Western River Red Cotton Flower Robe, a Beast-Faced Swallowing Head Linked Armor, and a Lion Mane Belt; with a bow and arrow by his side, holding a halberd.
With such a sight.
A flash crossed Ding Ling’s mind.
"Lü Bu!"
He shouted loudly.
"Hahaha..."
The man on horseback laughed boisterously:
"I am indeed Jiuyuan Lu Bu Lü Fengxian! Here specifically to claim your head!"
"Hmph!"
Ding Ling tightened his grip on the Heaven-piercing Halberd, instead of retreating, he advanced, riding his horse straight towards Lü Bu.
Fighting on the riverside was disadvantageous for him to display his skills.
"Such audacity."
Lü Bu was not alarmed but pleased, not angry but laughing.
His voice was like a great bell, echoing across the land:

"You ran quite fast! I originally thought you were a coward, but now it seems you have some courage! I respect you as a man, and later, I will ensure you die an honorable death, to honor the souls of my fallen men!"
He was tall and broad, with a waist measuring ten girdles!
Yet he looked sharp and handsome!
As they got closer.
The more clearly his bright star-like eyes could be seen.
He was clearly a peerless handsome man as beautiful as Pan Anx!

Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, not responding, just crazily channeling the two Breathing Techniques, while the Overlord Halberd Technique was fully activated, augmenting the Heaven-piercing Halberd.
Clip-clop!
As the two horses charged faster and faster.
The distance between them grew closer.
Lü Bu’s breathing could almost be heard.
"Dare to use a halberd in front of me!"
Lü Bu laughed:
"Do you know what it means to show a sword skill in front of a master! Today I’ll let you see what true Halberd Technique is! Watch out!"
Boom!
The two charged rapidly towards each other.
Both simultaneously used the first move of the Overlord Halberd Technique: Immortal Slaying Soul Destruction!
Clang!
This move contained three transformations, each one causing heart-stopping fear, enough to easily intimidate the enemy!
As one move fell, it was as if the Heavenly Dao was slaying immortals, the Divine Being destroying souls, and frightening destructive power surged in all directions, sizzle!
The void crackled with noise, electric sparks occasionally flying past!
Crack!

Their halberds clashed violently, each move stacked with immense force, one move after another, with Breathing Technique amplification, making the pierce power of this move aimed directly at the soul!

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Hua Xiong Eager to Test His Skills
paragraphs: An exquisite blow that seems divinely crafted, the Immortal Slaying Soul Destruction!
After Ding Ling and Lü Bu’s strikes, they were unexpectedly identical! As if they had perfectly replicated each other’s moves!
Boom!
Clang, clang, clang!
After one strike, three rapid transformations, the halberds clashed fiercely, causing both their hands to tremble slightly as they passed each other on their galloping horses.
Soon they turned their horses’ heads and faced each other directly again.
Lü Bu was uncertain, unsure if it was due to nervousness, anger, or sheer shock, as his hand holding the halberd trembled:
"You, you actually know the Overlord Halberd Technique!!"
"Indeed."
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, frankly admitting it.
"How did you learn it?!"
Lü Bu asked in disbelief:

"The Overlord Halberd Technique is a supreme secret skill passed down through the Lü Family! Your surname is Ding! You have no connection or link to the Lü Family! How could you possibly learn the Overlord Halberd Technique!"
From Lü Bu’s words, it’s not hard to hear.
That Wei Xu’s possession of the Overlord Halberd Technique might indeed have been acquired through abnormal means.
Naturally, Ding Ling could not reveal this matter, so he merely smiled in silence.
Lü Bu’s handsome face flushed red with embarrassment.
Recalling his previous words to Ding Ling, his shame and agitation were uncontainable!
Ding Ling’s halberd skills were no less than his own.
To a certain extent, in terms of mastery, it appeared Ding Ling’s halberd skills went even deeper than his!
Because Ding Ling’s halberd skills were so natural, free, and uninhibited!
This is the embodiment of mastery reaching the Transformation Realm!
The intricacies of the other halberd forms remained unknown. At the very least, the first form was like this!
"So young, yet able to cultivate the Overlord Halberd Technique to such a degree!"
Lü Bu’s face darkened, showing surprise, confusion, admiration, and anger:

"No wonder that scoundrel Dong Huang, after returning, always spoke of your might to everyone! It frightened Prime Minister Dong so much that he gave up continued pursuit and siege against you! Otherwise, how could you have possibly made it this far with such ease!"
Ding Ling felt relieved.
It seemed Dong Huang was not without use.
Initially, he wanted to catch up and shoot Dong Huang down.
However, the obstruction by Zhang Liao’s Wolf Cavalry and the arrival of more cavalry units made Ding Ling abandon the idea of shooting him.
But now it seemed, it was fortunate he didn’t shoot him.
After all, those additional cavalry units did not come to besiege him, possibly due to Dong Huang’s intervention!
If that unit was the Bingzhou Army, Dong Huang’s influence wouldn’t be significant.
But if it was the Xiliang Army, Dong Huang, being Dong Zhuo’s nephew, though not quite a kingpin, was influential enough to stop the cavalry’s pursuit against him.
As it turns out, Ding Ling’s guess wasn’t far off.
During this time, Dong Huang, being intimidated, tormented, and frightened by Ding Ling enough to develop a psychological shadow!
He originally thought that Zhang Liao, Wei Xu, and others’ joint efforts would surely crush Ding Ling.
For that, he was excited and expectant!
However, in Ding Ling’s fury, he counterattacked and killed, chasing the Wolf Cavalry Legion alone with his horse!
This scared Dong Huang out of his wits, and he refused to let Hua Xiong lead the Flying Bear Army to face Ding Ling directly, even going so far as to rage at Hua Xiong for it!
Yet this, too, couldn’t subdue Hua Xiong.

Until Dong Huang invoked ’Dong Zhuo,’ saying if Hua Xiong didn’t listen to him, he’d have Hua Xiong removed from his General position even if it cost him his life. Only then did Hua Xiong reluctantly stop chasing Ding Ling.
And after this.
News came of Cao Mengde’s impending attack on Hulao Pass.
By then, Dong Zhuo’s order came down, and Hua Xiong had to follow orders to withdraw to Luoyang and proceed to Hulao Pass to guard it.
Of course, regarding Ding Ling, whom Dong Huang, Zhang Liao, and others described as extremely terrifying, Hua Xiong, though hesitant, was eager to try and test Ding Ling’s edge!
As for Dong Zhuo?

He naturally was half-convinced by Dong Huang’s words. Because the way Dong Huang described Ding Ling had already reached a level comparable to a Land God, a celestial Immortal, incredibly powerful and unfathomable, defying the natural order!
How could a human achieve such ridiculous feats?
Dong Zhuo naturally did not believe it.
But Ding Ling’s achievements forced him to half-believe it. In the end, he was left believing partly.
"Hua Xiong had to follow the Prime Minister’s order to retreat to Luoyang. But I am different."

Lü Bu activated the Overlord Breathing Technique, his aura suddenly changed, becoming bold, domineering, and intense, like an Overlord descending to the Mortal World, a deity overlooking the human realm:
"I consider myself invincible under heaven. To deal with you and Zhao Yun, such mere generals, I’m certainly sure to handle it with ease!"
He pointed his halberd directly at Ding Ling:
"I’ll ask you one last time. Where exactly did you learn the Overlord Halberd Technique?!
If you answer truthfully, I’ll let you have a complete corpse, otherwise. Even dismembering you wouldn’t be excessive."
Ding Ling remained silent.

On the opposite riverbank, Zhao Yun looked anxious, wanting to cross the river to help but unable to find a boatman for the moment, could only pace back and forth nervously, watching the battle with unease.
In a more distant place, some players and local villagers were also observing the battle.

At this moment, after both Ding Ling and Lü Bu activated their Breathing Techniques, their auras were profound like the Immortal Gods, dignified and sharp, as if the Sword God was riding a Spiritual Phoenix sweeping across the world;
One seemed like an Overlord’s arrival, the tyrannical aura swept through the world.
Their auras were both unfathomable!
Specators, naturally, were immensely shocked and curious, finding it hard not to stop and watch, and their number was growing.
"Very well."
Lü Bu laughed loudly:
"How arrogant! Then take another strike from me. Let me see how far your mastery of the Overlord Halberd Technique has reached. Whether the other forms can match the first form’s perfection!"
Before the words were finished.
The Red Rabbit Horse beneath Lü Bu let out a long neigh, its four legs stomped the ground, and it charged towards Ding Ling like a rolling ball of blazing fire.
Ding Ling slightly raised his brows, running the Breathing Technique to the utmost, activating the Overlord Halberd Technique.
He also spurred his horse towards Lü Bu.
The two soon met.
Each raised their halberd and thrust at each other.
Boom!

At first glance, the halberd thrust seemed simple, but mid-air, the technique suddenly transformed, becoming intricate like a woven net, swift as thunderbolt, thrusting dozens of times in a brief moment!
Every thrust seemed capable of piercing the earth, with the void sizzling with sound!
Dozens of consecutive thrusts seemed as if trying to pierce the sky!
The booming sound echoed throughout the heavens and earth.
The two halberds clashed heavily, bang bang bang! Boom boom boom!

In the blink of an eye, there were dozens of collisions, each clash resounding like iron being forged, yet the speed was incredibly fast, with shadows of the Overlord’s phantoms flickering in the void.
Normal people simply couldn’t see how exactly the two halberds clashed and collided.
They could only see a moment after.
The two riders separated.
Their hands trembled slightly.
"You, you are even stronger than I imagined!"
Lü Bu’s face turned extremely unsightly.
He realized his solo assault this time had been careless!
The second form of the Overlord Halberd Technique, Godslaying Shattering, was extremely difficult to master.
Without sufficient agility and strength, it’s impossible to learn it!
But the opponent had already reached an extraordinary level, mastering it completely!
