By then, Dong Zhuo’s order came down, and Hua Xiong had to follow orders to withdraw to Luoyang and proceed to Hulao Pass to guard it.
Of course, regarding Ding Ling, whom Dong Huang, Zhang Liao, and others described as extremely terrifying, Hua Xiong, though hesitant, was eager to try and test Ding Ling’s edge!
As for Dong Zhuo?
He naturally was half-convinced by Dong Huang’s words.
Because the way Dong Huang described Ding Ling had already reached a level comparable to a Land God, a celestial Immortal, incredibly powerful and unfathomable, defying the natural order!
How could a human achieve such ridiculous feats?
Dong Zhuo naturally did not believe it.
But Ding Ling’s achievements forced him to half-believe it.
In the end, he was left believing partly.
"Hua Xiong had to follow the Prime Minister’s order to retreat to Luoyang.
But I am different."

Lü Bu activated the Overlord Breathing Technique, his aura suddenly changed, becoming bold, domineering, and intense, like an Overlord descending to the Mortal World, a deity overlooking the human realm:
"I consider myself invincible under heaven.
To deal with you and Zhao Yun, such mere generals, I’m certainly sure to handle it with ease!"
He pointed his halberd directly at Ding Ling:
"I’ll ask you one last time.
Where exactly did you learn the Overlord Halberd Technique?!
If you answer truthfully, I’ll let you have a complete corpse, otherwise.
Even dismembering you wouldn’t be excessive."
Ding Ling remained silent.

On the opposite riverbank, Zhao Yun looked anxious, wanting to cross the river to help but unable to find a boatman for the moment, could only pace back and forth nervously, watching the battle with unease.
In a more distant place, some players and local villagers were also observing the battle.

At this moment, after both Ding Ling and Lü Bu activated their Breathing Techniques, their auras were profound like the Immortal Gods, dignified and sharp, as if the Sword God was riding a Spiritual Phoenix sweeping across the world;
One seemed like an Overlord’s arrival, the tyrannical aura swept through the world.
Their auras were both unfathomable!
Specators, naturally, were immensely shocked and curious, finding it hard not to stop and watch, and their number was growing.
"Very well."
Lü Bu laughed loudly:
"How arrogant!
Then take another strike from me.
Let me see how far your mastery of the Overlord Halberd Technique has reached.
Whether the other forms can match the first form’s perfection!"
Before the words were finished.
The Red Rabbit Horse beneath Lü Bu let out a long neigh, its four legs stomped the ground, and it charged towards Ding Ling like a rolling ball of blazing fire.
Ding Ling slightly raised his brows, running the Breathing Technique to the utmost, activating the Overlord Halberd Technique.
He also spurred his horse towards Lü Bu.
The two soon met.
Each raised their halberd and thrust at each other.
Boom!

At first glance, the halberd thrust seemed simple, but mid-air, the technique suddenly transformed, becoming intricate like a woven net, swift as thunderbolt, thrusting dozens of times in a brief moment!
Every thrust seemed capable of piercing the earth, with the void sizzling with sound!
Dozens of consecutive thrusts seemed as if trying to pierce the sky!
The booming sound echoed throughout the heavens and earth.
The two halberds clashed heavily, bang bang bang!
Boom boom boom!

In the blink of an eye, there were dozens of collisions, each clash resounding like iron being forged, yet the speed was incredibly fast, with shadows of the Overlord’s phantoms flickering in the void.
Normal people simply couldn’t see how exactly the two halberds clashed and collided.
They could only see a moment after.
The two riders separated.
Their hands trembled slightly.
"You, you are even stronger than I imagined!"
Lü Bu’s face turned extremely unsightly.
He realized his solo assault this time had been careless!
The second form of the Overlord Halberd Technique, Godslaying Shattering, was extremely difficult to master.
Without sufficient agility and strength, it’s impossible to learn it!
But the opponent had already reached an extraordinary level, mastering it completely!

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Lü Bu’s Frustration (24/50)
paragraphs: The second move can be so masterful, truly outstanding!
You should know that even mastering the first move of the Overlord Halberd Technique is enough to dominate the battlefield!
Yet Ding Ling in front of me has trained the second move ’Godslaying Shattering’ to the realm of mastery!
"I admit I underestimated you!"
Lü Bu took a deep breath, his eyes fixed on Ding Ling:
"But from now on, I will not hold back!"
Ding Ling chuckled softly, without saying a word.
Lü Bu was both embarrassed and enraged by this laugh, and without further ado, he directly executed the third move of the Overlord Halberd Technique ’Demon-Slaying Shadowless’ to attack Ding Ling.
Ding Ling showed no fear, wielding his halberd and countering Lü Bu with the same move!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
As soon as they clashed, they became entangled in a fierce battle.
After the third move.
Came the fourth move, Demon Subduing Chaotic Dance!
What followed was Ghost-slaying World, Overbearing Dominance, and finally the strongest move, Devouring Heaven and Earth!
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
The two fought rapidly, like a whirlwind passing by, with outsiders unable to discern the details, only seeing fleeting shadows and overlord patterns formed by the halberds’ blades!

Each collision was like Mars hitting Earth or a meteor striking the ground, with booming sounds making the void resonate! A player hiding behind a tree not far away had a perforated eardrum from listening too much, becoming deaf in his left ear!
Terrified, he quickly fled the scene, feeling better only after moving farther away.
He was deeply moved, muttering to himself:
"What the hell... is Ding Ling a god descended to earth? He can now fight the World’s Number One General to such a bitter extent?! I can’t even bear to watch from close! Is this even human?!"
They were all players.
Compared to Ding Ling, he was still a novice!
Yet the progress was astounding!
Advancing at lightning speed!
Now he can fight Lü Bu!
This progress is unbelievably frightening!
"What a pity. There’s no recording equipment."
The player regretfully lamented:
"If only I could record this epic battle, I would definitely gain some fame! Maybe even become quite famous!"
He was extremely curious and eager:

"I just don’t know how Ding Ling learned all this? Is there some secret? Or a trick? Otherwise, how could he become a match for the World’s Number One General, almost equal in combat power, in such a short time?"
Many shared his thoughts.
But Ding Ling was too strong, and they didn’t have the guts to dare to steal Ding Ling’s secrets directly.
Otherwise, there would definitely be some bold people doing such things!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Ding Ling and Lü Bu’s Overlord Halberd Techniques fought through several cycles, unleashing brilliant and unimaginable moves, both drenched in sweat, yet neither was able to defeat the other.
Ding Ling did not expect Lü Bu to be this strong.
If it weren’t for learning the Overlord Halberd Technique and other martial arts, temporarily boosting his skills, he might have fallen here this time!
Lü Bu was much more formidable than he imagined.
’No wonder he could single-handedly challenge the Three Heroes.’
Guan Yu and Zhang Fei were super-elite!
Lü Bu could challenge both of them along with Liu Bei, clearly demonstrating his brute strength!
In this world, there is martial arts and breathing techniques! A super-elite combat power is truly terrifying!
After killing many formidable generals, he could still single-handedly fight the Three Heroes; Lü Bu’s combat power is self-evident!
But Ding Ling’s physique also reached super-elite!
He wasn’t afraid of a prolonged battle!
So he chose to wear down Lü Bu!
As expected.
After fighting for a while.
Lü Bu, on the Red Rabbit Horse, ’leaped’ out of the battle circle, glaring at Ding Ling with a face turned blue, his eyes burning as if he would devour him:
"Your endurance, stamina is terrifying! I can’t kill you!"
He was straightforward and decisive, immediately spurring his horse to turn away:
"The next time we meet, I shall take your head!"
Ding Ling’s response was three arrows!
Whizz whizz whizz!
The Tornado Arrow Skill and Double Extreme Arrow Skill both demonstrated their power.
With the empowerment of two great breathing techniques, the three arrows contained sharpness, nobility, and overbearing aura! Along with the unique Vortex Qi of the Tornado Arrow Skill!
Making the three arrows resemble flying streaks of white silk, descending like the Galaxy!
In the whizzing sound, in the blink of an eye, they caught up with Lü Bu.
Lü Bu seemed to detect it, quickly leaning to the side, raising his halberd to counter, clang clang clang!
In a fierce exchange, he barely managed to shatter two arrows, but the third arrow, from an unexpected angle, thud!
An arrow struck his thigh.
He felt a sudden pain in his leg, and couldn’t help but glance down to see the third arrow.
"You’re despicable!"
He glared at Ding Ling, shouting loudly:
"Sneak attack!"
"Who attacked first?"
Ding Ling said coldly.
Lü Bu was taken aback, almost suffocated:
"If you shoot any more arrows, you’ll force me to fight you to the death!"
’If you dare, come and try!’
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows, sneering.
Lü Bu realized he had met his nemesis today.
In the past, whenever he said this, it would intimidate many enemies, but today it didn’t work!
"Hmph!"
Lü Bu couldn’t stand Ding Ling’s sharpness and oppressive force, immediately grabbing his bow, bending it to release two arrows shooting at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling also began to bend his bow and shoot arrows, engaging in a shootout with Lü Bu.
For a while.
Arrows filled the sky!
Even though there were only two people.
It was like two great armies exchanging fire.
A rain of arrows filled the air, with whizzing sounds, occasionally colliding violently mid-air, the booming sounds relentless.
The native onlookers and players were dumbfounded, amazed by the celestial display:
"Wow, Ding Ling is truly unbelievable!"

"Oh. I now hate the fact that I’m not a woman the most, or I would definitely offer myself to Ding Ling, in exchange for learning his unparalleled archery skill! This archery is too powerful, an ancient version of a machine gun!!"
After shooting for a while.
Lü Bu’s endurance, stamina were rapidly declining.
He felt overwhelmed, secretly astounded, his gaze at Ding Ling changing continuously.
Especially upon seeing Ding Ling still full of energy, he tightened his pupils, his lips twitching slightly.
He had sensed it during the previous battle.
Ding Ling’s physique must be extremely astounding!
Now he realized, indeed it was not wrong.
Their strength and agility might be on par.
But the physique was definitely not comparable!
This endurance was terrifying!
He knew that if this shooting contest continued.
When his stamina dropped to the bottom, he would certainly become a lamb waiting to be slaughtered!
Thinking of this, how could he dare to stay any longer, after one last shooting round with Ding Ling, he turned and spurred his horse to flee.
The speed of the Red Rabbit Horse was extremely fast.
He believed Ding Ling absolutely couldn’t catch up to him.
"Lü Bu, if you’re brave, don’t run!"
Ding Ling felt more and more invigorated as he shot!
Feeling extremely satisfied.
Through this round of shooting contests, mastery in the application and control of the Tornado Arrow Skill and Double Extreme Arrow Skill.
Had already reached the peak, Realm of Perfection!

chapters.title: Chapter 120: E-level Medal: Subduing Lü Bu
paragraphs: Although martial arts can instantly reach full level.
But actual combat experience cannot.
In a fight against Lü Bu!
Ding Ling’s actual combat experience soared again.
Especially in the use of the Overlord Halberd Technique, Tornado Arrow Skill, and Double Extreme Arrow Skill, he reached the pinnacle!
Because of this, he fought more incisively and felt more refreshed!
In this state, he naturally intimidated Lü Bu, who thought he was still at his peak and dared not fight again, galloping away.
Ding Ling is not someone who likes to suffer losses.
Being ambushed by Lü Bu and threatened to kill him, he had to vent his pent-up anger somehow.
He immediately pursued Lü Bu on horseback, continually firing Tornado Arrows and Double Extremes Arrows!
The combination of Tornado Arrow and Double Extremes Arrow resulted in an arrow that embodies sharpness, overbearing aura, nobility, and speed!
Even for an instant, Lü Bu did not recognize that the arrow was a combination of Tornado Arrow and Double Extremes Arrow!
Yet he vaguely sensed that Ding Ling’s archery skill seemed to contain the essence of Cao Xing’s Tornado Arrow and Dong Zhuo’s family archery skill!
He felt bewildered and uncertain.
But being relentlessly pursued and shot by Ding Ling.
He was quite embarrassed.
He had no mind to delve into this matter temporarily.
Just secretly incensed, feeling humiliated.
Especially after seeing some people hiding behind trees, staring at him in astonishment.
His indignation grew even more, feeling his self-esteem was trampled!
In his rage, he was about to turn and fight Ding Ling to the death.

But thinking about Ding Ling’s formidable endurance, he took a deep breath and forcibly suppressed his discontent and reluctance, speeding up even more, transforming into a wisp of smoke, disappearing into the distance.
Ding Ling chased and shot for five or six li.
Seeing Lü Bu with arrows in his thighs and back, yet not turning back to fight him, he couldn’t help but secretly regret.
If he could take out Lü Bu here.
Then Dong Zhuo would undoubtedly lose.
Pan Feng’s misfortune might also be resolved.
[E-level Achievement Medal gained: You have intimidated Lü Bu!]
[Note: Lü Bu considers himself unrivaled in the world, especially in mounted combat, believing himself peerless and unstoppable! But your appearance dealt him a heavy blow!
For the first time, he truly realized there are people stronger than him in mounted combat!
He’s dejected, discouraged, and dismal.
But more so, he’s angry and unwilling!
He will undoubtedly strive to refine himself further! Work hard on medicinal cultivation and practicing breathing techniques!
Perhaps in the near future, you will encounter an even stronger and domineering Lü Bu!]
A notification sound brushed past his ear.
Ding Ling’s brow slightly raised.
Lü Bu’s achievement medal hasn’t been snatched away.
It seems that the numerous players staying in Luoyang are fundamentally helpless against Lü Bu.
Thinking about it, it’s understandable, such an unruly, domineering, and wild Lü Bu, who can truly subdue him?
Lü Bu is a wolf!
Only someone stronger can quell him!
Otherwise, backlash is inevitable!
During his encounter with Lü Bu, Ding Ling gained considerable insight into Lü Bu, thinking about their next meeting.
He must defeat him with absolute superiority!
Clip-clop!
Watching the Red Rabbit Horse disappear into the distance, Ding Ling sighed.
Although his mount, Ferghana Horse, is quite remarkable, it’s still a level below the Red Rabbit Horse.
He didn’t pursue and kill Lü Bu any further, turning back to the riverbank, took a boat, crossed the river, and disembarked, riding off with Zhao Yun.
As for his feats.
They spread in various ways, at unparalleled speed in the real online world and Player Plaza!
Many were astounded beyond measure upon learning about Ding Ling’s combat prowess!
"Too unbelievable! Is this for real?"
The beautiful landlord Ouyang Lingling was dumbfounded, staring at several pictures for comparison.
The former Ding Ling, and the current Ding Ling.
The transformation was immense!
But the outlines of the past could still be seen.
She suddenly realized why Ding Ling was in such a hurry to move out.
"It must be that he has a secret for rapidly enhancing himself! He didn’t want anyone to know."
Ouyang Lingling’s heart burned with passion, never expecting the Ding Ling she once disregarded could reach such heights of flourishing success!
"How can I find Ding Ling?"
Ouyang Lingling pondered for a long while, to no avail.
She couldn’t help but feel secretly annoyed and regretful.
She shouldn’t have been so straightforward in rejecting Ding Ling in the past.
If she had been more tactful.
She might still have Ding Ling’s contact information. Unlike now, directly losing touch!
"I was foolish too. I forgot to get a phone number or contact method from him."
Ouyang Lingling sighed.
Ultimately.
She didn’t care enough, regarded Ding Ling lightly, thus acting so casually, naturally unconcerned.
Had she been a bit earnest, cared more, maybe the results would have been different now.
After trying the mythological game, she was completely captivated by it! After staying beside Consort Yhu for a while, she further realized the enormous benefits of learning martial arts!
But Consort Yhu’s martial arts were taught by Xiang Yu, relatively basic.
Even those basic martial arts were incredibly difficult for her to learn.
How could Ding Ling evolve to a level comparable to the Three Kingdoms’ mightiest general Lü Bu in such a short time?
There must be an astonishing secret!
She can realize it, surely others will too.
"No wonder Ding Ling slipped away so quickly. Quite alert!"
"I wonder if I will meet him again in the Game World in the future?"
Ouyang Lingling inexplicably felt some anticipation!
The news of Ding Ling defeating Lü Bu stirred up turbulent waves among the players!
And in the small scope of the Plane World of the Late Eastern Han Dynasty, there were also some voices.
But most people did not believe it.
Because Lü Bu’s reputation is exceptionally high!
How could an unknown Ding Ling possibly defeat Flying General Lü Bu?
It’s just that Ding Ling’s recent achievements have been extremely astonishing, attracting many people’s side glances, shock, but saying he can defeat Lü Bu, still few would believe.
This is like saying a beggar is an emperor.
Even if the beggar authored several poems and articles that could be handed down for ages, few would believe!
Ding Ling compared to Lü Bu may not be that exaggerated.
But it’s somewhat similar in meaning.
Yet even if only a few people within a small scope believed.
Ding Ling’s War God progress bar still jumped forward a little.
[3: You must let your War God name resonate throughout the entire Plane World. 4%/100%.]
Previously it was 3%
Increased by 1% point.
Quite decent.
If more people know and believe this fact.
Then Ding Ling’s War God name progress will surely surge!
Ding Ling looked toward the direction of Hulao Pass, feeling somewhat tempted.
Knowing he is fully capable of challenging and defeating Lü Bu alone, Ding Ling’s confidence soared!
He thought of participating in the Hulao Pass battle.
Facing Hua Xiong, Lü Bu, and other fierce generals, and defeating them!
Then his War God name would resonate throughout Four Seas and Jiuzhou, perhaps the progress bar jumps to 80%. 90%?
But Ding Ling remembered the difficulty of the battle with Lü Bu.
Ultimately abandoned this enticing idea.
What he seeks isn’t evenly matched, nor a difficult victory.

The former Ding Ling, and the current Ding Ling.
The transformation was immense!
But the outlines of the past could still be seen.
She suddenly realized why Ding Ling was in such a hurry to move out.
"It must be that he has a secret for rapidly enhancing himself!
He didn’t want anyone to know."
Ouyang Lingling’s heart burned with passion, never expecting the Ding Ling she once disregarded could reach such heights of flourishing success!
"How can I find Ding Ling?"
Ouyang Lingling pondered for a long while, to no avail.
She couldn’t help but feel secretly annoyed and regretful.
She shouldn’t have been so straightforward in rejecting Ding Ling in the past.
If she had been more tactful.
She might still have Ding Ling’s contact information.
Unlike now, directly losing touch!
"I was foolish too.
I forgot to get a phone number or contact method from him."
Ouyang Lingling sighed.
Ultimately.
She didn’t care enough, regarded Ding Ling lightly, thus acting so casually, naturally unconcerned.
Had she been a bit earnest, cared more, maybe the results would have been different now.
After trying the mythological game, she was completely captivated by it!
After staying beside Consort Yhu for a while, she further realized the enormous benefits of learning martial arts!
But Consort Yhu’s martial arts were taught by Xiang Yu, relatively basic.
Even those basic martial arts were incredibly difficult for her to learn.
How could Ding Ling evolve to a level comparable to the Three Kingdoms’ mightiest general Lü Bu in such a short time?
There must be an astonishing secret!
She can realize it, surely others will too.
"No wonder Ding Ling slipped away so quickly.
Quite alert!"
"I wonder if I will meet him again in the Game World in the future?"
Ouyang Lingling inexplicably felt some anticipation!
The news of Ding Ling defeating Lü Bu stirred up turbulent waves among the players!
And in the small scope of the Plane World of the Late Eastern Han Dynasty, there were also some voices.
But most people did not believe it.
Because Lü Bu’s reputation is exceptionally high!
How could an unknown Ding Ling possibly defeat Flying General Lü Bu?
It’s just that Ding Ling’s recent achievements have been extremely astonishing, attracting many people’s side glances, shock, but saying he can defeat Lü Bu, still few would believe.
This is like saying a beggar is an emperor.
Even if the beggar authored several poems and articles that could be handed down for ages, few would believe!
Ding Ling compared to Lü Bu may not be that exaggerated.
But it’s somewhat similar in meaning.
Yet even if only a few people within a small scope believed.
Ding Ling’s War God progress bar still jumped forward a little.
[3: You must let your War God name resonate throughout the entire Plane World.
Previously it was 3%
Increased by 1% point.
Quite decent.
If more people know and believe this fact.
Then Ding Ling’s War God name progress will surely surge!
Ding Ling looked toward the direction of Hulao Pass, feeling somewhat tempted.
Knowing he is fully capable of challenging and defeating Lü Bu alone, Ding Ling’s confidence soared!
He thought of participating in the Hulao Pass battle.
Facing Hua Xiong, Lü Bu, and other fierce generals, and defeating them!
Then his War God name would resonate throughout Four Seas and Jiuzhou, perhaps the progress bar jumps to 80%.
But Ding Ling remembered the difficulty of the battle with Lü Bu.
Ultimately abandoned this enticing idea.
What he seeks isn’t evenly matched, nor a difficult victory.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: The Peerless Master Deep Within Lofty Mountains
paragraphs: It’s crushing!
Indeed.
Ding Ling wants to absolutely crush Lü Bu with an overwhelming victory!
Only by doing this.
Will the name ’War God’ truly be deserved!
Moreover:
[2, you must defeat the strongest in the plane. Prove you are the true War God.]
Task 2 must also be completed.
But right now, he is still no match for Wang Yue and Tong Yuan.
Therefore, heading south to Yangzhou to learn the Inner Refining Breathing Technique is necessary.
"I’ve already sent a carrier pigeon, hoping to contact Pan Feng and the others, it’s just a matter of time."
Ding Ling gave up the idea of participating in the battle at Hulao Pass.
The Three Heroes battling Lü Bu is certainly exciting.
But what he needs is to improve his strength and clear all barriers!
Why worry about fleeting gains and losses?
"Previously, the one you fought was Lü Bu?"
Zhao Yun glanced sideways.
"Indeed."
"So strong."
Zhao Yun was moved:
"No wonder the master said Jiuyuan Lü Bu is a genius, and told me to be careful when I encounter him."
"Elder Wang also said something similar."
"Indeed."
Zhao Yun gave Ding Ling a glance:
"But you’ve defeated him! Even if you’re not the number one of the younger generation now, you’re definitely not far off!"
Ding Ling smiled without speaking.
He really wants to say that his goal is not to be the number one of the younger generation, but the number one in this plane world!
But he didn’t say it.
Even facing Zhao Yun, Ding Ling doesn’t want to boast.
Although he’s full of confidence due to his ability to cheat, saying it out loud might cause Zhao Yun to think too much.
Once that status is achieved, everything will be evident.
There’s no need to say it.
Besides, he has long said he wants to be the War God, the world’s number one War General! Saying he’s the number one person in the world is a bit ’extravagant’.
Clop! Clop!
The two rode all the way, occasionally chatting about martial arts and skills.
Zhao Yun is indeed the closed-door disciple chosen by Tong Yuan from countless people in Jiuzhou, his talent is astonishing in the extreme.
Along the way, he’s been fighting, progressing at an unparalleled speed.
Moreover, with Ding Ling’s guidance, he is getting closer to the super-elite level.
Of course, facing Ding Ling, the cheat master.
Zhao Yun remains extremely humble and cautious, never thinking he’s formidable.
It’s truly because Ding Ling’s speed of learning martial arts is terrifying.
In front of Ding Ling, he’s completely crushed into dust!
How could he be proud or satisfied?
He remains in a state of ’I must double my efforts to catch up with Ding Ling’.
Whenever he’s free, he practices martial arts and breathing techniques.
He also wants to master the breathing technique to the level of Mastery as soon as possible, so that he can consume herbs to enhance his physique like Ding Ling!
He’s been envious of this for a long time!
On this day.
The two reached the depths of some towering mountains.
The roads were difficult to traverse.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun had to lead their horses, being cautious all the way, not daring to go too fast.
Compared to the wide avenue.
The mountain paths were rugged and challenging! Steep and dangerous!
And often encountered the winding and arduous paths like the "Nine Bends and Eighteen Turns"!
If Ding Ling hadn’t bought the relevant map in Song County in advance, and the ’Master of Geography’s’ ability to track and trace was top-notch.
They would definitely get dizzy and lost!
The chance of getting lost would be ninety-nine percent.
Only because Ding Ling discovered Zhao Yun has a ’road blindness’ attribute!
Compared to ordinary people, he is more confused about distinguishing the correct paths!
Ding Ling became increasingly glad he could cheat.
If not, upon arriving in the Three Kingdoms World, he might end up circling in the mountains for half a year!
Clop! Clop!
In the layered mountain ranges, besides the occasional roar of wild beasts, the chirping of birds, there were only the sounds of Ding Ling, Zhao Yun, and the eight horses’ footsteps and breathing.
Suddenly, a figure flashed before Ding Ling’s eyes.
That figure was incredibly fast, running swiftly on the steep mountain, like a monkey climbing cliffs or like a crane soaring high, agile and rapid to the extreme.
He seemed to be gathering herbs, climbing to the top of the cliff, picking a ’strange flower’, then climbing to the other side of the cliff to pick flowers.
In just a moment.
He had already filled the basket behind him.
He seemed to have completed his task, stepping down the cliff wall, about to leap away.
Seeing such a high person in this desolate place, Ding Ling couldn’t help but call out loudly:
"Elder, elder, wait a moment!"
"Hmm?!"
The high person stood on the cliff, feet perched on a protruding sharp rock, heard the voice and couldn’t help but turn back to look.
This turning back.
He saw each other’s appearances clearly.

Ding Ling saw the high person with crane-like white hair and youthful complexion, upright and strong body, bright eyes, standing steadily on the steep cliff with both feet, his hands empty, incredibly stable.
In awe and admiration, he stepped forward two steps, saluted, and said:
"Junior Ding Ling from Jizhou, greetings to the elder."
"Zhao Zilong of Changshan, greetings to the elder!"
Zhao Yun also immediately saluted.
"Hehe."
The high person smiled slightly, appearing more kindly and approachable, like an elderly neighbor.
Yet, he exuded Immortal Qi, stood on the cliff, his robes fluttering, with an exceptional demeanor, shining with brilliance, like an immortal on the verge of Ascension, catching attention!
The two qualities mixed perfectly.
Making this high person stand out remarkably, leaving a deep impression.
"No need to be so polite."
The high person stepped down from the cliff, a few leaps and bounds, lightly flew to the front of the two, stroking his beard and smiling at them:
"Did you get lost? Do you need me to lead you out?"
"No."
Ding Ling solemnly said:
"I accidentally encountered the elder, admired the elder’s martial skills. I wish to take the elder as my master!"
Ding Ling found this high person unexpectedly approachable.
He also straightforwardly expressed his intent.
Zhao Yun was dumbfounded.
The high person was also quite surprised, he studied Ding Ling carefully for a moment, then shook his head:
"I am not qualified to be your master."
Ding Ling had some guesses but feigned confusion.
The high person explained:
"Your physique has already broken the constraints of mortals, reaching the super-elite level! You’ve already stood at the peak of this world! How could I teach you?"
"I believe I’m far from the peak."
Ding Ling immediately replied.
"Humility is indeed a virtue, but excessive humility makes one seem a bit hypocritical."
The high person frowned and looked at Ding Ling, but seeing Ding Ling’s sincere expression, not seeming fake at all, he was unsure:
"Are you serious?!"
"Junior left the mountain to learn the Unparalleled Divine Skill of the Great River South."
Ding Ling’s full-level acting skill activated, he spoke earnestly:
"To me, martial arts is everything, breaking the world’s bottleneck is the goal. Super-elite is not my goal, breaking the void is!"
Zhao Yun was moved.
The high person was extremely shocked, couldn’t help but carefully scrutinize Ding Ling again:
"To reach the super-elite level at this age, you must be an extraordinary talent. It’s rare that you are not satisfied, not proud, nor self-centered. This is commendable."
He thought for a moment and said:
"I do know some martial arts and understand breathing techniques. But you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Five Animals Qigong Health Care Skill (27/50)
paragraphs: "...but you have already reached Super-Elite level, and your Breathing Technique has become instinctual! My Breathing Technique is useless to you. Moreover, my Martial Arts is a Health Cultivation Technique, not a Slaughter Technique. Even if you practice it, it cannot help you break the void, so it’s quite regrettable."
The master spoke with sincerity:
"Of course, I wish to find a successor to inherit my Martial Arts achievements. But clearly, you are not suitable."
Ding Ling’s eyes twitched twice, and he continued to deploy his Full-level Acting, solemnly saying:
"All Martial Arts Masterpieces to me can become my foundation. Even if it’s a Health Cultivation Technique, I can learn it!"
"Breaking the void is a legendary realm. It’s rumored only the Yellow Emperor and the Three Emperors from ancient times could achieve it. After them, no one else has been able to do it.
If you waste time learning my Health Cultivation Technique,
It’s even more unlikely you’ll reach that legendary realm, so why bother?"
The master sighed.
Ding Ling was surprised.
This was the first time he’d heard that the Yellow Emperor had broken the void?
Really?
Was the random statement he spouted actually true?
His mind was in turmoil, but he said aloud:
"For me, what I lack is Martial Arts, not time."
"What do you mean?!"
The master looked sideways.
"Ding Ling can learn any Martial Arts quickly, master it swiftly, and once mastered, it becomes instinctual."
Zhao Yun chimed in:
"For Ding Ling, what he lacks is enough Martial Arts Secret Manuals, not time to practice Martial Arts!"
The master looked at Zhao Yun like a fool, slightly annoyed:
"Do you think I’m too old to be lied to easily?"
"I absolutely dare not!"
Zhao Yun was solemn:
"If what I say is even slightly twisted, may I be struck by lightning and die a terrible death."
The master looked doubtfully at Zhao Yun, then at Ding Ling:
"Is this true?"
"It is true."
Ding Ling’s face had become thicker over time. Even without deploying any acting, his expression was confident and calm!
"This..."
The master stroked his beard, paced back and forth for a moment, then suddenly looked at Ding Ling:
"If it’s true as Zhao Zilong said, I’m not against teaching you my Martial Arts."
He sighed deeply:
"My Martial Arts require transmission anyway. In that case, I’ll teach you two.
He seemed to have come to terms, smiled slightly, and said:
"Regardless of whether Ding Ling’s talent is truly terrifying, I can still pass it on to you. You can learn together."
After speaking, he didn’t wait for the two to react.
He directly began to demonstrate the Technique.
His mouth continuously articulated complex, profound, and exquisite mantras.

"This skill is derived from my reading of countless ancient books, medical texts, Daoist scriptures, then venturing into remote mountains to observe the habits and movements of five animals: tiger, deer, bear, ape, and bird!
Thus, I named it Five Animals Qigong!"
Boom!
The master demonstrated Five Animals Qigong, each move was sometimes ethereal like smoke, sometimes stable like a mountain!
His movements were executed quickly!
But his explanations were neither fast nor slow, his voice was gentle, pleasing to the ear!
The more Ding Ling listened, the faster his heart beat.
Upon hearing the name Five Animals Qigong, he knew the person before him must be Hua Tuo!
The name of Divine Doctor Hua Tuo is renowned for centuries!
Ding Ling truly hadn’t expected to encounter him in these remote forests!
He had previously thought about finding Hua Tuo to learn his medical skills but saw no trace of him in Jizhou, Luoyang and other places, nor any news about him.
Unexpectedly, there’s always a bright side at the end of a dark road.
Unexpectedly, he met him here!
Ding Ling was thrilled, thinking, no wonder Hua Tuo is so agreeable. Turns out he’s an elderly Divine Doctor dedicated to relieving suffering, helping people, and resolving various crises!
Ding Ling felt quite fortunate. Fortunately, he had become bolder, calling out loudly, and opportunistically expressed his desire to become a disciple.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t have gone this smoothly.

After years of social experience, having come to the Three Kingdoms World, he’d met quite a few people. Though he still wasn’t precise in judging people, he knew when dealing with wicked people, one must be ruthless; with kind people, one must be bold-faced and kind-hearted.
Hua Tuo’s benevolent appearance naturally made boldness and thick skin the perfect approach.
"Alright."
Hua Tuo completed a demonstration of Five Animals Qigong and looked at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun:
"Do you want to continue?"
Zhao Yun claimed Ding Ling learns instantly.
Hua Tuo was also curious, wanting to see if such a genius truly exists.
Five Animals Qigong seems simple,
But in fact, it has two versions.
One version is for ordinary people to learn;
The other is prepared for successors, not only for health but also to kill enemies!
Though the killing effect is weak, it’s extraordinary enough for self-defense.
And naturally, he taught Ding Ling and Zhao Yun the second version.
If Ding Ling and Zhao Yun couldn’t learn the second version,
Then it’s all over, and they part ways from now on!
"No need."
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book materialized on the bookshelf of the library, engraved with three large flamboyant characters on the cover:
"Five Animals Qigong!"
In an instant.
[Five Animals Qigong Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.6]
Crack!
Whishing!
Hot breaths were exhaled, Ding Ling’s bones began vibrating, his skin strengthening.
An unexpected 0.6 gain in Constitution!
Actually surpassing Overlord Halberd Technique and Sunset Swordsmanship!
It’s important to know that as Ding Ling becomes stronger and stronger,
The attribute point bonus from even High Tier Martial Arts becomes continuously weaker!
Yet despite all this,
Five Animals Qigong still added 0.6
Although the overall data falls short of Overlord Halberd Technique or Dawn Swordsmanship!
In terms of Constitution, it’s an absolute crush.
It’s extraordinary!
With the explosive increase in physical qualities,
Ding Ling felt a distinct sense that his stamina, endurance, sustained peak combat power, etc., had all increased significantly!
Although Strength and Agility improvements were slight,
They still made Ding Ling feel considerably more powerful.
At his level, even a small increase is incredibly significant!
Boom!
Without waiting for Hua Tuo to inquire further, Ding Ling directly displayed the Five Animals Qigong.
The ferocity of the tiger, comfort of the deer, steadiness of the bear, agility of the ape, and the swiftness of the bird were executed perfectly by Ding Ling, practiced to perfection!

At the highest level, it seems perfectly natural as if he was born knowing this Technique! Perfectly making Five Animals Qigong an instinct. However, people examine or scrutinize it, they can’t find anything amiss!
Hua Tuo was dumbfounded, incredulous:
"This, this, this..."
Zhao Yun, proud to share the honor, spoke with great achievement:
"Master, I told you Ding Ling learns instantly, masters swiftly, and once mastered, becomes instinctual. Now do you believe it?"
The way he said it was almost like he’d learned Five Animals Qigong himself.
Clearly, Zhao Yun had long regarded Ding Ling as a friend and confidant. Otherwise, he wouldn’t act this way.
Hua Tuo was speechless for a long time, as if returning from a state of shock.

After years of social experience, having come to the Three Kingdoms World, he’d met quite a few people.
Though he still wasn’t precise in judging people, he knew when dealing with wicked people, one must be ruthless; with kind people, one must be bold-faced and kind-hearted.
Hua Tuo’s benevolent appearance naturally made boldness and thick skin the perfect approach.
"Alright."
Hua Tuo completed a demonstration of Five Animals Qigong and looked at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun:
"Do you want to continue?"
Zhao Yun claimed Ding Ling learns instantly.
Hua Tuo was also curious, wanting to see if such a genius truly exists.
Five Animals Qigong seems simple,
But in fact, it has two versions.
One version is for ordinary people to learn;
The other is prepared for successors, not only for health but also to kill enemies!
Though the killing effect is weak, it’s extraordinary enough for self-defense.
And naturally, he taught Ding Ling and Zhao Yun the second version.
If Ding Ling and Zhao Yun couldn’t learn the second version,
Then it’s all over, and they part ways from now on!
"No need."
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book materialized on the bookshelf of the library, engraved with three large flamboyant characters on the cover:
"Five Animals Qigong!"
In an instant.
[Five Animals Qigong Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.6]
Crack!
Whishing!
Hot breaths were exhaled, Ding Ling’s bones began vibrating, his skin strengthening.
An unexpected 0.6 gain in Constitution!
Actually surpassing Overlord Halberd Technique and Sunset Swordsmanship!
It’s important to know that as Ding Ling becomes stronger and stronger,
The attribute point bonus from even High Tier Martial Arts becomes continuously weaker!
Yet despite all this,
Five Animals Qigong still added 0.6
Although the overall data falls short of Overlord Halberd Technique or Dawn Swordsmanship!
In terms of Constitution, it’s an absolute crush.
It’s extraordinary!
With the explosive increase in physical qualities,
Ding Ling felt a distinct sense that his stamina, endurance, sustained peak combat power, etc., had all increased significantly!
Although Strength and Agility improvements were slight,
They still made Ding Ling feel considerably more powerful.
At his level, even a small increase is incredibly significant!
Boom!
Without waiting for Hua Tuo to inquire further, Ding Ling directly displayed the Five Animals Qigong.
The ferocity of the tiger, comfort of the deer, steadiness of the bear, agility of the ape, and the swiftness of the bird were executed perfectly by Ding Ling, practiced to perfection!
At the highest level, it seems perfectly natural as if he was born knowing this Technique!
Perfectly making Five Animals Qigong an instinct.
However, people examine or scrutinize it, they can’t find anything amiss!
Hua Tuo was dumbfounded, incredulous:
"This, this, this..."
Zhao Yun, proud to share the honor, spoke with great achievement:
"Master, I told you Ding Ling learns instantly, masters swiftly, and once mastered, becomes instinctual.
Now do you believe it?"
The way he said it was almost like he’d learned Five Animals Qigong himself.
Clearly, Zhao Yun had long regarded Ding Ling as a friend and confidant.
Otherwise, he wouldn’t act this way.
Hua Tuo was speechless for a long time, as if returning from a state of shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Lightweight Ascension Technique
paragraphs: Hua Tuo couldn’t help but examine Ding Ling thoroughly with bone-touching.
The more he looked, the more confused and puzzled he became.
After a while.
He gave up and sighed deeply:

"Truly, the Great Thousand Worlds are full of wonders! I can’t see through Ding Ling at all! I suppose you were able to learn martial arts so quickly because you’ve tapped into some astonishing human mystery. Unfortunately, my understanding is limited, and I cannot decipher it."
"You are too modest, senior,"
replied Ding Ling solemnly:

"To be able to create such a supreme health care skill as the Five Animals Qigong is evidence of your top-tier talent, insight, and understanding, unmatched among thousands. There’s no need to belittle yourself!"
"Comparing myself to you, I feel like an ordinary talent,"
Hua Tuo spoke directly, revealing his straightforward nature:
"Don’t bother flattering me. Your compliments make me feel utterly ashamed! In front of you, I don’t qualify as ’top-tier’ at all!!"
Ding Ling was speechless and decisively changed the subject:
"Earlier, you climbed steep cliffs as if walking on flat ground—is that the effect of the Five Animals Qigong as well?"
"Partly so,"
Hua Tuo replied without hesitation:
"It’s mainly because I know a lightweight ascension technique."
"Can you teach me?"
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting skills, genuinely earnest, serious, and sincere!
Zhao Yun was impressed, noting that Ding Ling’s shamelessness was increasing. Once he would blush, now he doesn’t even blink!
Hua Tuo was somewhat taken aback.
He glanced at Ding Ling, who truly seemed at ease with him! As if treating him like a family elder, how candid!
"Senior!"
With full-level acting, Ding Ling’s speech was deeply sincere and passionate, making it hard to distinguish his act:
"I will certainly carry forward your martial arts, greatness!"
"...Very well. Since I’ve already taught you the Five Animals Qigong, adding an ascension technique is not much,"
Hua Tuo, in nature, was generous and broad-minded.
He soon came to terms with it, at peace.
And began explaining the ascension technique, the mantra, the moves, and the esoteric truths once again.
His demonstration was very ordinary.
Yet during the movement and elevation, it seemed as if he wandered like an immortal, a divine dragon soaring through the sky—a kind of indescribable elegance, freedom, and grandeur!
This was an embodiment of his inherent nature and martial arts having merged to the Transformation Realm.
Ding Ling secretly admired.
Listening attentively.
After one round.
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A book titled "Ascending Skill" immediately crystallized on the library shelf.
In an instant.
[Ascending Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.1]
Ascending Skill undoubtedly is a high-tier lightweight body technique!
Though it didn’t increase much strength and constitution.
Yet it increased agility by 0.4 points!
The amplified scale is substantial compared to the Sunset Swordsmanship, almost equal to the Overlord Halberd Technique’s boost!
Bear in mind, the full-level Overlord Halberd Technique also added only 0.4 agility.
But now Ding Ling is much stronger than before; even with reduced amplification, it still reaches 0.4.
Showcasing the extraordinary quality of Ascending Skill!
Hoo-hoo!
With each breath, Ding Ling’s whole body felt light and buoyant, as if ready to step on cloud and fly like an immortal at any moment.
At present, his agility far exceeds the past!
This time the enhancement scale is exceptional, causing Ding Ling’s bones, meridian, and more to undergo changes, becoming smoother, resilient, stronger!
"You mastered it?!"
Hua Tuo glanced sideways, was moved.
"Yes,"

Ding Ling nodded, decisively operating the Ascending Skill—whoosh! After Five Animals Qigong entered mastery, combined with Ascending Skill and Breathing Technique, Ding Ling could clamber cliffs like ’child’s play’ just like Hua Tuo—swift, sharp, natural, effortlessly.
Just as if he was inherently an animal adept at climbing steep cliffs!
Hua Tuo was shocked, his heart overturning rivers and seas, unable to contain himself.
Zhao Yun watched numbly.
Yet seeing Hua Tuo’s expression, he couldn’t help but feel a dark satisfaction.
Such mind-blowing sensation, is better shared than borne alone!
Especially when even such high-up personalities are amazed by Ding Ling to the point of tingling scalps, Zhao Yun felt refreshed as if drinking sweet spring water.
Because he is on the same team as Ding Ling!
Anyone who regards his own people as celestial gods, extraordinary beings, how could Zhao Yun not feel collective pride?
Whoo!
Ding Ling descended the steep wall, leaped forward, stood before Hua Tuo, took a deep breath, and bowed with cupped hands:
"Senior, please guide me."
Hua Tuo gazed at the heavens in silence, sighed, shook his head, and said:

"Were it not for knowing my own affairs, I would definitely suspect you mastered my Five Animals Qigong and Ascending Skill long ago. But I remember very clearly, I’ve never taught Five Animals Qigong or Ascending Skill outside of you two."
He examined Ding Ling, filled with awe;
"As the ancient saying goes, in times of chaos, heroes and extraordinary beings rise together. I hope you are a hero!"
"I will,
said Ding Ling earnestly:
"Absolutely will not disappoint your high expectations!"
"Hmm,"
Hua Tuo sighed deeply:
"Five Animals Qigong represents the essence of my lifelong studies distilled. The difficulty of practice is unfathomable, yet you learned it effortlessly. I am deeply struck.
As for Ascending Skill, it took me five or six years to reach mastery.
How long did it take you to achieve mastery?
Truly bizarre, beyond comprehension."
Hua Tuo’s worldview seemed a bit shattered, his gaze toward Ding Ling filled with marvelous light:
"Encountering two random people in the mountains; one is a truly rare genius, and one is a world-renowned extraordinary talent I can’t fathom. Could this be fate’s design?"
After Hua Tuo touched Ding Ling’s bones,
he also touched Zhao Yun’s.
"It must be fate, senior!"
Ding Ling seized the opportunity, responded promptly:
"If you have any supreme skills left, why not teach me altogether?"
Hua Tuo was at a loss, coughed dryly, and said:
"My breathing technique is useless to you. One person can practice at most one internal and one external breathing technique. Even then, the failure rate for cross-techniques is notably high.
Mine is also an external refining breathing technique.
Judging by your aura and temperament, you should be practicing the Luoyang Sword God Wang Yue’s external refining breathing technique.
If so, you absolutely cannot learn my external refining breathing technique."
"Senior,"
Zhao Yun reminded:
"Actually, Ding Ling has already mastered two external refining breathing techniques."
"What?!"
Hua Tuo was startled:
"How is that possible?"
"If you don’t believe, take a look,"
Zhao Yun glanced at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling cooperatively activated both breathing techniques simultaneously.
In an instant.
The sharpness of the Sword God Breathing Technique and the noble overbearing aura of the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique manifested simultaneously, blended perfectly.
Hua Tuo watched, jaw dropping, his chin seemingly about to hit the ground.
After quite a while.
With a shocked expression, he said:
"Incredible, incredible indeed! How many years have I roamed Jiuzhou? Today’s experience is truly an eye-opener!"

chapters.title: Chapter 124: The Legacy of Medicine King Bian Que
paragraphs: "You must know that from ancient times to the present, no one has succeeded in cultivating two External Refining Breathing Techniques."
Hua Tuo looked at Ding Ling with a peculiar expression:
"You’ve broken records! Surpassed the Saints, you’ve become a pioneer of the new era! Incredible, absolutely incredible!"
He did not shy away from mentioning the Saints, directly stating that Ding Ling might become a mythical figure like the Yellow Emperor, Chiyou, or Confucius!
"The future holds much promise, endless possibilities."
Hua Tuo was very pleased and happy:
"To meet an era-opening figure like you, truly, fate has brought us together."
"In that case, may I learn your other martial arts?"
Ding Ling looked at Hua Tuo with great anticipation.
Hua Tuo was momentarily speechless, then said:
"Alright. Anyway, I’ve taught you Five Animals Qigong and Ascending Skill. Teaching you Breathing Technique doesn’t matter."
He sighed:
"I am getting old, and the world is in chaos; I could die in the flames of war at any time. I’ve always regretted not finding a suitable heir. Meeting you two is really a surprise."
He expressed his joy without reservation:
"Very well. I’ll just teach you all. Just hope that in the future, you find suitable disciples to pass on my Martial Arts Heart Method and others, so they don’t become lost."
Hua Tuo could travel alone across the Jiuzhou Land, often venturing into deep forests filled with wolves, tigers, and leopards to collect herbs.
He understands body techniques.
He knows martial arts.
It seems not beyond understanding.
But he also knows Breathing Techniques, especially the supreme ’Medicine King Breathing Technique.’
Ding Ling was surprised.
But at this moment, it was not appropriate to ask more, just listened carefully.
After one session.
A book formed on the library’s shelf, appearing unstable and illusory.
It was the Medicine King Breathing Technique.
Besides the illusory Medicine King Breathing Technique, there were also the illusory Warrior’s Breathing Method and Flying Bear Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling pondered:
"It seems my body’s condition hasn’t reached the level to withstand three External Refining Breathing Techniques. Otherwise, I could instantly reach full level."
If the body can’t bear it and insists on doing it, it might lead to an explosion and death.
From ancient times to the present.
How many Saints, heroes, brave men?
None had succeeded in cultivating two External Refining Breathing Techniques; Ding Ling succeeded with cheats and fully mastered them. He broke historical records.
Want to cultivate another?
Ding Ling estimated he might need to break through another barrier or bottleneck?
What the truth is remains unknown.
"Remember?"
Hua Tuo asked.
Ding Ling nodded.
Hua Tuo asked again if he had learned it?
Ding Ling shook his head.
Hua Tuo, however, breathed a sigh of relief:

"If you mastered the third External Refining Breathing Technique, I think even the Saints would rise from the dead! Because this is simply a fantasy. No. To be precise, cultivating two External Refining Breathing Techniques to mastery is already a fantasy. You’ve become the mythic legend of the new era."
He clicked his tongue and praised.
Then introduced himself.
Afterward, he said:

"All that I have learned, besides Breathing Technique, Five Animals Qigong, Ascending Skill, all my focus has been on medical skills. Compared to martial arts, my medical skills are truly formidable."
"Did your medical skills pass down from a Medicine King?"
"I can’t say that."
Hua Tuo reflected for a moment and said:

"I indeed received the inheritance of Medicine King Bian Que; I obtained Medicine King Breathing Technique and Inner Scripture from his medical texts. But most of my medical skills still come from family supreme skills. Moreover, I’ve traveled extensively, searched for ancient medical prescriptions, read countless medical books; that’s how I’ve achieved today’s medical accomplishments."
The three talked for quite a while.
Ding Ling expressed his desire to learn medicine.
Hua Tuo was puzzled:
"Your talent in Martial Dao is unparalleled! Why give up a watermelon to pick a sesame seed? Developing your Martial Dao has a more promising future than developing Medical Dao."
"I also have talent in Medical Dao."
Ding Ling’s full-level acting naturally activated, confident and straightforward, completely calm:
"I can definitely become a Medical God of the era!"
Zhao Yun was speechless. Ding Ling could act anytime and anywhere; the feeling was very subtle.
After spending a long time with Ding Ling.
Zhao Yun naturally knew what character Ding Ling was and what he usually behaved like.
Now this appearance, no need to think, he knew it was an act!
But this act was so natural.
A genius!
Even the acting was so lifelike!
Zhao Yun felt inferior.
If Ding Ling were serious and earnest, Zhao Yun wouldn’t dare to confirm Ding Ling was acting; he would still think Ding Ling had thick skin or something.
But with this confident and spirited look.
Isn’t it obvious he’s acting?
Ding Ling usually isn’t like this!
"This..."
Hua Tuo wasn’t familiar with Ding Ling, but seeing Ding Ling exude strong confidence from within, he couldn’t help but be moved, stroked his beard and hesitated for a while, then said:
"It’s not impossible to pass on you my family’s supreme skills. Unless you can prove your talent in Medical Dao. Besides helping me with one thing."
"Feel free to say, senior. How do I prove it? And how to help?"
"Proving is simple.
Hua Tuo said:
"I can teach you Bian Que’s Pulse Diagnosis Technique now. Then teach you Bian Que’s Inner Scripture technique; once you master these two, treating internal ailments should pose no problem."
Ding Ling was overjoyed and thanked him.
It’s said Hua Tuo is merely a surgical master.
Now it seems somewhat false.
To become a generation’s Divine Doctor, how could Hua Tuo be mediocre?!
Not saying he’s omnipotent, but definitely adept in internal medicine!
Perhaps his inner medicine supreme skills all became lost, leading to the misconception he’s just a surgical master.
However, one undeniable fact is that Hua Tuo is definitely proficient in surgery!
"You’re welcome."
Hua Tuo smiled:
"If you truly have great talent in Medical Dao, gaining an associate, I couldn’t wish for more."
He sighed:
"There are too few true Divine Doctors on the Jiuzhou Land."
Hanging the gall and curing the world, miraculous hands and returning spring with a heart full of kindness.
This describes people like Hua Tuo.
Ding Ling greatly admired people like this.
But he could never become such a person because he couldn’t be completely selfless, wholeheartedly for the people.
"Listen carefully. This is the Heart Technique, Mantra of the Inner Scripture..."
Hua Tuo began to meticulously analyze and explain to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling focused his attention.
After one session.
Hua Tuo stopped, somewhat expectantly looked at Ding Ling.
He believed Ding Ling wouldn’t be able to learn the Inner Scripture in one go.
Because the Medical Dao is different from Martial Dao! It is typically easy to learn but hard to master.
Of course, even easy to learn is for geniuses. For ordinary people, the difficulty of Inner Scripture isn’t low.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book formed on the shelf:
"Inner Scripture"
In an instant.
[Inner Scripture Full Level]
[Charisma +0.3]
Various related essences, truths, esoteric truths of Inner Scripture surged and roared in the Sea of Consciousness.
Then quickly transformed into an instinct, rushing into every corner of Ding Ling’s body.
In just a moment.
Ding Ling completely penetrated the Inner Scripture.
Acknowledged all the secrets of the Inner Scripture.

Ding Ling could act anytime and anywhere; the feeling was very subtle.
After spending a long time with Ding Ling.
Zhao Yun naturally knew what character Ding Ling was and what he usually behaved like.
Now this appearance, no need to think, he knew it was an act!
But this act was so natural.
A genius!
Even the acting was so lifelike!
Zhao Yun felt inferior.
If Ding Ling were serious and earnest, Zhao Yun wouldn’t dare to confirm Ding Ling was acting; he would still think Ding Ling had thick skin or something.
But with this confident and spirited look.
Isn’t it obvious he’s acting?
Ding Ling usually isn’t like this!
"This..."
Hua Tuo wasn’t familiar with Ding Ling, but seeing Ding Ling exude strong confidence from within, he couldn’t help but be moved, stroked his beard and hesitated for a while, then said:
"It’s not impossible to pass on you my family’s supreme skills.
Unless you can prove your talent in Medical Dao.
Besides helping me with one thing."
"Feel free to say, senior.
How do I prove it?
And how to help?"
"Proving is simple.
Hua Tuo said:
"I can teach you Bian Que’s Pulse Diagnosis Technique now.
Then teach you Bian Que’s Inner Scripture technique; once you master these two, treating internal ailments should pose no problem."
Ding Ling was overjoyed and thanked him.
It’s said Hua Tuo is merely a surgical master.
Now it seems somewhat false.
To become a generation’s Divine Doctor, how could Hua Tuo be mediocre?!
Not saying he’s omnipotent, but definitely adept in internal medicine!
Perhaps his inner medicine supreme skills all became lost, leading to the misconception he’s just a surgical master.
However, one undeniable fact is that Hua Tuo is definitely proficient in surgery!
"You’re welcome."
Hua Tuo smiled:
"If you truly have great talent in Medical Dao, gaining an associate, I couldn’t wish for more."
He sighed:
"There are too few true Divine Doctors on the Jiuzhou Land."
Hanging the gall and curing the world, miraculous hands and returning spring with a heart full of kindness.
This describes people like Hua Tuo.
Ding Ling greatly admired people like this.
But he could never become such a person because he couldn’t be completely selfless, wholeheartedly for the people.
"Listen carefully.
This is the Heart Technique, Mantra of the Inner Scripture..."
Hua Tuo began to meticulously analyze and explain to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling focused his attention.
After one session.
Hua Tuo stopped, somewhat expectantly looked at Ding Ling.
He believed Ding Ling wouldn’t be able to learn the Inner Scripture in one go.
Because the Medical Dao is different from Martial Dao!
It is typically easy to learn but hard to master.
Of course, even easy to learn is for geniuses.
For ordinary people, the difficulty of Inner Scripture isn’t low.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book formed on the shelf:
"Inner Scripture"
In an instant.
[Inner Scripture Full Level]
[Charisma +0.3]
Various related essences, truths, esoteric truths of Inner Scripture surged and roared in the Sea of Consciousness.
Then quickly transformed into an instinct, rushing into every corner of Ding Ling’s body.
In just a moment.
Ding Ling completely penetrated the Inner Scripture.
Acknowledged all the secrets of the Inner Scripture.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Hua Tuo Comes Here to Gather Medicinal Herbs
paragraphs: No doubt about it.
Ding Ling can now be regarded as a Medical Grandmaster.
After all, he had already mastered numerous medical skills in the real world.
If supplemented with the incredible techniques and methods of the Inner Scripture, Ding Ling’s medical skills undoubtedly reach a new pinnacle at this moment.
And because of the Inner Scripture’s enhancement.
Ding Ling embodies the aura of ’compassionate heart’, ’relieving the world’, and a ’Saint’ aura!
This is the exclusive aura of the Saints of the Medical School.
Hua Tuo recognized it at a glance and couldn’t help but take a deep breath, muttering:
"It shouldn’t be possible, right? Master the Inner Scripture in one go?! How extraordinary must one’s medical talent be to achieve this?"
You should know he spent immense effort to master the Inner Scripture.
It took him tremendous hard work, time, and mental exertion!
Not counting energy and spirit.
The time alone was measured in years!
But Ding Ling?!
Hua Tuo looked at Ding Ling, filled with uncertainty.
Ding Ling opened his eyes and thanked again.
Hua Tuo waved his hand, indicating no need, he urgently asked:
"Did you learn it?!"
"Yes."
Hua Tuo felt as if struck by lightning, his body trembled for a while before calming down.
Even his hand stroking his beard was trembling, showing how shocked and shaken he was inwardly!
The turmoil in his Heart Lake and internal organs were insufficient to describe his complex emotions at this moment.
Hua Tuo took a deep breath, still unable to stay calm:

"In Martial Dao, it is understandable. The Medical Dao, unlike Martial Dao, requires real experience in practice to gradually understand the intricacies, then clear the meridians, organize everything, comprehend the truth, and master the essence! But you?"
Ding Ling solemnly said:
"Medicine and Martial Dao are interconnected. I believe I am indeed extraordinarily talented and unparalleled in this field! If you don’t believe me, test me."
This is where acting skills come into play.
Although his face is thick-skinned now, facing a generation’s ’Divine Doctor’ Hua Tuo.
Without hiding behind acting skills, he couldn’t help but feel nervous, leading to revealing flaws.
"Alright."
Hua Tuo didn’t hesitate, immediately starting the examination.
The content of the examination naturally concerned various techniques and methods within the Inner Scripture.
He specially sought some animals with internal injuries from the deep mountains for Ding Ling to diagnose.
The Inner Scripture can treat humans.
Naturally, it can also diagnose and treat animals!
This is the supreme Medical Dao method, utilizing Pulse Diagnosis Technique, observation, inquiry, palpation, and other methods.
Of course, animals can’t speak and can’t communicate, some Techniques don’t work here.
But the majority are still applicable.
After reaching full level in the Inner Scripture, Ding Ling has already integrated its various concepts into Mastery and comprehended everything.
Although lacking in experience, he is like the World’s Number One War General who has never been on the battlefield, truly entering the battlefield. For him, dealing with some minor soldiers is easy.
Thus.
Ding Ling’s diagnostic experience accumulates and increases crazily as he diagnoses one animal after another.
After a half day.
Hua Tuo spoke gasping:
"Alright, alright. You’ve passed."
He stopped the examination.
After all, it’s difficult to specifically find some relevant cases.
And by observing Ding Ling’s starting techniques and methods, Hua Tuo already determined that Ding Ling indeed learned the Inner Scripture.
He felt it was incredible.
But after the shock, he felt more joy.
"It seems another Divine Doctor is about to emerge in the world."
Hua Tuo laughed heartily, the laugh echoing and agitating endlessly in the forest.
He suddenly looked at Ding Ling:
"Do you know why I ventured into this deep mountain and forest region?"
"To gather herbs?"
"Correct."
Hua Tuo stroked his beard and said:
"I’m here to gather herbs. The mountains stretch far and wide, with few inhabitants. Various ancient herbs root here! Some rare medicinal herbs I seek can only be found here."
He paused and said:
"Now that I’ve collected the herbs, I’m ready to leave the mountains."
He looked at Ding Ling:
"If you want to learn my family’s Supreme Skill, help me cure the Runan epidemic this time, and I’ll teach you."
"Runan epidemic?"
Ding Ling was startled.
"Indeed."
Hua Tuo’s expression became solemn as water:

"Years of war have left the people living in hardship, too many are barely surviving among the common folks. Especially in places like Runan, pillaged repeatedly by Yellow Turban Thieves, bandits, and fearsome outlaws, ten rooms empty is commonplace, and silence within ten miles is usual.
In some areas, white bones lie unburied, temperatures rise, corpses decay, leading to the spread of epidemics. I am here to gather herbs to treat the epidemic.
If you can accompany me to resolve this epidemic, I’ll pass on the Qingnang Scripture to you."
"Qingnang Scripture?"
Ding Ling felt it sounded familiar.
After pondering slightly, he suddenly realized.
Isn’t this the lost supreme medical skill?
"Indeed, the Qingnang Scripture.
Hua Tuo nodded, saying:

"The Qingnang Scripture covers all treatments for human internal organs, skin membranes, and other parts. Internal and external treatment methods are described. It also includes complementary skills such as acupuncture.
Once you completely master the Qingnang Scripture, you can become my equal!"
"I’m in!"
Ding Ling decisively agreed. Heading south to Yangzhou, taking a detour, Runan is on the way.
"Good."
Hua Tuo was very pleased:
"Your courage is commendable! Many hear the word epidemic and shy away like avoiding snakes and scorpions, yet you knowingly head into danger, your spirit and bravery are praiseworthy!"
"I’m purely after mastering your Supreme Skill."
Ding Ling said earnestly, straightforwardly.
"Hahaha..."
Hua Tuo laughed:
"In this troubled world, finding someone dedicated to the Medical Dao and talented is very rare. Meeting you is my luck. I’m not qualified to be your master.
During this Runan journey, regardless of the outcome.
I will teach you all I’ve learned."
Hua Tuo also hoped to find a successor before he died.
But he has never managed to fulfill this wish.
After all, the world is too chaotic.
To live peacefully is a luxury for the common people.
How could they have time to study medicine?
As for the Royal Family and the aristocrats, they prefer studying state governance, Military Strategy, Martial Dao over Medical Dao!
Because they consider the Medical Dao as a humble pursuit.
Thus, Hua Tuo had difficulty finding a suitable successor.
Ding Ling’s unexpected arrival was also a pleasant surprise for him.
He’s come here to gather herbs more than once.
Never thought this time he would meet such extraordinary talents, especially Ding Ling, whose medical talent is no weaker than his martial skill.
This for Hua Tuo is a great joy!
After the three chatted and made arrangements.
They headed out of the mountain together.
Hua Tuo, a seasoned Divine Doctor who often frequents the wilderness.
Actually knows a few trails.
Using these trails, it can at least reduce the journey by one or two days.
Keep in mind, horseback riding in this mountain is almost impossible.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun both traveled on foot.
Hua Tuo’s guidance was truly timely rain.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Who Is the Horse Thief
paragraphs: On the road, Ding Ling inquired if there were any Great Medicines in the mountains.
Hua Tuo understood what Ding Ling meant:
"No."
He sighed:

"Even if there were, they would be impossible to find in a short time. Any conspicuous Great Medicines have long been picked by hunters and medicine gatherers who live at the foot of the mountains. They earn their living by picking Great Medicines. Their experience in gathering herbs is extremely rich.
Especially as the years of warfare drag on.
The number of Martial Artists has skyrocketed.
The demand for Great Medicines has risen crazily!
The medicine gatherers have nearly harvested all the obvious Great Medicines clean.
Even when I sometimes urgently need some Great Medicines to treat people, it’s hard to find them."
"I see."
Zhao Yun understood:
"No wonder we haven’t seen a single Great Medicine along the way."
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun are both Military Generals.
The Cultivation Breathing Technique requires Great Medicines.
While traveling through the deep forest, they inevitably watch the surroundings for any herbs.
Unfortunately.
They didn’t see a single one.
Even the lucky Zhao Yun couldn’t find any.
Naturally, Ding Ling also gained nothing.
This demonstrates that Hua Tuo was entirely correct.
The wars in recent years have truly harvested all visible and discoverable Great Medicines!
"Indeed."
Hua Tuo sighed:

"The true Great Medicines are now hidden in the treasure vaults of some great families. They lack neither money nor manpower, so Great Medicines are hard to find in the market. You used to be able to buy them.
But as the chaos deepens.
As soon as a Great Medicine appears, the eyes of the great families immediately notice, report to their superiors, and then quickly purchase them.
Because of the increasingly frantic stockpiling of Great Medicines by the great families.
The market price of Great Medicines remains high.
I can’t afford them anymore.
Even some somewhat precious herbs are too expensive for me.
I have no choice but to enter the deep mountains and forests to pick them myself."
He glanced at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, laughed heartily, quite delighted:
"As the ancient saying goes, ’Blessings and misfortunes are intertwined!’ It seems like bad luck hit me, but meeting you two isn’t a blessing? It seems there is destiny in the unseen world.
Accumulate enough merit, and Heaven will help me too."
Ding Ling didn’t have the heart to discourage Hua Tuo, just nodded silently.
In this age where rituals and music are on the verge of collapse, those who are not ruthless often struggle to survive.

Liu Bei appears merciful, but he can strike at his adopted son, make a subtle move when Lü Bu surrenders, and shatter his child in front of everyone... All of which show that he possesses great wisdom and courage, not to mention his determination, decisiveness, resilience, and excellent ability to unite people, all are first-class.
How could such a person truly be a high-minded person like Hua Tuo who serves the people?
Though Hua Tuo was so virtuous, he ultimately met his end at Cao Mengde’s hands.
It can only be said that it’s difficult for good people to live long in chaotic times.
How ’vicious’ is Jia Xu?
Yet he lived to over seventy, dying a natural death!
Unless good people, like Tong Yuan and others, live in seclusion, not meddling in worldly disputes.
Otherwise, when contending with a group of villains in Magical Battles, good people often get defeated or killed by evil people due to their kindness, etc.
Ding Ling has his own principles and values.
He certainly respects and admires good people like Hua Tuo and is willing to engage with such people.
But he will never become such a person.
Especially in chaotic times.
He does not wish to die young!
The road was difficult and winding.
And they were caught in a heavy rain.
The three of them, along with eight horses, got drenched.
By the time they emerged from the deep mountains and reached a farmer’s house at the foot for shelter, it was already dark.
The three of them stayed there for the night.
The next day.
Ding Ling gave the farmer some money and was about to leave.
Clatter, clatter!
Along with shouting, the thunderous sound of hooves came from afar.
The galloping horses moved quickly.
As soon as Ding Ling and the others led their horses out of the farmer’s yard and mounted them,
a group of people had already charged up to Ding Ling and the others.
"Are these the three?"
This group was clad in solid armor, wearing helmets, each was tall and burly, holding long spears.
The leader, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, full of whiskers, held a large hammer, looking majestic and fierce.
He gripped the reins with one hand, pointing his hammer at Ding Ling and the others, looking at a soldier at his side:
"Are you sure it’s them who stole our horses?"
The soldier, timid and less than seven feet tall, compared to the other Great Han, looked like a scholar. Faced with the leader’s questioning, he shook with fear and instinctively nodded.
The leader laughed, hammer in hand pointed at Ding Ling and the others:
"Did you hear that? You’d better scram if you know what’s good for you! Otherwise, you’ll be in trouble!"
He glared, eyes wide as if Thunder God was angry, roaring, like a lion raging, his eyes glowing fiercely, like a venomous snake squinting, ready to pounce at any moment.
A person with three kinds of complex expressions intertwined and fused.
It can be seen that this person must be a capricious person.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, quite displeased:
"We don’t know each other. Isn’t it too much to falsely accuse us out of thin air!"
If Hua Tuo weren’t present,
Ding Ling would have already drawn his bow and shot down the group.
As the killings increased.
Constantly competing with famous generals in the realm.
Ding Ling’s mindset has subtly changed unknowingly.
Becoming more confident, calm, and decisive in killing!
"Hahaha..."
The leader was stunned, then laughed heartily, as if hearing the most ridiculous joke in the world, but suddenly, he stopped laughing, looked at Ding Ling with a sullen face, and said sinisterly:
"Do you not recognize me?"
"Why should I know you?"
Ding Ling was perplexed:
"Who do you think you are?"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Yun immediately gripped his Dragon Gall Silver Spear tightly.
Hua Tuo, sensing something amiss, immediately stepped forward, greeted the leader without arrogance, and said:
"General, we are just passing by, strangers meeting by chance, it’s impossible we stole your horses. These horses were brought by my two young friends from the Si Li Region."
"Si Li Region?"
The leader sneered disdainfully:
"This is Nanyang, separated by layers of mountains from Si Li! And you tell me you came from Si Li, do you really take me for a fool?"
"It’s true."
Hua Tuo said solemnly:
"Moreover, even if my two young friends didn’t take the mountain road. To bring horses from Si Li to Nanyang, there are many paths. Why are you so sure we stole your horses?"
"Alas."
The leader sighed, suddenly clamped the horse’s belly, causing the horse to gallop forward in pain.
The leader then swung his large hammer, smashing it heavily towards Hua Tuo’s head, grinning ferociously:
"Old chap, refusing the toast only to drink the forfeit. You’re almost in the grave. What are you doing acting heroic?"
The wind from the hammer was fierce, filled with Evil Qi!
Hua Tuo was dumbfounded, instinctively ready to use Ascending Skill to retreat, but couldn’t be quicker than the horse!
Seeing Hua Tuo about to be struck down.
Swoosh!
An arrow suddenly shot out from the side.
Through whistling whirlwinds crossing the void, with a crisp pfft.
The arrow hit the leader’s forehead directly, penetrating more than two inches deep!
The entire arrowhead deeply embedded into the person’s skull.
