He glared, eyes wide as if Thunder God was angry, roaring, like a lion raging, his eyes glowing fiercely, like a venomous snake squinting, ready to pounce at any moment.
A person with three kinds of complex expressions intertwined and fused.
It can be seen that this person must be a capricious person.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, quite displeased:
"We don’t know each other.
Isn’t it too much to falsely accuse us out of thin air!"
If Hua Tuo weren’t present,
Ding Ling would have already drawn his bow and shot down the group.
As the killings increased.
Constantly competing with famous generals in the realm.
Ding Ling’s mindset has subtly changed unknowingly.
Becoming more confident, calm, and decisive in killing!
"Hahaha..."
The leader was stunned, then laughed heartily, as if hearing the most ridiculous joke in the world, but suddenly, he stopped laughing, looked at Ding Ling with a sullen face, and said sinisterly:
"Do you not recognize me?"
"Why should I know you?"
Ding Ling was perplexed:
"Who do you think you are?"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Yun immediately gripped his Dragon Gall Silver Spear tightly.
Hua Tuo, sensing something amiss, immediately stepped forward, greeted the leader without arrogance, and said:
"General, we are just passing by, strangers meeting by chance, it’s impossible we stole your horses.
These horses were brought by my two young friends from the Si Li Region."
"Si Li Region?"
The leader sneered disdainfully:
"This is Nanyang, separated by layers of mountains from Si Li!
And you tell me you came from Si Li, do you really take me for a fool?"
"It’s true."
Hua Tuo said solemnly:
"Moreover, even if my two young friends didn’t take the mountain road.
To bring horses from Si Li to Nanyang, there are many paths.
Why are you so sure we stole your horses?"
"Alas."
The leader sighed, suddenly clamped the horse’s belly, causing the horse to gallop forward in pain.
The leader then swung his large hammer, smashing it heavily towards Hua Tuo’s head, grinning ferociously:
"Old chap, refusing the toast only to drink the forfeit.
You’re almost in the grave.
What are you doing acting heroic?"
The wind from the hammer was fierce, filled with Evil Qi!
Hua Tuo was dumbfounded, instinctively ready to use Ascending Skill to retreat, but couldn’t be quicker than the horse!
Seeing Hua Tuo about to be struck down.
Swoosh!
An arrow suddenly shot out from the side.
Through whistling whirlwinds crossing the void, with a crisp pfft.
The arrow hit the leader’s forehead directly, penetrating more than two inches deep!
The entire arrowhead deeply embedded into the person’s skull.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Yuan Shu’s General Lei Bo
paragraphs: The leader died on the spot.
The raised sledgehammer fell powerlessly to the ground.
He looked toward Ding Ling’s position with a face full of astonishment and disbelief, the fierce and cruel light in his eyes gradually fading.
"General Lei!"
The leader had led a team of more than a hundred people here.
These people, seeing their leader dead, were filled with grief and anger.
One by one, they grabbed their spears and rode their horses toward Ding Ling, Hua Tuo, and Zhao Yun, shouting loudly:
"Avenge General Lei!"
"Hmph."
Ding Ling snorted lightly, squeezed the belly of his Ferghana Horse.
After a period of contact and interaction with Ding Ling, the Ferghana Horse had already been completely tamed and subdued by him.
It was extremely intelligent; once Ding Ling squeezed its flanks, it quickly charged out, heading straight for the enemy.
Clang!
Ding Ling raised the halberd in his hand.
The Overlord Halberd Technique was unleashed, sweeping through enemies like autumn leaves.
Wherever he passed, limbs flew and scattered.
In just a few blinks of an eye, Ding Ling had torn through the team, then turned around amidst their terrified gazes to kill again.
"Ah!"
"Run fast!"
Seeing Ding Ling so fierce and terrifying.
The team immediately fell into disarray, scattering and riding off in all directions.
"Trying to run?"
Ding Ling easily killed a few people.
He took out the Six-Stone Bow.

He bent his bow, nocked an arrow, aimed at three, and whoosh, whoosh, whoosh! Three Tornado Arrows shot out, slicing through the sky like lightning, embedding into the backs of three soldiers in the blink of an eye, accompanied by three screams.
The three of them were suddenly knocked off their horses by a great force!
With the Full Level of Five Animals Qigong and Ascending Skill.
Ding Ling’s strength, agility, and physique had all increased.
Stronger power, faster speed, longer endurance!
In addition, the Full Level of Inner Scripture allowed Ding Ling to better understand the weak points of the human body; almost every arrow hit a vital point!
One could say.
Ding Ling’s efficiency in killing enemies has improved by more than thirty percent!
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Zhao Yun hadn’t even had time to make a move, as arrows rained down all around.
The seventy or eighty cavalry that fled were all shot off their horses.
Hua Tuo was dumbfounded, astonished as if seeing a Celestial Being:
"Such strong archery skills, such high physique!"
Only with an amazing physique could one draw the Six-Stone Bow at such high speed while maintaining peak condition!
This is extremely rare.
According to Hua Tuo’s knowledge.
The vast majority of Super-Elite Experts didn’t have a strong enough physique!
With Ding Ling’s physique, if it came to a long battle, he could definitely crush over ninety percent of the Super-Elite!
[Achieved Achievement Medal: Annihilate General Lei Bo’s Elite Thunder Cavalry!]
[Note: Lei Bo, as a major general under Yuan Shu, commanded over ten thousand troops, guarding the area north of Nanyang. His Thunder Cavalry roamed unchallenged in Nanyang.
The Elite Thunder Cavalry were exceptionally brave and strong.
You single-handedly severely crippled and destroyed them. Surely, this will cause an uproar in the area!]
A notification sound echoed in his ear.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow slightly as he listened.
He hadn’t expected the team he casually killed to be Lei Bo’s Elite Thunder Cavalry.
No wonder they felt rather troublesome.
But that was all.
He was now even stronger than when he battled Lü Bu!

With the enhancement of Five Animals Qigong, Ascending Skill, and Inner Scripture, his efficiency in killing enemies had skyrocketed; with the Six-Stone Bow in hand, he was like a ’lawnmower’ on the battlefield!
No matter how strong the Thunder Cavalry were, they were just like weeds to him, something to be solved with a single arrow!
But why did this cavalry come looking for trouble with him?
He looked toward the Seven-foot Scholar dressed as a soldier, motioning for him to come over.
Ding Ling had deliberately spared him.
He wanted to figure out what was going on.

The Seven-foot Scholar felt his scalp tingle, cold sweat on his back, his feet heavy as lead; but with Ding Ling’s gesture, he didn’t dare ignore it, and trembling with fear, he stumbled over to Ding Ling.
Then ’thud’, he knelt down:
"Hero! Have mercy!
He pleaded first.
Ding Ling waved his hand, indicating for him to rise.

With Hua Tuo by his side, he didn’t want to kill indiscriminately, but it was clear the Seven-foot Scholar wasn’t innocent; Ding Ling put on an act, trying to appear amiable and natural, lest he accidentally kill him with a stab of his halberd.
Was the urge to kill growing stronger?
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, hastily calming his boiling emotions with two Breathing Techniques.
It was no wonder War Generals had such intense Evil Qi.
Killing so many did indeed turn one into a ruthless god of death!
Ding Ling realized his frame of mind was off.
How long had it been?
How many people had he killed along the way?
Bloodshed had already tainted him.
Fortunately, his Breathing Technique was extraordinary, able to suppress it, and he believed that after some recuperation, there shouldn’t be any problem.
But now, it seemed he wouldn’t have time to rest; he’d have to use the Techniques from Inner Scripture and Five Animals Qigong to help suppress it along with the Breathing Technique.
Be it the Techniques from Inner Scripture or Five Animals Qigong, they were extremely calm and balanced, rightly so.
Rapid operation over a period brought him back to normalcy; he marveled secretly, growing more interested in Health Care Skill and Medical Dao techniques, Heart Techniques.
He was bound to step into higher Martial Dao in the future, likely to kill even more, so learning some ’Heart-calming Techniques’ was quite necessary.
"Speak."
Ding Ling looked down at the Seven-foot Scholar:
"What’s going on exactly? Who was the leader just now?"
"The leader was Lei Bo."
So it was Lei Bo indeed.
One of the Generals under Yuan Shu notorious for pillage and plunder.
Ding Ling had an impression of Lei Bo.
This guy left Yuan Shu, and together with Chen Lan, they became mountain bandits, even attacking the defeated Yuan Shu, looting treasures, etc. Completely disloyal, a bandit through and through.
And indeed, as expected, someone who could unhesitantly and blatantly accuse others of horse theft to justify robbery was no less than a bandit!
Lei Bo was even more reckless than a bandit; seeing Hua Tuo argue, he swung a hammer intending to kill him.
A true scoundrel! A bully!
Thinking about the numerous people like this in the real world, Ding Ling accepted it. It was a time of chaos, after all, and such people were not uncommon.
"After Dong Zhuo seized power, Yuan Shu fled to Nanyang. As the direct descendant of the Yuan Family, he naturally had many supporters upon arrival. Lei Bo was just one among them.

Since Lei Bo pledged allegiance early and flattered Yuan Shu well, Yuan Shu valued him. Not long ago, Yuan Shu joined the Alliance Against Dong, commanding Lei Bo to guard the northern part of Nanyang.
Without Yuan Shu’s oversight.
Lei Bo acted even more lawlessly, with extortion being common, oppressing good people, bullying the weak, and exploiting good families, women as daily occurrences..."

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Warrior Yann Xiang (33/50)
paragraphs: "...Lei Bo’s actions attracted many hooligans, ruffians, bandits, etc. to join his cavalry troops."
At this point.
The Seven-foot Scholar secretly glanced at Ding Ling, then quickly lowered his head and swiftly said:
"Hero, your eight horses are indeed conspicuous. Not long ago, someone reported your affairs to a local bully, who, in order to gain Lei Bo’s favor, immediately reported the matter. And then..."
Ding Ling understood.
He asked:
"Who reported it to the bully? And where is the bully?"
"The bully has already been shot by you, hero."
The Seven-foot Scholar pointed to a cavalryman lying dead dozens of meters away:
"That fellow was promoted on the spot by Lei Bo to become an elite member of the Thunder Cavalry due to his meritorious report. As for who passed it to the bully?"
He glanced at the farmer behind Ding Ling, the implication was clear.
The farmer’s family had eight members.
The courtyard was extremely spacious!
It counted as a local wealthy family, otherwise they wouldn’t be able to accommodate Ding Ling and three others with eight horses.
The head of the household had been watching the battle closely.
When he saw Ding Ling’s prowess, his face turned pale as paper in fear.
Seeing Ding Ling summon the Seven-foot Scholar.
The scholar confessed everything honestly.
The head of the household could no longer stand, and despite his fear, he walked out of the courtyard, knelt down with a thud and kept bowing his head, saying:
"Hero, spare us, hero, spare us! We were momentarily blinded by foolishness, that led to our big mistake. Hero, spare us."
The farmer’s wife and children also came out, the wife knelt on the ground, wiping tears and speaking mournfully:

"That Lei Bo rampages through this area, not long ago, he even kidnapped several of my daughters. We thought that if we offered your eight good horses, even if Lei Bo wouldn’t return our daughters, he would at least treat us kindly. And, and..."
At this point.
The farmer’s wife bowed her head repeatedly:
"We had already informed the other party clearly beforehand, they only want the horses, they definitely wouldn’t harm your lives, we did not expect Lei Bo would..."
"Ah."

Ding Ling sighed, his heart surged with killing intent, he practiced Five Animals Qigong and Inner Scripture techniques to calm his mind, and after a long time, he suppressed the turbulent killing intent.
"Forget it."
Hua Tuo, a typical good-hearted elder, saw this and softened, saying:

"They were also forced to do this. Lei Bo is cruel and tyrannical, living under his rule, the people are fearful every day. So, it’s understandable they would act this way. Moreover, they had no intention of harming us."
He sighed:
"Blame it on society being too chaotic!"
He looked at Ding Ling:
"Let’s just give them a face."
He felt somewhat guilty, ashamed, his old face slightly red.
He knew that if it weren’t for Ding Ling’s decisive intervention, he would have already crossed to the Western Heaven!
So although he thought Ding Ling’s killing was excessive, he didn’t stop it.
It was only when the farmer’s family came out that he couldn’t help but stand up and advise a few words.

Even so, he felt very embarrassed, thinking that once they were past this place, he should give the Qingnang Scripture to Ding Ling. There’s no need to really wait until he reaches Runan to treat the plague before giving it.
Meeting Ding Ling, such a medical genius, was a completely unexpected joy for him.
Earlier, he only thought of testing Ding Ling for a bit.
Now Ding Ling had become his lifesaver, moreover, he had just advised Ding Ling not to kill the farmers, he felt somewhat guilty, feeling he had let Ding Ling down.
He thought of passing on the Qingnang Scripture immediately. Yet, it was clearly not the right time now.
"Alright then."
Others’ face could be ignored.
Hua Tuo’s could not be.
After all, he had helped him greatly in the wilderness.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling didn’t want to deal with people there anymore, he mounted his horse and left directly.
Hua Tuo also mounted a horse.
He led the way ahead.
"Hero..."
The Seven-foot Scholar couldn’t help calling out.
"What is it?"
Ding Ling held the reins, looked back at him.
The Seven-foot Scholar enduring discomfort, caught up, saluted with cupped fists, whispered:

"Thank you, hero, for not killing me. I need to tell you something. Lei Bo is Yuan Shu’s confidant. Recently, Yuan Shu’s son, Yuan Yao, also came to the Northern Lands. He is now five or six miles ahead, on a clearing leading over a thousand Thunder Cavalry soldiers awaiting Lei Bo. If you go, you will inevitably encounter them, it is best to be cautious."
"You have a kind heart."
Ding Ling deeply looked at the Seven-foot Scholar, asked:
"What is your name?"
"Yann Xiang."
"Yann Xiang?"
Ding Ling was surprised, sideways glance.
Yann Xiang, a late Eastern Han Dynasty figure, Yuan Shu’s Chief Clerk.
He was a brilliant strategist on Yuan Shu’s side!
Unexpectedly met him here, and he’s in such dire straits?
It couldn’t be, could it?!
But when he thought of the players’ intervention, Ding Ling was relieved.
With players involved, anything could happen.
Yann Xiang looked so downtrodden, maybe because he hadn’t truly grown yet, or maybe he was heavily oppressed by Lei Bo and others, or maybe he was too bullied by hooligans and ruffians...
No matter the truth.
Yann Xiang’s original image, in this instant, completely shattered in Ding Ling’s heart.
He didn’t ask how Yann Xiang ended up in this state, or how he became the guide who led Lei Bo here.
He just deeply looked at Yann Xiang then rode away.
After leaving the farm.
[Achievement Medal obtained: You have compelled Yann Xiang!]
[Note: Yann Xiang is patient, broad-minded, with great wisdom. He has always believed that wisdom can solve difficult problems.
But your appearance overturned his original beliefs.
You solved Lei Bo and others like chopping cucumbers and vegetables, shattering all difficulties like smashing challenges, cleanly, straightforwardly!
He was pleasantly enlightened, exhilarated, yet he couldn’t help but tremble, fear, then question his true value!
No doubt, he will continue to pay attention to you.
He wants to observe and distinguish between your approach and his, to see whether great wisdom prevails or unrivaled brute strength wins!]
A hint echoed.
Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, thought:
"It seems that much of Yann Xiang’s previous behavior was pretended. This can explain."
He was relieved.
Didn’t think further.
He wasn’t playing a conquest game.
No need to bother to recruit strategists.
At this moment, he felt quite fortunate he didn’t choose the path of conquest, otherwise, dealing every day with these strategists who can act and pretend, wouldn’t it be mentally exhausting?
These strategists are all old actors, old schemers.
Facing them, martial power is the most direct approach.
Playing tricks and plots?
Ding Ling admits his wisdom is average, likely to be played to death by Guo Jia, Zhuge Liang, and others.
Better to choose the path of a War God!
Pushing through is the real path!
It’s like the saying: when a scholar meets a warrior, reasoning is futile.
As long as you are strong enough, all calculations are illusions!
*Trot trot!*
All eight horses were fine ones.
Hua Tuo, lightly dressed, galloped ahead, leading quickly.
To avoid colliding with Yuan Yao’s main force, Hua Tuo even changed to a small path midway.
Yet...

He didn’t ask how Yann Xiang ended up in this state, or how he became the guide who led Lei Bo here.
He just deeply looked at Yann Xiang then rode away.
After leaving the farm.
[Achievement Medal obtained: You have compelled Yann Xiang!]
[Note: Yann Xiang is patient, broad-minded, with great wisdom.
He has always believed that wisdom can solve difficult problems.
But your appearance overturned his original beliefs.
You solved Lei Bo and others like chopping cucumbers and vegetables, shattering all difficulties like smashing challenges, cleanly, straightforwardly!
He was pleasantly enlightened, exhilarated, yet he couldn’t help but tremble, fear, then question his true value!
No doubt, he will continue to pay attention to you.
He wants to observe and distinguish between your approach and his, to see whether great wisdom prevails or unrivaled brute strength wins!]
A hint echoed.
Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, thought:
"It seems that much of Yann Xiang’s previous behavior was pretended.
This can explain."
He was relieved.
Didn’t think further.
He wasn’t playing a conquest game.
No need to bother to recruit strategists.
At this moment, he felt quite fortunate he didn’t choose the path of conquest, otherwise, dealing every day with these strategists who can act and pretend, wouldn’t it be mentally exhausting?
These strategists are all old actors, old schemers.
Facing them, martial power is the most direct approach.
Playing tricks and plots?
Ding Ling admits his wisdom is average, likely to be played to death by Guo Jia, Zhuge Liang, and others.
Better to choose the path of a War God!
Pushing through is the real path!
It’s like the saying: when a scholar meets a warrior, reasoning is futile.
As long as you are strong enough, all calculations are illusions!
*Trot trot!*
All eight horses were fine ones.
Hua Tuo, lightly dressed, galloped ahead, leading quickly.
To avoid colliding with Yuan Yao’s main force, Hua Tuo even changed to a small path midway.
Yet...

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Slaying the Fierce General Chen Lan
paragraphs: However, even so.
They still ran into a large army.
Swoosh!
An arrow suddenly shot from afar, with a whistling sound, hitting a wild rabbit beside the path.
The rabbit bounced a few times and finally fell on the path.
"Hahaha..."
Laughter echoed in all directions:
"I finally hit it."
Accompanied by the thunderous sound of iron hooves, a cavalry of over a thousand rushed out from one side, directly facing Ding Ling and his companions.
"Whinny!"
Hua Tuo promptly pulled the reins, causing the fine horse to rear up, whinnying several times before the front hooves heavily landed on the ground, kicking up a cloud of dust.
"Huh?!"
Zhao Yun frowned and said:
"Could these people be the ones Yuan Yao mentioned by Yan Xiang?"
"Such bad luck."
Hua Tuo’s face was full of bitterness.
"Who are you?"
The leader of the cavalry, over a thousand strong, was a handsome and carefree young man.
He had a handsome appearance, was eight feet tall, wearing armor, holding a bow and arrow, like a young general stepped out from a painting.
Ding Ling was seeing someone so handsome for the first time.
Lü Bu was already very handsome.
The young man before them was a level higher! He had reached a new level.
Such a handsome man could never be found in the real world.
To say he surpassed ancient figures like Pan An and Song Yu would not be an exaggeration.
But the young man’s demeanor was arrogant, fierceness glinted in his eyes, which utterly ruined his handsome and charming aura.
An artistic masterpiece was splashed with pig manure, waking people ’startled’ from their admiration.
Ding Ling felt exactly this way now.
Fearing Hua Tuo might suffer, he rode forward and said loudly:
"We are travelers passing by. If we disturbed you, please forgive us. We shall leave now."
Hua Tuo nodded appreciatively.
Ding Ling’s choice to avoid conflict was what he hoped for.
Great powers can restrain themselves, show benevolence and love for the people—that is heroism.
Otherwise, they are demons, committing senseless slaughter, without restraint.
He would never teach what he learned to demons.
"Stop!"
The young man shouted loudly:
"Who allowed you to come and go as you please? Get off your horses and kneel! Bow to me thrice first and then speak."
He was very displeased, exhibiting the arrogance and boundless spirit of youth:
"Seeing me, you dare remain seated on horseback and not pay respects? Who gave you the courage?"
He glanced at Zhao Yun and Ding Ling’s horses, his eyes growing brighter:
"Common mounts of civilians are better than mine. Who are you? Which family’s members?"
"My name is Ding Ling, from Jizhou."
Unyielding and displaying integrity, Ding Ling said:
"I wonder who you are?"
"Are you blind!"
A fierce general with a long knife rode up from the young man’s side.
He looked ordinary but was tall and strong, extremely robust. At this moment, he glared angrily at Ding Ling and shouted:

"Before you is the heir of the four generations three ministers from Runan, the direct descendant of the Yuan Clan, Yuan Yao! If you did not recognize him, that is forgivable. But now you have heard my introduction, yet you remain seated on horseback? Not dismounting, bowing, and apologizing?"
Hua Tuo and Zhao Yun exchanged glances.
Especially Hua Tuo, who was full of regret. He had inadvertently dragged Ding Ling and Zhao Yun into trouble!
Ding Ling frowned and said:
"I am the Tiger Valor General from Jizhou, a seventh-rank official of the court. Is it not too much for you to treat us this way?"
His heart was helpless.
He managed to avoid Yuan Yao.
Yet, he still encountered him.
Yuan Yao couldn’t stay idle and went out hunting, right?
"Oh?"
Yuan Yao raised an eyebrow, scrutinized Ding Ling, and looked at the direction Ding Ling came from before suddenly asking:
"Did you encounter Yan Xiang or Lei Bo?"
Hua Tuo’s expression changed slightly, with a somewhat unnatural demeanor.
Zhao Yun tightly gripped the Dragon Gall Silver Spear, protecting Hua Tuo.
Ding Ling had specifically instructed him that if a real battle occurred, he only needed to ensure Hua Tuo’s safety.
"It seems that you have indeed met them."
Yuan Yao acted carefree, yet seemed astute in observing expressions:
"You encountered Lei Bo and Yan Xiang and still could bring eight fine horses to my presence unharmed. Tell me, how did you bribe Lei Bo and Yan Xiang to spare your lives?"
"I killed him."
Ding Ling rode out, his halberd flicking, eyes fixed fiercely on Yuan Yao:
"If you further provoke me, be careful about your head!"
Ding Ling also resolved to act.
It’s fortune, not misfortune. If it’s misfortune, it can’t be avoided.
Since trouble has come knocking, he shall solve it!
Even Lü Bu and Dong Zhuo do not frighten him.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Shu are nothing but dust to him, and he dares to wield his halberd to smite heaven and earth, so why wouldn’t he dare to face Yuan Yao?
The more he thought.
The clearer Ding Ling’s mind became; he had decided, no demonic creatures daring to obstruct, to be wanton, to insult him, even in Hua Tuo’s presence, would survive!
His character is not idle or hesitating!
Yuan Yao was taken aback, then burst into laughter:
"Such guts. You’re the first to threaten me in my territory like this. Interesting, very interesting."
He looked at the fierce general on his side:
"Chen Lan, help me mount his head on the wall as a reminder. There are so few people like him. I need to closely watch this peculiar sight when he dies; it should be quite unique."
He laughed arrogantly and wildly.
Clearly, doubtful that Ding Ling had killed Lei Bo and his group.
"Yes, my lord."
Chen Lan, holding a long knife, rode toward Ding Ling:

"Tiger Valor General, isn’t it? I am the Sixth-Grade Left Imperial Guard. Why don’t you dismount and pay respect upon seeing a superior! Such insolence, today I’ll execute you as an example to others!"
Hua Tuo’s face showed reluctance but did not intervene.
He had already made several mistakes, and further rash actions might lead them all to ruin.
He was a good man but not a fool, naturally aware of what was best to do now.
Zhao Yun looked at Chen Lan and his followers as if already dead.
Ding Ling chuckled, gently squeezed the Ferghana Horse’s belly, rushing forward, swiftly approaching Chen Lan.
As Chen Lan bellowed, raising his long knife to strike, Ding Ling swung his halberd, bang! Impacting Chen Lan’s long knife as if struck by thunder.
His long knife slipping from his hand.
As he expressed shock and opened his mouth to plead for mercy, splat!
The halberd spun mid-air, executing the Split Head move from the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, a sharp crack, and Chen Lan died with a shattered skull.
Thud!
The corpse swayed on horseback and suddenly fell to one side.
Yuan Yao was astonished.
The cavalry of over a thousand under his command was also equally shocked.
Chen Lan was their side’s extraordinary warrior!
Among their tens of thousands of troops, those who could surpass him were few in number!
Yet he couldn’t withstand even a single round!
Ding Ling?!
Who is this man?
Why is his name unknown, yet his skills are impressive?
"Clatter, clatter!"
Ding Ling urged his mount forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: One Man, One Halberd, Annihilates the Whole Army
paragraphs: When Ding Ling decided to use lethal force, he was already planning to sweep through this cavalry. So after killing the second-class general Chen Lan with one strike, he continued to charge forward with unstoppable momentum.
The speed of the Ferghana Horse was extremely fast, quickly reaching Yuan Yao. As Yuan Yao screamed in panic, ’Kill him,’ crunch!
Casually, with two stabs, he killed the soldiers waving their long spears at him.
Puff! Another thrust struck Yuan Yao’s shoulder, brutally lifting him from his horse and into the air.
"Ah!"
Yuan Yao screamed miserably.
A wave of excruciating pain shot straight to his mind.

How could he have ever experienced such agony in his life? Unable to endure the unbearable pain, he instinctively started to lose control! The screaming, the howling, were heart-wrenching, utterly tragic.
Ding Ling smelled the stench.
He frowned slightly, casually swung, exerted force at the tip of the halberd, boom! Yuan Yao was sent flying behind.
Thud!
Yuan Yao heavily crashed onto the ground, rolled around a few times, curled into a ball, and shivered in pain, face pale as death.
He didn’t even have the energy or heart power to rebuke, threaten, or intimidate Ding Ling anymore.
The damage of that strike was evident.
Ding Ling suddenly looked at the dozen or so cavalry charging at him.
Neigh!
Terrified, the cavalry instinctively pulled the reins, their mounts neighed incessantly.
"Get lost!"
Ding Ling shouted angrily.
Two breathing techniques activated.
At this moment, Ding Ling’s sharp aura soared to the heavens, a noble and domineering aura spread overwhelming in all directions.
Sitting atop the Ferghana Horse.
Holding a Heaven-piercing Halberd, exuding authority without anger, radiating supreme majesty!
Coupled with the lingering evil qi from just easily killing several people with a few thrusts.
Several cavalrymen were instantly frightened and turned to flee.
Yet some, not afraid of death, pumped themselves up, stubbornly shouted:
"He is only one person. Together! Kill him! Save the young master!"
Upon hearing the words ’young master’.
Many cavalrymen seemed to tense up, then, amid the urging and shouting from several deputy generals and military marquises, they all rode towards Ding Ling.
"Ignorant of life and death."
Ding Ling did not spare this group.
They followed Lei Bo and Yuan Yao to commit atrocities, dominating the countryside, just armored bandits!
Just a more organized bandit army than ruthless thieves.
It’s better they don’t retreat.
To dare attack proactively.
Ding Ling was already filled with murderous intent, enraged, thus immediately urged his horse charging at this group of cavalry.
Crack!
Poof!
Clang!

The Heaven-piercing Halberd was like Death God’s scythe, clanging as it sang, occasionally a Celestial Spirit Giant Axe pattern flashed and vanished in the void, each time the pattern flashed, transformations saw several soldiers forcibly knocked out from their saddles!

These soldiers, without exception, had their armor sunk into their bodies, blood spurted from their mouths, powerless, flew, with rumbling thuds, crashed into other cavalry, dragging several down with them, these soldiers then rolled on the ground, crushed to death and trampled by other cavalry’s hooves.
Clang!
The Heaven-piercing Halberd sometimes transformed into Setting Sun Diagram, seemingly like Sword God swinging a blade, where it passed, soldier’s necks got slashed, puff puff!
Soldiers clutched their throats, in disbelief, toppled and fell from their horses.

Heaven-piercing Halberd sometimes transformed into a giant ’Celestial Dragon City-Breaking Halberd pattern’, faintly revealing a roaring Overlord in the pattern, when this appeared, its power was earth-shattering, akin to a giant dragon crashing into the mortal world, meteors hitting the land, rumble, rumble, as the Ferghana Horse charged, leaving behind overturned bodies, gushing blood, flying severed limbs!
Heads rolled.
Blood flowed like a river!
Ding Ling alone with a horse and a halberd, forcibly fought with the momentum of a thousand charging troops.
Invincible aura shook the nation!
When he fought through the cavalry formation, turned back, fought through again, prepared to turn for another attack.
The cavalry was already scared witless.
One by one hurriedly retreated in fear.
Among them, a few players hiding in the cavalry fled the fastest.
They had heard of Ding Ling’s reputation long ago, thus, when the war approached, they retreated to the edges, and when they saw Ding Ling explode, without a word, they turned their horses to flee.
At this moment, they had already fled hundreds of meters away, seeing their companions behind screaming, fleeing in panic like rats, couldn’t help but look at each other.
Swish Swish!
Suddenly, the sound of arrows breaking through the air passed their ears.
Turning their heads to see.
Upon seeing, their eyes almost bulged out of their sockets.

Only to see Ding Ling swiftly drawing his bow, despite being one person with a bow, in the rapid drawing of the bowstring’s thudding sound, produced an eerie scene of arrow rain sweeping in all directions.
"No wonder some players say Ding Ling’s battle with Lü Bu is like ancient times with machine guns shooting!"
They suddenly understood.
Especially upon seeing an arrow whizzing, piercing a player’s head, a mighty force carrying the player flying off his horse, couldn’t help but turn pale with shock.
"Inhuman!"
"Terrifying to this extent!"
They, as if chased by Death God, heavily whipped the horses, making the mounts neigh loudly, galloping even faster.
After some time.
Over a thousand Wolf Cavalry.
Except for a few players who ran far enough that the Six-Stone Bow’s range couldn’t reach.
The other soldiers were all shot dead.
The scene was a chaotic, tragic mess!
Yuan Yao’s screams were stifled back into his throat, making his face even paler, his entire body trembling incessantly.
Clip clop!
Ding Ling rode leisurely to Yuan Yao’s side, looking down at him.
At this moment, Yuan Yao had come back to his senses from the intense pain, at first he hoped the cavalry formation would kill Ding Ling, preferably capture alive, to vent his anger.
If Ding Ling wasn’t tortured to pieces and endured all sorts of deaths, he would definitely not allow Ding Ling to descend into hell easily.
But after witnessing Ding Ling’s terrifying combat power.
His mind was blank, filled with voices of ’how is this possible’ ’such a monster surely can’t exist in this era!!’
Need to know his father’s first divine general Jii Ling was an absolute expert!
But compared to this terrifying combat power, was tens of thousands of miles apart!
How could he know, usually Jii Ling was just humoring him, if truly enraged, the methods of a first-class general were very sharp, terrifying.
Not to mention could defeat Lü Bu’s peak super-elite expert Ding Ling!
A human beast!
None other than this.
Hua Tuo’s mind suddenly emerged these words.
He looked at Ding Ling, his gaze changing repeatedly. His expression slightly complicated, his hand stroking his beard trembled slightly, uncertain what he was pondering.
Zhao Yun, on the other hand, seemed perfectly natural.
This bunch of rogues, thugs, were so rampant, if he wasn’t protecting Hua Tuo, he would also rush up and slaughter!
"You previously said I’m interesting?"
Ding Ling slightly curled his lips, looking at Yuan Yao, spoke softly.
Such demeanor, combined with the sea of corpses behind him.

How could he know, usually Jii Ling was just humoring him, if truly enraged, the methods of a first-class general were very sharp, terrifying.
Not to mention could defeat Lü Bu’s peak super-elite expert Ding Ling!
A human beast!
None other than this.
Hua Tuo’s mind suddenly emerged these words.
He looked at Ding Ling, his gaze changing repeatedly.
His expression slightly complicated, his hand stroking his beard trembled slightly, uncertain what he was pondering.
Zhao Yun, on the other hand, seemed perfectly natural.
This bunch of rogues, thugs, were so rampant, if he wasn’t protecting Hua Tuo, he would also rush up and slaughter!
"You previously said I’m interesting?"
Ding Ling slightly curled his lips, looking at Yuan Yao, spoke softly.
Such demeanor, combined with the sea of corpses behind him.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Intimidating Yuan Yao
paragraphs: It’s like a demon crawled out of hell whispering gently to mortals.
Yuan Yao’s scalp tingled with fear, cold sweat dripping down his back. At this moment, the sharp pain inexplicably weakened a lot; he could actually straighten his tongue to speak:
"I, I was joking."
His awkward smile was filled with great fear and great confusion:
"I, I absolutely did not intend to threaten or kill you."
"Sigh."
Ding Ling sighed:
"You’ve already ordered Chen Lan to cut off my head. Telling me this now, do you take me for a fool, or do you think I’m deaf?"
"No, no. I wouldn’t dare."
Yuan Yao’s tongue began to knot, his whole body trembling and shivering in fear, even losing control of his bladder!
When had he ever experienced such terror?
Calling him a greenhouse flower wouldn’t be wrong.
He’s lived his entire life in flattery, sunlight, warmth, and glory.
How could he ever have imagined he’d end up like this? He was completely bewildered.
"Speak up."
Ding Ling’s voice was very calm:
"How will you make it up to me?"
"You, you can decide how to compensate."
Yuan Yao, as if hearing the voice of heaven, quickly said:
"As long as you don’t kill me. Anything can be discussed."
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied with Yuan Yao’s attitude:
"As long as you don’t play any tricks, sparing you is not a problem. But if you dare to act rashly, these people will be your fate."
He pointed with his halberd behind him.
Yuan Yao was scared again, shaking his head frantically, saying he wouldn’t dare.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You intimidated Yuan Yao.]
[Note: As the only son of Yuan Shu in this Plane World, Yuan Yao, a direct descendant of the Yuan Family, has led a life without lack, cherished, respected, and loved by many.
He is outstanding in appearance, graceful and unrestrained, dashing and uninhibited!
Thus often intoxicated amongst beauties.
Such a person doesn’t know what fear is, nor does he know the hardships of the world.
Your arrival made him experience the creeping fear and terror of Death’s approach!]
Another achievement medal.
Ding Ling glanced at Yuan Yao.
He didn’t know how many sons the other Three Kingdoms World Yuan Shu had, but in this world, there was only Yuan Yao, showing his high status!
Killing Yuan Yao could only bring momentary pleasure.
Keeping him alive.
Could bring even greater rewards.
It was at the moment he was about to kill Yuan Yao.
Ding Ling suddenly remembered what Hua Tuo told him, ’The great medicines in the world have all been hoarded by powerful families!’
Ask yourself.
How many powerful families have more influence than the Yuan Family?
As long as you raid the Yuan Family’s treasury.
You might gain immense loot.
By then, your strength alongside Zhao Yun might achieve qualitative improvement!
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling’s heart burned with passion, making it impossible to kill Yuan Yao.
If he were to kill, it would be after reaping enough benefits first!
"Lead the way."
Ding Ling gestured for Yuan Yao to mount up.
Yuan Yao was a bit bewildered.
"Take me to your home!"
Ding Ling feared Yuan Yao might not understand, directly clarifying:
"Get the Great Medicine, Secret Manual, Divine Weapon!"
Yuan Yao was horrified, his eyes suddenly widening.
"Do you have any objections?"
Ding Ling smiled faintly.
Yuan Yao shook his head frenetically.
"Then why are you standing there?"
"I, I’m going now."
Yuan Yao endured the sharp pain in his shoulder, tremblingly mounted his horse.
His shoulder was bleeding; fearing he might bleed to death, Ding Ling specifically came forward to treat and bandage him.
Yuan Yao thanked him shakily.
Yet in his heart he wished to tear Ding Ling to pieces.
His acting was evidently not up to par.
The cruelty and madness occasionally flickering in his eyes completely exposed his true intentions.
Hua Tuo sighed, tried several times to speak, but in the end said nothing more, only suggesting burying these corpses to avoid causing an epidemic.
Ding Ling nodded, saying he would hire people to handle it.
He never bothered about such matters before.
Who would kill and purposefully bury the bodies?
He was not a warlord?
Nor was he pursuing conquests!
However, the burial reminded Ding Ling to loot the bodies.
He gave Zhao Yun a look. Zhao Yun understood, dismounted to search the bodies of Chen Lan and other key generals, but found nothing.
Ding Ling was somewhat disappointed, but he knew this was normal.
How could ordinary people possibly carry their family’s Martial Arts Secret Manual with them?
"Let’s go!
Clippity-clop!
They journeyed towards the direction of Wan City.
At this moment, Ding Ling and his party were near Gaoling Mountain; originally heading towards Runan, the best routes were through Luyang City or Ye County.
But having met Yuan Yao.
Going through Wan City, then detouring into Runan worked too.
Anyway, they’re heading south.
With the Ferghana Horse as mounts, their pace was quick.
Even Hua Tuo had a few horses to rotate riding, so there was no worry of taking too long.
Midway.
Ding Ling stopped, went to a village, called the village chief, gave him some money, and asked him to help deal with the bodies.
The village chief naturally had no reason to refuse.
Burying the bodies meant all items on them belonged to them. Armor, weapons, if lucky, some horses, then they’d strike it rich.

And after Ding Ling pointed out they were all cavalry bodies, the village chief was overjoyed yet a bit anxious, asked a few questions, and only after confirming there’d be no major trouble, did he gather his men to swarm out.
Hua Tuo was pleased and said:
"You’ve thought ahead."
Ding Ling said it was the right thing to do.
"While we have time, I’ll pass the Qingnang Scripture to you."
Hua Tuo lagged behind, gesturing for Ding Ling to follow him further back.
Zhao Yun immediately moved forward to keep an eye on Yuan Yao.
Ding Ling then fell back and walked side by side with Hua Tuo, looking at him with some surprise:
"Senior, didn’t you say..."
"This time is different."
Hua Tuo had a complicated expression, speaking directly:

"You saved my life. Furthermore, your talent in the Medical Dao is extraordinary, and I would’ve taught you eventually. This journey might be turbulent, I fear something might happen unexpectedly, cutting off the inheritance, which would be a great pity."
He sighed:
"The Hua Family is now down to just me. I also haven’t found a suitable disciple. I hope you can carry forward the Qingnang Scripture."
He looked deeply at Ding Ling:

"The Qingnang Scripture contains techniques for keeping a calm heart, I see you’ve killed a lot, if you’re not careful, Evil Qi might enter your body. Learning the Qingnang Scripture can help you keep calm, protect your heart veins, and avoid being eroded by Evil Qi."
Ding Ling was invigorated, promptly expressing his sincere gratitude.
"No need for that."
Hua Tuo waved his hand:

"Although your talent is exceedingly high, it seems you are far behind Zhao Yun in terms of physique and resistance to Evil Qi. This is innate, and cannot be strengthened afterward. You can only practice specific techniques to resist and defend."
Ding Ling realized.
Now he understood.
However, he disagreed with Hua Tuo’s view; he felt there must be techniques to improve physique and resistance to Evil Qi! He just hadn’t found them yet.
"I know what you’re thinking."
Hua Tuo stroked his beard and said:
"Alright. I won’t waste words. Listen closely. This is where the Qingnang Scripture’s techniques, mysteries, and essence lie..."

chapters.title: Chapter 132: The Qingnang Scripture Can Quell Inner Fire
paragraphs: Hua Tuo carefully explained the heart techniques and essence of the Qingnang Scripture.
Ding Ling listened very seriously and attentively.
After one round.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book immediately materialized on the bookshelf, engraved with three large characters:
"Qingnang Scripture"
A moment later.
[Qingnang Scripture Full Level]
[Charm +0.8]
All the essence, secrets, and esoteric truths of the Qingnang Scripture surged and roared within the Sea of Consciousness.
Then quickly became instinct, rushing into various organs and parts of Ding Ling’s body.
Only in an instant.
Ding Ling penetrated all the secrets of the Qingnang Scripture.
This is an ultimate medical dao technique, not inferior in the slightest to the Sword God Breathing Technique!
Charm +1 after Full Level for the Sword God and Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique.
Charm +0.3 after Full Level for the Inner Scripture.
After Ding Ling’s cultivation soared, the amplification of attributes for heart techniques of the same level weakened.
The Qingnang Scripture’s 0.8 augmentation at this stage.
Was already quite remarkable.
Especially after Ding Ling had thoroughly mastered the Qingnang Scripture, he felt that it was a supreme-level heart technique within the medical dao.
At least, there’s no doubt in this world!
It includes surgical, internal medicine treatments, and also acupuncture techniques using the Breathing Technique, massage methods combined with Health Care Skill, etc.
You could say.
Having mastered the Qingnang Scripture, Ding Ling could truly be considered a Divine Doctor in this world!
In medicine, compared to Hua Tuo, what he lacks is experience.
His medical skills and abilities are absolutely not inferior to Hua Tuo!
"How is it?"
Hua Tuo asked immediately when he saw Ding Ling open his eyes.
"It’s done."
Ding Ling nodded, solemnly saluting and expressing thanks.
The corner of Hua Tuo’s mouth slightly twitched:
"You mean you’ve completely mastered the Qingnang Scripture?!"
"Correct."
Ding Ling said calmly.

The Qingnang Scripture indeed has heart techniques to dissolve Evil Qi and suppress heart fire, and while they don’t enhance physical qualities, they have a subtle effect on the elevation of one’s state of mind.
At least while operating this technique, Ding Ling felt tranquil and invigorated, as if some heart fire was being continuously expelled, making him increasingly graceful and clear.
He praised silently, indeed, the extraordinary Qingnang Scripture! A cherished ancestral secret by Hua Tuo!
Hua Tuo’s mouth gaped open, taking quite a while to close.
He took a breath, in disbelief:
"This is as good as a fantasy. I don’t dare to dream like this. You learned so quickly? Know that the difficulty of the Qingnang Scripture far surpasses that of the Inner Scripture!"
Not that the Inner Scripture is bad.
But the Inner Scripture only records some medical dao techniques from Bian Que.
While the Qingnang Scripture?
It encompasses the lifelong learning of Hua Tuo’s ancestors! Its vastness and complexity can be imagined.
Hua Tuo explained the Qingnang Scripture methodically, which took a full two hours.
And his speech was particularly fast.
This shows the wide range of knowledge the Qingnang Scripture covers!
However, even so.
Ding Ling still learned it in one go?
Normally, people would doubt.
Hua Tuo naturally was no exception.
If Ding Ling hadn’t already shown a highly extraordinary medical dao talent before, Hua Tuo upon hearing this would surely sneer and leave in a huff.
This is completely playing him for a fool!
Even now, he still found it unbelievable, but recalling Ding Ling’s prior performance, he managed to restrain his boiling thoughts and began discussing the Qingnang Scripture with Ding Ling.
He asked Ding Ling many questions regarding the Qingnang Scripture.
The difficulties involved were numerous.
Yet Ding Ling seemed to reply without much thought, and his answers were exceedingly precise.
Hua Tuo was moved, the hand stroking his beard trembling slightly, an outer manifestation of extreme excitement, delight, and amazement.
"Show me the heart technique contained in the Qingnang Scripture."
"Yes."

Ding Ling nodded, immediately operating the opening mantra of the esoteric truth of the Qingnang Scripture, his entire demeanor transforming in an instant, embodying a merciful aura akin to an ethereal immortal in a hidden realm!
Hua Tuo’s expression changed:
"It’s—it’s real!"
He looked up at the sky, seemingly utterly astonished, with a dazed expression, murmuring:
"How incredible! It’s beyond imagination that in this era, such a medical dao genius would exist!"
[Acquired E-Level Achievement Medal: You received high recognition from Hua Tuo.]
[Note: Hua Tuo’s talent in the medical dao is unparalleled. He believed it would be very difficult in his lifetime to find someone with superior talent in medical dao.
Originally, he just wanted to find someone slightly inferior to himself, but even so, it was still hard to find.
However, your medical dao talent is so high, it seems like a dream!
Making Hua Tuo, who is remarkably gifted, question life and shatter his worldview.
There is no doubt, you will become his true successor! His hope for the medical dao might be placed on you!]
A notification sound passed by his ears.
Ding Ling’s heart slightly moved, thinking:

’Only now did I receive Hua Tuo’s Achievement Medal, and it’s only E-Level! It seems Hua Tuo’s level in medical dao has reached Super-Elite? Or perhaps his mastery of the Breathing Technique is Super-Elite?’
Thinking of Hua Tuo’s skills.
Ding Ling contemplated.
Hua Tuo was very strong, undoubtedly.
If it wasn’t for Lei Bo’s sudden ambush, with Hua Tuo’s body technique and speed, no one could easily catch or harm him.
It’s just Hua Tuo’s Super-Elite status excels in the physical aspect, while power and agility seem rather weak?
"Could it be that as long as one physical attribute meets the standard, then it’s Super-Elite?"
It’s highly likely.
Lü Bu is also a top-tier Super-Elite.
But Lü Bu’s physique definitely isn’t Super-Elite, his endurance is too lacking.
Hua Tuo’s endurance is very strong, perhaps his physique has already met the standard. But his strength and other aspects should be relatively weak.
’It should be correct. Hua Tuo is likely Super-Elite in physique!’
Ding Ling was relieved.
Stop pondering.
The Qingnang Scripture has been learned.
Even if it’s a fatal injury in the future.
As long as there are enough herbs, Ding Ling can heal himself, and won’t die.
For the life-loving Ding Ling, it’s a vital skill.
That day at noon.
Ding Ling and his companions arrived near Wan City.
With Ding Ling’s complete mastery of the Qingnang Scripture, he practiced on Yuan Yao, and along the way, Yuan Yao’s injuries were almost healed.
Yuan Yao’s pale complexion improved considerably.
But toward Ding Ling, he remained both hateful and frightened.
There was no trace of gratitude at all.
Though on the surface, he pretended to be extremely grateful.
His acting was too poor.
Zhao Yun saw through it at a glance, and thought: Compared to Ding Ling, Yuan Yao’s acting is horribly bad! With such pretense, Ding Ling would not show mercy!
Zhao Yun believed he understood Ding Ling reasonably well, naturally knowing Ding Ling’s decisive nature.
Thus, he neither opposed nor refuted.
Because despite his kindness, he knew the importance and wouldn’t hold anyone back.
"Only the two of us need to go in."

But toward Ding Ling, he remained both hateful and frightened.
There was no trace of gratitude at all.
Though on the surface, he pretended to be extremely grateful.
His acting was too poor.
Zhao Yun saw through it at a glance, and thought: Compared to Ding Ling, Yuan Yao’s acting is horribly bad!
With such pretense, Ding Ling would not show mercy!
Zhao Yun believed he understood Ding Ling reasonably well, naturally knowing Ding Ling’s decisive nature.
Thus, he neither opposed nor refuted.
Because despite his kindness, he knew the importance and wouldn’t hold anyone back.
"Only the two of us need to go in."

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Mighty Jii Ling
paragraphs: Ding Ling asked Hua Tuo to wait with a few horses and some supplies in the dense forest a dozen miles outside Wan City.
Hua Tuo had no objection.
This journey into the dragon’s lair and tiger’s den.
He himself would be a burden if he went. He understood this well, and simply urged Ding Ling to hurry back and stay safe.
As Ding Ling learned the Qingnang Scripture.
Hua Tuo became increasingly amiable towards Ding Ling! Closer! More appreciative!
Others could clearly see this.
Ding Ling was naturally no exception either.
After exchanging a few words with Hua Tuo.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, together with Yuan Yao, galloped straight towards Wan City.
Yuan Yao’s mount was naturally his own.
It was a fine horse from Da Wan.
No less impressive than the mounts of Houcheng and Wei Xu.
But Ding Ling already had enough mounts, so he did not take his.
Clop-clop-clop!
The hooves pounded the earth, the clop-clop sounded resonating in all directions, while dust flew.
After a period of time.
The three persons and their horses arrived at the gate of Wan City.
Welcoming Ding Ling was a fully prepared force of three thousand Iron Cavalry.
In front of the Iron Cavalry stood a general.
He had a tiger’s back and a bear’s waist, was tall and broad, with a dignified face, and rarely smiled or spoke.

Covered in a layer of golden armor, holding a Three-Pointed Two-Blade, seated on horseback, with eyes that opened with imposing might as if a Celestial God descending to the Mortal World, intimidating anyone who looked upon him.
He seemed ready to go on an expedition.
But upon seeing Yuan Yao, he obviously was taken aback:
"Young Master! You, you’re alright?!"
"General Jii Ling!"
Yuan Yao seemed as if he had seen a relative, almost breaking into tears.
In the past one or two days, he had been on the verge of wanting to die!
Living in purgatory was an understatement.
Having finally reached Wan City and seeing the army’s strongest general, Jii Ling, he was so overjoyed he almost leaped.
Upon hearing Jii Ling’s words.
He was eager to say, "I’ve almost died, how could I be alright?!"
But beside him were two gods of death, forcing him to endure the agony, nodding with a face full of grievance and repressed feelings:
"I’m fine. Not a thing wrong."
His acting was so poor.
Jii Ling naturally did not believe him, his eyes swiftly moved to look at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun:
"Are you Ding Ling and Zhao Yun?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling could easily guess that it must be those few people who managed to escape and report.
At this moment, Jii Ling and the others knowing their Young Master was in danger and subsequently organizing the troops for revenge was only normal.
"I heard you two killed Generals Lei Bo and Chen Lan?"
Jii Ling glanced at Yuan Yao, seeing his face was very off, his mind racing, he quickly said:
"I don’t care what you’ve done in the past, as long as you release our Young Master now, and do not coerce him, all past grievances will be written off."
He pointed his blade to the distance:
"You can go now. I thank you for bringing back our Young Master."
Yuan Yao slightly breathed a sigh of relief, ready to leave anytime.
Though he feared Ding Ling, they were at the doorstep now.
His courage swelled!
His confidence soared!
The fear he had towards Ding Ling naturally faded quite a bit.
Ding Ling saw through it and chuckled:
"I’m not here to reason with you."
He looked at Yuan Yao, lightly reprimanding:
"If you don’t want to die, quickly tell Jii Ling to move his troops aside!"

Yuan Yao felt as if cold water had been poured over him, instantly recalling scene after scene of Ding Ling slaughtering mercilessly, he glanced at Ding Ling, saw Ding Ling staring at him expressionlessly.
His heart was chilled, his shoulder began to throb painfully again, he quickly turned his head away and did not look at Ding Ling more, instead saying loudly to Jii Ling:
"Jii Ling, quickly take your men and move aside, don’t block the way!"
"Young Master!"
Jii Ling’s eyes widened.
"Are you deaf?!"
Yuan Yao vented with a shout.
Already so aggrieved to the point of death, and his own servant wasn’t listening, Yuan Yao was furious!
"Yes."
Jii Ling sighed deeply, bowed his hand in compliance, and retreated with his troops to the side.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun then coerced Yuan Yao into the city.
The scene fell in the eyes of many players, causing them to look at each other in shock, marveling at the Celestial Being:
"This guy, his courage is too big! This is Yuan Shu’s main base!"
’Although it’s said Yuan Shu will move to Shouchun later. But for now, his main force is stationed here. Does Ding Ling not fear death?’
"The man defeated Lü Bu. Why should he fear these small soldiers? If I could defeat Lü Bu, I’d walk as if owning the place!"
"Do you really believe he defeated Lü Bu? With Lü Bu’s stature, how is it possible for him to be defeated by him? It’s definitely exaggerated stories!
Clop-clop-clop!
Wan City’s high walls and deep trenches span vast areas.
Its internal roads crisscross, buildings densely packed.
Apart from the main road, other roads are crowded with people.
Evidently, the main road has been temporarily cleared.
Yet Ding Ling and the others sped down the main road, highly conspicuous and eye-catching.
Attracting many to glance sideways, pointing and talking.
Yuan Yao used to thoroughly enjoy such attention.
Now he only wished to find a crack and drill into it, his face burning like fire, seemingly swollen as if someone had slapped it, red like the sunset.
Especially upon seeing the bewildered and confused eyes of familiar faces, it felt more like being struck by lightning, appearing as though stripped naked, thrown onto the street for public viewing.
He increasingly felt oppressed and painful.
Pushed himself to urge the mount vigorously to speed up.
Ding Ling did not stop him, he also wanted to obtain the Great Medicine and other treasures and leave as quickly as possible.
Jii Ling, with a few loyal subordinates, followed from afar.
He kept an unwavering watch on Ding Ling, turning to a soldier:
"You say Ding Ling killed his way through from the Si Li Region?!"
The soldier was a player, eager to earn Jii Ling’s recognition, and poured out everything he knew.
Jii Ling frowned.
The more he listened, the more incredulous it seemed.
Especially hearing about Ding Ling single-handedly taking a city and chasing down the Wolf Cavalry, it felt to him like the soldier was playing a joke!
He was furious, about to lash out.
The player, observing his demeanor, immediately presented the prepared carrier pigeon, extracting a letter from its leg, handing it to Jii Ling:
"Court Officer himself wrote it, no falsity!"
Jii Ling skeptically accepted the letter and read through it carefully, reaching the stamped part, his eyelid twitched slightly, though instinctively he remained doubtful:
"Nowadays all lords oppose Dong. Court Officer is with Thief Dong. It’s perfectly normal for him to deceive me."
"But earlier, Ding Ling single-handedly defeating Thunder Cavalry is indeed the bloody truth."
The soldier brought up this.
Jii Ling couldn’t help but turn cold-faced.
He already looked down on the Thunder Cavalry assembled by a bunch of bandits and hoodlums.
Thus considered it normal for them to be scattered by someone.
But to say over 90% of Thunder Cavalry was killed by one person seemed too frivolous.
Did they truly think Ding Ling was a Celestial God descending from above?
Thunder Cavalry’s mounts had four legs, they couldn’t escape?
The soldier was also helpless, finding achieving an Achievement Medal with Jii Ling far too difficult, he could only endure discomfort and analyze again for Jii Ling, saying:
"Does the General think he wouldn’t possess such extraordinary Martial Power to dare come with just two men to this heavily guarded Wan City?"

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Sun Ce VS Zhao Yun
paragraphs: Jii Ling remained silent.
But he always harbored some doubt about these ’rumors’.
The reason was simple.
He himself was a First-class Peak Martial General!
He knew very well that these tasks were impossible even for three of him.
How could Ding Ling accomplish them alone?
He was unwilling to believe he was much worse than Ding Ling.
It was worth noting, he always prided himself as the world’s number one general, and that was indeed the case.
Since joining the army, he had never met his match! Always victorious, always invincible!
In a battlefield duel, few were his match for even ten rounds!
Until he met Sunx Jian.
Only then did he realize there’s always someone stronger.
But even Sunx Jian couldn’t be that fierce!
To single-handedly take down almost all the Thunder Cavalry, unable to escape? It’s beyond belief!
"Regardless."
Jii Ling heavily thrust the Three-Pointed Two-Blade into the ground, with a fierce look on his face:
"Ding Ling and Zhao Yun dare humiliate my master, I absolutely won’t let them off!"
"Need me to secretly launch a sneak attack?"
The player seemed to suggest, but in reality was aiming for promotion.
"Heh."
Jii Ling glanced at the player, coldly chuckled two times without speaking.
The player felt indignant, silently cursed! If it weren’t for learning Martial Arts, to make himself stronger in the real world! He would never listen to an NPC’s commands!

He felt it was too difficult to earn Jii Ling’s Achievement Medal, and lowered the difficulty, planning to seek other generals to earn medals. Even if without Jii Ling’s Breathing Technique and Martial Arts, getting some lesser Martial Arts and Breathing Technique is still good.
Having something is better than nothing!
Even if he has to sell himself into slavery! He still wants the Breathing Technique!
In the real world, the player is someone who works at a desk for extended periods, physically very frail, frequently visiting hospitals.
To improve his physical fitness, he entered the Game World to find opportunities!
Many are like him.

Some have extraordinary intelligence and means, having already soared to the top, mingling with people like Cao Mengde as confidants, lacking nothing like Breathing Techniques, Martial Arts, and Great Medicine! Physical fitness gradually improving!
While some are still lingering in military camps as lowly soldiers.

Ultimately, ordinary people from the real world who come to this turbulent age, are mostly still ordinary people! Unless they have remarkable encounters or special fortune, it’s hard for them to turn their lives around!
Reality is so cruel.
If the player finds he can’t progress with Jii Ling, naturally he will think about trying with someone else!
What is the purpose of coming to the Game World?
Isn’t it to improve physical fitness and ’enjoy’ a second life, among other reasons?
Jii Ling closely followed behind Ding Ling and his group.
Ding Ling was completely unaware.
He only remained constantly alert to dark corners where someone might launch a sneak attack.
Luckily, he was a different person now, with his physique and defense continually increasing.
As long as he’s not hit in a vital spot, he won’t die!
Therefore, he only needed to protect his vital spots.
Thud thud thud!
They soon reached the Yuan Mansion.
Before Yuan Yao got close to the gate, he couldn’t help but shout:
"Open the door for me!"
"It’s the young master, the young master is back!"
The guards stationed at the mansion quickly opened the gate upon seeing this.
Click!
The door opened.
Yuan Yao charged in on horseback.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun followed closely behind.
Someone attempted to stop Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, but Ding Ling casually knocked them down with two strokes.
He didn’t kill them.
He merely glanced coldly at the remaining soldiers attempting to surround him, and chuckled twice.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Yao trembled, hastily reprimanded the soldiers, telling them to scram. He said Ding Ling and Zhao Yun were distinguished guests and should not be treated poorly!
The soldiers were perplexed, but ultimately dared not intercept anymore.
Thud thud thud!
From then on, it was almost smooth sailing.

Until turning through several long corridors, reaching a martial training ground, when a spirited young man clad in black armor leapt over from the side, taking strides of seven or eight meters, landing with a roar in front of Yuan Yao and his companions.
He glanced at Yuan Yao, greeted him respectfully.
Then he looked at Ding Ling and Zhao Yun, raised his eyebrows, and shouted:
"Which one is Ding Ling?"
"Why?"
Ding Ling looked at the young man:
"Didn’t you hear your master telling you to move aside?"
"I’ll move aside, but not now."
The young man’s eyes burned as he stared at Ding Ling, his gaze filled with intense battle intent, his long spear pointed straight at Ding Ling, growling:

"I heard from my subordinates that you fought your way out of the Si Li Region. Not a single person under Dong Zhuo could match you! Are you that strong?! I want to test your skills, to see if you truly live up to your name!"
"Just you?"
Zhao Yun chuckled lightly:
"Still wet behind the ears. You’d better practice at home for a few more years before coming back."
He wasn’t intentionally mocking the young man.
He simply felt it would be better not to fight, because if they did, the young man would likely be beaten to death.
Thus, he tried to dissuade him with words.

But the young man misunderstood Zhao Yun’s good intentions, and being humiliated and looked down upon like this, his handsome face flushed with rage, he yelled furiously, and without another word, thrust his spear towards Ding Ling’s head.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Zhao Yun shouted angrily:
"How dare you!"
Bang!
Zhao Yun shook his Dragon Gall Silver Spear, and the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear pattern flashed momentarily in the air.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Almost instantly, Dragon Gall Silver Spear clashed and collided with the opponent’s spear a dozen times.
Within moments, the two had exchanged three to five rounds.
Bang!
Finally, upon finding he couldn’t easily handle this young man, Zhao Yun blushed, increased his force a bit, bang bang bang!
The sound of weapons clashing grew louder, resembling celestial thunder meeting earth fire, more like lightning clashing!
Amid the resonance echoing throughout.
The young man was shaken, his limbs went numb, and his tiger’s mouth split, bleeding. In the end, he was stabbed in the shoulder blade by Zhao Yun, reluctantly retreating while injured.
He looked at Zhao Yun with an uncertain expression:
"Who are you?"
"I’m Zhao Zilong of Changshan."
Zhao Yun looked at the young man with an unusual expression:
"You’re quite skilled. But unfortunately, you can’t even defeat me, so how can you hope to win against Ding Ling?"
The young man, shocked and angry, was about to retort.
Yuan Yao frowned, sighed silently, thinking to himself that Sunx Ce was useless, but said aloud:
"Sunx Ce, move aside quickly! We have business to attend to. Don’t block the way!"
Sunx Ce?
Ding Ling looked at the young man with surprise.
This young man seemed to be only fifteen or sixteen, spirited and heroic, emanating an intimidating Evil Qi. Though young, it was clear he would definitely become a peerless warrior in the future.
He’s a Super-Elite Expert in the making!
Indeed named Sunx Ce.
No wonder he could stand against Zhao Yun for several rounds.
After all, he is the Little Overlord of Jiangdong!
However, Sunx Ce is currently practicing martial arts at the Yuan Mansion?
It seems Sunx Jian and Yuan Shu are still in a honeymoon phase!
They haven’t parted ways due to the player’s involvement.
"I want to compete against Ding Ling."
Sunx Ce was very determined, his eyes firm, speaking with powerful conviction, his words landed heavily:
"Until we have a match, I won’t move aside."
"You, you..."

"Who are you?"
"I’m Zhao Zilong of Changshan."
Zhao Yun looked at the young man with an unusual expression:
"You’re quite skilled.
But unfortunately, you can’t even defeat me, so how can you hope to win against Ding Ling?"
The young man, shocked and angry, was about to retort.
Yuan Yao frowned, sighed silently, thinking to himself that Sunx Ce was useless, but said aloud:
"Sunx Ce, move aside quickly!
We have business to attend to.
Don’t block the way!"
Sunx Ce?
Ding Ling looked at the young man with surprise.
This young man seemed to be only fifteen or sixteen, spirited and heroic, emanating an intimidating Evil Qi.
Though young, it was clear he would definitely become a peerless warrior in the future.
He’s a Super-Elite Expert in the making!
Indeed named Sunx Ce.
No wonder he could stand against Zhao Yun for several rounds.
After all, he is the Little Overlord of Jiangdong!
However, Sunx Ce is currently practicing martial arts at the Yuan Mansion?
It seems Sunx Jian and Yuan Shu are still in a honeymoon phase!
They haven’t parted ways due to the player’s involvement.
"I want to compete against Ding Ling."
Sunx Ce was very determined, his eyes firm, speaking with powerful conviction, his words landed heavily:
"Until we have a match, I won’t move aside."
"You, you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Sun Ce’s Target Person (40/50)
paragraphs: Yuan Yao was furious, so angry he felt his hair stand on end. Instinctively, he took out his whip and lashed it toward Sunx Ce.
Sunx Ce raised an eyebrow but did not evade.
Smack!
The whip struck his body, yet he did not even flinch.
Yuan Yao wanted to strike again, but Sunx Ce wouldn’t allow it. He pointed his spear at Ding Ling and shouted loudly:
"Ding Ling, you cowardly rat, do you dare to fight me to the death?"
Upon hearing his words.
Yuan Yao paused his whip and didn’t lash it again.
The strength of Sunx Ce and Sunx Jian, the father and son.
He was very clear about it.
This family wasn’t his family’s slaves; they were merely temporarily dependent. Yuan Yao couldn’t go too far, so he just snorted and pulled his horse aside.
He hoped Sunx Ce could defeat Ding Ling.
But Zhao Yun weaker than Ding Ling?
Yuan Yao was bewildered; he hadn’t seen Ding Ling and Zhao Yun in combat, so how could he know this?
But he had seen Zhao Yun just defeat Sunx Ce.
He had little hope that Sunx Ce could completely defeat Ding Ling.
"I couldn’t win, what makes you better to fight Ding Ling?"
Zhao Yun, stern and powerful:
"I advise you not to seek trouble!"
"You won’t know until you try."
Sunx Ce sneered:
"Many famed generals aren’t what they seem. For all I know, Ding Ling might overshadow your fame, Zhao Zilong!"
Although Sunx Ce still disagreed with Zhao Zilong, his tone had softened considerably.
Ding Ling witnessed this, spurred his horse forward, confronted Sunx Ce, and said:
"Your arm is injured, how will you duel with me?"
"Even injured, I can capture a tiger!"
Sunx Ce, defiant, widened his tiger eyes and shouted loudly:
"Ding Ling, you coward, will you fight me or not?"
"You’re asking to die."
Ding Ling’s battle axe trembled in his hand, and he leapt from his horse:
"I won’t bully you, I’ll dismount and use my left hand to duel with you."
He switched the battle axe to his left hand.
Sunx Ce’s expression was ugly, wanting to say it wasn’t necessary.
But his right hand was injured, forcing him to also use his left hand, so he merely snorted lightly and didn’t respond.
"Get ready, I won’t be polite!"
Before the words fell.
He suddenly thrust his spear at Ding Ling.
Clang!

The spear blossoms blink into existence in the void, blooming into seven or eight flowers, and within moments, conjured dozens of spear blossoms, which burst into a drawing of a Celestial God capturing the moon.
The pattern gleamed brightly, like a galaxy falling from the heavens, crashing toward Ding Ling.
Ding Ling smiled faintly, instead of retreating, he advanced, the Overlord Halberd Technique boomed to life, boom!
A massive force converged into a figure of dominance, along with the overwhelming shadows of halberds, it violently collided into the Celestial God capturing the moon graphic.
In just an instant, it shattered the Celestial God capturing the moon pattern, the sharp, unmatched halberd tip struck Sunx Ce’s spear shaft.
Clang!
Like a meteor hitting the earth!
More like lightning striking a tree!
Sunx Ce, as if struck by thunder, trembled, his tiger mouth cracking, the hand holding the spear failed to grasp it and it flew out of his hands.
He seemed as if he were hit by a surging, torrent-like wave, his armor splitting open, he flew uncontrollably straight out.
After flying seven or eight meters, he heavily landed on the ground, rolling a few circles to disperse the frightening momentum.
Poof!
He opened his mouth wide, spewing out a thick mouthful of blood.
He held the ground, staggering to stand, his face frightened as he stared at Ding Ling:
"You, you, you..."
"Still want to fight?"
Zhao Yun sighed:
"I told you not to overestimate yourself."
He knew Ding Ling had held back; otherwise, Sunx Ce would surely be dead from that strike.
Sunx Ce had no words to match, forcefully endured the severe pain, sulkily walked aside, looking somewhat desolate.
Yet still looking unyielding, he shouted at Ding Ling mounting his horse:
"I’m still young, when I grow older and stronger, I will definitely defeat you!"
Ding Ling noncommittally smiled, leaving with Yuan Yao and Zhao Yun.
Watching their retreating figures.
Sunx Ce’s blood boiled again, uncontrollably spewing another mouthful of blood:
"Too strong!"
He murmured:
"No wonder he could break out from Si Li Land!"
He never feared anything, nor submitted to anyone.
Even his father.
He firmly believed he could eventually surpass him.
But facing Ding Ling’s age, coupled with his halberd technique and brute strength, for the first time made Sunx Ce feel powerless.
"When can I be this strong?!"
"Can I have such terrifying power at Ding Ling’s age?!"
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have gained Sunx Ce’s high recognition.]
[Note: You have subdued Sunx Ce with martial power, making him realize there is always someone stronger! In this world, it is not only the Sunx Family that is most courageous!
No doubt. He will aim at you, continuously spurring himself onward, hoping to one day catch up to or even surpass you!
By then, he is sure to challenge you again!]
Upon hearing the prompt.
Ding Ling paused, then felt relieved.
He glanced at the character panel:
[1: Defeat more than 20 Plane Warriors: 8/20.]
Eight in total.
Counting them up.
Juyi, Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Zhao Zilong, Zhang Feiyan, Zhang Liao, Lü Bu, Sunx Ce.
These are the eight listed.
Sunx Ce, obviously, is a First-class or above expert, counted as a Plane Warrior.
If Sunx Ce becomes Super-Elite, the Achievement Medal will certainly be grade E, rather than ordinary.
Clip-clop!
Amid the sound of the iron hooves, along with Yuan Yao’s shout ’We’ve arrived’.
Ding Ling returned to his senses.
He looked at the three-story pavilion not far away.
Above the entrance hung a plaque.
Engraved with two bold characters:
Armory!
"Right here?"
"Correct."
Yuan Yao dismounted, yelled at the gatekeepers to open the gate.
The gatekeepers were two tall, sturdy warriors, clad in solid armor, who frowned as they looked at Yuan Yao, saying:
"Young Master, don’t make it difficult for us. The lord said, without his orders, the Armory cannot be opened!"
"Impudent!"
Yuan Yao roared:
"This young master is the future Patriarch of the Yuan Family! You dare block me?! Tired of living?!"
"I dare not!"
The warrior’s face was pale, and they hurriedly kneeled.
"Then open the gate for this young master!"
"Yes. Young Master!"
The warriors sighed and stepped forward to open the Armory’s heavy gates.
Click! Click!
The heavy doors opened, soon revealing the interiors’ wonders.
With one glance, Ding Ling could determine the layout within.
An Armory.
Held all kinds of armor, crossbows, and more.
"Enter."
Ding Ling dismounted, leading his horse, entering the pavilion with Yuan Yao.
Also, he closed the gates.
In doing so, it prevented anyone from stealing the horses.
A war general without a horse’s power greatly diminishes.
Arriving at the pavilion, closing the doors, allowed immediate response to any disturbances.
Although they had Yuan Yao as a hostage, there were many players in this world, players capable of anything, they needed to guard against them.
"Does it contain any Divine Weapons?"
Ding Ling asked Yuan Yao.
