chapters.title: Chapter 136: Ancient Divine Weapon Juque Sword
paragraphs: "Yes."
Compared to Dong Huang, Yuan Yao is not inferior in the least.
They’re both typical of the type who sell their ancestral land without sentiment.
However, encountering such a playboy is lucky for Ding Ling.
If it were someone more brave or steadfast, Ding Ling would not have reached here so smoothly.
Da da!
Yuan Yao walked straight to the very end of the armory!
Then he knocked on the wall of the attic here and there. After a while, accompanied by the sound of mechanisms snapping and cracking, part of the wall suddenly recessed.
A portion protruded out.
In the protruding part, there was a deep and long groove.
Inside the groove, there was an exquisitely crafted iron box.
Yuan Yao stepped forward to take out the iron box, but after several attempts, the iron box didn’t budge. He couldn’t help but say embarrassedly:
"I can’t move it."
Ding Ling was secretly amazed.
To hide a Divine Weapon so discreetly.
It shows that this Divine Weapon is undoubtedly extraordinary.
He stepped forward and grabbed the chain on the iron box, giving it a strong pull. Accompanied by a clinking sound, the iron box was pulled out of the groove by him.
Boom!
The iron box was placed heavily on the ground.
"It must weigh over two hundred pounds at least."
Ding Ling raised his brow, drew the Shuoyue Sword, cut the chain binding the iron box, and then used force to open the iron box along the gap.
What met his eyes was a sword!
The sword was likely over six feet long!
Long swords of this length are extremely rare.
Ding Ling reached out to take the sword, feeling a slight heaviness upon touch.
He was surprised in his heart.
It’s worth knowing that he is now a master with physique, agility, and strength all reaching the Super-Elite Realm!
To make him feel heavy.
It proves that this sword weighs at least a hundred pounds or so.
Such heaviness is really rare.
Ding Ling held the scabbard with one hand and the hilt with the other, slowly drawing it out.
Ang!
It was as if a true dragon was leaving the sea, faintly hearing the sound of dragons, and as it was pulled out further, the clanging sound echoed in all directions.
Zhao Yun was moved:
"This must be an unparalleled sword!"
Clang!
Ding Ling pulled hard, and the entire sword was drawn out by him.
The sword was a broad sword!
Compared to other swords, it was extremely heavy and enormous!
It was like a looming Mount Tai, full of an indestructible and god-defying sense of enormity!
"It is indeed a good sword."
Ding Ling was delighted.
He looked closely. He saw two ancient seal script characters engraved on the upper part of the sword blade:
Giant Que!
"Giant Que Sword!"
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly shrank:
"Could it really be the Giant Que Sword, which is as famous as Zhan Lu, Mo Ye, and Fish Guts?!"
"Is it really the Giant Que Sword?"
Zhao Yun was also slightly surprised.
Wang Yue has an unparalleled Divine Weapon, the Shadow Sword.
Far superior to the Shuoyue Sword.
But he couldn’t give the Shadow Sword to Ding Ling.
And the Giant Que Sword is in no way weaker than the Shadow Sword.
In terms of heaviness and enormity, it surpasses the Shadow Sword by a lot!
This ancient famous sword has been treasured by the Yuan Family!
No wonder they are a family of four generations of Three Ministers!
Ding Ling couldn’t help but admire it in his heart.
This time he indeed came to the right place.
Just the rarity of this sword makes it worth the trip.
He then gave the Shuoyue Sword to Zhao Yun and equipped himself with the Giant Que Sword.
The Giant Que Sword was strapped to his back. Although slightly heavy, he could still handle it.
After all, Ding Ling is a Super-Elite with high physique, strength, and agility!

Zhao Yun also strapped the Shuoyue Sword to his back. He had also asked Ding Ling for advice on sword techniques on the road, and his sword technique was now not bad. With the Shuoyue Sword in hand, his combat power could also rise a notch.
He and Ding Ling are now close comrades-in-arms, and he wasn’t too polite with Ding Ling.
After all, their friendship was at a point where they didn’t need to say too many polite words.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied with Yuan Yao’s attitude and let him continue leading the way.
Yuan Yao said the Divine Weapon Pavilion only had one truly unparalleled Divine Weapon, the Giant Que.
There were other weapons, some of which were quite good, but far inferior to the Giant Que.
Ding Ling took a close look and picked a Six-Stone Bow.
He once had a Six-Stone Bow, but in terms of quality, it was not as good as this one.
Zhao Yun chose a sleeve arrow, which could be fired at short distances.
To the second floor.
It was the Library Pavilion.
When Ding Ling saw the books, he couldn’t help but show joy.
Without asking Yuan Yao, he stepped forward and began to peruse various books.
Most were ancient book collections.
Many were rare versions that couldn’t be found in the outside world.
There were medical books documenting medicine;
There were books on artisan skills;
There were books explaining the making of the Luu Ban Lock;
There were books on military strategy.
All were complete.
Ding Ling quickly flip through them.
The library’s shelves in his Sea of Consciousness were rapidly collecting related books.
[Luu Ban Lock Making Skill Full Level]
[Lord’s Military Strategy Full Level]
[Middle-tier Artisan Skills Full Level]
[Middle-tier Medical Science Full Level]
[High-tier Medical Science Full Level]
Ding Ling’s foundation in the Medical Dao was still slightly weak.
But here, he was perfectly supplemented.
His Medical Dao became increasingly strong and flawless.
As for the skill improvement in military strategy, etc.
Ding Ling just felt that his wisdom increased slightly, and his understanding and usage of military strategy seemed to deepen a lot, but beyond that, he felt nothing else.
He glanced at the character panel.
Sure enough.
[Wisdom +0.1]
[Charm +0.2]
Having read over a thousand books.
He received the attribute point boosts mentioned above.
Ding Ling knew this must be because his strength had reached the Super-Elite level.
Causing strength and other attributes not to budge.
"In the end, these books are just basic books. Although many books on military strategy and the art of governance are very profound. Yet the increase in wisdom is still pitifully small."
"With unimpressive wisdom, even if given military strategy, I can only be a glib Zhao Kuo!"
Ding Ling shook his head, not thinking anymore.
In the real world, he had read many military strategy books.
Back then, the increase in wisdom was higher than now.
But obviously.
With the improvement of strength, the increase in attribute points has become increasingly difficult.

Even though he had read military strategy, knew how to use it, without extremely high wisdom, just copying the gourd-drawing ladle, it was still very hard to replicate the many legendary campaigns in the strategy books!
This is like having no extremely high strength; the Overlord Halberd Technique cannot be flawlessly applied;
If it weren’t for this.
Ding Ling wouldn’t choose to walk the Path of the War God.
He felt that if he fought with wisdom, competed with intrigue, he definitely couldn’t compare to Zhuge Liang, Guo Jia, and other prodigies.
But speaking of martial power.
He’s got a cheat.
Who’s he afraid of?
"Besides these books?"
Ding Ling looked at Yuan Yao:
"What about your family’s Martial Arts Secret Manuals?"
Reading over a thousand books had already taken several hours.
Even though Ding Ling could read as quickly as flipping through books, it still took time.
Yuan Yao didn’t understand the meaning behind Ding Ling flipping through books.
He was already napping on the side. Hearing Ding Ling’s question, he was startled and a bit troubled:
"This, this..."
"I won’t make it difficult for you even if you don’t speak."
Ding Ling said very calmly:
"Later, after leaving the attic, I’ll stab you to death with a halberd, or maybe I’ll do it now."
Yuan Yao’s eyes widened in shock, and he hurriedly said:
"All my family’s Martial Arts Secret Manuals I’ve memorized. I can recite them to you."

[Luu Ban Lock Making Skill Full Level]
[Lord’s Military Strategy Full Level]
[Middle-tier Artisan Skills Full Level]
[Middle-tier Medical Science Full Level]
[High-tier Medical Science Full Level]
Ding Ling’s foundation in the Medical Dao was still slightly weak.
But here, he was perfectly supplemented.
His Medical Dao became increasingly strong and flawless.
As for the skill improvement in military strategy, etc.
Ding Ling just felt that his wisdom increased slightly, and his understanding and usage of military strategy seemed to deepen a lot, but beyond that, he felt nothing else.
He glanced at the character panel.
Sure enough.
[Wisdom +0.1]
[Charm +0.2]
Having read over a thousand books.
He received the attribute point boosts mentioned above.
Ding Ling knew this must be because his strength had reached the Super-Elite level.
Causing strength and other attributes not to budge.
"In the end, these books are just basic books.
Although many books on military strategy and the art of governance are very profound.
Yet the increase in wisdom is still pitifully small."
"With unimpressive wisdom, even if given military strategy, I can only be a glib Zhao Kuo!"
Ding Ling shook his head, not thinking anymore.
In the real world, he had read many military strategy books.
Back then, the increase in wisdom was higher than now.
But obviously.
With the improvement of strength, the increase in attribute points has become increasingly difficult.

Even though he had read military strategy, knew how to use it, without extremely high wisdom, just copying the gourd-drawing ladle, it was still very hard to replicate the many legendary campaigns in the strategy books!
This is like having no extremely high strength; the Overlord Halberd Technique cannot be flawlessly applied;
If it weren’t for this.
Ding Ling wouldn’t choose to walk the Path of the War God.
He felt that if he fought with wisdom, competed with intrigue, he definitely couldn’t compare to Zhuge Liang, Guo Jia, and other prodigies.
But speaking of martial power.
He’s got a cheat.
Who’s he afraid of?
"Besides these books?"
Ding Ling looked at Yuan Yao:
"What about your family’s Martial Arts Secret Manuals?"
Reading over a thousand books had already taken several hours.
Even though Ding Ling could read as quickly as flipping through books, it still took time.
Yuan Yao didn’t understand the meaning behind Ding Ling flipping through books.
He was already napping on the side.
Hearing Ding Ling’s question, he was startled and a bit troubled:
"This, this..."
"I won’t make it difficult for you even if you don’t speak."
Ding Ling said very calmly:
"Later, after leaving the attic, I’ll stab you to death with a halberd, or maybe I’ll do it now."
Yuan Yao’s eyes widened in shock, and he hurriedly said:
"All my family’s Martial Arts Secret Manuals I’ve memorized.
I can recite them to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Human Emperor Swordsmanship
paragraphs: "Very good."
Ding Ling said with satisfaction:
"Recite it."
Yuan Yao was indignant, wishing he could kill Ding Ling. From childhood to adulthood, he had never felt so humiliated and aggrieved.
But life and death were not self-determined; he could only obediently ’follow orders’ and began to recite his family’s inherited Breathing Technique.
He was evidently very familiar with his family’s Breathing Technique.
The recitation was smooth, and midway through, he deliberately messed up the sequence several times.

When Ding Ling saw that there were no books materializing on the bookshelf after he finished, he knew Yuan Yao was up to mischief. He then gave Yuan Yao a beating, causing him to scream in agony before he stopped.
"Try any tricks again, and next time I’ll chop you up!"
Ding Ling coldly glared at him.
Yuan Yao was perplexed; how did Ding Ling know his Breathing Technique was wrong?
He just made a few mistakes, switched a couple of words around!
How was he found out?!
He was deeply puzzled.
However, seeing Ding Ling’s anger, he dared not act out again. He then recited the entire Inherited Breathing Technique.
After one round.
Ding Ling closed his eyes once again.
A book, intangible and elusive, instantly materialized on the library bookshelf.
It was the Human Emperor Breathing Technique.
Alongside the Medicine King Breathing Technique, Warrior’s Breathing Method, and Flying Bear Breathing Technique.
Now, there were four illusory Breathing Techniques on the shelf.
About the Human Emperor Breathing Technique.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow:
"How does your family possess the Human Emperor Breathing Technique? Is it related to the Three Emperors and Five Kings of the Ancient Era?"
"Our family acquired this technique by chance."
Yuan Yao’s face almost overflowed with confusion:
"I never said our Inherited Breathing Technique was the Human Emperor Breathing Technique. How did you know?"
He looked as if he had seen a ghost!
It’s essential to know that the Human Emperor Breathing Technique is a taboo!
This is a Royal Secret Technique!
It is a required technique for a Human Emperor.
However, the current Human Emperor learns the Howling at the Moon Breathing Technique, not the Human Emperor Breathing Technique!
"That’s none of your business how I know."
Ding Ling said coldly:
"Answer whatever I ask honestly!"
Yuan Yao felt bitter in his heart, but could only obediently say:

"It’s because my ancestor, while being the Human Emperor’s teacher, replaced the Royal family’s Human Emperor Breathing Technique with the Howling at the Moon Breathing Technique. Since then, the true Secret Technique of the Royal Supreme Skill, the Human Emperor Breathing Technique, became exclusive to our Yuan Family."
"How is that possible?"
Zhao Yun didn’t believe it:
"The Imperial Palace is full of experts like clouds. Even if your Yuan Family had influence, you couldn’t achieve that!"
"I also don’t know how my ancestor managed it."
Yuan Yao thought for a moment, then said, looking bewildered:
"That’s just what happened. Although I also find it incredible and hard to understand!"
"Alright."
Ding Ling didn’t ask further.
The Yuan Family, four generations and three ministers, had immense power.
Reaching into the Armory of the Imperial Palace in some generation isn’t surprising.
But how did they manage the switch without being noticed?
It’s truly a miracle!
Because Ding Ling knew if it were him, there’s no way he could achieve this.
But the Yuan Family planned for the Human Emperor Breathing Technique and succeeded back then.
It shows their great ambition!
No wonder Yuan Shu dared to claim the throne!
The root of it all sprouted from the ancestor’s generation!
"Continue."
Ding Ling signaled Yuan Yao to continue revealing other techniques.
Yuan Yao dared not disobey.
He then divulged the key points and moves of the Human Emperor Swordsmanship one by one.
After he knew Ding Ling could see through his lies,
he dared not play any tricks.
He recited the mantra word for word and demonstrated it once.
After Ding Ling watched, he closed his eyes.
Another book instantly materialized on the library bookshelf:
"Human Emperor Swordsmanship"!
In an instant.
[Human Emperor Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
The improvement in strength, agility, and constitution was quite balanced.
Overall, the stats were slightly inferior to Dawn Swordsmanship and Overlord Halberd Technique!
But in terms of power,
they were in no way inferior to Dawn Swordsmanship and Sunset Swordsmanship!
This was a magnificent, grand Sword Technique! Unmatched!
It belonged solely to the Human Emperor!
If a Human Emperor wielded this Sword Technique, it would surely have an effect!
Boom!
A grand momentum exclusive to the Human Emperor Swordsmanship burst forth from Ding Ling!
It was as if an ancient Human Emperor had descended upon the world, an overwhelming Emperor’s Qi bore down on Yuan Yao, almost pressing him to the ground.
He was aghast, staring at Ding Ling in disbelief, unable to imagine Ding Ling had mastered the Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
But Ding Ling’s current display was clearly the expression only shown when the Human Emperor Swordsmanship was mastered to its height!
His father Yuan Shu had spent decades diligently cultivating the Human Emperor Swordsmanship to reach the Transformation Realm, only exhibiting such prowess!
And Ding Ling?
Recalling Ding Ling’s questioning and denial of the incorrect Human Emperor Breathing Technique, Yuan Yao’s mind raced with thought:
"Could it be that Ding Ling is one of the lost Dragon Sons and Grandsons? A true descendant of the Royal Family?!"
His eye twitched.
The look in his eyes towards Ding Ling changed again and again.
Zhao Yun, however, was calm and composed as if used to it.
Seeing this, Yuan Yao was even more convinced that Ding Ling was a descendant of Liu Bang, merely changing his name to Ding Ling to conceal his identity. His real name must be Liu Ling!!
He had never thought Ding Ling could master the Human Emperor Swordsmanship to the Mastery and Great Success Realm in a few blinks of an eye!
Because no one with normal intelligence would think that way!
Yuan Yao fancied himself wise, so naturally, would not think in that direction.
"Not bad."
Ding Ling savored it for a moment.
He found that the Human Emperor Swordsmanship paired with Giant Que Swordsmanship was just perfect. Dignified and majestic!
The Giant Que Sword was extremely heavy, perfectly complementing the simple and straightforward moves of Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
"Any more?"
Ding Ling was not satisfied.
Feeling very much that this trip was worthwhile, he truly benefited.
"No more."
Yuan Yao had a different view of Ding Ling already, hearing this, he tightened his heart, speaking dryly:
"I’ve only memorized these two Cultivation Techniques."
"From what you said, your family has other Martial Arts?"
"There are, but I haven’t memorized them."
Yuan Yao, seeing Ding Ling’s unfriendly face, quickly explained:
"Our family’s strongest are these two techniques. My father also said that mastering them to the state of Mastery would make one a first-class, possibly even a Super-Elite Expert in the world.
There’s no need to waste time learning others.
So, I didn’t learn them."
Ding Ling understood, though feeling a slight regret.
If Yuan Yao had memorized them,
the gains today might have been even greater.
But things as they were, he couldn’t force it.
He then proceeded to the third floor.
Creak!
Creak!
Walking on the wooden stairs, there were occasional creaking sounds.
The sound echoed through the loft, revolving tirelessly, ’lingering for three days,’ further highlighting the deep, tranquil, and spaciousness of the place!
Upon stepping onto the third floor.
Without even seeing what the third floor held, a short blade suddenly slashed out from the side, aiming for Ding Ling’s arm.
The blade was as quick as lightning.
Resembling the Xun Wind sweeping across the ground!

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Divine Weapon—Fish Guts Sword (43/50)
paragraphs: If it were anyone else, under such an unexpected attack, they would definitely be instantly cut down to the ground.
But Ding Ling is different; his agility is exceptionally high. Coupled with the defense techniques like Ascending Skill and Wall-Climbing, he can dodge and maneuver in an extremely short time.
He suddenly kicked off the ground, his whole body soaring up, spinning lightly in mid-air like a flying crane, avoiding the second slash.
Then he abruptly drew the Giant Que Sword from his back.
He employed the Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Boom!
The sword struck right on the incoming blade.
With a clang of a huge noise, accompanied by a scream, boom! A graceful shadow flew back, knocking over several shelves before rolling down onto the attic wooden floor!
Clang clang!
A short blade fell onto the wooden floor, bouncing a few times, and landed at Ding Ling’s feet.
Ding Ling looked down at it.
It was a sharp-edged dagger.
Even after being struck by the Giant Que Sword, it was undamaged.
Ding Ling was surprised. With a light flick of his toe at the dagger’s handle, the dagger flew up and was caught by Ding Ling, who examined it closely and his eyes lit up:
Fish Guts Sword!
"That is my sword!"
A clear voice with a hint of nervousness and unease sounded:
"Give it back to me."
Ding Ling followed the voice and saw that the owner of the graceful shadow was now struggling to get up.
She had a slim waist, and her figure was graceful.
She was dressed in black with a bamboo hat, but the hat was now slashed by the sharpness of the Giant Que Sword, exposing its internal wonders.
It was a woman with a veiled face, having delicate features.
Her face was indistinct.
But her brows and eyes were picturesque, with an elegant demeanor, clearly from a distinguished family.
However, that sudden sword strike showed she was definitely a first-class expert.
A woman.
Her skills were even better than Lei Bo and Chen Lan’s?!
Ding Ling racked his brains, and could not find a matching female general in the Three Kingdoms World.
"Who are you?!"
Just as Ding Ling was about to ask the woman a few questions, Yuan Yao’s astonished voice came from the side.
Yuan Yao had also come upstairs.
At first, Yuan Yao thought it was his own people ambushing Ding Ling and felt somewhat gratified, but after really seeing the general shape and features of the woman, he was shocked and confused.
"You don’t recognize her either?!"
Ding Ling looked sideways.
"I don’t recognize her."
Yuan Yao looked innocent:
"I would never harm you. I’m not that stupid."
Ding Ling just chuckled.
Yuan Yao’s acting was too poor, as he had exposed his desire to kill him a few times.
It was thanks to Ding Ling learning Five Animals Qigong, Inner Scripture, and Qingnang Scripture techniques, which allowed him to dispel anger and calm Evil Qi.
If not, had the killing intent erupted, Yuan Yao would have been killed by him long ago.
The more people he killed.
The more he understood why Xiang Yu was a maniacal city slaughterer.
Needless to say, although Xiang Yu was exceptionally gifted, his ability to calm Evil Qi was certainly not high!
After all, not everyone is Zhao Zilong!
"Who are you?"
Ding Ling ignored Yuan Yao and looked at the woman, asking the question Yuan Yao had asked.
When Yuan Yao asked, Ding Ling could sense the woman’s hostility.
Clearly.
The woman was not fond of Yuan Yao.
"Don’t blame me for being ruthless if you don’t speak."
Ding Ling weighed the Fish Guts Sword in his hand.
This sword was also peculiar, appearing like a short blade when used by the other party, but when held, it was indeed a dagger.
No doubt, it must be due to the woman’s technique, which created an illusion.
A cultivation technique that could cause him an illusion was definitely first-class!
"My name is Ren Hongchang."
The woman seemed to make up her mind, standing straight, her bright eyes fixed on Ding Ling:
"I’m here to rescue my sisters. You don’t seem to be one of Yuan Yao’s household generals or servants, who are you?"
"Ren Hongchang, that name sounds so familiar."
Ding Ling was stunned, a bolt of lightning flashed through his mind, he stared at the woman, examining her up and down, his pupils slightly contracted:
"Are you Diao Chan?!"
"What Diao Chan?"
Ren Hongchang also paused, then seemed to recall something, and said softly:

"Indeed, many called me Diao Chan, but that was when I held the Mink Hat over the imperial ministers in the Imperial Palace. Because I was in charge of the Mink Hat, people called me Diao Chan. There are many like me in the palace."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was uncertain and said:
"Do you know Wang Yun?"
"As a Grand Minister in the current court, how could I not know Wang Yun? But I am not very familiar with him. Why? Who exactly are you? What do you want to know?
Ren Hongchang carried a heroic aura common to women in power, her voice clear yet forceful:
"As long as you return the Fish Guts Sword to me and let me go, anything I know, I will tell you without reserve."
"Straightforward."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"You can call me Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?"
Ren Hongchang thought for a while, shaking her head slightly:
"Never heard of it."
She looked at Ding Ling with a curious expression:
"Your skills are very advanced. I am far inferior to you."
She bowed in ceremony and apology:

"I did not intend to kill you earlier, only to injure you so you would leave. I thought you were in league with Yuan Yao. Now that you are not allies, we have no reason to be enemies. Don’t you agree?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling tossed the Fish Guts Sword back to Ren Hongchang:
"Tell me why you came here."
"Thank you."
Ren Hongchang didn’t expect Ding Ling to really return the Fish Guts Sword to her and was momentarily stunned, then proceeded to gracefully give her thanks.
[Achieved E-level Achievement Medal: You have earned high recognition from Ren Hongchang (Diao Chan).]

[Note: As the most beautiful and gentle woman of this plane, Diao Chan’s charm is unparalleled. No one can resist her slightest gesture, unless your skill is extremely high and your nature very strong. Otherwise, one day you will surely fall at her feet.
No doubt.
Your martial power and skills impressed her.
The generous act of returning the Fish Guts Sword moved her, winning recognition.
Because the Fish Guts Sword is the only gift from her deceased parents, it is her most precious item.
She kept it close, never letting it leave her side.
That short moment without the Fish Guts Sword was already a torment for her.
You returned it in time.
It deeply touched her heart, like drinking sweet spring water! Recognition naturally rose, which is very ordinary.
Moreover, since you both have a common enemy in Yuan Yao, her high recognition towards you is not surprising.
However, clearly.
Her mind is not on you.
This encounter may perhaps never be repeated.]
Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
His heart confirmed that the woman before him was indeed the unparalleled beauty Diao Chan from the Three Kingdoms, and he was somewhat bewildered.
Diao Chan was not in Luoyang.
Yet she’s here!

"Indeed, many called me Diao Chan, but that was when I held the Mink Hat over the imperial ministers in the Imperial Palace.
Because I was in charge of the Mink Hat, people called me Diao Chan.
There are many like me in the palace."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was uncertain and said:
"Do you know Wang Yun?"
"As a Grand Minister in the current court, how could I not know Wang Yun?
But I am not very familiar with him.
Why?
Who exactly are you?
What do you want to know?
Ren Hongchang carried a heroic aura common to women in power, her voice clear yet forceful:
"As long as you return the Fish Guts Sword to me and let me go, anything I know, I will tell you without reserve."
"Straightforward."
Ding Ling smiled slightly:
"You can call me Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling?"
Ren Hongchang thought for a while, shaking her head slightly:
"Never heard of it."
She looked at Ding Ling with a curious expression:
"Your skills are very advanced.
I am far inferior to you."
She bowed in ceremony and apology:
"I did not intend to kill you earlier, only to injure you so you would leave.
I thought you were in league with Yuan Yao.
Now that you are not allies, we have no reason to be enemies.
Don’t you agree?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling tossed the Fish Guts Sword back to Ren Hongchang:
"Tell me why you came here."
"Thank you."
Ren Hongchang didn’t expect Ding Ling to really return the Fish Guts Sword to her and was momentarily stunned, then proceeded to gracefully give her thanks.
[Achieved E-level Achievement Medal: You have earned high recognition from Ren Hongchang (Diao Chan).]
[Note: As the most beautiful and gentle woman of this plane, Diao Chan’s charm is unparalleled.
No one can resist her slightest gesture, unless your skill is extremely high and your nature very strong.
Otherwise, one day you will surely fall at her feet.
No doubt.
Your martial power and skills impressed her.
The generous act of returning the Fish Guts Sword moved her, winning recognition.
Because the Fish Guts Sword is the only gift from her deceased parents, it is her most precious item.
She kept it close, never letting it leave her side.
That short moment without the Fish Guts Sword was already a torment for her.
You returned it in time.
It deeply touched her heart, like drinking sweet spring water!
Recognition naturally rose, which is very ordinary.
Moreover, since you both have a common enemy in Yuan Yao, her high recognition towards you is not surprising.
However, clearly.
Her mind is not on you.
This encounter may perhaps never be repeated.]
Ding Ling heard the prompt sound.
His heart confirmed that the woman before him was indeed the unparalleled beauty Diao Chan from the Three Kingdoms, and he was somewhat bewildered.
Diao Chan was not in Luoyang.
Yet she’s here!

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Diao Chan Is a First-class Expert
paragraphs: What about the beauty trap?
Will Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu still clash?
Ding Ling won’t worry about that for now.
He originally thought that Ren Hongchang might not be the Diao Chan from Romance of the Three Kingdoms, since Diao Chan herself mentioned there are many palace maids named Diao Chan.
Maybe the execution of the beauty trap was done by another Diao Chan?
But now upon hearing the alert sound,
Ding Ling can confidently determine that the Ren Hongchang before him is indeed Diao Chan, one of the four great beauties.
She actually possesses an E-level Medal!!
Needless to say, the effect is certainly not related to defense or strength.
Recalling the phrase about her unparalleled charm.
Ding Ling comes to a realization:
"Could it be that her charm value has reached a super-elite level?!"
Ding Ling clicks his tongue.
If that’s truly the case.

The level of her charm is simply unimaginable, no wonder she can turn the world upside down, enchanting both the super-elite like Lü Bu and the powerful minister Dong Zhuo into confusion, unaware of north, southeast, or west, even causing them to kill each other over her.
How could any ordinary beauty drive Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu to such an extent?
After all, Dong Zhuo is a formidable man who spends nights in the dragon bed!
The concubines and palace maids in the Imperial Palace, haven’t he slept with innumerable ones, and what beauty has he not seen?
To him,
Beauty is just ordinary.
Lü Bu, needless to mention, being a first-class top expert, persistently adheres to the Martial Dao and surely lacks no beautiful companions, ordinary women hardly move him or catch his eye.
Yet such formidable men are played like puppets in Diao Chan’s hands!
To what extent must her charm and beauty reach?
That even Dong Zhuo, who views women as insignificant, would be so captivated?
Although it can’t be denied that Wang Yun, Diao Chan, and others surely employed strategies of estrangement and heart separation, ordinary women wouldn’t succeed with these tactics.
It only highlights Diao Chan’s exceptionally high charm value!
"I came here first thing in the morning."
Diao Chan is speaking.
Ding Ling snaps back to reality and looks towards the sound.
Only to see Diao Chan holding the Fish Guts Sword, with a flick of her wrist, the sword disappears, presumably hidden in her sleeve or elsewhere.
She speaks crisply:
"I came here to find some Great Medicine. My sister is injured, and I must save her."
"Who is your sister?"
"Du Qingcheng."
Diao Chan doesn’t hide anything from Ding Ling, frankly stating:

"She was deceived to come here and then trapped in the deep courtyard of the Yuan Mansion. Refusing to comply with Yuan Shu, she’s been imprisoned till now, likely for over half a month. She was poisoned several times during this time. Were it not for our Heart Technique being highly resistant to poison,
she might have already died.
Even so,
She’s now on her last breath.
I must save her!"
"Du Qingcheng?"
Ding Ling recalls briefly, having never heard of such a name.
However, considering Ren Hongchang’s altered ’history’ trajectory, Du Qingcheng must also be a great beauty he’s unfamiliar with.
Otherwise, why dare to be named Qingcheng?
And even be so desired by Yuan Shu.
He glances at Yuan Yao, surely, Yuan Yao’s expression is extremely complex, uncertain of what he’s thinking.
Ding Ling then asks Yuan Yao about Du Qingcheng’s situation.
Yuan Yao doesn’t dare not to speak:
"Du Qingcheng was lured here by Qin Yilu along with a few strangers I don’t recognize. They handed Du Qingcheng and Qin Yilu over to my father, and
Father was overjoyed.
At that moment, he rewarded those persons with some Martial Arts and our family’s collection of less important Breathing Technique.
After receiving the reward, they left and vanished without trace.
And Qin Yilu, realizing he was deceived, wanted to take Du Qingcheng away.
But how would my father allow him to leave?
Qin Yilu was taken away and beaten to death that day.
Du Qingcheng was imprisoned.
My father alternates between threats and rewards, trying to get her to comply..."
Upon hearing Qin Yilu’s name.
Ding Ling understands who Du Qingcheng is.
Qin Yilu:
Initially a soldier defending Luoyang, later became the County Magistrate of Zhi County.
He’s rather mediocre.
But his wife, Du Clan, is famous in history.
Du Clan was admired by Guan Yu, who repeatedly requested Cao Mengde to grant Du Clan to him after defeating Lü Bu.
Yet Guan Yu’s repeated requests aroused Cao Mengde’s curiosity and suspicion.
Although he verbally agreed well, after breaking Xiapi City, Cao Mengde summoned Du Clan immediately.
The outcome was naturally astonishing as a Celestial Being, even risking the ’hardly reconcilable’ issue with Guan Yu, for he took her for himself.
This reveals Du Clan’s grace and charm!
Moreover, Du Clan later bore two sons and a daughter for Cao Mengde.
Clearly demonstrating Cao Mengde’s immense affection for her!
Such beauty, Ding Ling remembers.
Other players naturally remember too, unable to lay hands on Cai Wenji or Diao Chan, surely they first targeted Du Clan and ’sold’ her to Yuan Shu for martial arts and the like.
After all, Yuan Shu, notorious for his brutality and lecherousness,
besides, being from the Four Generations of Three Ministers, his family is affluent, lacking no Martial Arts.
Why certain it’s players?
Aside from players? Ding Ling can’t think of anyone else doing such a thing!
Just unexpected to Ding Ling, Du Clan’s real name is Du Qingcheng, and she’s actually Diao Chan’s sister?
Subsequently,
Ding Ling chatted with Diao Chan for a while.
Learning more inside stories and truths.
It turns out Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan are fellow disciples and sisters.
Diao Chan, more talented, progresses swiftly in Martial Dao.

Du Qingcheng, although not inherently talented in Martial Dao, excels quickly in the Breathing Technique, making her physique, demeanor, and charm increasingly extraordinary, resembling a Fox Immortal descending to the Mortal World, thus her master specially named her Du Qingcheng.
Meaning Du Clan’s stunning city beauty.
Diao Chan even modestly says Du Clan’s grace surpasses hers a hundredfold.
Ding Ling naturally doesn’t believe that.
The Achievement Medal’s annotation states Diao Chan is the world’s most beautiful woman, with no other.
How could Du Qingcheng surpass Diao Chan in beauty?
Yet being praised so highly by Diao Chan, shows Du Qingcheng’s extraordinariness.
Ding Ling nods, and says:
"I know medicine, apprenticed to Hua Tuo. Perhaps I can help you save Du Qingcheng."
"Thank you, sir!"
Diao Chan gives a deep bow:
"I tell you so much, hoping you can save my sister. Alone I’m truly powerless to bring Qingcheng out of this Yuan Mansion."
She bites her lip, dropping to her knees with a plop:
"If only you can rescue Qingcheng. I am willing to follow you!"
Having introduced himself.
She already knows Ding Ling is the Tiger Valor General.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling raises an eyebrow, saying:
"Your Martial Arts are decent. But I don’t want a burden."
Diao Chan’s sense of vigilance and caution remains strong.
She still hasn’t removed her mask.
Ding Ling naturally won’t force her.
"I’m not a burden."
Hearing these words, Diao Chan isn’t pleased, she says with determination:
"My skills are not inferior to a First-class Expert! If it’s a street fight, regular First-class Fierce Generals may not defeat me! I’ll only be your asset, not a burden!"

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Swallowing Great Medicine Fiercely
paragraphs: "I still find it strange. Why is Du Qingcheng worth your effort?"
Ding Ling was quite intrigued, but he kept up his act and spoke without revealing any emotion.
He liked beauties.
But he wasn’t a lustful spirit!
He wouldn’t be enchanted by a few words from Diao Chan to the point of losing his senses!
"We are sisters in training, and each other’s only family!"
Diao Chan said:
"If I were in trouble, she would save me at all costs. The same goes the other way!"
Ding Ling felt relieved.
At the same time, he began to ponder.
In the story.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were on Lü Bu’s side, could it be because they were sisters in training?
Later, Du Qingcheng agreed to marry Cao Mengde.
Maybe it was to save Diao Chan?
After all, Diao Chan was Lü Bu’s concubine!
And Lü Bu was hanged at White Gate Tower, as Lü Bu’s family, what good could become of Diao Chan?
Du Qingcheng, to save Diao Chan, might even be willing to serve Thief Cao, which seems reasonable.
Ding Ling was extremely astonished.
He hadn’t expected such a strange story in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms World!
If he hadn’t come to the Yuan Mansion, he might never have discovered the truth of this matter in his lifetime!
Indeed, many facts are often buried in places unknown to people.
Such is the case with Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan.

’Previously in Luoyang, I thought about going to witness the breathtaking beauty of Diao Chan and Cai Wenji, but now it seems, even if I went, what I’d see would surely be impostors! The real Diao Chan is right in front of me. Even if there is a Diao Chan in Luoyang, wouldn’t she be a fake?’
Ding Ling then chatted with Diao Chan for a while longer.
He agreed to her request.
Diao Chan was skilled in both literature and martial arts, and could do laundry and cook, truly a good helper.
Previously, in Jizhou, Ding Ling thought about taking Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan with him.
But considering Zhao Bingxuan’s low Combat Power and Zhao Xiaoyiu’s ability only to defeat a few small thieves, Ding Ling gave up.
He wanted to take true masters!
He didn’t even want to take Zhao Feng, let alone Zhao Xiaoyiu.
However, having a woman help with cooking and laundry while traveling was indeed convenient.
Therefore, Ding Ling was naturally pleased.

Furthermore, Diao Chan was the world’s most beautiful woman! Ding Ling was also curious about her true appearance, and once they rescued Du Qingcheng, he figured he would have the chance to see her true face.
"You wait aside for now."
Ding Ling walked directly towards the shelf holding the Great Medicine and looked over.
It was densely packed, and the shelf was filled with various exquisite wooden boxes.
There were labels on the shelf as well.
Hundred-year Great Medicine!
Two hundred-year Great Medicine!
Three hundred-year Great Medicine!
And finally, the Thousand-year Great Medicine!
"Even the Thousand-year Great Medicine is here!"
Ding Ling’s breathing quickened. He took a closer look and found two boxes of the Thousand-year Great Medicine.
He opened them.
One box was empty.
In the other box, there was a purple ginseng.
The ginseng had a form resembling a doll, translucent and extremely lively.
"This is what our Yuan Family acquired with tremendous effort from outside the region. Hundreds died or were injured! In the end, my father obtained it by sheer luck and then treasured it here!"
Yuan Yao’s feelings were complicated. He knew he couldn’t keep the Great Medicine, and although he felt heartache and reluctance, compared to his own life, mere Great Medicine was nothing.
Moreover.
To use the Great Medicine, one must use a medicinal bath.
As long as Ding Ling let him go.
He would have a chance to reclaim these Great Medicines!
How could he not seek revenge?
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied, and he immediately had Diao Chan take Yuan Yao down to the second floor.
Diao Chan, although puzzled, nodded and escorted Yuan Yao down.

Ding Ling claimed to have been taught by Hua Tuo, possessing exceptional Medical Dao skills. Although Diao Chan was skeptical, she had no other options in this isolated place, so she could only treat a dead horse as if it were alive.
Moreover, Ding Ling, being highly skilled in Martial Arts and having an open heart, even returned the exquisite Divine Weapon Fish Guts Sword to her!
She had quite a high level of acceptance of him.
Although she did not fully trust Ding Ling, she had a fair amount of trust!
After Yuan Yao left.
Ding Ling first went to the area with Hundred-year Great Medicine.
He opened box after box.
There were hundreds of them.
Without another word, he started eating.
He consumed one plant after another.
Ginseng, reishi, Polygonum multiflorum, deer antler—there were many.
There were also some other Spirit Fruits, rare flowers, and herbs.
All of them were hundreds of years old.
Ding Ling devoured a full hundred portions.
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
[Strength +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
After eating a hundred portions.
Ding Ling noticed the progress bar wasn’t moving.
His body also didn’t have a heating sensation.
Only with a heating sensation would there be a significant improvement in physical attributes.
It was usually like this in the past.
Unconvinced, Ding Ling ate another dozen or so plants, but the result was the same.
He felt disappointed.
He thought to himself:
"Could it be that I’ve developed a resistance to the medicine? Or has my power advanced to a new level, making Hundred-year Great Medicine useless for me?!"
He glanced at his Character Panel:
Strength: [Bone 1 (Normal human is 1 point), Wisdom 2+0.1 (2.1), Agility 22.3+0.1+0.4+0.3 (23.1), Constitution 21.7+0.6+0.1+0.3 (22.7), Charm 4+0.3+0.8+0.2 (5.3)]
After consuming over a hundred portions of Hundred-year Great Medicine.
Ultimately:
[Strength +0.9]
[Defense +0.9]
Which makes the Defense: 20.1
Strength 26.6.
The Defense once again broke through the threshold.
Now Ding Ling had advanced to Super-Elite in agility, constitution, strength, and defense!
Especially with strength soaring to 26.6!
A whopping over 2,600 pounds of strength!
Combined with Human Emperor Swordsmanship and the Giant Que Sword, he was definitely a Demon God Level presence on the battlefield!
"Very good."
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
He looked over at Zhao Yun.
Seeing Zhao Yun staring at him enviously, Ding Ling felt a sudden idea, telling Zhao Yun to quickly pack up all the Hundred-year Great Medicines.
"You’re not eating them anymore?"
Zhao Yun asked in surprise.
"No effect anymore."
Zhao Yun was speechless.
Eating Hundred-year Great Medicine to the point of no effect.
Did this Breathing Technique completely absorb and utilize the medicinal effects? How else would over a hundred plants be useless now?
Although he was puzzled, he was more envious.
Two major Breathing Technique Mastery, fully refining the power of the Great Medicines!
The efficiency was extremely high and terrifying, not to mention it maximized the use of medicinal power without any waste!
Ding Ling no longer concerned himself with the Hundred-year Great Medicine.
He started eating the Two Hundred-year Great Medicine.
Compared to the Hundred-year Great Medicine.
The quantity of Two Hundred-year Great Medicines drastically reduced.
There were only fifty plants.
Ding Ling consumed them all.
[Strength +1]
[Defense +1]
Once the strength improved, the difficulty of increasing attribute points became higher, and the drug resistance continued to increase.
Even the Two Hundred-year Great Medicine didn’t enhance much.
In the past.
The Two Hundred-year Great Medicine would have increased strength by more than 1 point.
Just like how Low-tier Martial Arts now doesn’t benefit Ding Ling much anymore.
The benefit was undeniable before.
Further improvement in strength:
Defense: 21.1
Strength: 27.6.
Ding Ling could clearly feel his skin, sinews, and internal organs becoming stronger!
Becoming tougher and more robust!
Previously, an arrow could easily penetrate skin and sinews.
Now it definitely wouldn’t be that easy!
"Continue."
Ding Ling walked towards the Three Hundred-year Great Medicine area.

He would have a chance to reclaim these Great Medicines!
How could he not seek revenge?
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied, and he immediately had Diao Chan take Yuan Yao down to the second floor.
Diao Chan, although puzzled, nodded and escorted Yuan Yao down.
Ding Ling claimed to have been taught by Hua Tuo, possessing exceptional Medical Dao skills.
Although Diao Chan was skeptical, she had no other options in this isolated place, so she could only treat a dead horse as if it were alive.
Moreover, Ding Ling, being highly skilled in Martial Arts and having an open heart, even returned the exquisite Divine Weapon Fish Guts Sword to her!
She had quite a high level of acceptance of him.
Although she did not fully trust Ding Ling, she had a fair amount of trust!
After Yuan Yao left.
Ding Ling first went to the area with Hundred-year Great Medicine.
He opened box after box.
There were hundreds of them.
Without another word, he started eating.
He consumed one plant after another.
Ginseng, reishi, Polygonum multiflorum, deer antler—there were many.
There were also some other Spirit Fruits, rare flowers, and herbs.
All of them were hundreds of years old.
Ding Ling devoured a full hundred portions.
[Strength +0.2]
[Defense +0.2]
[Strength +0.1]
[Defense +0.1]
After eating a hundred portions.
Ding Ling noticed the progress bar wasn’t moving.
His body also didn’t have a heating sensation.
Only with a heating sensation would there be a significant improvement in physical attributes.
It was usually like this in the past.
Unconvinced, Ding Ling ate another dozen or so plants, but the result was the same.
He felt disappointed.
He thought to himself:
"Could it be that I’ve developed a resistance to the medicine?
Or has my power advanced to a new level, making Hundred-year Great Medicine useless for me?!"
He glanced at his Character Panel:
Strength: [Bone 1 (Normal human is 1 point), Wisdom 2+0.1 (2.1), Agility 22.3+0.1+0.4+0.3 (23.1), Constitution 21.7+0.6+0.1+0.3 (22.7), Charm 4+0.3+0.8+0.2 (5.3)]
After consuming over a hundred portions of Hundred-year Great Medicine.
Ultimately:
[Strength +0.9]
[Defense +0.9]
Which makes the Defense: 20.1
Strength 26.6.
The Defense once again broke through the threshold.
Now Ding Ling had advanced to Super-Elite in agility, constitution, strength, and defense!
Especially with strength soaring to 26.6!
A whopping over 2,600 pounds of strength!
Combined with Human Emperor Swordsmanship and the Giant Que Sword, he was definitely a Demon God Level presence on the battlefield!
"Very good."
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
He looked over at Zhao Yun.
Seeing Zhao Yun staring at him enviously, Ding Ling felt a sudden idea, telling Zhao Yun to quickly pack up all the Hundred-year Great Medicines.
"You’re not eating them anymore?"
Zhao Yun asked in surprise.
"No effect anymore."
Zhao Yun was speechless.
Eating Hundred-year Great Medicine to the point of no effect.
Did this Breathing Technique completely absorb and utilize the medicinal effects?
How else would over a hundred plants be useless now?
Although he was puzzled, he was more envious.
Two major Breathing Technique Mastery, fully refining the power of the Great Medicines!
The efficiency was extremely high and terrifying, not to mention it maximized the use of medicinal power without any waste!
Ding Ling no longer concerned himself with the Hundred-year Great Medicine.
He started eating the Two Hundred-year Great Medicine.
Compared to the Hundred-year Great Medicine.
The quantity of Two Hundred-year Great Medicines drastically reduced.
There were only fifty plants.
Ding Ling consumed them all.
[Strength +1]
[Defense +1]
Once the strength improved, the difficulty of increasing attribute points became higher, and the drug resistance continued to increase.
Even the Two Hundred-year Great Medicine didn’t enhance much.
In the past.
The Two Hundred-year Great Medicine would have increased strength by more than 1 point.
Just like how Low-tier Martial Arts now doesn’t benefit Ding Ling much anymore.
The benefit was undeniable before.
Further improvement in strength:
Defense: 21.1
Strength: 27.6.
Ding Ling could clearly feel his skin, sinews, and internal organs becoming stronger!
Becoming tougher and more robust!
Previously, an arrow could easily penetrate skin and sinews.
Now it definitely wouldn’t be that easy!
"Continue."
Ding Ling walked towards the Three Hundred-year Great Medicine area.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Power Reaches the Limit of the Breathing Technique (46/50)
paragraphs: The herbs here are fewer.
Only a mere twenty-eight plants.
But having this many is quite extraordinary.
You must know, even hundred-year-old great medicines are rare in the outside world now.
However, thinking about the few great medicines I’ve obtained earlier, Ding Ling has reason to suspect they might be five hundred years old or even older.
Because after consuming a three-hundred-year-old great medicine, he found its potency was still far less than the great medicine he obtained earlier in Luoyang.
Thinking of the great medicine he obtained earlier in Luoyang, just one of them increased his Strength Attribute Value by about 1 point.
Ding Ling felt relieved.

It goes without saying that Dong Huang and the others must have raided the Imperial Palace Treasury and many family treasuries, and it’s normal for them to be allotted numerous great medicines as Dong Zhuo’s ’close ministers’.
Especially Dong Huang, being Dong Zhuo’s nephew, was allotted at least two or more!
They would surely be allocated high-tier medicines!
"Dong Zhuo is really crude and rough. He raided the Imperial Palace and some families. How can the amount of great medicine he received be small?"
At this moment, Ding Ling began to think that becoming a ruler seems more convenient for collecting great medicines.
But thinking about the various intrigues and troubles on the path to hegemony.
He extinguished this thought.
Having already chosen the Path of the War God, he cannot choose again, even if he could, he would probably still choose this path.
His greatest desire is to quickly grow stronger and break through all the plane worlds’ checkpoints!
How could he simply circle the Three Kingdoms World’s plane?
Realistically, battling for supremacy would take years, maybe decades, and with players stirring up trouble, it’s too exhausting and demanding! And it will definitely be very troublesome!
Ding Ling has automatic Full Level Martial Arts from the library and can completely travel to various worlds looking for quality resources to enhance himself.
No need to stay in one world for a long time to play supremacy.
Having understood this clearly.
Ding Ling no longer worried about this matter.
He continued devouring the great medicine.
Crunch!
Crunch!
One plant after another was swallowed into his stomach.
The Sword God Breathing Technique and Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique operated swiftly, his body began to heat up, streams of warm flows surged into every limb, organ, membrane, and meridian.
Ding Ling could clearly feel the rise in power.
His skin, organs, etc., were constantly strengthening.
Crunch!
Once all the three-hundred-year-old great medicines were consumed.
[Strength +1.1]
[Defense +1.1]
Change in power:
[Defense is: 22.2
Strength 28.7.]
Grew stronger again!
Power surged even more! With a gentle fist clench, it crackled and seemed as though it could crush the Qiankun Realm!
"So strong, so explosive feeling!"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow.
Experiencing this rapid growth in strength felt like flying in the clouds, truly indescribably intoxicating and thrilling!
Carefully appreciating the defense.
It seems not even an ordinary person hitting him with a stick could cause any harm now.
The skin was as tough as leather armor!
Defense increased to this extent, skin membrane, meridians, etc., were unknowingly transforming!
Like a chrysalis transforming into a butterfly, differing completely from before.
Ding Ling suspected that if he continues evolving.
In the future, his skin could become akin to armor or shields!
By then, even a body blocking bullets seems plausible.
But obviously not at that level yet, sharp arrows can still pierce through the leather armor!
Still need to keep striving.
He approached the four-hundred-year-old medicine area.
The great medicine here was fewer.
Only 11 plants.
Devoured in one go.
[Strength +1]
[Defense +1]
Change in power:
[Defense is: 23.2
Strength 29.7.]
Five-hundred-year-old medicine area.
Only 8 plants.
Devoured.
[Strength +0.3]
[Defense +1.1]
Change in power:
[Defense is: 24.3
Strength 30.]
Strength broke through the bottleneck again.
Crackle!
His bones and meridians transformed once more, Ding Ling’s stature seemed to grow slightly taller.
He suspected that if he continues getting taller, he might become like Lü Bu, tall and broad, extremely robust!
Defense grew stronger again.
Skin membrane was continuing to evolve towards armored defense!
Approached the six-hundred-year-old medicine area.
Only 5 plants.
Consumed.
[Strength +0]
[Defense +1.3]
[Physique +0.5]
Change in power:
[Defense is: 25.6
Strength 30.
Physique: 22.7 grew to 23.2]
Organs quivered, bones shivered.
Heat spread all over.
Endurance, stamina, vitality, etc., were constantly soaring. This was the enhancement of physique.
Ding Ling sighed a long deep breath, feeling immensely delighted.
Just somewhat perplexed, contemplating:

"Previously the great medicine only enhanced strength and defense. Now strength can’t increase anymore, and instead enhances physique. But why does physique only increase by 0.5? Could it be because the Sword God Breathing Technique and Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique’s first focus of refining the medicine’s power is strength and defense?!
Ding Ling thought of the power of these techniques, having a sudden realization.
Though logically speaking.
The Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique should focus more on speed.
But thinking now, maybe the thought was mistaken.
Tong Yuan’s spear technique and others emphasize speed more.
Yet his strength was evidently extremely powerful, sharp and unstoppable, vast and magnificent! Extremely hard to contend with!
Defense is unknown, but presumably extraordinarily formidable. After all, Zhao Yun’s seven ins and outs on Changban Slope without a scratch is proof!
And his strength and defense undoubtedly trace back to the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique.
Wang Yue was same principle.
Combining the two breathing techniques.
Naturally, it also leaned towards transforming the medicine’s power into strength and defense!
Thinking of this, Ding Ling was suddenly enlightened.
And now strength reached a new bottleneck.
Seems the two breathing techniques are unable to enhance strength Attribute Points anymore.
The massive medicine power was diverted to physique!
Though it seems the medicine power siphoning to physique wasted quite some medicine power.
This is similar to Ding Ling’s power reaching a certain stage.
Low stage Martial Arts cannot enhance strength etc., merely converts energy into defense, the same way.
"Certainly, that’s the truth without doubt." Ding Ling felt slightly regretful.
If strength could grow continuously, that would be great.
But now it seems the breathing techniques also have their limits.
To break through strength barrier again, perhaps he needs to find an Inner Refining Breathing Technique!
Nonetheless, reaching a force of 3000 jin.
Ding Ling was greatly satisfied.
At this level of strength, fighting Lü Bu would surely allow him to overpower Lü Bu!
"Continue."
Ding Ling moved to the seven-hundred-year-old medicine area.
Only 3 plants.
Consumed.
[Strength +0]
[Defense +1.4]
[Physique +0.6]
Change in power:
[Defense is: 27
Strength 30.
Physique: 23.8]
Strengthened again.
Ding Ling shivered with excitement.
At this moment, Zhao Yun has already packed the hundred-year-old medicine, having found a large bag to store it.
Because wooden boxes were relatively heavy.
Zhao Yun threw all the wooden boxes away and directly took the hundred-year-old medicine out of them and placed it into the bag.
Filled an entire burlap sack!
After organizing, he happened to witness Ding Ling’s transformation from devouring the medicine, couldn’t help but grow increasingly envious and admiring.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Skin Toughness Comparable to Leather Armor
paragraphs: Zhao Yun increasingly yearned for the day he could, like Ding Ling, effortlessly devour medicinal herbs and refine them to enhance himself.
Otherwise, he could only stare at the herbs helplessly!
After all, he could only rely on medicinal baths!
Ding Ling arrived at the area of 800-year-old great medicine.
There were only two plants.
He opened the box.
Still empty.
There were also two plants of 900-year-old medicine, also empty.
Only the millennium-old great medicine had one plant.
Ding Ling devoured it without hesitation.
Crunch!
Crunch!
The medicinal power of the millennium-old great medicine surged and overflowed, far surpassing the power of the 700-year-old great medicine!
After completely devouring it.
[Strength +0]
[Defense +2.4]
[Constitution +0.7]
Change in strength:
[Defense is: 29.4
Strength 30.
Constitution: 24.5]
It must be said that the two mastery Breathing Techniques complemented each other extremely well.
The efficiency of refining the medicinal power was extremely high.
In just a moment’s work.
The medicinal power of the millennium-old great medicine was perfectly refined, integrating into his organs and other areas, significantly enhancing his defense and constitution.
Now approaching 30 points of defense.
It gave Ding Ling the feeling that his skin could compare to two or three layers of leather armor!
Extremely resilient!
He asked Zhao Yun to use the Dragon Gall Silver Spear to pierce the palm of his hand to see.
Zhao Yun, puzzled, heard Ding Ling’s explanation. His eyes brightened slightly, he nodded, and dared not use too much force, only lightly piercing Ding Ling’s palm with the spear.
Completely unharmed.
Ding Ling was delighted.
Zhao Yun was shocked.
He knew his Dragon Gall Silver Spear was extremely sharp; even with no force, an ordinary soldier would be killed if lightly touched by it!
"Very good."
Ding Ling didn’t let Zhao Yun try again.
The Dragon Gall Silver Spear had already given his palm a cold feeling like a piercing awl.
He knew if Zhao Yun used more force, the palm would definitely be pierced.
But he had a rough estimate.
That is, if an ordinary person used a weapon to slash at him without much strength, it would be ineffective!
Only with greater strength could his skin barrier be broken.
"Very impressive!"
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
He was ultimately afraid of death.
With defense so high, with an added layer of hardened armor, he was nearly indestructible on the battlefield!
"So powerful."
Zhao Yun was stunned, envious, and admiring.
"One day, you’ll be this strong too."
Ding Ling was now certain that Tong Yuan’s strength must be a defense of 30, strength of 30!
As long as he broke the strength of 30 barrier!
Tong Yuan would no longer be his match!
The once-unattainable big figure now seemed like someone he could surpass and defeat anytime.
"I hope so."
Zhao Yun also looked forward to the day he could be like that.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling glanced around.
This was his blessed land!
After devouring the millennium treasure medicine, he had a feeling.
Dong Huang’s great medicine surely wasn’t at the millennium level, most likely seven hundred years.
Knowing that his current strength was increasing, the medicinal power’s effect became weaker and weaker.
Three plants of 700-year-old great medicine could still give a defense of +1.4 and constitution of +0.6.
Very precious indeed.
"Luoyang surely has millennium great medicine, and it seems Dong Zhuo himself enjoyed these great medicines. This means Dong Zhuo’s martial power must be incredibly terrifying?!"
Ding Ling pondered:

"The Flying Bear Breathing Technique, Double Extremes Arrow, Double Extremes Saber Technique are all extraordinary. Even if Dong Zhuo hasn’t cultivated them to mastery, by soaking in the bath of these supreme medicines every day, it certainly would lead to very rapid improvement!"
Clearly, Dong Zhuo won’t be easy to deal with.
But that’s none of his business.
His goal was simply to become the War God.
Pat pat pat!
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun descended the stairs.
Yuan Yao saw Ding Ling’s aura becoming increasingly profound, feeling uncertain and suspicious.
But upon seeing the large sack on Zhao Yun’s back, suddenly realizing, several thoughts ran through his mind, and he said immediately:
"You two have already gotten what you wanted. Can you let me go now?"
"Let’s talk after I save Du Qingcheng!"
Ding Ling gazed coldly at Yuan Yao:
"Lead the way!"
"Let me lead the way."
Diao Chan volunteered:
"I know where Qingcheng is."
She thanked Ding Ling once again.
Ding Ling waved his hand:
"Thank me after healing Du Qingcheng."
Diao Chan’s almond-shaped eyes, bright as water, glanced at Ding Ling, said no more, and took the lead.
Reaching the first floor.
Diao Chan went to open the door.
Ding Ling, Zhao Yun, and others mounted the horses.
Once the door was open.
The burly gatekeepers were startled to see an extra person coming from the armory, instinctively about to question, but seeing Yuan Yao, they swallowed their questions.
Both quietly prayed they wouldn’t be blamed by the Patriarch.
Otherwise, if the armory was indeed short of too many items, not even ten lives would suffice to pay back.
Tap tap tap!

Diao Chan didn’t know what Breathing Technique or martial arts she practiced; her body moved like swaying willow branches, drifting lightly forward over ten meters, her speed exceptionally fast, like a wisp of cloud mist that could vanish beneath people’s eyelids at any moment.
Seeing this.
Ding Ling was enlightened.
Especially seeing Diao Chan leap three or four meters high, he was more certain of his thought.
She must have taken a ’Thief’ kind of shortcut into the Armory.
"The famous Diao Chan, surprisingly a martial arts expert! If other players knew, they’d be astonished!"
Ding Ling thought to himself:

"The famous figures in the Three Kingdoms World seem to have many hidden ultimate skills! Zhuge Liang, known throughout the Three Kingdoms, shines like the brightest star. His skills and martial arts must be even more outstanding! But Zhuge Liang is probably still a child now! I wonder if there’s a chance to meet him?"
Tap tap tap!
Galloping all the way.
Diao Chan’s speed was almost unmatched by the swift horses, which showed she had some confidence to enter the Yuan Mansion alone!
Though alone, she could roam freely.
With someone else, especially someone severely injured, the speed would slow down to an unbearable crawl.
Diao Chan must have thought about healing Du Qingcheng first, then escaping the Yuan Family together, which seemed comprehendible.
If she didn’t heal him, with Diao Chan carrying Du Qingcheng, both of them probably couldn’t make it out.
Once healed.
Du Qingcheng, with a grounding in martial arts, might manage an escape if careful.
Ding Ling understood Diao Chan’s thought process.
But he didn’t say much.
After a few turns.
They reached deep into the Yuan Family inner courtyard.
Ding Ling saw many Yuan Family members.
They were of all ages, men, and women alike.
All without exception, exuding elegance, dressed in lavish clothing.
Seeing Ding Ling’s group daring to ride through the inner courtyard on horseback, someone stepped forward, shouting to stop them.
Yuan Yao angrily reprimanded them, causing them to leave unwillingly.
But soon enough.
People of higher status blocked the way.
A middle-aged man in a magnificent robe, with a face full of authority.
"Uncle."
Yuan Yao called out.
"I’ve already heard about your matters."
The middle-aged man slightly furrowed his brow, glancing at Yuan Yao, then turned his gaze to Ding Ling, Zhao Yun, and Diao Chan:

Zhao Yun also looked forward to the day he could be like that.
"Let’s go."
Ding Ling glanced around.
This was his blessed land!
After devouring the millennium treasure medicine, he had a feeling.
Dong Huang’s great medicine surely wasn’t at the millennium level, most likely seven hundred years.
Knowing that his current strength was increasing, the medicinal power’s effect became weaker and weaker.
Three plants of 700-year-old great medicine could still give a defense of +1.4 and constitution of +0.6.
Very precious indeed.
"Luoyang surely has millennium great medicine, and it seems Dong Zhuo himself enjoyed these great medicines.
This means Dong Zhuo’s martial power must be incredibly terrifying?!"
Ding Ling pondered:
"The Flying Bear Breathing Technique, Double Extremes Arrow, Double Extremes Saber Technique are all extraordinary.
Even if Dong Zhuo hasn’t cultivated them to mastery, by soaking in the bath of these supreme medicines every day, it certainly would lead to very rapid improvement!"
Clearly, Dong Zhuo won’t be easy to deal with.
But that’s none of his business.
His goal was simply to become the War God.
Pat pat pat!
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun descended the stairs.
Yuan Yao saw Ding Ling’s aura becoming increasingly profound, feeling uncertain and suspicious.
But upon seeing the large sack on Zhao Yun’s back, suddenly realizing, several thoughts ran through his mind, and he said immediately:
"You two have already gotten what you wanted.
Can you let me go now?"
"Let’s talk after I save Du Qingcheng!"
Ding Ling gazed coldly at Yuan Yao:
"Lead the way!"
"Let me lead the way."
Diao Chan volunteered:
"I know where Qingcheng is."
She thanked Ding Ling once again.
Ding Ling waved his hand:
"Thank me after healing Du Qingcheng."
Diao Chan’s almond-shaped eyes, bright as water, glanced at Ding Ling, said no more, and took the lead.
Reaching the first floor.
Diao Chan went to open the door.
Ding Ling, Zhao Yun, and others mounted the horses.
Once the door was open.
The burly gatekeepers were startled to see an extra person coming from the armory, instinctively about to question, but seeing Yuan Yao, they swallowed their questions.
Both quietly prayed they wouldn’t be blamed by the Patriarch.
Otherwise, if the armory was indeed short of too many items, not even ten lives would suffice to pay back.
Tap tap tap!

Diao Chan didn’t know what Breathing Technique or martial arts she practiced; her body moved like swaying willow branches, drifting lightly forward over ten meters, her speed exceptionally fast, like a wisp of cloud mist that could vanish beneath people’s eyelids at any moment.
Seeing this.
Ding Ling was enlightened.
Especially seeing Diao Chan leap three or four meters high, he was more certain of his thought.
She must have taken a ’Thief’ kind of shortcut into the Armory.
"The famous Diao Chan, surprisingly a martial arts expert!
If other players knew, they’d be astonished!"
Ding Ling thought to himself:
"The famous figures in the Three Kingdoms World seem to have many hidden ultimate skills!
Zhuge Liang, known throughout the Three Kingdoms, shines like the brightest star.
His skills and martial arts must be even more outstanding!
But Zhuge Liang is probably still a child now!
I wonder if there’s a chance to meet him?"
Tap tap tap!
Galloping all the way.
Diao Chan’s speed was almost unmatched by the swift horses, which showed she had some confidence to enter the Yuan Mansion alone!
Though alone, she could roam freely.
With someone else, especially someone severely injured, the speed would slow down to an unbearable crawl.
Diao Chan must have thought about healing Du Qingcheng first, then escaping the Yuan Family together, which seemed comprehendible.
If she didn’t heal him, with Diao Chan carrying Du Qingcheng, both of them probably couldn’t make it out.
Once healed.
Du Qingcheng, with a grounding in martial arts, might manage an escape if careful.
Ding Ling understood Diao Chan’s thought process.
But he didn’t say much.
After a few turns.
They reached deep into the Yuan Family inner courtyard.
Ding Ling saw many Yuan Family members.
They were of all ages, men, and women alike.
All without exception, exuding elegance, dressed in lavish clothing.
Seeing Ding Ling’s group daring to ride through the inner courtyard on horseback, someone stepped forward, shouting to stop them.
Yuan Yao angrily reprimanded them, causing them to leave unwillingly.
But soon enough.
People of higher status blocked the way.
A middle-aged man in a magnificent robe, with a face full of authority.
"Uncle."
Yuan Yao called out.
"I’ve already heard about your matters."
The middle-aged man slightly furrowed his brow, glancing at Yuan Yao, then turned his gaze to Ding Ling, Zhao Yun, and Diao Chan:

chapters.title: Chapter 143: The Incomprehensible Yuan Yin
paragraphs: "You all really have some nerve. Do you know where you are?"
The middle-aged man’s demeanor was extraordinary, fully displaying the aura of someone in power, his eyes exceedingly sharp and intimidating:

"My Yuan Family’s students and old retainers are spread across the world! You’ve offended my family, and in this world, you will certainly face insurmountable obstacles! You should consider the consequences, think twice, and stop provoking us!"
He pointed outward:
"Leave here now, and I can overlook everything. Otherwise, you’ll be responsible for the consequences."
He seemed to fear that Ding Ling wouldn’t believe him:
"Everyone knows the reputation of me, Yuan Yin. No one dares defy my words. If you heed my advice now, you can avoid death. After that, it’ll be hard to say."
Yuan Yin, a figure from the late Eastern Han Dynasty, is said to be the son of Yuan Kui, a cousin of Yuan Shu.
In the "Romance of the Three Kingdoms," he is the nephew of Yuan Shu.
But looking at the current situation, Yuan Yin should be Yuan Shu’s cousin.
Thinking further, this world only references the "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" for inspiration.
Ding Ling was relieved.
It goes without saying that this world is certainly not a direct reproduction of the world view and character settings of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms."
But it’s merely somewhat similar to the world of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms."
"Are you still not leaving?"
Yuan Yin shouted sternly:
"Do you really want to become mortal enemies with my Yuan Family?"
Diao Chan’s heart tightened, and the Fish Guts Sword in her sleeve was already gripped in her hand.
If Ding Ling proves unreliable, she could only fight her way in, risking her life to take Du Qingcheng away!
She could never give up on Du Qingcheng!
She knew very clearly.
If Ding Ling truly backed down. Yuan Yao, knowing all this, would definitely torture Du Qingcheng to death!
That is something she cannot accept!
"Alas."
Ding Ling came to his senses and sighed, shooting a curious glance at Yuan Yin.
This man’s demeanor was highly remarkable.
How could he be so foolish?!
Even he, Ding Ling, dared to kidnap Yuan Yao and had thoroughly offended the Yuan Family, was there any room for reconciliation?
Moreover, how could Yuan Yin compare with Yuan Shu?
Was he so used to being high and mighty and giving orders that he thought his generosity would surely earn him others’ gratitude and admiration?
Specifically how.
Ding Ling couldn’t be certain, and he was too lazy to deal with Yuan Yin, so he directly drew the Giant Que Sword, gently nudging the stomach of the Ferghana Horse.
Neigh!
The Ferghana Horse was extremely intelligent, and with one sprint, it was already beside Yuan Yao.

Ding Ling wielded the Giant Que Sword, delivering a few casual slashes, as if the Human Emperor were hacking at corrupt officials, and a magnificent sword light flashed in the mortal realm, faintly revealing the Human Emperor Pattern in the void. With a booming sound, the Giant Que Sword struck several nearby officers, instantly slicing them out of sight. In the shock and astonishment of Yuan Yin, Ding Ling’s sword tip was already at his throat.
Ding Ling looked down on him, smiling slightly:
"Yuan Yin, is it? We would be obliged if you could come with us."
"You, you, how dare you?"
Yuan Yin trembled, staring in disbelief:
"I’m a direct descendant of the Four Generations of the Three Ministers! Don’t you value your life?"
"So much nonsense."
Ding Ling tapped the sword’s dull edge on Yuan Yin’s face, making a crisp slapping sound:
"Of all the so-called big shots I’ve met along the way, you’re the stupidest! If you keep chattering, I might just kill you, do you believe that?"
Instantly, Yuan Yin felt baffled, like a scholar encountering a soldier with his logic failing him, stammering ’I, I’ without being able to articulate a thing.
In contrast, being glared at by Ding Ling almost made him stumble backward in fright.
He regretted it repeatedly.
He realized that he had underestimated the situation and overestimated his influence.

Usually, people around him fawned over him due to the immense influence of the Yuan Family, resulting in a very comfortable lifestyle for Yuan Yin, akin to those ignorant of the masses’ struggles and sufferings.
He couldn’t truly understand the struggles and miseries of the lower classes, and he naturally couldn’t empathize.
He even believed that his favors would earn others’ loyalty. After all, this tactic had never failed him before.
And now, saying he could overlook past grievances, he thought he was being exceptionally magnanimous.
In the past, if there were bandits like this.
They certainly wouldn’t dare kidnap a member of the Yuan Family, risking thoroughly offending them!
But now he seemed to have encountered a rude and foolish ’bandit’!
Yuan Yin followed alongside Yuan Yao, trembling, often glancing at Ding Ling with apparent bewilderment and disdain in his eyes.
He scorned Ding Ling for his foolishness.
Ding Ling also found Yuan Yin’s actions utterly ridiculous! Truly a real fool!
This was practically giving them a free hand!
Where could you find such ’kind-hearted’ people?!
He refrained from killing Yuan Yin for now, merely having him and Yuan Yao follow Diao Chan to lead the way.
Zhao Yun observed the two from the side.
Ding Ling, holding the Giant Que Sword, followed closely behind.
Diao Chan cast a glance brimming with emotion at Ding Ling, loosening her grip on the Fish Guts Sword, further elevating her trust in Ding Ling.
In circumstances like this, where he unhesitatingly chose to side with her, Ding Ling proved himself trustworthy!
With Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao breaking the trail.
There was no one left daring enough to obstruct them.
The way Yuan Yao looked at Yuan Yin was quite peculiar, making it hard to discern if he was mocking his uncle’s foolishness.
At first, Yuan Yin didn’t realize it, but as he came to understand, he couldn’t help feeling humiliated and furious.
Praised as exceedingly smart, yet today he found himself here, due to ’arrogance’ and ’pride,’ being ’robbed’ by some crude and foolish buffoons—truly a blunder!
"Here it is."
Diao Chan pointed to a courtyard ahead.
This courtyard was located in the deepest, most secluded part of the Yuan Mansion.
They walked in and glanced around.
Wild grass abounded, cockroaches scurried everywhere, and occasionally a few mice dashed across squeaking.
Looming not far from the courtyard was a latrine.
Ding Ling understood.
This must have previously been the servants’ quarters, now abandoned and left unmaintained, rendering it so desolate.
The courtyard was arranged in the style of a traditional Chinese quadrangle.
Diao Chan walked in front of one of the rooms on the left, pulling a key from her sleeve. With a series of creaks, she unlocked the door, discarded the lock, and pushed the door open.
A musty, rotten smell assaulted their noses.
Ding Ling focused his gaze inside.
The room was simply furnished, with only a table and a bed.
A pair of bowls and chopsticks lay on the table.
On the bed lay a person.
Upon closer inspection.
The person’s face was deathly pale, her breathing weak, eyes tightly shut, her chest rarely rising and falling, resembling a sleeping beauty near death.
"Is she Du Qingcheng?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
Although this person was very beautiful, with an oval face, well-proportioned features, and a unique charm about her, she was a quintessential Eastern classical beauty.
But she wasn’t as extraordinarily beautiful as Diao Chan had described.
"That’s right."
Diao Chan nodded, her eyes misty with unshed tears:
"She is my sister, my only kin."
As if understanding Ding Ling’s thoughts, she explained:
"She is now in a near-death state, with her powers restrained, so you feel she is beautiful, but not breathtakingly so."
