chapters.title: Chapter 144: Du Qingcheng Truly is Peerless (49/50)
paragraphs: "But if you wait until she recovers, you will understand."
Diao Chan had no reason to deceive Ding Ling.
Ding Ling no longer ponders over the matter.
Du Qingcheng, even in her weakened state, still possesses an extraordinary beauty, hinting at her peak appearance.
Among the women Ding Ling has encountered.
Du Qingcheng’s beauty truly stands unrivaled at the time!
But Diao Chan’s previous words were too excellent and absolute, causing some disappointment for Ding Ling.
However, compared to average beauties, Du Qingcheng exceeds them by a great margin.
Ding Ling is proficient in the Medical Dao.
The Qingnang Scripture has already become intuitive.
By taking Du Qingcheng’s pulse and observing her skin, eyes, mouth, and nose, Ding Ling realized she was poisoned by a mixed toxin.
This toxin contains the poison of various toxic herbs.
An ordinary person consuming a little would surely die.
Du Qingcheng managed to endure until now.
Showing her physical strength is exceedingly high.
Ding Ling immediately began to compose a prescription, instructing Zhao Yun to pressure Yuan Yin to fetch top-grade herbs from the Yuan Family pharmacy.
As for the herb Diao Chan previously obtained from the Armory, it turns out to be an 800-year-old reishi.
Ding Ling said, "The weak cannot tolerate supplements. Besides, this reishi can’t remove the mixed toxin. Giving it to her would be useless."
Diao Chan blushed.
Upon seeing Ding Ling’s professionalism, Diao Chan trusted him more.
Furthermore, after Ding Ling required her cooperation in acupuncture to detoxify Du Qingcheng.
The level of trust considerably increased.
Because Du Qingcheng’s complexion became noticeably rosier.
Diao Chan was overjoyed, repeatedly expressing gratitude.
Ding Ling said:
"We’ll discuss more once she’s cured."
Though Ding Ling’s medical experience was lacking.
In the process of treating Du Qingcheng, he continued to gain experience.
Using the unique techniques and therapies recorded in the Qingnang Scripture and Inner Scripture, combined with the Breathing Technique, he used force to give Du Qingcheng a massage.
Phew!
Du Qingcheng suddenly sat up, spitting out a mouthful of blackened poisonous blood.
Ding Ling didn’t stop.
Employing various techniques and therapies simultaneously.
Diao Chan felt rather uncomfortable watching from the side, for after Ding Ling’s treatment, Du Qingcheng might marry none other than Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling was indeed treating Du Qingcheng; despite her discomfort, she could not interfere.
In comparison to innocence.
Life is surely more important.
Moreover.
Ding Ling was wholly focused, without any ulterior motives.
This wasn’t the time for Diao Chan to interrupt or defame Ding Ling.
Thinking thus.
Diao Chan was comforted, merely assisting Ding Ling occasionally and performing auxiliary tasks.
When Zhao Yun and Yuan Yin returned with various herbs.
Ding Ling directed Diao Chan to brew and decoct the medicines.
Yuan Yao’s delicate fingers had never touched a spring water; he couldn’t assist beyond watching, feeling quite astonished, wondering:
"Ding Ling wasn’t just boasting! This exceptional military general is also a healer!! Unbelievable!"
He couldn’t comprehend how a person could simultaneously cultivate Martial Dao and Medical Dao to such profound levels!
Just as Yuan Yin couldn’t understand Ding Ling’s disregard for the Yuan Family’s intimidation!
"It’s ready."
Ding Ling had Diao Chan administer the medicine to Du Qingcheng once more.
Diao Chan followed instructions throughout.
Exhausted and somewhat breathless after half an hour of intense focus.
Yet she grew increasingly excited and joyful.
Because Du Qingcheng’s complexion became more radiant after taking the medicine.
Her breathing began to stabilize.
"After taking two more doses, Du Qingcheng should recover completely."
Ding Ling contemplated:
"Let’s stay here, depart once Du Qingcheng recovers tomorrow."
"What?!"
Zhao Yun’s expression changed slightly:
"If this drags on, won’t we be completely surrounded and trapped?"
"Aren’t we already surrounded now?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly, remaining calm:

"We’ve openly kidnapped two direct descendants of the Yuan Family, Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin. How could the Yuan Family remain indifferent? They’ll surely dispatch heavy troops to besiege us from all sides. Whether we leave sooner or later, we would face blockade. So why not wait for Du Qingcheng to recover before leaving?"
Zhao Yun fell silent, saying no more.
Diao Chan was immensely grateful, bowing deeply:
"Thank you, sir. Ren Hongchang has nothing to repay you with but will faithfully keep her promise and follow you!"
"Hmm."
Ding Ling had witnessed Diao Chan’s martial arts skills, nodding in agreement after hearing her words.
Observing Diao Chan’s adept medicine brewing, he thought she must excel in tasks like washing clothes and cooking.
Furthermore, her nimble movements and swift actions were more than enough for a scout.
Moreover, she’s the top beauty in the Three Kingdoms World! Ding Ling appreciated her presence daily as well.
Able to fight, handle chores, both beautiful and elegant.
What reason does Ding Ling have to refuse?
Seeing this, Diao Chan exhaled deeply, feeling somewhat lost yet hopeful for the future.
Several hours later.
Du Qingcheng awakened.
The moment her eyes opened, the world seemed much brighter!
Her eyes seemed to speak, adorning her charming face like two suns on the blue sky!
A world-shaking allure and beauty unfurled and scattered.
Zhao Yun was stunned.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin’s breaths became rapid.
Ding Ling was also momentarily frozen, for the first time believing Diao Chan’s words!
Du Qingcheng was indeed captivatingly beautiful and enchanting!
Clearly, dignified and graceful like a lady from a noble family, she exuded a classic charm, beautiful like a fairy in a landscape painting.
Yet she possessed an innate beauty akin to a celestial fox, naturally formed, with enchanting elegance permeating her every move, captivating hearts, mesmerizing minds unconsciously.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun quickly regained composure, exchanging glances, clearly seeing admiration in each other’s eyes.
A beauty like her.
No wonder Yuan Shu couldn’t let go, even lavishly rewarding players.
As for why Du Qingcheng ended up in such a predicament?
No need to say.
Surely it’s women from the ’palace’ in a ’magical battle’!
If a woman like Du Qingcheng rose to power, how could the status of other women in the palace not plummet?
"Qingcheng!"
Diao Chan joyously embraced Du Qingcheng.
"Hongchang."
Du Qingcheng hesitated for a moment, then quickly reciprocated, hugging Diao Chan tightly.
The two exchanged heartfelt and caring words.
Afterward, Diao Chan quietly told Du Qingcheng about the whole situation.
Du Qingcheng listened, her face gradually turning red.
Her beautiful eyes filled with shy embarrassment.
She furtively glanced at Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling standing tall with an imposing air, exuding both nobility and overbearing aura, she felt a certain fondness.
No matter the time period or world.
Judging by appearance is common sense!
Pang Tong the Phoenix Chick was shunned by Sun Quan and Liu Bei because of his looks! Clearly evident.

Through cultivating the Breathing Technique, Inner Scripture, and Qingnang Scripture, Ding Ling’s charm increased, surpassing common folk in appearance and demeanor, naturally enhancing his attractiveness.
"Follow me to express gratitude to the master."
Diao Chan helped Du Qingcheng up.
Together, they gracefully bowed to Ding Ling.
Du Qingcheng’s face, blushing to the point of seeming to drip water.

Yuan Yao’s delicate fingers had never touched a spring water; he couldn’t assist beyond watching, feeling quite astonished, wondering:
"Ding Ling wasn’t just boasting!
This exceptional military general is also a healer!!
Unbelievable!"
He couldn’t comprehend how a person could simultaneously cultivate Martial Dao and Medical Dao to such profound levels!
Just as Yuan Yin couldn’t understand Ding Ling’s disregard for the Yuan Family’s intimidation!
"It’s ready."
Ding Ling had Diao Chan administer the medicine to Du Qingcheng once more.
Diao Chan followed instructions throughout.
Exhausted and somewhat breathless after half an hour of intense focus.
Yet she grew increasingly excited and joyful.
Because Du Qingcheng’s complexion became more radiant after taking the medicine.
Her breathing began to stabilize.
"After taking two more doses, Du Qingcheng should recover completely."
Ding Ling contemplated:
"Let’s stay here, depart once Du Qingcheng recovers tomorrow."
"What?!"
Zhao Yun’s expression changed slightly:
"If this drags on, won’t we be completely surrounded and trapped?"
"Aren’t we already surrounded now?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly, remaining calm:
"We’ve openly kidnapped two direct descendants of the Yuan Family, Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin.
How could the Yuan Family remain indifferent?
They’ll surely dispatch heavy troops to besiege us from all sides.
Whether we leave sooner or later, we would face blockade.
So why not wait for Du Qingcheng to recover before leaving?"
Zhao Yun fell silent, saying no more.
Diao Chan was immensely grateful, bowing deeply:
"Thank you, sir.
Ren Hongchang has nothing to repay you with but will faithfully keep her promise and follow you!"
"Hmm."
Ding Ling had witnessed Diao Chan’s martial arts skills, nodding in agreement after hearing her words.
Observing Diao Chan’s adept medicine brewing, he thought she must excel in tasks like washing clothes and cooking.
Furthermore, her nimble movements and swift actions were more than enough for a scout.
Moreover, she’s the top beauty in the Three Kingdoms World!
Ding Ling appreciated her presence daily as well.
Able to fight, handle chores, both beautiful and elegant.
What reason does Ding Ling have to refuse?
Seeing this, Diao Chan exhaled deeply, feeling somewhat lost yet hopeful for the future.
Several hours later.
Du Qingcheng awakened.
The moment her eyes opened, the world seemed much brighter!
Her eyes seemed to speak, adorning her charming face like two suns on the blue sky!
A world-shaking allure and beauty unfurled and scattered.
Zhao Yun was stunned.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin’s breaths became rapid.
Ding Ling was also momentarily frozen, for the first time believing Diao Chan’s words!
Du Qingcheng was indeed captivatingly beautiful and enchanting!
Clearly, dignified and graceful like a lady from a noble family, she exuded a classic charm, beautiful like a fairy in a landscape painting.
Yet she possessed an innate beauty akin to a celestial fox, naturally formed, with enchanting elegance permeating her every move, captivating hearts, mesmerizing minds unconsciously.
Ding Ling and Zhao Yun quickly regained composure, exchanging glances, clearly seeing admiration in each other’s eyes.
A beauty like her.
No wonder Yuan Shu couldn’t let go, even lavishly rewarding players.
As for why Du Qingcheng ended up in such a predicament?
No need to say.
Surely it’s women from the ’palace’ in a ’magical battle’!
If a woman like Du Qingcheng rose to power, how could the status of other women in the palace not plummet?
"Qingcheng!"
Diao Chan joyously embraced Du Qingcheng.
"Hongchang."
Du Qingcheng hesitated for a moment, then quickly reciprocated, hugging Diao Chan tightly.
The two exchanged heartfelt and caring words.
Afterward, Diao Chan quietly told Du Qingcheng about the whole situation.
Du Qingcheng listened, her face gradually turning red.
Her beautiful eyes filled with shy embarrassment.
She furtively glanced at Ding Ling.
Seeing Ding Ling standing tall with an imposing air, exuding both nobility and overbearing aura, she felt a certain fondness.
No matter the time period or world.
Judging by appearance is common sense!
Pang Tong the Phoenix Chick was shunned by Sun Quan and Liu Bei because of his looks!
Clearly evident.

Through cultivating the Breathing Technique, Inner Scripture, and Qingnang Scripture, Ding Ling’s charm increased, surpassing common folk in appearance and demeanor, naturally enhancing his attractiveness.
"Follow me to express gratitude to the master."
Diao Chan helped Du Qingcheng up.
Together, they gracefully bowed to Ding Ling.
Du Qingcheng’s face, blushing to the point of seeming to drip water.

chapters.title: Chapter 145 145: Diao Chan Injured (50/50)
paragraphs: Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin were watching from the side, swallowing hard.
Extremely jealous and envious of Ding Ling.
They also wanted to be thanked by such a beauty!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You have won Du Qingcheng (Du Xiuniang)'s profound gratitude.]
[Note: Du Qingcheng was on the brink of death, readying herself for hell. You pulled her back from the hands of Death God in time!
And even used massage techniques on her.
At this moment, she is incredibly shy.
You just need to make a bit of effort.
She will surely fall for you.
After all, people in this world value purity and chastity extremely highly.]
Ding Ling was taken aback upon hearing the prompt.
He hadn't thought of this during the treatment, but now seeing Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng's strange looks, he suddenly understood.
He sighed softly.
He sometimes indeed tends to be a bit slow in this regard.
But since things have turned out this way.
Ding Ling decided to just go with the flow.
Du Qingcheng is so breathtakingly beautiful.
To be honest, any man would be moved upon seeing her.
Ding Ling considered himself not a lecher.
Yet upon seeing such a beauty, he couldn't help but lament that Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan, such pretty girls, paled in comparison to Du Qingcheng, appearing only as handmaids.
He is a normal man, how could he not be tempted?
But he definitely remembered his goal: to conquer this game world! To be able to stand firm against a nuclear bomb in the real world!
Otherwise, he wouldn't feel secure!
His heaven-defying cheats are unpredictable, who knows if someone might show up with cannons to kill him!
Would he be able to block it then?
So in the face of life and death crisis, all romantic entanglements, in Ding Ling's view, are worthless.
Once he truly improves to the point where he can face everything calmly, then perhaps he would consider marriage and other such matters.
But at that time, will his mindset be the same as it is now?
That's hard to say.
"Ahem."
Diao Chan suddenly started coughing.
Ding Ling snapped back to reality and looked towards the sound.
Seeing Diao Chan coughing up specks of blood onto her veil with each cough.
"Hongchang, Hongchang, what's wrong with you?"
Du Qingcheng was shocked.
"I'm fine."
Diao Chan quickly replied:
"Maybe my lungs were injured during the exchange with the lord."
She smiled bitterly:
"The lord's Giant Que Sword is immensely powerful; even a casual strike carries the force of a thousand pounds. I couldn't withstand it!"
"Let me take a look."
Ding Ling walked over.
Diao Chan was taken aback, but under Du Qingcheng's urging, she obediently extended her delicate hand to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling began to check her pulse.
He had already realized the sensitivity of this world's women towards pulse-checking, massage, and the like.
So with the activation of his acting skills, he became extremely serious and solemn.
Heaven knows how excited he was inside.
Only because as Diao Chan kept coughing, her veil had fallen from one side, revealing a face that seemed not of this mortal world!
Upon seeing her face.
Ding Ling felt as if his brain was struck heavily with a sledgehammer, buzzing!
His mind went blank!
As if knowing nothing.
If Du Qingcheng's beauty resembled a Fox Immortal descending to the Mortal World.
Then Diao Chan's beauty, gentle and charming, was like a clear spring flowing into one's heart, leaving an everlasting impression!
Her beauty, gentleness, and charm carried a few traces of heroic spirit within divinity!
As if a Goddess riding a phoenix across the mortal realm!
Possessing an indescribable majestic and noble aura.
Ding Ling was affected this way.
Yuan Yao and the others were even more stunned, with their jaws seemingly about to hit the floor.
Such a beauty was unheard of, let alone seen.
Having thought Du Qingcheng had already portrayed ultimate beauty perfectly, Diao Chan was even more astonishing, showing there are always greater heights to reach!
"Hmm!"
Seeing the look of the crowd, Diao Chan hurriedly pulled her hand back from Ding Ling and turned her back, putting her veil back on.
As she turned away.
It felt like the sun being covered by darkness, dimming the whole world.
Ding Ling and the others snapped back to their senses.
Each with differing moods.
Ding Ling felt secretly ashamed. In the real world, he had already seen countless female celebrities and streamers.
Yet now was bewitched by Diao Chan.
But at this moment, Ding Ling truly realized what was meant by the most beautiful woman of the Three Kingdoms!
Many beauties existed in the Three Kingdoms, Da and Xiao Qiao, Du Qingcheng, Cai Wenji, and others; Diao Chan could overwhelmingly be crowned number one, her beauty evident!
"My Kung Fu hasn't been fully practiced yet."
Diao Chan turned back around and said bashfully:
"Therefore, I cannot restrain my natural charms. Once I ascend to the Transformation Realm, I can naturally become an ordinary girl."
"Then you previously performed as Diao Chan in the Palace..."
Ding Ling was puzzled.

"At that time, my skills hadn't reached such a high level, so I wasn't particularly conspicuous. Later, as my body and face matured and my skills improved, my master took me away from the Imperial Palace. I no longer played Diao Chan.
Diao Chan explained.
Ding Ling was enlightened.
He found it curious.
Such a beauty, no man would possibly pass her up!
In Luoyang, so many nobles and officials, how could they possibly overlook Diao Chan?
Now it seems, there was this hidden secret involved.
"Come. Let's continue checking the pulse."
Ding Ling activated his acting skills, speaking solemnly:
"Your organs have been injured; if not treated in time, it's troublesome to lag behind!"
Diao Chan was taken aback.
Du Qingcheng secretly nudged her.
Diao Chan blushingly extended her hand to Ding Ling once more.
Yuan Yin, Yuan Yao, and even Zhao Yun were all envious of such a peerless beauty...
However, Ding Ling's meticulous and serious demeanor managed to convince Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan that he must be an upright and righteous man!
Only Zhao Yun seemed thoughtful, instinctively sensing Ding Ling was acting.
Yuan Yao, Yuan Yin were sent outside.
Zhao Yun observed them.
After Ding Ling performed pulse-checking and massage on Diao Chan, he prescribed a few doses of medicine and had Yuan Yin and Zhao Yun go prepare the medicine.
Additionally, they were asked to bring a physician to brew and simmer herbal medicines.
Yuan Yin was speechless.
This was the Yuan Mansion!
He, a legitimate scion of the Yuan Family, was being treated like a servant, not just once! What nonsense!
He intended not to go.
Zhao Yun was not vague either, directly pointing his spear at Yuan Yin's throat:
"Going or not?"
Yuan Yin was aggrieved, looking speechlessly at the sky.
Grown this big, when had he suffered such grievances?!
Diao Chan's organs and meridians were injured.
The Giant Que Sword paired with the Human Emperor Swordsmanship carried immense power!
Under one strike, an ordinary Second-class Fierce General would be surely killed instantly!
It was only because Diao Chan's 'assault' at the time lacked murderous intent and wasn't aimed at Ding Ling's vital points; thus Ding Ling's counterattack wasn't so fierce.
Otherwise, Diao Chan would definitely have faced a fate of being 'scrapped.'
Impossible to survive till now without bleeding!
Diao Chan certainly bore no resentment towards Ding Ling, even apologizing multiple times for her previous 'assault.'

chapters.title: Chapter 146 146: Innocent Diao Chan (1/12)
paragraphs: Ding Ling was somewhat embarrassed by Diao Chan.
He was unscathed.
Yet, Diao Chan ended up in such a state, and she still managed to comfort him!
This woman was not only of breathtaking beauty, but she could also fight, do household chores, and be considerate...
Truly, how many men dream of someone like this?
Ding Ling sighed inwardly, suppressing his unusual thoughts, and began instructing the healers on how to brew the herbal medicine.
Diao Chan, comparable to a First-class Fierce General, was suitable for consuming some Great Medicine.
Ding Ling took a century-old Great Medicine, sliced a few pieces into the herbal concoction as a supplement.
He was proficient in the Qingnang Scripture and etc., and was naturally skilled at controlling the heat and the dosage of the medicine, executing it with ease and precision.
The healers present initially didn't take him seriously.
They looked down on Ding Ling.
Thinking he was an amateur instructing professionals.
But after really understanding his methods, they couldn't help but be amazed at Ding Ling as if he were a Celestial Being!
Since then, they dared not harbor any small thoughts and instead had the desire to learn from him.

However, Ding Ling's methods were unique, and his administration of medicine, acupuncture, and etc. were extremely precise and casual. The Vigorous Qi from his Breathing Technique occasionally penetrated the patients' skin or wounds, coordinating with the medicine to achieve rapid healing.
These healers were all third-rate individuals.
Although each of them understood the Breathing Technique, they couldn't compare to Ding Ling's technique, naturally unable to understand the true esoteric truths and essence.
Even if they only grasped a superficial understanding.
These healers felt their trip was more than worthwhile.
From then on, Ding Ling's orders and instructions were completely adhered to.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin felt extremely uncomfortable and disgusted watching from the side!
Even the family servants were at the beck and call of an outsider!
But seeing Ding Ling so effortlessly heal both Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng.
They were also deeply shocked.
Especially Yuan Yin, who even considered whether he should ask Ding Ling to look at his hidden ailments?
But thinking about the conflict between his family and Ding Ling, he couldn't help but have a bitter taste in his mouth, feeling very unlucky!
Time flowed like water.
Under Ding Ling's treatment.
Diao Chan was the first to recover.
Although she suffered serious injuries, due to timely treatment and her high physical fitness, along with the Great Medicine and good herbs, she naturally recovered quickly.
If it were delayed and a good healer couldn't be found, it would have been hard to say.
A protracted condition could potentially lead to chronic diseases, tuberculosis, and so on.
She was well aware of this, and was naturally deeply grateful to Ding Ling.
[Achievement Medal earned: You have earned Diao Chan's (Ren Hongchang's) deep gratitude.]
[Note: You have already had physical contact with Diao Chan.
This is the first time she has been touched by a man in this way. She has already developed unusual thoughts about you.
Although she has had a rough life, experiencing unrest.
In terms of emotions, she is a blank slate. Your arrival has painted it with colors!
You were destined to have no fate in this life.
But through several coincidences.
You two have already become deeply entangled.
Diao Chan is also someone who values promises very much.
Needless to say, at the moment Du Qingcheng recovers completely.
That's when she decides to fully pursue you!]
Listening to the prompt.
Ding Ling was slightly stunned.
Previously, he had obtained an E-level Achievement Medal from Diao Chan.
Now he got another ordinary medal.
It seems that Diao Chan truly is a 'Super-Elite' expert.
It's not that her strength is super-elite, but her charisma is super-elite.
After seeing Diao Chan's face, Ding Ling was very certain about this!
However, in terms of Diao Chan's feelings...
It was merely taking a pulse, a normal medical massage technique.
Isn't this a bit exaggerated?!
Ding Ling was surprised and clicked his tongue.
In the real world, girls might break up even after living together.
No.
They might even get divorced after getting married!
Unlike Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng.
It's just normal treatment!!
At this moment, Ding Ling deeply understood why 'from then on, the king did not attend court in the morning.' Facing such pure, deep-hearted women, which man could resist?!
"Have you never been treated by healers before?"
Ding Ling couldn't help but ask.
"I have."
Diao Chan was stunned, as if recalling something, her beautiful eyes glistening like water as she glanced at Ding Ling, replying crisply:
"It was always my master treating us. She's a woman!"
"Where is your master then?"
Ding Ling decisively changed the topic.
Continuing the conversation would become awkward.
"She passed away."
Diao Chan looked saddened:
"She left when her time came. After she was gone, I only had Qingcheng to rely on."
"But I remember that Du Qingcheng was tricked by Qin Yilu to come here, right?"
Ding Ling looked at Du Qingcheng:
"Could it be that Qin Yilu is your..."
"He's just my friend."
Du Qingcheng, as if afraid Ding Ling might misunderstand, hurriedly explained with a blushing face:

"We have nothing going on. He told me there was a rare Great Medicine in the Nanyang realm that could help Hongchang improve her Martial Arts Cultivation. He asked me to accompany him to get it. Since he often interacted with me and seemed quite reliable, I trusted him.
Little did I know.
He actually took me to a Demon Cave..."
As she spoke, her expression showed a hint of displeasure.
Ding Ling said that Qin Yilu was dead.
Du Qingcheng paused, sighed, and the resentment on her face quickly faded:
"The dead are already gone, let the past be in the past."
Ding Ling did not mention the players.
It would be of no use if he did.
Players are as sly as ghosts, hard to deal with. Unless he takes them out in reality!
But killing someone in real life would be suicidal, right?
How could Ding Ling possibly do something so foolish now?
So everything should aim upwards.
Another day passed.
By midday.
Du Qingcheng finally recovered.
The toxins were completely cleansed.
She appeared radiant, exuding the elegant temperament of a lady from a rich family, like a classic beauty walking out of a painting, carrying qualities such as dignity, grace, and exquisite beauty.
The terms "nation-toppling beauty", "fish sink and geese alight" fit her perfectly!
"Time to go."
Ding Ling, having eaten and drunk to his fill.
Had considerably improved his strength at the Yuan Mansion.
Certainly, at the Yuan Mansion, he had gorged himself on a lot of premium meat to supplement nutrition and relieve hunger!
To say.
The food at the Yuan Mansion was indeed much tastier than the random barbecues outside.
Of course.
Ding Ling's 'culinary skills' had long reached full level.
If he were to genuinely cook a meal, it would definitely be sumptuous and mouthwatering.
But Ding Ling's goal was to be a War God, not a Kitchen God!
As for eating, getting full was enough.
He wasn't asking for much.
Of course, if someone were indeed there to serve him, cooking good meals every day, he would gladly accept it.
"Whew."
Yuan Yin wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, was this killer finally leaving?
These past two days had tormented him greatly.
Not to mention losing face.
Being ordered around and threatened with life or death at even the slightest dissatisfaction!
Yuan Yin swore.
From now on, he would no longer reason with brutes!
And keep his distance upon seeing one!
"Let's go."
Ding Ling and his company mounted their horses.
Including Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng, who were equipped with fine Da Wan horses.
The fine horses were naturally selected meticulously from the Yuan Mansion.
Even in the Yuan family, such fine horses weren't abundant.
Ding Ling chose two for each of Diao Chan.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao were pained beyond measure.

Needless to say, at the moment Du Qingcheng recovers completely.
That's when she decides to fully pursue you!]
Listening to the prompt.
Ding Ling was slightly stunned.
Previously, he had obtained an E-level Achievement Medal from Diao Chan.
Now he got another ordinary medal.
It seems that Diao Chan truly is a 'Super-Elite' expert.
It's not that her strength is super-elite, but her charisma is super-elite.
After seeing Diao Chan's face, Ding Ling was very certain about this!
However, in terms of Diao Chan's feelings...
It was merely taking a pulse, a normal medical massage technique.
Isn't this a bit exaggerated?!
Ding Ling was surprised and clicked his tongue.
In the real world, girls might break up even after living together.
No.
They might even get divorced after getting married!
Unlike Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng.
It's just normal treatment!!
At this moment, Ding Ling deeply understood why 'from then on, the king did not attend court in the morning.' Facing such pure, deep-hearted women, which man could resist?!
"Have you never been treated by healers before?"
Ding Ling couldn't help but ask.
"I have."
Diao Chan was stunned, as if recalling something, her beautiful eyes glistening like water as she glanced at Ding Ling, replying crisply:
"It was always my master treating us.
She's a woman!"
"Where is your master then?"
Ding Ling decisively changed the topic.
Continuing the conversation would become awkward.
"She passed away."
Diao Chan looked saddened:
"She left when her time came.
After she was gone, I only had Qingcheng to rely on."
"But I remember that Du Qingcheng was tricked by Qin Yilu to come here, right?"
Ding Ling looked at Du Qingcheng:
"Could it be that Qin Yilu is your..."
"He's just my friend."
Du Qingcheng, as if afraid Ding Ling might misunderstand, hurriedly explained with a blushing face:
"We have nothing going on.
He told me there was a rare Great Medicine in the Nanyang realm that could help Hongchang improve her Martial Arts Cultivation.
He asked me to accompany him to get it.
Since he often interacted with me and seemed quite reliable, I trusted him.
Little did I know.
He actually took me to a Demon Cave..."
As she spoke, her expression showed a hint of displeasure.
Ding Ling said that Qin Yilu was dead.
Du Qingcheng paused, sighed, and the resentment on her face quickly faded:
"The dead are already gone, let the past be in the past."
Ding Ling did not mention the players.
It would be of no use if he did.
Players are as sly as ghosts, hard to deal with.
Unless he takes them out in reality!
But killing someone in real life would be suicidal, right?
How could Ding Ling possibly do something so foolish now?
So everything should aim upwards.
Another day passed.
By midday.
Du Qingcheng finally recovered.
The toxins were completely cleansed.
She appeared radiant, exuding the elegant temperament of a lady from a rich family, like a classic beauty walking out of a painting, carrying qualities such as dignity, grace, and exquisite beauty.
The terms "nation-toppling beauty", "fish sink and geese alight" fit her perfectly!
"Time to go."
Ding Ling, having eaten and drunk to his fill.
Had considerably improved his strength at the Yuan Mansion.
Certainly, at the Yuan Mansion, he had gorged himself on a lot of premium meat to supplement nutrition and relieve hunger!
To say.
The food at the Yuan Mansion was indeed much tastier than the random barbecues outside.
Of course.
Ding Ling's 'culinary skills' had long reached full level.
If he were to genuinely cook a meal, it would definitely be sumptuous and mouthwatering.
But Ding Ling's goal was to be a War God, not a Kitchen God!
As for eating, getting full was enough.
He wasn't asking for much.
Of course, if someone were indeed there to serve him, cooking good meals every day, he would gladly accept it.
"Whew."
Yuan Yin wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, was this killer finally leaving?
These past two days had tormented him greatly.
Not to mention losing face.
Being ordered around and threatened with life or death at even the slightest dissatisfaction!
Yuan Yin swore.
From now on, he would no longer reason with brutes!
And keep his distance upon seeing one!
"Let's go."
Ding Ling and his company mounted their horses.
Including Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng, who were equipped with fine Da Wan horses.
The fine horses were naturally selected meticulously from the Yuan Mansion.
Even in the Yuan family, such fine horses weren't abundant.
Ding Ling chose two for each of Diao Chan.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao were pained beyond measure.

chapters.title: Chapter 147 147: Defense Reaches Its Limit! Sunx Ce Is Moved (2/12)
paragraphs: Other than that.
Ding Ling also went to the armory to prepare leather armor, solid armor, and divine weapons for Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng.
At this moment, Diao Chan is clad in fiery red armor, riding a chestnut warhorse, holding a long spear, sitting proudly on horseback, exuding the aura of a heroic female warrior.
Du Qingcheng wears black armor on a black horse, different from Diao Chan, charming yet valiant, possessing an extraordinary flair.
One in red and one in black, they are like Flower Fairies descending to the Mortal World, extremely captivating and eye-catching!
"Let's go."
Ding Ling commanded crisply.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin galloped ahead on horseback.
Ding Ling followed closely behind, with Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng behind him.
Zhao Yun guarded the rear.
Ding Ling, Diao Chan, Du Qingcheng, and Zhao Yun formed an elliptical formation.
Ding Ling, as the spearhead, led the charge.
Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng were on Ding Ling's left and right, very close to each other.
Zhao Yun took up the rear.
The formation they formed could support each other at any moment.
Ding Ling carried the Giant Que Sword on his back.
The Giant Que Sword was thick and wide, lying slanting on Ding Ling's back like an extended sword-shaped shield.
This allowed him to draw it for battle at any moment.
He held the Heaven-piercing Halberd, staring sharply at Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin.
Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin felt as if they had thorns on their backs, not daring to act rashly.
They obediently urged their horses forward, constantly shouting for people to make way.
Clip-clop-clop!
The group smoothly left the inner courtyard and entered the outer courtyard.
Here, Ding Ling saw Sun Ce again.
Unlike before, this time he led a troop blocking on one side. Seeing Ding Ling's group approaching, he stepped forward with a spear, shouting loudly:
"By General Jii's order, I must stop you all for a moment. Excuse me."
He charged at Ding Ling on his horse.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, giving Sun Ce a deep look, then casually swung his halberd, boom!
Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques!
A series of exquisite moves, as if created by divine craftsmanship, were unleashed with the halberd's edge. In a moment, they collided more than ten times with Sun Ce's spear.
Each time, Sun Ce seemed struck by lightning.
Eventually, his body trembled, his face flushed red, and after another collision, pfft! He couldn't hold back anymore, his throat stirred, and he suddenly spat out a stream of blood.
He looked at Ding Ling with a face full of surprise and uncertainty, then decisively retreated, shouting loudly:
"The enemy general is formidable, can't be stopped. Retreat quickly!"
His actions were somewhat exaggerated, with an element of acting.
But it was clear.
He was indeed frightened by Ding Ling's martial power.
Sun Ce naturally saw that Ding Ling didn't really exert much force, swinging the halberd as if casually, like a Celestial God splitting a mountain, magnificent like great waves striking the shore!
He couldn't block even a single strike.
If Ding Ling hadn't really exerted force, how could he have blocked more than ten strikes?
He felt grateful yet more and more depressed, astonished, and confused.
He naturally realized that Ding Ling's strength had skyrocketed.
How long had it been?
And Ding Ling's strength had already soared?!
In fact, not only had Ding Ling's strength soared.
Zhao Yun, Diao Chan, and Du Qingcheng's strength had also increased significantly.
After finding the Century-old Great Medicine useless, Ding Ling specifically followed ancient methods to start preparing various medicinal herbs needed for a medicinal bath.
Many of these herbs were rare but not categorized as Great Medicine.
But in the pharmacy at Yuan Mansion, everything was available.
These herbs were hard to buy even with money outside.
How could Ding Ling miss this opportunity?
He acted decisively.
While treating Diao Chan's injuries, he had Zhao Yun prepare for the medicinal bath.
Zhao Yun's medicinal bath was the most advanced, with many rare herbs along with numerous Century-old Great Medicines.
This made Zhao Yun's strength skyrocket in just a few days.
This was also related to his improvement in Breathing Technique and increased foundation, otherwise, even with a medicinal bath, such a rapid increase in strength would have been impossible.
Now Zhao Yun was getting closer and closer to entering the realm of Super-Elite.
After Diao Chan's injuries healed.
Ding Ling also prepared a medicinal bath for Diao Chan.
Having roamed everywhere for nearly a year, Diao Chan rarely had time for medicinal baths, and this time she soaked in a bath filled with various rare herbs and Century-old Great Medicines.
Her strength also improved significantly as a result.
Du Qingcheng, after a near-death experience, seemed to have comprehended some blockage. Under the influence of the medicinal bath, her strength also advanced rapidly.
It can be said.
Now in Ding Ling's team, there was not a single weak person.
The weakest, Du Qingcheng, though lacking in strength, had techniques and defense on par with a Second-class General.
Diao Chan was a bona fide First-class fierce warrior!
Additionally.
The eight-hundred-year-old Great Medicine of Diao Chan was gulped down by Ding Ling.
The result was:
Defense +0.6, Physique +0.4.
Strength changes:
[Defense: 30
Strength: 30.
Physique: 24.9]
Ding Ling's defense also reached its peak. Now, the toughness of his skin could match several layers of leather armor, beyond any doubt!
Not only that, but the hardness and toughness of his internal organs, meridians, and bones also reached their peak, far surpassing before.
Because of this strength transformation once again.
Ding Ling had the confidence to break out.
Both strength and defense had reached their limits.
His physique also enhanced significantly.
Now he could be said to be at the peak level among Super-Elite experts!
Just now he also noticed that Sun Ce was acting.
Otherwise, he would have already finished Sun Ce with a single halberd strike.
Tap-tap!
Doubtful soldiers led a team charging at Ding Ling, only to be easily hacked and pierced by Ding Ling like cutting vegetables and slicing melons, killing fifty or sixty people.
In a moment.
Before Ding Ling's horse lay a field of bodies!
The corpses piled up together.
Surrounding Ding Ling, forming a semicircle!
The smell of blood filled the air.
Everyone turned pale, trembling, and retreated.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao were so frightened they didn't dare move.
It was Yuan Yin's first realization of Ding Ling's fierceness and terror.
"So strong."
Sun Ce stood at a distance, coughing dryly from time to time, a bit of blood oozing from his mouth:
"This was with the other side holding back, if not, wouldn't I have been instantly killed by them?!"
He was unwilling, envious, and admiring:
"Rumor has it Flying General Lü Bu is reputed as World's Number One. What rank is Ding Ling in the world? What rank am I?!"
He felt dejected.
A sense of despair as if just starting, unable to see the mountain peak's scenery at all.
The gap was too vast!
[Achievement Medal obtained: Awe-inspiring at Yuan Family]

[Note: As a super family of four generations and Three Ministers, Yuan Family is extremely prominent. Yuan Shu's mansion is the key core of his lineage. You broke into Yuan Shu's mansion, unleashed a slaughter, and easily killed sixty members of the elite Imperial Guard of Jii Ling!
Intimidating all those observing from the shadows!]
Unexpectedly.
Your renown will soon spread throughout Yuan Mansion and rapidly throughout the Nanyang Ten Directions Realm!
Ding Ling ignored the sound of the prompt, just snorted softly, and charged into the team daring to block his way.
Crash-bang!
Clang!
Under the Heaven-piercing Halberd, no enemy was a match.
Touching meant death, a scrape meant injury!
Those who blocked were swept aside!
He was like a Divine General descending to the Mortal World;
More like a god of war in a fierce, thrusting charge!

chapters.title: Chapter 148 148: Human Wave Tactics Against Ding Ling (3/12)
paragraphs: Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng watched with wide eyes.
Only at this moment did they realize Ding Ling's terrifying and formidable power!
With no one to compare against, it was hardly noticeable.
But now, each of the elite soldiers and generals under Ding Ling's Heaven-piercing Halberd seemed like mere paper, easily pierced, killed, and sent flying!
It even gave Diao Chan and the others the illusion that they could do the same!
Because Ding Ling slaughtered them with such ease.
From start to finish, he didn't even make any defensive moves, sweeping with his halberd as if he were sweeping the ground, sending soldiers flying like trash.
An autumn wind that sweeps away fallen leaves, destroying anything in its path!
Nothing more than that!
Tap tap tap!
Ding Ling led the way, arriving at the closed gate of the Yuan Mansion.
Just as he was about to crash open the door with his halberd.
Whoosh whoosh!
Suddenly, hundreds of hidden arrows were shot from the shadows, aiming directly at Ding Ling's heart and head, among other vital spots.
Ding Ling's pupils shrank, quickly squeezing his horse's flank, and drew the Giant Que Sword with his left hand!
Sunset Swordsmanship!
Dawn Swordsmanship!
Utilizing the Sword God Skill with the heavy Giant Que Sword!
Displayed an extraordinary visual effect!
Sword shadows in the sky formed thick, wide sword flower patterns!
These patterns converged into shield formations, perfectly protecting Ding Ling's vital areas, even the Ferghana Horse's vulnerabilities.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Arrows shattered against the blade of the Giant Que Sword.
The sword remained unscathed.
Ding Ling swayed the Giant Que Sword, using the Sword God Skill to slay the hidden archers.
He saw that this unit, concealed beside the gate, numbered in the hundreds!
All that was remarkable about the archer unit was speed and surprise.
Now that aspect was lost.
Facing Ding Ling's thrusts, they couldn't even fire a second arrow before Ding Ling charged into the midst, wielding the Giant Que Sword in one hand and the Heaven-piercing Halberd in the other.
Human Emperor Swordsmanship!
Overlord Halberd Technique!
Human Emperor Swordsmanship, grand and powerful, like a galaxy falling from the heavens, unstoppable!
In the narrow space, Human Emperor Swordsmanship combined with the Giant Que Sword was perfect, each strike sweeping vast areas!
Overlord Halberd Technique was fierce and intense like a surging tidal wave, each move showcasing the overwhelming aura of the Human King's strike against the Azure Dragon!
Two weapons, two different Techniques, were simultaneously deployed by Ding Ling.
Wherever he aimed.
It broke through like bamboo!
Cutting through with ease.
Among the hundred archers, only a few managed to flee in disarray, discarding their gear, while the rest couldn't escape and were completely slaughtered.
The scene was utterly gruesome.
Severed limbs were scattered everywhere.
Thud thud!
The Ferghana Horse snorted, its iron hooves stepping in the blood, producing dull thudding sounds.
Ding Ling swiftly looked at Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao, who arrived at the entrance.
The two shivered, forcing a flattering smile towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling's ferocity and brutality were beyond their imagination! They were utterly terrified!
Thud thud!
Ding Ling rode to the gate and gestured for Yuan Yin to open it.
Yuan Yin dared not refuse, dismounted, and laboriously opened the door.
Only to see ranks of soldiers lined up, stretching seemingly endlessly, impossible to tell how many had arrived.
Every one of them held weapons.
The archers in the front row bent their bows and aimed directly at Yuan Yin.
Yuan Yin broke out in a cold sweat and yelled:
"Blind fools! Don't you know who I am?"
'Sir.'
A general stepped out from the crowd and saluted Yuan Yin:
"We have orders from the lord that Ding Ling and Zhao Yun must be killed without mercy. We have no choice."
"I don't care what Yuan Shu said; today you must retreat!"
Yuan Yin's face turned pale as he spoke sternly:
"Otherwise, who will guarantee my safety?"
"Sir, don't put us in a difficult position."
The general hesitated.
Yuan Yin became enraged:
"I'm putting you in a difficult position?! You're the ones making it hard for me! Do you know my predicament, yet you send archers here? Are you trying to have me killed too?"
Furious, he shouted:
"Fools! Withdraw the archers immediately!"
Not long ago, seeing the archers suddenly shoot at Ding Ling was enough to terrify Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao.
Had they followed even a little closer, they might have been struck by the random arrows.
They lacked Ding Ling's powerful martial arts!
Therefore, Yuan Yin's anger was genuine.
"Can't withdraw.
A burly general with a full beard spoke loudly.
He dared not come forward but addressed from within the great army:
"The lord explicitly stated that Ding Ling and Zhao Yun's crimes are unforgivable and they must not be spared!"
"Foolish!"
Yuan Yin was livid, his face turned black as he glared deeply at the distant general.
He suspected that these two generals were there to sabotage him!
Otherwise, how could they speak such words in front of everyone?
But sabotaging him was not crucial.
Yuan Shu's own son, his only son, was among them; he really dared to disregard his son's safety and order harsh measures in public?
"Return. Mount up and continue the journey."
Ding Ling had discerned Yuan Shu's intent to kill him.
There must be tens of thousands of troops stationed here in Wan City.
To kill the two of them.
Such spectacle!
Obviously, Yuan Shu had advisors informing him, they must have known of his achievements, hence disregarding military expenses to encircle and kill.
As for how Yuan Shu's orders reached Wan City so quickly?
Sending messages by Pigeon Post is something Ding Ling could do, surely others could too.
"Understood."
Yuan Yin returned and mounted. He took the lead, followed by Ding Ling.
Yuan Yao followed next.
Yuan Yao was under the constant threat of Diao Chan's spear; any reckless move and Yuan Yao would be dead.
Yuan Yao's eyes locked onto the speaking generals, wishing to tear them limb from limb.
The generals felt a chill on their scalps, but they were speaking the truth, encouraging the soldiers' determination to encircle Ding Ling.
Otherwise, if one after another act cautiously, and tens of thousands of soldiers are deployed but Ding Ling held hostages and escaped, wouldn't it be a joke?
Thud thud!
Yuan Yin rode to the front of the formation, indicating the archers to leave!
No one moved.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, feeling Yuan Shu was truly ruthless.
This was clearly deploying his tactics to use "attrition warfare" and "human wave tactics" to exhaust and deplete him!
Earlier, he hadn't realized it.
Seeing this scene now.
He suddenly understood.
Although due to Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao's presence, they refrained from unleashing an arrow rain, secretly shooting cold arrows at him, dispatching batches of soldiers to besiege him was achievable!
If Ding Ling did not want to be killed by a rain of arrows, he wouldn't harm Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao!
Thus.
As long as they exhaust his and Zhao Yun's stamina, their side would swarm and attack, leaving them no chance of survival!

Among the hundred archers, only a few managed to flee in disarray, discarding their gear, while the rest couldn't escape and were completely slaughtered.
The scene was utterly gruesome.
Severed limbs were scattered everywhere.
Thud thud!
The Ferghana Horse snorted, its iron hooves stepping in the blood, producing dull thudding sounds.
Ding Ling swiftly looked at Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao, who arrived at the entrance.
The two shivered, forcing a flattering smile towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling's ferocity and brutality were beyond their imagination!
They were utterly terrified!
Thud thud!
Ding Ling rode to the gate and gestured for Yuan Yin to open it.
Yuan Yin dared not refuse, dismounted, and laboriously opened the door.
Only to see ranks of soldiers lined up, stretching seemingly endlessly, impossible to tell how many had arrived.
Every one of them held weapons.
The archers in the front row bent their bows and aimed directly at Yuan Yin.
Yuan Yin broke out in a cold sweat and yelled:
"Blind fools!
Don't you know who I am?"
'Sir.'
A general stepped out from the crowd and saluted Yuan Yin:
"We have orders from the lord that Ding Ling and Zhao Yun must be killed without mercy.
We have no choice."
"I don't care what Yuan Shu said; today you must retreat!"
Yuan Yin's face turned pale as he spoke sternly:
"Otherwise, who will guarantee my safety?"
"Sir, don't put us in a difficult position."
The general hesitated.
Yuan Yin became enraged:
"I'm putting you in a difficult position?!
You're the ones making it hard for me!
Do you know my predicament, yet you send archers here?
Are you trying to have me killed too?"
Furious, he shouted:
"Fools!
Withdraw the archers immediately!"
Not long ago, seeing the archers suddenly shoot at Ding Ling was enough to terrify Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao.
Had they followed even a little closer, they might have been struck by the random arrows.
They lacked Ding Ling's powerful martial arts!
Therefore, Yuan Yin's anger was genuine.
"Can't withdraw.
A burly general with a full beard spoke loudly.
He dared not come forward but addressed from within the great army:
"The lord explicitly stated that Ding Ling and Zhao Yun's crimes are unforgivable and they must not be spared!"
"Foolish!"
Yuan Yin was livid, his face turned black as he glared deeply at the distant general.
He suspected that these two generals were there to sabotage him!
Otherwise, how could they speak such words in front of everyone?
But sabotaging him was not crucial.
Yuan Shu's own son, his only son, was among them; he really dared to disregard his son's safety and order harsh measures in public?
"Return.
Mount up and continue the journey."
Ding Ling had discerned Yuan Shu's intent to kill him.
There must be tens of thousands of troops stationed here in Wan City.
To kill the two of them.
Such spectacle!
Obviously, Yuan Shu had advisors informing him, they must have known of his achievements, hence disregarding military expenses to encircle and kill.
As for how Yuan Shu's orders reached Wan City so quickly?
Sending messages by Pigeon Post is something Ding Ling could do, surely others could too.
"Understood."
Yuan Yin returned and mounted.
He took the lead, followed by Ding Ling.
Yuan Yao followed next.
Yuan Yao was under the constant threat of Diao Chan's spear; any reckless move and Yuan Yao would be dead.
Yuan Yao's eyes locked onto the speaking generals, wishing to tear them limb from limb.
The generals felt a chill on their scalps, but they were speaking the truth, encouraging the soldiers' determination to encircle Ding Ling.
Otherwise, if one after another act cautiously, and tens of thousands of soldiers are deployed but Ding Ling held hostages and escaped, wouldn't it be a joke?
Thud thud!
Yuan Yin rode to the front of the formation, indicating the archers to leave!
No one moved.
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, feeling Yuan Shu was truly ruthless.
This was clearly deploying his tactics to use "attrition warfare" and "human wave tactics" to exhaust and deplete him!
Earlier, he hadn't realized it.
Seeing this scene now.
He suddenly understood.
Although due to Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao's presence, they refrained from unleashing an arrow rain, secretly shooting cold arrows at him, dispatching batches of soldiers to besiege him was achievable!
If Ding Ling did not want to be killed by a rain of arrows, he wouldn't harm Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao!
Thus.
As long as they exhaust his and Zhao Yun's stamina, their side would swarm and attack, leaving them no chance of survival!

chapters.title: Chapter 149 149: Slaying the Fierce General Le Jiu with a Single Sword (4/12)
paragraphs: And Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao naturally were able to escape this situation.
No wonder Yuan Shu is a heartless tyrant, who tramples lives underfoot, wreaks havoc, and desires to become emperor!
To kill him.
He even used human wave tactics.
And blatantly, overtly at that! As if afraid Ding Ling wouldn't know.
Because even if Ding Ling knew, he couldn't do anything about it.
He could only choose to endure!
If it were before coming to the Yuan Mansion, Ding Ling might have thought it was a bit precarious.
But now his strength has increased dramatically.
Power and defense both reached the limits of the Breathing Technique!
Agility and physique have both improved!
In terms of stamina, endurance, and all other aspects, he has greatly enhanced!
Compared to before.
He is now stronger, more courageous, and more enduring!
Trying to exhaust him with human wave tactics is truly a delusion.
However, to be more efficient.
Ding Ling chose to hang the Heaven-piercing Halberd on the side of his horse's belly, holding the Giant Que Sword in his right hand, he charged out on horseback.
Clang!

The Human Emperor Swordsmanship unfolded, paired with the incredibly sharp and mountain-like Giant Que Sword, like a streak piercing through the void, with the galaxy falling into the mortal world, amidst the clang, with one sword strike.
Seven or eight archers in front of Yuan Yin were instantly swept away.
Boom!
Ding Ling, with immense strength, seems able to uproot mountains, waving the Giant Que Sword in his hand, akin to Xingtian dancing with spear and shield, Celestial God manipulating Heaven and Earth!
With the thundering sound of galloping horses, the Giant Que Sword is unstoppable! Dominating the human realm!
Like a speedboat cutting through waves;
More like a divine spirit moving through mountains!
Ding Ling swung the Giant Que, hacking left and right, sword shadows flashing continuously, wherever the sword shadows passed, heads flew into the sky!
The extremely sharp Giant Que Sword paired with the Human Emperor Swordsmanship is simply a lawnmower!
"So fierce!"
Many players originally wanted to come and try to block Ding Ling, to see if they could gain any benefits.
Or participate in the capture operation, to find out the secret of Ding Ling's rapid rise in power!
But at this moment, they knew they were too naive and fanciful.
"He's simply not like a human!"
"I finally believe the rumor that Lü Bu couldn't defeat him! I've seen Lü Bu strike with my own eyes, but not as fierce and unrivaled as this!"
"So terrifying. How does he train! In such a short time, he's already stood at the peak of the mortal world!"
All the players were shocked, admiring, envying, longing, and jealous as they looked at Ding Ling.
They desperately wanted to know the secret of Ding Ling's rapid ascent!
The players felt this way.
The native NPCs were even more stunned, shivering, and trembling!
Each one of them felt utmost fear!
Jii Ling, sitting in the central army commanding, saw this scene from afar and gasped, murmuring:
"How could there be such a brave person in this world?! It's unbelievable!"
He already regarded Ding Ling as very brave.
Otherwise, he wouldn't have gone to such lengths to mobilize troops to encircle Ding Ling and his partner.
But as soon as Ding Ling struck, it was earth-shattering! Heaven and Earth seemed to crumble!
These kinds of martial arts and killing techniques, Jii Ling admitted he couldn't match.
It was at this moment he fully believed what the players told him earlier.
"One man breaks a city!"
"One man chases down Wolf Cavalry!"
"One man nearly wipes out Thunder Cavalry!"
"It's all true!"
His eyes twitched, pupils dilated, unable to believe there would be such terrifying and powerful people in the world!
"Is this man a Martial God descended to the mortal realm?"
When he saw Ding Ling effortlessly split 'Xun Zheng', his own fierce general, with a single sword strike, he could no longer remain calm and composed:
"Go! Heavy Cavalry, go! Block him! Kill him!"
Xun Zheng was his deputy general.
He knew very well Xun Zheng's martial arts skills, able to exchange over a dozen rounds with him without any problem.
But Xun Zheng couldn't even withstand a single move from Ding Ling, directly getting struck off horseback, falling among the crowd, knocking over several soldiers, unconscious and life unknown.
This immense force!
Sword technique!
Jii Ling found it somewhat familiar but more so, shocking.
Under his loud reprimand.
Some infantry split to the sides, a heaving heavy cavalry galloped down the wide street, charging at Ding Ling.
The leading general was none other than a tall, eight-foot man, with a stern face, extremely intimidating.
He wielded a long blade, wearing heavy armor, riding a horse fully armored from head to toe!
"Le Jiu!"
Yuan Yin recognized at a glance that the leading general was one of the rare top generals in their great army!
His skills were not much inferior to Jii Ling.
Boom!
Le Jiu led the heavy cavalry, coldly gazing at Ding Ling, commanding the heavy cavalry to charge at Ding Ling!
Ding Ling charged ahead.
A long whistle!
He did not retreat but advanced, charging into the ranks of the heavy cavalry.
His Ferghana Horse was fast, before the heavy cavalry could display their might, he was already in.
This was not the wild.
Heavy cavalry wanted to truly show their might, obviously impossible.
And Ding Ling now wielded three thousand catties of immense force, paired with the heavy, incomparably sharp Giant Que Sword, indeed like a tiger with wings, unstoppable in courage!
With each casual strike, heavy cavalry were swung off horseback!
Not a single cavalry was Ding Ling's match in a single round!
Wherever Ding Ling went, like splitting seas and flows, at lightning speed, he reached Le Jiu, amidst Le Jiu's horrified screams, clang!
One sword strike cleaved Le Jiu's wielded blade.
Crack!
Due to excessive force, the Giant Que Sword actually cleaved Le Jiu's sword into pieces with one strike.
"Ancient Divine Weapon Giant Que Sword! How is it with you?!"
Le Jiu finally recognized the true face of the Giant Que Sword.
But he hadn't even managed to shout out before he saw the sword edge of the Giant Que Sword flash before his eyes.
In the next moment.
The world spun.
The scenery and warriors before his eyes constantly reversed.
He was dizzy and confused, suddenly seeing a headless body on a Ferghana Horse.
He felt the body looked familiar, until he saw the half-broken sword in the figure's hand.
He realized.
"That's me!"
Then a wave of incomparable pain surged straight into his mind.
As the sound of thumping resounded by his ears.
His head fell to the ground, bounced, and rolled under an iron horse's hooves, getting crushed to broken mud.
"I, one of the most valiant of the Le Family clan! Died before shining brightly?!"
"I should have followed Le Jin to join Cao Mengde."
Le Jiu vanished forever, filled with regret, unwillingness, pain, resentment, and remorse.
If he had another chance to choose again.
He definitely wouldn't have listened to Jii Ling and opposed Ding Ling.
At least not now.
If he went, he should have waited until Ding Ling exhausted his strength. What was the outcome?
He became a sacrificed pawn!
How could he be reconciled?!
"First-class expert?"
Ding Ling slightly turned his head.
Just now, he actually managed to kill a first-class fierce general with one sword?
Though this first-class fierce general's strength seemed slightly lacking, certainly he met the benchmarks in agility or physique.

chapters.title: Chapter 150 150: Even the Vanguard Breakthrough General Was Slain
paragraphs: Just because Ding Ling heard the notification sound.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You've subjugated Le Jiu.]

[Note: As a member of the Le Clan, Le Jiu is a slightly inferior first-class fierce general compared to Le Jin. Bold and courageous, with immense bravery and vigor! He yearns for accomplishments and honors deeply.
Yet, in the face of this moment, everything was shattered!
He deeply regrets clashing head-on with you!
He realizes he has completely overestimated the combat strength of the heavy cavalry and his own resilience! And greatly underestimated you!]
It was due to the notification sound.
That Ding Ling realized Le Jiu was a first-class fierce general!
He killed a first-class fierce general with one strike.

Ding Ling's spirit was invigorated, laughing heartily twice, as he wielded the Giant Que Sword, brandishing blossoms of sword flowers, showcasing the power of the Sunset Swordsmanship and Dawn Swordsmanship!
A series of floral patterns, the Setting Sun Diagram fell into the heavy cavalry formation.
Wherever the sword's edge passed.
Heads flew off, severed and launched into the air!
The Giant Que Sword paired with the swift, fierce Sword God Skill!
Simply an unrivaled weapon on the battlefield!
No one could withstand even a single move.
"Unbelievable!"
Sun Ce, observing secretly from behind, gasped, eyes wide with astonishment:
"Can a person become this powerful?!"
Ding Ling all the way here.
How many people has he killed?
No less than hundreds!
One man, one horse, one sword, one spear! Capable of shattering everything, cutting through Heaven and Earth!
Sun Ce watched with admiration, envy, shock, and couldn't help but feel his blood boil:
"A man should be like this!!"
He felt that he should strive to reach Ding Ling's level!
If one day he could also achieve Ding Ling's Martial Dao standard! That would be truly wonderful!
"Ding Ling..."
Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan's eyes lingering on Ding Ling's back, their hearts trembled intensely.
Ding Ling was far more reliable and brave than they had imagined!
"Go!"
Zhao Yun shouted from behind.
Du Qingcheng and Diao Chan snapped back to reality, urging Yuan Yao and Yuan Yin to closely follow Ding Ling.
Yuan Yin and Yuan Yao, scalp tingling and backs sweating, followed numbly, with trepidation.
Someone attempted to kill Diao Chan, but with a quick lift and stab, she killed the attacker.
Zhao Yun stayed behind to clear up, occasionally deflecting incoming arrows, while also riding to assist Du Qingcheng.
Diao Chan needed no assistance.
For she was also extremely brave, charging left and right, and for a moment, no one could stand against her.
The players watching from the shadows were astonished.
They were also shrewd people.
Realizing Ding Ling couldn't be stopped in a short time, they swiftly retreated to various hidden corners, ignoring the reprimands from Shangguan.
Because they knew that dying would be costly.
But as long as they're alive, anything is possible.
"Who is that female general with the mask? She's so strong!"
A player pointed at Diao Chan, utterly puzzled:
"How did Ding Ling manage to bring out two female generals with remarkable cultivation after visiting Yuan Mansion once! We, until now, haven't found a single male general, let alone female ones!"
They were immensely envious.

Because even though Diao Chan and Du Qingcheng wore face masks, their eyebrows were like distant mountains, eyes like waving autumn waters, with an elegant and graceful figure! Clearly, they possessed the beauty of peerless women!
How could they not feel jealous beyond words, itching to take Ding Ling's place!
Boom!
Rumble!
Ding Ling, with one person, one sword, one horse, seemed like a meteor shower crashing to earth, advancing with blood and iron, shaking the very ground!
He charged straight towards Jii Ling!
Anyone daring to block his path.
Was struck down or pierced dead on the spot!
Charging forward like the wind sweeping away the clouds, more like an arrow tearing through the sky.
Without any pause or hindrance.
Unbelievably smooth!
Even a first-class fierce general couldn't stop his sword!
Who in the world could withstand his second?
"Liang Gang!"
Jii Ling watched, his hair standing on end, raising his Three-Pointed Two-Blade and shouted:
"Lead the Sword Shield Soldiers forward!"
Liang Gang, also a brave and fierce general of Yuan Shu's faction.
Upon hearing this, he didn't argue.
Immediately leading two thousand Sword Shield Soldiers ahead, clanging!
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Under Liang Gang's command and formation.
A wall of shields formed by the sword shield soldiers blocked Ding Ling's path.
Ding Ling laughed heartily, exuding iron-blooded heroism!

He spurred his horse and charged to the shield wall, executing the Human Emperor Swordsmanship, swinging his sword down, and in an instant, a dozen beams of sword light surged like a flowing Sword River, crashing onto the shield wall with a thunderous roar.
A three-thousand-pound force combined with the indestructible Giant Que Sword!
With the grand and majestic Human Emperor Swordsmanship clearing the way!
Resembling the ancient Human Emperor stabilizing the sea or parting mountains, with a tremendous sound!
The shield formation in front was instantly overturned and scattered aside.
The Ferghana Horse neighed loudly, taking advantage of the momentum, pierced in, and trampled over a dozen Sword Shield Soldiers!
Clang!
Clang! Clang! Clang!
Entering the midst of the Sword Shield Soldiers, Ding Ling transformed into a Mountain God, cutting down soldiers one by one.
Screams echoed relentlessly.
Resonating across the universe.
Many soldiers began to fear at this moment!
People are naturally afraid of death!
Previously they thought with their numbers, they could definitely crush Ding Ling.
Thus, they were full of vigor, without fear.
But fighting until now.
Ding Ling remained awe-inspiringly mighty, full of energy, growing more spirited the more he fought. How could the soldiers not feel their hearts tremble and flutter?
Many Sword Shield Soldiers began to retreat, not daring to encircle Ding Ling!
Ding Ling capitalized on this, charging through this barrier, breaking into the second shield wall.
Following the same pattern!
Boom!
Crashed through the second shield wall.
Then the third.
Inside the fourth shield wall, Ding Ling saw the commander Liang Gang!
A tall, sturdy man with a resolute face, he seemed very composed and proper.
However, at this moment even his face was filled with shock.
Ding Ling charged forward, striking with a sword.
Clang!

Liang Gang, being a fierce general, seemed to have awaited this moment, did not retreat but advanced. With a roar, as if putting oneself in a deadly situation then surviving, completely disregarding life and death, the blade pointed directly at Ding Ling's heart!
Sharp blade glows burst forth!
Liang Gang's Breathing Technique and family Sword Technique were pushed to the extreme, at this moment as if breaking through limits, reaching the first-class fierce general realm he had longed for!
Saw his power surging, and the Sword Technique growing sharper, and with a slight tremor, a spinning lotus flower pattern flashed in the void.
"Sword Lotus! I've finally mastered it!"
Liang Gang felt a surge of joy.
However, the next moment.
Clang! Clang! Clang!
The Giant Que Sword, like a Cyan Dragon overturning rivers and seas, swiftly swept down, in an earth-shaking clangor!
The Giant Que Sword cut through Liang Gang's Sword Lotus, blade, and blade shaft with one strike!
It also severed his arm and neck along the way!
Thud!
Blood gushed like a spring.
The broken sword in Liang Gang's hand fell to the ground, producing a weak clattering sound.
Liang Gang's eyes widened like copper bells, his face filled with disbelief:
"The Sword Lotus, can't it even withstand a single sword?!"

How could they not feel jealous beyond words, itching to take Ding Ling's place!
Boom!
Rumble!
Ding Ling, with one person, one sword, one horse, seemed like a meteor shower crashing to earth, advancing with blood and iron, shaking the very ground!
He charged straight towards Jii Ling!
Anyone daring to block his path.
Was struck down or pierced dead on the spot!
Charging forward like the wind sweeping away the clouds, more like an arrow tearing through the sky.
Without any pause or hindrance.
Unbelievably smooth!
Even a first-class fierce general couldn't stop his sword!
Who in the world could withstand his second?
"Liang Gang!"
Jii Ling watched, his hair standing on end, raising his Three-Pointed Two-Blade and shouted:
"Lead the Sword Shield Soldiers forward!"
Liang Gang, also a brave and fierce general of Yuan Shu's faction.
Upon hearing this, he didn't argue.
Immediately leading two thousand Sword Shield Soldiers ahead, clanging!
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!
Under Liang Gang's command and formation.

A three-thousand-pound force combined with the indestructible Giant Que Sword!
With the grand and majestic Human Emperor Swordsmanship clearing the way!
Resembling the ancient Human Emperor stabilizing the sea or parting mountains, with a tremendous sound!
The shield formation in front was instantly overturned and scattered aside.
The Ferghana Horse neighed loudly, taking advantage of the momentum, pierced in, and trampled over a dozen Sword Shield Soldiers!
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!
Entering the midst of the Sword Shield Soldiers, Ding Ling transformed into a Mountain God, cutting down soldiers one by one.
Screams echoed relentlessly.
Resonating across the universe.
Many soldiers began to fear at this moment!
People are naturally afraid of death!
Previously they thought with their numbers, they could definitely crush Ding Ling.
Thus, they were full of vigor, without fear.
But fighting until now.
Ding Ling remained awe-inspiringly mighty, full of energy, growing more spirited the more he fought.
How could the soldiers not feel their hearts tremble and flutter?

Following the same pattern!
Boom!
Crashed through the second shield wall.
Then the third.

A tall, sturdy man with a resolute face, he seemed very composed and proper.
However, at this moment even his face was filled with shock.
Ding Ling charged forward, striking with a sword.
Clang!
Liang Gang, being a fierce general, seemed to have awaited this moment, did not retreat but advanced.
With a roar, as if putting oneself in a deadly situation then surviving, completely disregarding life and death, the blade pointed directly at Ding Ling's heart!
Sharp blade glows burst forth!
Liang Gang's Breathing Technique and family Sword Technique were pushed to the extreme, at this moment as if breaking through limits, reaching the first-class fierce general realm he had longed for!
Saw his power surging, and the Sword Technique growing sharper, and with a slight tremor, a spinning lotus flower pattern flashed in the void.
"Sword Lotus!
I've finally mastered it!"
Liang Gang felt a surge of joy.
However, the next moment.
Clang!
Clang!
Clang!

The Giant Que Sword cut through Liang Gang's Sword Lotus, blade, and blade shaft with one strike!
It also severed his arm and neck along the way!
Thud!
Blood gushed like a spring.

Liang Gang's eyes widened like copper bells, his face filled with disbelief:
"The Sword Lotus, can't it even withstand a single sword?!"
